games.name: Dino Odyssey
games.title: Dino Odyssey
games.description: Extinction is not an option!

games.name: Scramble Knights Online
games.title: Scramble Knights Online
games.description: Adventure with friends in this MMO-lite action RPG! Explore the shared online kingdom of Terracott as a knight-in-training. Team up to conquer dungeons, slay monsters, discover rare loot, and return home to forge powerful new gear before setting out on your next quest.

games.name: Forza Horizon 6
games.title: Forza Horizon 6
games.description: Discover the breathtaking landscapes of Japan in over 550 real-world cars and become a racing Legend in Forza Horizon's biggest open world driving adventure yet.

games.name: Halo: Campaign Evolved
games.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved
games.description: Halo: Campaign Evolved is a faithful yet modernized remake of Halo: Combat Evolved’s campaign, rebuilt from the ground up – now with HD visuals, refined controls, up to 4-player online co-op, 3 new missions, & an expanded arsenal of weapons, vehicles, & new enemies.

games.name: Forza Horizon 4 Standard Edition
games.title: Forza Horizon 4 Standard Edition
games.description: Dynamic seasons change everything at the world’s greatest automotive festival. Go it alone or team up with others to explore beautiful and historic Britain in a shared open world. Collect, modify and drive over 450 cars. Race, stunt, create and explore – choose your own path to become a Horizon Superstar. The Forza Horizon 4 Standard Edition digital bundle includes the full game of Forza Horizon 4 and the Formula Drift Car Pack.

games.name: METRO 2039
games.title: METRO 2039
games.description:
METRO 2039 is the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers, 4A Games. Journey into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.

Experience a powerful single-player story that weaves exploration, survival, combat and stealth across a hauntingly beautiful world.

games.name: Forza Horizon 5
games.title: Forza Horizon 5
games.description: Limitless driving fun in an ever-evolving open world.

games.name: State of Decay 3
games.title: State of Decay 3
games.description: Play as a community of survivors, build up your settlements with friends, and destroy zombies in State of Decay 3, the latest in the franchise from developer Undead Labs.

games.name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
games.title: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
games.description: On RuneScape's forgotten continent of Ashenfall, dragons have awoken. Gather, build, skill and craft in this co-operative survival adventure. Only by mastering survival and uncovering ancient secrets can you hope to face the ferocious Dragon Queen.

games.name: Fable
games.title: Fable
games.description:
Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed. 

Customize your Hero’s appearance, master style-weaving combat, and build relationships in a richly detailed open world brimming with eccentric villagers and twisted fairytale creatures. Want to settle down after slaying a troll? Go ahead: buy a cottage, flirt with the neighbors, and run the town shop. Or skip all that and chase chickens. Because why not?  

Every decision affects your story and the fate of Albion itself. Will you be a shining role model or the kind of Hero parents warn their children about? In Fable, the only certainty is that your tale will be unforgettable.

games.name: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION
games.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION
games.description: The final battle to decide the fate of the world has begun. Take to the skies, chart your course, and stand with your companions against Sephiroth one last time. A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

games.name: Minecraft Dungeons II
games.title: Minecraft Dungeons II
games.description: The next chapter of Minecraft Dungeons begins in the fall of 2026! A new threat stirs, ready to descend upon the land and its inhabitants to cause unspeakable mayhem. Become a hero and take on foes unlike anything you’ve faced before, journey through long‑forgotten locations, and clash with the forces of evil once more!

games.name: Gears of War: E-Day
games.title: Gears of War: E-Day
games.description: Experience the horror and brutality of Emergence Day. Join Marcus Fenix and Dominic Santiago as the Locust Horde erupts from below, igniting a desperate fight for survival.

games.name: Forza Motorsport 7 Standard Edition
games.title: Forza Motorsport 7 Standard Edition
games.description:
After September 15, 2021, Forza Motorsport 7 and its associated DLC will no longer be available for purchase in the Microsoft Store or offered on Xbox Game Pass. games.name: LEGO® Star Wars™: The Skywalker Saga
games.title: LEGO® Star Wars™: The Skywalker Saga
games.description:
Play through all nine Skywalker saga films in a game unlike any other.   With over 300 playable characters, over 100 vehicles, and 23 planets to explore, a galaxy far, far away has never been more fun! 

*Purchasers of the digital edition receive an exclusive classic Obi-Wan Kenobi playable character.

games.name: Dune: Awakening
games.title: Dune: Awakening
games.description: Dune: Awakening is a single- and multiplayer Open World Survival game with immersive adventure and RPG gameplay. Explore, build, craft, and unravel a cinematic Dune story as you rise from survival to greatness on the most legendary planet in the universe. Just remember: the sandworm always comes.

games.name: Forza Horizon 3
games.title: Forza Horizon 3
games.description:
THIS IS YOUR HORIZON
You’re in charge of the Horizon Festival. Customize everything, hire and fire your friends, and explore Australia in over 350 of the world’s greatest cars. Make your Horizon the ultimate celebration of cars, music, and freedom of the open road. How you get there is up to you.

games.name: KINGDOM HEARTS IV
games.title: KINGDOM HEARTS IV
games.description:
The latest addition to the KINGDOM HEARTS series.

Sora awakes in the world of Quadratum. As he looks for a way to return to his world, Donald and Goofy go to the Underworld to try to find him.

Wield the Keyblade in fast-paced battles that match to your own play style.

games.name: 007 First Light
games.title: 007 First Light
games.description: Earn the Number. 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Follow James Bond as a young, resourceful and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training program, and discover an origin story of the world’s most famous spy.

games.name: Resident Evil Village
games.title: Resident Evil Village
games.description: Experience survival horror like never before in the 8th major installment in the Resident Evil franchise - Resident Evil Village. With detailed graphics, intense first-person action and masterful storytelling, the terror has never felt more realistic.

games.name: Spyro™: A Realm Beyond
games.title: Spyro™: A Realm Beyond
games.description:
Wishlist now and get ready for Spyro™’s bold new adventure.

Take flight in a brand-new journey through a strange and wondrous realm.

games.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
games.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
games.description: Pursue your aviation career throughout the world with dynamically-generated missions ranging from Medevac and Search & Rescue to Aerial Firefighting and Passenger Transport. Compete against other pilots in the iconic Reno and Red Bull Air Races. Enhanced physics and aircraft systems and a groundbreaking flight planner create an unparalleled simulation experience. Explore the most detailed digital twin of the world to date with real-time air and ship traffic and a vast array of animals. Set out on your global adventure with our largest fleet of aircraft as Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 takes simulation to new heights of authenticity and realism.

games.name: Forza Horizon 3 Deluxe Edition
games.title: Forza Horizon 3 Deluxe Edition
games.description:
THIS IS YOUR HORIZON
You’re in charge of the Horizon Festival. Customize everything, hire and fire your friends, and explore Australia in over 350 of the world’s greatest cars. The Forza Horizon 3 Deluxe Edition includes the full game of Forza Horizon 3, VIP Membership and cars, and the Motorsport All-Stars Car Pack, which gives you the chance to take 10 of the hottest modern race cars off the track and out on the open road!

games.name: The Elder Scrolls Online
games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online
games.description: Every legend starts somewhere and in The Elder Scrolls Online, it starts with you. Join millions of players in an online, fantasy RPG set in a vast living Elder Scrolls world.

games.name: Middle-earth™: Shadow of War™
games.title: Middle-earth™: Shadow of War™
games.description: Experience an epic open-world brought to life by the award-winning Nemesis System.  Forge a new Ring of Power, conquer Fortresses in massive battles and dominate Mordor with your personal orc army in Middle-earth™: Shadow of War™.

games.name: Alien Deathstorm
games.title: Alien Deathstorm
games.description: Explore a devastated off-world colony that is ravaged by a cataclysmic mega-storm and overrun by bloodthirsty aliens in a desperate fight to survive.

games.title: Warhammer Survivors

games.title: Golf With Your Friends 2

Golf With Your Friends is back, and this time it means fore.

Up to 12 players, Chaos Mode, a new level editor, and enough questionable shots to end any friendship.

Celebrate 20 Years of Forza Motorsport in the 20th Anniversary Tour and obtain special rewards.

games.title: Hela: of Mice & Magic
games.description: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.

games.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020)

games.name: ILL
games.title: ILL
games.description: A realistic first-person action horror game that takes you into a dark fort overtaken by a mysterious entity. Unpredictable monsters, a visceral dismemberment system, and realistic physics create an atmosphere of relentless terror.

Digital download bonus:
- Social-Lord Outfit for Star-Lord (Early Unlock)

Fire up Star-Lord’s jet boots for a wild ride across the cosmos in this third-person action-adventure game, a fresh take on Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy. With the unpredictable Guardians at your side, blast your way from one explosive situation to another, with original and iconic Marvel characters caught in a struggle for the fate of the universe. You got this. Probably.

games.name: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
games.title: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn

games.name: Valor Mortis
games.title: Valor Mortis
games.description: Valor Mortis is a first-person action Souls-like from the creators of Ghostrunner. Rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army. Wield supernatural powers, battle horror monsters, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens all of humanity.

games.name: Police Simulator
games.title: Police Simulator

games.title: Little Nightmares III
games.description: Embark on a new adventure in the unique world of Little Nightmares. Face your childhood fears together with a friend in online co-op, or in solo with an AI companion.

Explore a dark fairy-tale landscape and befriend the charming characters who reside in the kingdom’s underbelly. Battle terrifying beasts and gain new abilities to expand your map. Solve puzzles, discover secrets, and unravel the mysteries that lie in this rotted kingdom.

games.name: There Are No Ghosts at the Grand
games.title: There Are No Ghosts at the Grand
games.description: Inherit a crumbling English hotel and restore it by day—battle ghosts by night. With a sardonic cat, a talking power tool, and a twisting supernatural plot, this is a musical mystery unlike any other. Can you hold it together while everything around you falls apart?

games.name: Arkheron
games.title: Arkheron
games.description: Fast-paced isometric team PVP looter where every item you find changes everything. Adapt your playstyle, build on the fly and fight your way up to the top of the Tower.

games.name: Forza Horizon 4 Expansions Bundle
games.title: Forza Horizon 4 Expansions Bundle
games.description: Get two game expansions at a reduced price! This bundle gives you access to the Fortune Island and LEGO® Speed Champions game expansions. This add-on requires Forza Horizon 4 (game sold separately).

games.name: Beer Manufacture Simulator
games.title: Beer Manufacture Simulator
games.description: Brew, Expand, and Build Your Beer Empire

games.name: Hasbro Games™ Junior Collection
games.title: Hasbro Games™ Junior Collection
games.description: Play Monopoly Jr., Clue Jr., and The Game of Life Jr. in one fun collection! Play solo or with up to 4 players locally, customize your avatar, unlock rewards, and enjoy fast, family-friendly excitement every round.

games.name: Katanaut
games.title: Katanaut
games.description: Katanaut is a fast-paced, Metroidvania-inspired action roguelite blending fluid combat and cosmic horror. Slash, dodge, and wield powerful abilities as you battle through a station sprawling with twisted, once-human horrors. Adapt, survive, and descend into the shadows to uncover dark secrets.

games.name: Crowsworn
games.title: Crowsworn
games.description: Explore a dark world inhabited by men and monsters in this action packed platformer. Lay waste to the monsters that stand in your way with a wide array of stylish combat maneuvers, as you attempt to unravel the truth behind the curse of Fearanndal.

games.name: Magicians: The Devil's Deal
games.title: Magicians: The Devil's Deal
games.description: Magicians: The Devil’s Deal is a narrative driven FPS where stage magic becomes real. You play as Jacob Menteuro, a fallen illusionist bound by a pact with The Devil and cast into Hell. Master deadly tricks, steal the powers of rival magicians, and escape the infernal world of Theatreland.

games.name: Holstin
games.title: Holstin
games.description: A psychological survival horror game set in an eerie, isolated 90’s Polish town consumed by an ominous presence. You’ve come looking for answers, but everyone seems possessed by something foul. Explore the festering town, interrogate locals and fight ungodly manifestations to get to the truth.

games.name: Stunt Paradise 2
games.title: Stunt Paradise 2
games.description: Stunt Paradise 2 - more speed, more explosions, more madness! Jump over ramps, dodge lasers, buzzsaws, and rockets while performing insane stunts. With new traps, improved graphics, and pure arcade chaos - get ready for the ultimate stunt challenge!

games.name: Chosen by Odin
games.title: Chosen by Odin
games.description: Hunt the cults of Ragnarök across epic Norse realms in this 1-3 player co-op action game. Wield Godly powers, roll dice to shape mighty builds with your friends, and escape as overwhelming hordes close in. Return to Valhalla, grow stronger, and rewrite the saga.

games.name: Super Lucky's Tale
games.title: Super Lucky's Tale
games.description: A delightful, playground platformer for all ages that follows Lucky, the ever-optimistic, energetic, and lovable hero, on his quest to find his inner strength and help his sister rescue the Book of Ages from Jinx.  Jinx is the scheming and mysterious villain trying to reshape the world, but for what reason?

games.name: Crackdown 3: Campaign
games.title: Crackdown 3: Campaign
games.description: Time to step up your boom to stop crime as a super-powered Agent in Crackdown 3’s sandbox of mayhem and destruction.

games.name: Don't Fret
games.title: Don't Fret
games.description: A sentient guitar trapped inside a nightmare music school. Hide, distract, and survive horrifying creatures as you tune your way through musical puzzles and fractured memories to uncover the truth.

games.name: NORSE: Oath of Blood
games.title: NORSE: Oath of Blood
games.description: A Turn-Based Tactics game set in Viking-Age Norway. Build a settlement, forge alliances, and fight strategic battles. Manage a community of craftspeople, farmers, and warriors, as you grow strong on your path to vengeance in this story-rich saga.

games.name: Bad Magpie
games.title: Bad Magpie
games.description: You are a magpie with one wing, a missing flock, and an unhealthy obsession with a fallen star. Steal shiny trinkets, cause chaos, and stick your beak where it doesn’t belong.

games.name: Fable Fortune
games.title: Fable Fortune
games.description:
A collectible card game that combines the iconic world and characters of the Fable series with fast-paced tactical gameplay.
Choose between Good and Evil to alter special abilities and even the cards in your deck.

Compete in leagues and events, or take on a boss with a friend in co-operative mode.
Whether new to card games or a veteran, it's time to return to Albion!
 
Fable® content and materials reproduced under licence from Microsoft Corporation Copyright 2017 Microsoft Corporation

games.name: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
games.title: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
games.description: The shadows are your ally. Return to the city as Garrett, master thief, in this remastered classic by Nightdive Studios. Pickpocket, prowl, and outsmart in a world where trust is a luxury and every stolen secret comes at a price.

games.name: Kingdom III: Rising Realms
games.title: Kingdom III: Rising Realms
games.description: Kingdom returns in an all-new micro-strategy and tower defense game set in a shattered realm. Embark on an atmospheric adventure across lands of legend to build a lasting legacy and challenge the empowered Greed threat.

games.name: The Eternal Life of Goldman
games.title: The Eternal Life of Goldman
games.description: In this breathtaking platformer adventure, explore a vast hand-drawn Archipelago, inspired by ancient fables and depicted in classic frame-by-frame animation, and defeat a mysterious Deity.

games.name: Forever Ago
games.title: Forever Ago
games.description: Following a tragic stroke of fate, Alfred embarks on a journey north in search of redemption in this single-player road trip adventure.

games.name: PBA Pro Bowling 2027
games.title: PBA Pro Bowling 2027
games.description: Dominate the lanes in PBA Pro Bowling 2027! Customize your bowler’s unique style and arsenal with in-depth ball mechanics and Perks. Forge your legacy in PBA Tour Mode and Online Leagues, and defend your title in Online Tournaments and Ranked Play. This is where champions are made.

games.name: Rogue Fortune
games.title: Rogue Fortune
games.description: A fast-paced action roguelite where your treasure is your health bar. Gamble your gold for the power to survive a hostile temple that wants it back. Arrange geometric relics in your backpack to create unique, creative, devastating synergies.

games.name: NINJA GAIDEN 3: Razor's Edge
games.title: NINJA GAIDEN 3: Razor's Edge
games.description: High-speed ninja action that's as sharp as a razor's edge

games.name: NINJA GAIDEN Σ
games.title: NINJA GAIDEN Σ
games.description: Too amazing? What's wrong with that? After obtaining the "Dragon Sword", a legendary blade, master ninja Ryu Hayabusa cuts down the darkness!

games.name: Militsioner
games.title: Militsioner
games.description: Every move you make is being followed by a Colossal Policeman. Anger, flatter, disappoint, deceive or even romance him to escape in this kafkaesque immersive sim.

games.name: SiN Reloaded
games.title: SiN Reloaded
games.description: SiN: Reloaded is a completely remastered experience of the 1998 shooter. This diamond-in-the-rough, story-driven FPS features memorable characters, horrific enemies, and a devastating arsenal that pushed the Quake II Engine to its limits. Now with remastered graphics and overhauled control schemes.

games.name: DIRT 5 Amplified Edition
games.title: DIRT 5 Amplified Edition
games.description:
Game leverages Smart Delivery allowing access to both the Xbox One title and Xbox Series X title when available.

Let Loose in DIRT 5 -  the boldest off-road racing experience ever, with a star-studded Career, four-player split-screen, innovative online modes, livery editor and more. Blaze a trail on global tracks, covering gravel, ice, snow and sand, with cars ranging from rally icons to trucks, to GT heroes.

games.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival
games.title: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival
games.description: Fight walkers as Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon, Michonne, and unlockable Negan in a brutal arcade brawler set in the world of AMC’s The Walking Dead. Face ruthless enemies like the Saviors and overwhelming walker swarms as you unleash relentless combos, signature weapon attacks, and crushing finishers.

games.name: Laundering Simulator
games.title: Laundering Simulator
games.description: Laundering Simulator puts you in charge of a two-faced enterprise – a hidden counterfeiting workshop with a laundromat as its front! Help Eddie Wiser run this crazy show and deal with small-business management, a criminal underground, nosy authorities, and a rage-inducing grandmother!

games.name: The Séance of Blake Manor
games.title: The Séance of Blake Manor
games.description: The Séance of Blake Manor is a supernatural detective mystery, set in 1897 Ireland, where you investigate the disappearance of Evelyn Deane in a remote hotel full of secrets and other-worldly occurrences.

games.name: Werewolf: The Apocalypse – Rageborn
games.title: Werewolf: The Apocalypse – Rageborn
games.description: Set in the World of Darkness, Rageborn sees Taylor rise as a pack leader to become Gaia’s fiercest warrior. Master three forms of the Garou, explore the wilds of Alaska, and confront the Wyrm in this visceral action-adventure metroidvania.

games.name: Vivarium
games.title: Vivarium
games.description: Step into a summer that never ends in this life-sim adventure, featuring hand-illustrated art inspired by timeless anime classics.

games.name: Silver Pines
games.title: Silver Pines
games.description: Silver Pines is a survival horror metroidvania set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

games.name: NINJA GAIDEN Σ2
games.title: NINJA GAIDEN Σ2
games.description: Powered-up, high-speed ninja action that is even faster and more beautiful than before.

games.name: Gear.Club Unlimited 3
games.title: Gear.Club Unlimited 3
games.description: The Gear.Club series is back! Customize and set up your favourite cars to race at top speed along the roads of the French Mediterranean coast and Japan. Don't just win – show off your style!

games.name: Worms: Galactic Tactics
games.title: Worms: Galactic Tactics
games.description: Worms makes an explosive leap into tactical roguelike combat! Battle across destructible arenas, mod classic weapons and unleash devastating strategic combos as you fight for survival, riches and glory!

games.name: The Witch's Bakery
games.title: The Witch's Bakery
games.description: The Witch's Bakery is a cozy Adventure RPG about a joyful witch who opens her bakery in modern Paris. She has one special power: she can see into people's heart and heal emotions through magic!

games.name: The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem
games.title: The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem
games.description: The Cat in the Hat once said, “It’s fun to have fun.” Play with him and your favorite characters in 18 exciting minigames or chase him around the house. Whether you play solo or with friends, your house is about to be full of giggles, groans, and glorious mayhem.

games.name: Slain 2: The Beast Within
games.title: Slain 2: The Beast Within
games.description: A brutal gothic hack-and-slash where steel and savagery collide. As Prince Akran, wield the sentient blade Bathoryn, embrace your werewolf fury, and battle through a dying world against the forces of Vroll. The quest begins now.

games.name: The Relic: First Guardian
games.title: The Relic: First Guardian
games.description: A dark action RPG rooted in Korean mythology, with brutal, fast combat.

games.name: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage 30th Anniversary Edition
games.title: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage 30th Anniversary Edition
games.description: The pioneer 3D fighting series continues to evolve as Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage arrives on Xbox Series X|S.

games.name: Crackdown 3: Wrecking Zone
games.title: Crackdown 3: Wrecking Zone
games.description: Test your skills in the all-new “Wrecking Zone,” an explosive 5v5 multiplayer competition where destruction is your ultimate weapon against friends and rivals.

games.name: Remothered: Tormented Fathers Remastered
games.title: Remothered: Tormented Fathers Remastered
games.description: The first chapter of the modern old school survival horror saga, rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5. Same ruthless tension, sharper everything.

games.name: DOOM: The Dark Ages Digital Artbook and Soundtrack
games.title: DOOM: The Dark Ages Digital Artbook and Soundtrack
games.description: The Digital Artbook and Soundtrack are included with the DOOM: The Dark Ages Premium Edition and Premium Upgrade.

games.name: At Fate's End
games.title: At Fate's End
games.description: At Fate’s End is an action-adventure game where you fight the ones you love and your skill tree is your family tree. Explore a lush fantasy world, defeat the foul creatures of the realm, and face your estranged siblings in intense, emotional duels to decide your family’s fate.

games.name: SKINWALKER: First Blood
games.title: SKINWALKER: First Blood
games.description: Skinwalker is a hack n’ slash action platformer where you swear allegiance to a formidable beast to save your daughter from a terminal illness. Shapeshift into the creature’s monstrous form and wield untamed wrath in exchange for its freedom and the promise of a cure.

games.name: Remothered: Broken Porcelain Remastered
games.title: Remothered: Broken Porcelain Remastered
games.description: The second chapter of the iconic modern old school survival horror saga. Remastered in Unreal Engine 5 to deliver a dramatically improved experience, while keeping every mechanic, every scare, and every secret exactly as they were.

games.name: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined
games.title: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined
games.description: Unravel the mysteries of the past in DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined! Gather your companions and travel beyond the shores of your small kingdom to discover why it is the only remaining island in the world.

games.name: Rhythm Towers
games.title: Rhythm Towers
games.description: Use both brains and beats to defend your planet’s precious AlgoRhythm.

games.name: LumenTale: Memories of Trey
games.title: LumenTale: Memories of Trey
games.description: LumenTale: Memories of Trey is a captivating Monster Collector RPG set in a beautiful and enchanting world. Follow Trey as he embarks on an adventure to recover his missing memories and make new ones with the Animon.

games.name: Rockbeasts
games.title: Rockbeasts
games.description: Lead a band of misfits on a roller-coaster ride to stardom in the age of MTV, rock anthems, and bad haircuts. ROCKBEASTS is a story-driven, role-playing management game that puts you in the shoes of a manager of an up-and-coming rock band. Your job – take them to the top.

games.name: Shape of Dreams
games.title: Shape of Dreams
games.description: Shape of Dreams delivers fast-paced top-down roguelite action with chaotic projectile-filled battles, fluid combat, and high-stakes co-op. Play solo or in up to 4-player co-op mode as you dodge overwhelming attacks and unleash devastating builds.

games.name: Screenbound
games.title: Screenbound
games.description: Screenbound lets you discover a dual reality through the Qboy! Navigate challenging puzzles and battle through multiple levels in a blend of 2D and 3D platforming that creates the world’s first '5D' platformer.

games.name: Echo Weaver
games.title: Echo Weaver
games.description: Time is your greatest resource. Master a time loop Metroidvania where secrets are your only upgrades.  Explore what remains. Uncover the mystery. Perfect the loop.

games.name: Survivor Cells
games.title: Survivor Cells
games.description: In other survivor-likes, you run. Here, running is NOT an option! Defend your cell against relentless swarms of viruses and bacteria in this tactical bullet hell that blends roguelite and tower defense. Create insane builds of medicines and nanotechnology to survive!

games.name: Raji: Kaliyuga
games.title: Raji: Kaliyuga
games.description: Six years after the war, warrior Raji and dreamwalker Darsh face Mahabalasura, who unleashes Kaliyuga, an age where every choice can unmake the universe.

games.name: Kalanoro
games.title: Kalanoro
games.description: Start a band with crazy lemurs and save your island from an evil witch in Kalanoro, an ode to Madagascar’s folklore and vibrant artistic scene! Hop on an action-adventure journey to discover the world of Lemuria, rescue lemur artists, and defeat the witch Raneny.

games.name: BRAVELY DEFAULT FLYING FAIRY HD Remaster
games.title: BRAVELY DEFAULT FLYING FAIRY HD Remaster
games.description: BRAVELY DEFAULT returns in HD! Relive the tale of the warriors of light. Enjoy strategic battles and over 20 different jobs. Plus modern gameplay enhancements and all-new minigames. The story of light and shadow that never fades is reborn.

games.name: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World
games.title: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World
games.description:
In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle.

Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

games.name: Lofsöng
games.title: Lofsöng
games.description: Explore, listen, and unravel a hidden language buried in stone and sound. An exploration puzzle adventure set across vast brutalist landscapes shaped by deep time ages.

games.name: Mark of the Deep
games.title: Mark of the Deep
games.description: Mark of the Deep is an epic pirate adventure with a strong narrative and a thrilling mix of elements from acclaimed Metroidvania and Souls-Like games. Embark on this journey as the pirate Rookie, explore the mysteries of a cursed island and find your missing pirate crew!

games.name: Carrier Command 2
games.title: Carrier Command 2
games.description: Take control of a naval carrier at the heart of a futuristic war in a tactical sim that blends real-time strategy with first-person piloting in a complete command-to-cockpit experience. Gather intel, plan attacks, then deploy and pilot military vehicles as you conquer territory and secure resources.

games.name: Outbreak: Shades of Horror Furry Convention Collection
games.title: Outbreak: Shades of Horror Furry Convention Collection
games.description: Enjoy that warm and fuzzy feeling— literally!  This bundle includes new content that is also available for purchase separately.  This bundle is only available for a limited time.

games.name: Neon Abyss 2
games.title: Neon Abyss 2
games.description: Take the plunge into the chaotic cybermyth, roguelike world of Neon Abyss 2! With immense variety of combat styles and limitless item synergies, every run delivers a dramatic and action-packed experience you won't forget.

games.name: South of Midnight - Digital Extras
games.title: South of Midnight - Digital Extras
games.description:
Immerse yourself into the macabre and fantastical world of South of Midnight with digital Artbook, Soundtrack, Comic book, Music video and Documentary (Director's cut).

This is additional content for South of Midnight and does not include the base game.

games.name: DIMENSIONS 2
games.title: DIMENSIONS 2
games.description: Sequel and definitive collection: DIMENSIONS 2 includes remastered versions and brings the experimental saga of the Dimensions to its conclusion.

games.name: Delphinium
games.title: Delphinium
games.description: A cozy narrative farming sim set in a hidden mountain village. Grow crops, cook, fish, and build heartfelt relationships as you struggle to find your place among a close-knit community.

games.name: Rivage
games.title: Rivage
games.description: Rivage is an immersive sci-fi puzzle adventure set aboard the A.R.E.S. space station trapped in a time loop. Wake up as Miranda, forced to explore, solve intricate puzzles to unravel the fate of your missing crew.

games.name: Beaten Path
games.title: Beaten Path
games.description: Beaten Path is a turn-based tactical RPG set in a world ruled by fallen gods and ancient machines. Take command of Panna and her companions as they unravel the secrets of time, confronting lost memories, mythic powers, and a looping fate.

games.name: Wax Museum: Hidden Objects
games.title: Wax Museum: Hidden Objects
games.description: Trapped inside a shadowy and mysterious, abandoned Wax Museum after a severe storm, you must piece together clues, solve brand-new puzzles, and uncover dark secrets to defeat an ancient Evil. Step inside!

games.name: Halo Wars 2
games.title: Halo Wars 2
games.description:
Real-time strategy makes an explosive return to the Halo universe in Halo Wars 2. Lead Spartans, Warthogs and other classic Halo fighting forces in a brutal war against a terrifying new enemy on the biggest Halo battlefield ever.

*Online multiplayer features require Game Pass Core membership (sold separately).

games.name: Greak 2: Alliance of the Storms
games.title: Greak 2: Alliance of the Storms
games.description: Greak 2 is a hand-drawn co-op metroidvania adventure. After fleeing their invaded world, siblings Greak and Adara find themselves in the hostile lands of Synoraz. Split in parallel dimensions, they must work together to save the last Storm egg before the ancient species is lost forever.

games.name: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle™: Digital Artbook
games.title: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle™: Digital Artbook
games.description: Immerse yourself in a world of adventure with the bonus digital artbook, included with the Premium Edition of Indiana Jones and the Great Circle™. This application allows players to view concept art of the game.

games.name: Fading Echo
games.title: Fading Echo
games.description: Unleash water, and trigger chain reactions in a fast-paced desert punk action-adventure. Shift and slide through the surreal realities of a reactive world that rewards creativity. Play as One, a young Legend on a quest to discover her past and secure her future.

games.name: Mirth Island
games.title: Mirth Island
games.description: Mirth Island is a cozy rhythm adventure game where you play as Dodo, a young duck, who returns home and teams up with his friends to rebuild the island’s legendary theater. Explore a vibrant island, interact with charming locals, and enjoy fun rhythm games.

games.name: DeadRoot
games.title: DeadRoot
games.description: DeadRoot is a barbaric medieval action-adventure set in a bug-sized world of underground dungeons and towering ruins. Splatter bug guts and slay colossal bosses as Kitt, a lone snail warrior, who must draw his sword against overwhelming odds.

games.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio Atlus 35th Digital Anniversary Edition
games.title: Metaphor: ReFantazio Atlus 35th Digital Anniversary Edition

games.name: Flamecraft
games.title: Flamecraft
games.description: Flamecraft is a 1-5 player cozy strategy game filled with magic. Become a Flamekeeper and help adorable dragon artisans find the perfect home. Enchant the town’s stores and fill them with dragon cards as you watch the whimsical shopping district come to life.

games.name: CALX
games.title: CALX
games.description: Flow across the WARP-corrupted planet Syro. Master movement as the Seeker. Double jump, dash, levitate and grapple through atmospheric ruins. Scan, solve puzzles, and engage in measured combat in waves of stillness and frenzy.

games.name: Hollow Home
games.title: Hollow Home
games.description: Hollow Home is a narrative survival RPG set in a city under occupation. Learn to adapt, choose who to trust and make decisions that carry real weight. No weapons, no battles and no easy answers.

games.name: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
games.title: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
games.description: The Road of Dust and Sorrow is a tense, story-driven pixel art horror inspired by ’90s classics. Survive a world gone wrong and protect what matters most: your daughter.

games.name: Wilderings: The Lost Spring
games.title: Wilderings: The Lost Spring
games.description: Master the wilds. Restore a broken world. In this creature-collecting roguelite, dynamic action meets open-world exploration. Befriend mystical Hântu to heal a corrupted land!

games.name: Brave Escape
games.title: Brave Escape
games.description: Embark on a thrilling co-op adventure in 'Brave Escape,' a challenging platformer demanding teamwork to conquer perilous traps and treacherous terrain.

games.name: The Outer Worlds 2 – Digital Artbook & Soundtrack
games.title: The Outer Worlds 2 – Digital Artbook & Soundtrack

games.name: Au Revoir
games.title: Au Revoir
games.description: Play as Tristan and solve puzzles to recover human consciousnesses in the year 2071. Investigate environments, uncover secrets, and make choices that affect the ending. Explore a neon-noir world with a low poly aesthetic inspired by the 90s.

games.name: MECHBORN
games.title: MECHBORN
games.description: Protect Earth and her colonies in a roguelike deckbuilder inspired by ’90s mech anime and Greek mythology. In MECHBORN - YOUR MECH IS YOUR DECK - Unlock mech parts and pilots, craft custom decks and unleash devastating combos as you fight to repel the Kaiju incursions!

games.name: Outbreak: Shades of Horror Founders Edition
games.title: Outbreak: Shades of Horror Founders Edition
games.description: Online co-op survival horror returns in this early 2000s-inspired, undead apocalyptic nightmare. This founders edition is a limited time offering containing the core game, standalone prequel, and starter DLC packs.

games.name: A Heavy Morning
games.title: A Heavy Morning
games.description: A psychological narrative adventure where every small decision shapes reality and the path through one heavy morning.

games.name: Blades & Battles
games.title: Blades & Battles
games.description: Pick your hero, master devastating sword combos, and defeat epic armies solo or in local co-op.

games.name: Bobo and the Chest of Nightmares
games.title: Bobo and the Chest of Nightmares
games.description: Bobo and the Chest of Nightmares is a Dark 3D Collectathon platformer that mixes fluid acrobatics, light combat, and secret-hunting inside a twisted carnival of dreams.

games.name: What Goes Up
games.title: What Goes Up
games.description: A chaotic co-op physics-building game where you stack, balance and jury rig gigantic junk towers to ridiculous heights for collection using the power of grav guns and friendship before the clock runs out.

games.name: Rover's Tale
games.title: Rover's Tale
games.description: A cosy, heart-warming, ecosystem driven metroidvania! Take control of a LAIKA Space Rover, capture and research alien creatures, complete quests for the other Rovers and forge a bond with your new Human friend, as you uncover the ancient mysteries of the planet Terra II!

games.name: The Orphaned House
games.title: The Orphaned House
games.description: Step into mystery in The Orphaned House. Explore its rooms, manipulate the environment to solve puzzles, and follow your intuition to uncover every hidden secret in this atmospheric adventure game.

games.name: FOUNTAINS
games.title: FOUNTAINS
games.description: Master high-skilled combat to uncover the secrets of this war-torn empire and escape your captors. Carve your way through a gritty souls-like RPG set in a sprawling, interconnected world.

games.name: MANIC MINER
games.title: MANIC MINER
games.description:
MANIC MINER was developed by Matthew Smith at the age of 17. When it was released for the Sinclair ZX Spectrum in August 1983, the game was considered revolutionary for its smooth animations, large sprites, and colorful levels.
 
Now, Manic Miner returns as a faithful revival, reimagined and rebuilt for a new generation while preserving the charm of the 1983 original.

games.name: Richman 10
games.title: Richman 10
games.description: "Richman10" is a classic chess game in which players earn money by luck (dicing) and strategy (buying land and buying cards) to defeat other players. Fine arts adopt pure 3D Q version of the original painting style. Game modes include: story mode, biography mode, multi-person hot seat mode!

games.name: Avowed Digital Artbook & Soundtrack
games.title: Avowed Digital Artbook & Soundtrack
games.description: This is additional content for Avowed, but does not include the base game.

games.name: Prismania
games.title: Prismania
games.description: Prismania is a surreal puzzle adventure game. After waking up in a strange triangle-shaped well full of strange mechanisms, you must solve prism puzzles to escape and figure out how you ended up there and what's going on.

games.name: Lost in Loss
games.title: Lost in Loss
games.description: Welcome to the strangest case of your career, detective: characters have forgotten who they are! In this cozy hidden object adventure, find items tied to memories and restore lost identities — uncover the truth behind the loss.

games.name: Corner Shop: NightShift
games.title: Corner Shop: NightShift
games.developer: Console Labs S.A / Live Motion Games
games.developerName: Console Labs S.A / Live Motion Games

games.name: Sea of Thieves Insider
games.title: Sea of Thieves Insider
games.description:
This version of the game is exclusive to members of the Sea of Thieves Insider Programme and will contain new features and fixes that haven’t yet been made available to everyone. Play, explore and let us know if you run into any issues or have any feedback through our official Insiders Forum.







Reminder: The Sea of Thieves Insider Programme is covered by a Non-Disclosure Agreement which prohibits discussion of the insider experience outside the official Insiders Forum.

games.name: Squishy's Leap
games.title: Squishy's Leap
games.description: Every landing is a victory in Squishy’s Leap. Soar through levels avoiding quirky frenemies and one very bitter ex-girlfriend. One wrong move and it’s game over—but one perfect leap could land you at #1 on the Global Leaderboard. Start leaping. Keep focused. Stay squishy!

games.name: ARK: Survival Evolved Explorer's Edition
games.title: ARK: Survival Evolved Explorer's Edition
games.description: Combining the base game with 3 massive Expansion Packs, ARK: Survival Evolved Explorer's Edition is the ultimate way to get even more dinosaur action! The Explorer's Edition gives you access to the mega hit ARK: Survival Evolved as well as the Scorched Earth, Aberration, and Extinction Expansion Packs, adding nearly 900 hours of gameplay!

games.name: Thunder Hoop Collection (QUByte Classics)

games.description: A Next-Generation RPG Set in the World of Dungeons & Dragons

games.name: ARK: Survival Evolved
games.title: ARK: Survival Evolved
games.description: Stranded naked, freezing & starving on a mysterious island, you must hunt, harvest, craft items, grow crops, & build shelters to survive. Use skill & cunning to kill, tame, breed, & ride the Dinosaurs & primeval creatures living on ARK. Team up with hundreds of players online or try to survive on your own in offline play.

games.name: Halo Infinite
games.title: Halo Infinite
games.description: From one of gaming's most iconic sagas, Halo is bigger than ever with a dynamic free to play multiplayer experience.

games.name: Invincible VS
games.title: Invincible VS
games.description: Invincible VS is a brutal superhero 3v3 tag fighting game set in the Invincible universe, where you can battle to the death as a team of fan-favorite characters in iconic locations.

games.name: KINGDOM HEARTS Collection [I～III]
games.title: KINGDOM HEARTS Collection [I～III]
games.description: Play KINGDOM HEARTS I–III together in one unforgettable collection.

games.name: Minecraft Dungeons II Deluxe Edition
games.title: Minecraft Dungeons II Deluxe Edition
games.description:
Level up with the Deluxe Edition, featuring the Soul cape, Blub pet, 4 hero skins, and DLC 1 & 2 available as released. 

Pre-order Minecraft Dungeons II today and get 2 additional hero skins, the Twisted cape, and the Twisted chicken pet!

games.name: Grounded
games.title: Grounded
games.description: The world is a vast, beautiful, and dangerous place – especially when you have been shrunken to the size of an ant. Can you thrive alongside the hordes of giant insects, fighting to survive the perils of the backyard?

games.name: Hell Let Loose
games.title: Hell Let Loose
games.description: Enlist in the ever-expanding Hell Let Loose experience, bringing you World War II on an epic scale. This first-person shooter demands teamwork, communication, and strategy, not only to win but to survive! With battles of 50v50 players that include infantry, tanks, artillery and a dynamically shifting front line – be ready for combat on a whole new scale.

games.name: No Man's Sky
games.title: No Man's Sky
games.description: No Man's Sky is a science fiction game about exploration and survival in an infinite procedurally generated universe.

games.name: FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH
games.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH
games.description: The Unknown Journey Continues... After escaping the city of Midgar, Cloud and his friends set out on a journey across the planet. New adventures await in a vibrant, expansive world in this standalone entry of the FFVII remake trilogy.

games.name: Hogwarts Legacy
games.title: Hogwarts Legacy
games.description: Hogwarts Legacy is an immersive, open-world action RPG. Now you can take control of the action and be at the center of your own adventure in the wizarding world.

games.name: Gears of War: Reloaded
games.title: Gears of War: Reloaded
games.description: The iconic original, faithfully remastered.

games.name: DayZ
games.title: DayZ
games.description: The post-soviet country of Chernarus is struck by an unknown virus, turning the majority population into frenzied infected. Fighting over resources has bred a hostile mentality among survivors, driving what’s left of humanity to collapse. You are one of the few immune to the virus - how far will you go to survive?

games.name: Who's Your Daddy?!
games.title: Who's Your Daddy?!
games.description: Who's Your Daddy?! is a casual multiplayer game featuring a clueless father attempting to prevent his infant son from certain death. Test your parenting skills in a competitive setup with wacky physics and over 67 potentially ominous household items.

games.name: Fable Standard Edition
games.title: Fable Standard Edition
games.description: Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world Action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed. Fable Premium Edition includes the full game with Early Access, letting you play up to 5 days before launch, and Premium Edition Content Pack (featuring Splendid Armour, Bastard Armour, and in-game gifts), Fable Digital Artbook & Soundtrack, and the Fable: Order of the Hero expansion coming post-launch.

games.name: Wuthering Waves
games.title: Wuthering Waves
games.description: Wuthering Waves is a story-rich open-world action RPG with a high degree of freedom. You wake from your slumber as Rover, joined by a vibrant cast of Resonators on a journey to reclaim your lost memories and change the world.

games.name: Buckshot Roulette
games.title: Buckshot Roulette
games.description: Play Russian roulette with a 12-gauge shotgun. Four enter. One leaves. Roll the dice with your life. Good luck!

games.name: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy
games.title: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy
games.description: Fire up a wild ride across the cosmos with a fresh take on Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy. In this action-adventure game, you are Star-Lord leading the unpredictable Guardians from one explosion of chaos to the next. You got this. Probably.

games.name: Jurassic World Evolution 3
games.title: Jurassic World Evolution 3
games.description: Build your own Jurassic World like never before. Nurture generations of awe-inspiring dinosaurs with the series debut of juveniles, create and manage sprawling prehistoric parks around the globe, and let your imagination roar with powerful new creative options.

games.name: Zenless Zone Zero
games.title: Zenless Zone Zero
games.description: Venture into a post-apocalyptic world, explore perilous Hollows, and unveil the mysteries behind the last beacon of hope for human civilization.

games.name: 3on3 FreeStyle
games.title: 3on3 FreeStyle
games.description:
3on3 FreeStyle!
Welcome to the world of 3on3 FreeStyle street basketball.

Choose from 57 unique characters, each with their own signature skills, and lead your team to victory in intense 3v3 matches.
Experience fast-paced, stylish street basketball action.

Master each character’s skills and strategic team play to dominate the court.

Enjoy both single-player and multiplayer modes:
Grow your character in My Career (PVE) or compete in real-time 3v3 matches.

Play solo or together—create your own style and become the best.

Probability Item Info: http://3on3.fsgames.com/newNews/drawRate/5583/view

games.name: Hell is Us
games.title: Hell is Us
games.description: If war is the closest we get to hell on earth, it's because Earth harbours the worst of demons: humankind. In an isolated country ravaged by infighting, discover the secrets of your past and deal with the repercussions of a mysterious calamity.

games.name: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu
games.title: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu
games.description: In up to four player co-op, form a group of explorers searching for treasure. In this cursed jungle, danger is everywhere and monstrous creatures alter reality. Stay clear-headed and tame the jungle before it devours you…

games.name: REANIMAL: Friend's Pass
games.title: REANIMAL: Friend's Pass
games.description: Download Friend’s Pass to play REANIMAL with your bestie FOR FREE! As long as one of you owns the full game, you can share the scare together in both Online AND Couch Co-op! So grab someone you love, turn the lights down low, and go through hell together!

games.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 - Standard Edition
games.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 - Standard Edition
games.description: Pursue your aviation career throughout the world with dynamically-generated missions ranging from Medevac and Search & Rescue to Aerial Firefighting and Passenger Transport. Compete against other pilots in the iconic Reno and Red Bull Air Races. Enhanced physics and aircraft systems and a groundbreaking flight planner create an unparalleled simulation experience. Explore the most detailed digital twin of the world to date with real-time air and ship traffic and a vast array of animals. Set out on your global adventure with our largest fleet of aircraft as Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 takes simulation to new heights of authenticity and realism.

games.name: THE FINALS
games.title: THE FINALS
games.description: THE FINALS is the ultimate virtual combat game show, where you and your team fight for fame, riches, and the favor of generous seasonal sponsors. This free-to-play, team-based, first-person shooter pits contestants against each other in Virtual Arenas based on iconic real-world locations that can be altered and even destroyed.

games.name: Police Simulator: Patrol Officers
games.title: Police Simulator: Patrol Officers
games.description: POLICE SIMULATOR: PATROL OFFICERS offers a Simulation Mode for veteran players looking for the most authentic experience, as well as a Casual Mode for players who want a more relaxing patrol around the streets of Brighton.

games.name: Hogwarts Legacy: Digital Deluxe Edition
games.title: Hogwarts Legacy: Digital Deluxe Edition
games.description: Hogwarts Legacy is an immersive, open-world action RPG. Now you can take control of the action and be at the center of your own adventure in the wizarding world.

games.name: MOUSE: P.I. For Hire
games.title: MOUSE: P.I. For Hire
games.description: Join Private Investigator Jack Pepper on a guns blazing, jazz-fueled adventure in MOUSE: P.I. For Hire. The charm of hand-drawn rubber hose animation meets an explosive first-person shooter in this gritty tale of crime and corruption - with a cartoon twist.

games.name: Fable Premium Edition
games.title: Fable Premium Edition
games.description: Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world Action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed. Fable Premium Edition includes the full game with Early Access, letting you play up to 5 days before launch, and Premium Edition Content Pack (featuring Splendid Armour, Bastard Armour, and in-game gifts), Fable Digital Artbook & Soundtrack, and the Fable: Order of the Hero expansion coming post-launch.

games.name: Mortal Kombat 11 Ultimate
games.title: Mortal Kombat 11 Ultimate
games.description:
Includes MK11, Kombat Pack 1, Aftermath Expansion & Kombat Pack 2.

Take control of Earthrealm's protectors in 2 acclaimed, time-bending Story Campaigns as they race to stop Kronika from rewinding time & rebooting history. Features the komplete 37-fighter roster, incl. Rain, Mileena & Rambo.

games.name: REANIMAL
games.title: REANIMAL
games.description: The creators of Little Nightmares™ I & II have returned to take you on a darker, more terrifying journey than ever before. In this horror adventure game, a brother & sister go through hell to rescue their missing friends and escape the island that they used to call home.

games.name: State of Decay 2: Juggernaut Edition
games.title: State of Decay 2: Juggernaut Edition
games.description: State of Decay 2: Juggernaut Edition is an improved version of the popular zombie survival game and includes the all-new Homecoming Update – a fully remastered, open world version of Trumbull Valley for the core game, reintegrating the Mount Tanner and Fairfield regions to the map, and adding new sites to scavenge, along with new sights to behold.

games.name: PowerWash Simulator 2
games.title: PowerWash Simulator 2
games.description: PowerWash Simulator is back, bubbling with fresh locations, soap-erior equipment and splashy features. Effortlessly transform soiled surroundings into clean, serene scenes, solo or with pals. Satisfaction is a spray away!

games.name: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4 - Vault Edition Upgrade
games.title: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4 - Vault Edition Upgrade
games.description:
Upgrade to the Vault Edition and receive the following bonus content*:

- Hostile Alliance Operator Pack
- Special Forces Operator Pack
- Signature Weapon Collection
- BlackCell (1 Season)**
- DMZ Deployment Bonus

games.name: The First Descendant
games.title: The First Descendant
games.description: The First Descendant is a cross-platform (free-to-play) next-gen, third-person looter shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5.

games.name: Gears 5 Game of the Year Edition
games.title: Gears 5 Game of the Year Edition
games.description:
The complete Gears 5 experience in one bundle. Get the celebrated campaign, recharged multiplayer and Hivebusters campaign expansion as part of the Game of the Year Edition.  
 
Gears 5 Game of the Year Edition includes: 
•	Gears 5 base game 
•	Halo: Reach Character Pack  
•	30 days of Boost 
•	Gears 5: Hivebusters expansion

games.name: DOOM: The Dark Ages
games.title: DOOM: The Dark Ages
games.description: Developed by id Software, DOOM: The Dark Ages is the prequel to the critically acclaimed DOOM (2016) and DOOM Eternal that tells an epic cinematic story worthy of the DOOM Slayer’s legend. In this third installment of the modern DOOM series, players will step into the blood-stained boots of the DOOM Slayer, in this never-before-seen dark and sinister medieval war against Hell.

games.name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered
games.title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered
games.description: Explore Cyrodiil like never before with stunning new visuals and refined gameplay in The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion™ Remastered.

games.name: Fortnite OG
games.title: Fortnite OG
games.description:
FORTNITE OG is BACK and here to stay. Drop into Chapter 1 and explore the OG map, collect OG loot, and relive OG gameplay. 

Getting this add-on is not necessary to access this content.

games.name: Date Everything!
games.title: Date Everything!
games.description:
Find the object of your affection

Date Everything! is a sandbox dating simulator set in the comfort of your own home, featuring 100 fully voice acted datable characters! Let the romance flow between your bed, smoke alarm and… Overwhelming Sense of Existential Dread? Are you ready to Date Everything?

games.name: Disney Speedstorm
games.title: Disney Speedstorm
games.description: Drift into the ultimate hero-based combat racing game, set on high-speed circuits inspired by Disney and Pixar worlds. Master each character’s unique skills on the racetrack and claim victory in this thrilling arcade racing experience.

games.name: Undisputed
games.title: Undisputed
games.description: Become Undisputed and rule the ring in the most authentic boxing game to date! Featuring true to life visuals, bone-jarring action, and more licensed boxers than ever before, Undisputed gives you unprecedented control to master every inch of the ring.

games.name: Call of Duty®: Black Ops 7 - Vault Edition
games.title: Call of Duty®: Black Ops 7 - Vault Edition
games.description: In Call of Duty®: Black Ops 7, Treyarch and Raven Software are bringing players the biggest Black Ops ever across an innovative Co-Op Campaign, an electrifying Multiplayer experience, and the legendary Round-Based Zombies mode.

games.name: Mortal Shell: Enhanced Edition
games.title: Mortal Shell: Enhanced Edition
games.description: Mortal Shell is a deep action-RPG that tests your sanity and resilience in a shattered world. Your adversaries spare no mercy, with survival demanding superior awareness, precision, and instincts. Possess lost warriors, track down hidden sanctums of the devout, and face formidable foes.

games.name: The Planet Crafter
games.title: The Planet Crafter
games.description: A space survival open world terraforming crafting game, designed for 1 to 8 players. Alter the ecosystem of an inhospitable planet to render it habitable for humanity. Survive, gather resources, and build your base. Then, generate oxygen, warmth, and pressure to create a brand new biosphere.

games.name: Gears of War 4
games.title: Gears of War 4
games.description: A new saga begins for one of the most acclaimed video game franchises in history. Supports Xbox Play Anywhere: yours to play on both Xbox One and Windows 10 PC at no additional cost.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide
games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide
games.description:
Take back the city of Tertium from hordes of bloodthirsty foes in this intense and brutal action shooter. Warhammer 40,000: Darktide is the new co-op focused experience from the award-winning team behind the Vermintide series.

As Tertium falls, Rejects Will Rise.

games.name: Totally Accurate Battle Simulator
games.title: Totally Accurate Battle Simulator
games.description: Be the leader of wobblers from ancient lands, spooky places and fantasy worlds. Watch them fight in simulations made with the wobbliest physics system ever created, make your own wobblers in the unit creator and send your army off to fight your friends in multiplayer.

games.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley
games.title: Disney Dreamlight Valley
games.description: Explore a world filled with the magic of Disney as you discover rich stories and build the perfect neighborhood alongside Disney and Pixar heroes and villains in this new life-sim adventure game. Welcome to Disney Dreamlight Valley.

games.name: FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE Digital Deluxe Edition
games.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE Digital Deluxe Edition
games.description:
This product is the Digital Deluxe Edition of FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE. 
It contains the full game, as well as the FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE Digital Art Book and Digital Mini-Soundtrack.

games.name: Forza Horizon 6 Premium Edition
games.title: Forza Horizon 6 Premium Edition
games.description: Discover the breathtaking landscapes of Japan in over 550 real-world cars and become a racing Legend in Forza Horizon's biggest open world driving adventure yet. Forza Horizon 6 Premium Edition includes the full game, and VIP Membership, Welcome Pack, Time Attack Car Pack, and Car Pass (30 cars delivered to your game, one per week). You also get the Italian Passion Car Pack and two Premium Expansions when they are released.

games.name: Albion Online
games.title: Albion Online
games.description: Albion Online is a sandbox MMORPG in which you write your own story. Explore a vast open world, grow your wealth, forge alliances, and leave your mark on the world of Albion!

games.name: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II
games.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II
games.description: A thrilling story-driven action RPG set in a richly detailed open world of 15th-century Medieval Europe. Experience the ultimate medieval adventure through the eyes of young Henry as you embark on an epic journey.

games.name: SILENT HILL 2
games.title: SILENT HILL 2
games.description: "My name...is Maria," the woman smiles, just like my late wife.

games.name: Persona 5 Royal
games.title: Persona 5 Royal
games.description: Don the mask and join the Phantom Thieves of Hearts as they stage grand heists, infiltrate the minds of the corrupt, and make them change their ways!

games.name: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion
games.title: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion
games.description: A cosmic battle awaits! Choose between 15 Marvel Super Heroes in this frenetic action beat ‘em up to fight against the deadly Annihilation Wave threatening the galaxy. From New York City to the depths of the Negative Zone, the future of the Marvel Universe will be fought for across the stars!

games.name: METAL GEAR SOLID Δ: SNAKE EATER
games.title: METAL GEAR SOLID Δ: SNAKE EATER
games.description: A remake of the 2004 game METAL GEAR SOLID 3: SNAKE EATER, with the same gripping story and engrossing world, now with all new graphics and 3D audio that enhance the jungle atmosphere.

games.name: Gotham Knights
games.title: Gotham Knights
games.description: Batman is dead. It is now up to the Batman Family - Batgirl, Nightwing, Red Hood, and Robin - to protect Gotham City.

games.name: Resident Evil Village
games.title: Resident Evil Village
games.description: Experience survival horror like never before in the 8th major installment in the Resident Evil franchise - Resident Evil Village. With detailed graphics, intense first-person action and masterful storytelling, the terror has never felt more realistic.

games.name: Persona 3 Reload
games.title: Persona 3 Reload
games.description: Enter the Dark Hour and seal your fate.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Master Crafted Edition
games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Master Crafted Edition

games.name: Bellwright
games.title: Bellwright
games.description: Establish and expand your own settlements, liberate the land and assist its villagers, and recruit others to your cause while learning more about a life you had to leave behind. Command your forces, prove your valor, and cement yourself as the hero of your people.

games.name: Blindfire
games.title: Blindfire
games.description: Blindfire delivers unique FPS action in pitch-black arenas. Rely on sound and high-tech gadgets to develop your skills in new ways. Ideal for quick, high-tension matches with friends.

games.name: PAYDAY 3
games.title: PAYDAY 3
games.description: PAYDAY 3 is the ultimate FPS crime fantasy. Work alone or conspire in co-op mode, choose your approach between stealth and loud, build a deadly arsenal, and pull off the perfect heist.

games.name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Standard Edition
games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Standard Edition
games.description: Every legend starts somewhere and in The Elder Scrolls Online, it starts with you. Join millions of players in an online, fantasy RPG set in a vast living Elder Scrolls world.

games.name: Little Nightmares III - Free Trial & Friend's Pass
games.title: Little Nightmares III - Free Trial & Friend's Pass
games.description: With the Free Trial, play the beginning of the game for free in solo or with a friend, using online co-op on the same platform.

games.name: Monsters are Coming!
games.title: Monsters are Coming!
games.description: Beware, Monsters are Coming! In this Tower-Survivor rogue-lite, you protect an ever-moving city from unrelenting hordes. Gather resources, fortify defences, and boost potential through enhanced player progression. Will you reach the Ark?

games.name: High On Life 2
games.title: High On Life 2
games.description: An intergalactic conspiracy threatens the fate of humanity! Team up with a wide cast of talking alien guns as you shoot, stab, and skate your way through the exotic locales to take down the bad guys and save your favorite species (humans)!

games.name: Rocket Racing
games.title: Rocket Racing
games.description:
From the developers of Rocket League comes Rocket Racing, a supersonic arcade racer that lets you drift, fly, and boost with your friends through an ever-growing selection of tracks and modes.

Getting the bundle/add-on is not necessary to access this content.

games.name: Quake
games.title: Quake
games.description: Developed by the award-winning id Software, Quake® is the ground-breaking, original dark fantasy first-person shooter that inspires today’s retro-style FPS games. Now, experience the authentic, updated, and visually enhanced version of the original.

games.name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
games.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
games.description: Lead the members of Expedition 33 on their quest to destroy the Paintress - so she can never paint death again. Explore a world of wonders inspired by Belle Époque France and battle unique enemies in this turn-based RPG with real-time mechanics.

games.name: Cuphead
games.title: Cuphead
games.description: Cuphead is a classic run and gun action game heavily focused on boss battles. Inspired by cartoons of the 1930s, the visuals and audio are painstakingly created with the same techniques of the era, i.e. traditional hand drawn cel animation, watercolor backgrounds, and original jazz recordings.

games.name: World War Z
games.title: World War Z
games.description:
World War Z is a heart-pounding co-op third-person shooter for up to 4 players featuring massive swarms of hundreds of zombies and fast-paced gruesome action.

Battle swarms of hundreds of zombies in gruesomely spectacular firefights
Co-op story-driven campaigns
Fight other survivors in Player vs Player vs Zombies modes
Level 16 character classes and weapon upgrades to take on greater challenges

games.name: Roadside Research (Game Preview)
games.title: Roadside Research (Game Preview)
games.description: Roadside Research is a 1 to 4 player co-op gas station simulator. Except you’re aliens. And undercover. Do very human things like restocking shelves while preparing for the invasion. Just don’t get caught.

games.name: I'm in Love With Your Dead Grandmother
games.title: I'm in Love With Your Dead Grandmother
games.description: Hello, I'm Noah. I'm 28 years old and still haven't got a single date in my life, I'm looking for a life coach who can help me figure out the hard choices in my day to day life, you know? I'm sad and single, I have some friends online, but that's it.

games.name: Subnautica: Below Zero
games.title: Subnautica: Below Zero
games.description: Dive into a freezing underwater adventure on an alien planet. Below Zero is set two years after the original Subnautica. Return to Planet 4546B to uncover the truth behind a deadly cover-up. Survive the harsh conditions by building habitats, crafting tools, and diving deeper into the world of Subnautica.

games.name: Gallipoli
games.title: Gallipoli
games.description: Land on the beaches of Gallipoli and fight intense 50-player objective-based battles on the Ottoman Fronts! Experience WW1 trench warfare and desert expeditions as one of 10 historic classes, armed with authentic weaponry. Gallipoli brings the most immersive WW1 FPS battles yet.

games.name: Human Fall Flat
games.title: Human Fall Flat
games.description: ***NEW LEVELS STEAMPUNK PARTY + TEST CHAMBER AVAILABLE NOW***

games.name: Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord
games.title: Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord
games.description: The horns sound, the ravens gather. An empire is torn by civil war. Beyond its borders, new kingdoms rise. Gird on your sword, don your armour, summon your followers and ride forth to win glory on the battlefields of Calradia.

games.name: PowerWash Simulator
games.title: PowerWash Simulator
games.description:
Release the Pressure with PowerWash Simulator! Wash away your worries with the soothing sounds of high-pressure water. Fire up your power washer and blast away every speck of dirt and grime you can find. Build your own power-washing business and unlock new tools, upgrades and more – all with the simple satisfaction of power-washing to a sparkling finish. 
Relax, unwind in single player, or play with friends in Online Co-Op; either way, have good, clean fun. No dirt is too tough for your range of washers, nozzles, cleaners, and extensions. From casual, clean freaks to players looking to get into the nitty-gritty, everyone can pick up and play to feel immersed. Absorb the relaxing atmosphere and stress-free pace as you strip dirt from patios, pavements, vehicles, and public parks. Get creative and make art. Your nozzles are your brushes; the neighbourhood is your canvas. Sit back, relax, and wash your worries down the drain.
RELAXATION, SATISFACTION GUARANTEED.

games.name: Trailmakers
games.title: Trailmakers
games.description: Build the ultimate vehicle and explore a vast open world filled with challenges and adventure. Play solo or team up with friends in multiplayer to conquer the toughest obstacles. With a thrilling campaign mode and endless creative possibilities, Trailmakers is the ultimate sandbox for builders and adventurers alike.

games.name: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam Deluxe Edition
games.title: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam Deluxe Edition
games.description: Step into the explosive fury of war with Hell Let Loose – Vietnam. Play a decisive role in one of the most iconic conflicts in history with expansive 50v50 player battles, where teamwork, tactics and an arsenal of destructive weapons combine to shape the battlefield in your favour.

games.name: FINAL FANTASY XVI COMPLETE EDITION
games.title: FINAL FANTASY XVI COMPLETE EDITION
games.description: FINAL FANTASY XVI Complete Edition includes the base game, the first DLC Echoes of the Fallen and the second DLC The Rising Tide.

games.name: Descenders
games.title: Descenders
games.description: Descenders is extreme downhill freeriding for the modern era, with procedurally generated worlds, and where mistakes have real consequences. Will you lead your team to glory and become the next legendary Descender?

games.name: Mortal Kombat™ 1: Definitive Edition
games.title: Mortal Kombat™ 1: Definitive Edition
games.description: New to Mortal Kombat 1? Get started with the Definitive Edition for the most extensive Mortal Kombat 1 Experience! Includes access to Base Game, Story Expansion, Kombat Pack, Kombat Pack 2, Mortal Kombat and II Movie Skins, Dragon Krystals, and more!

games.name: World of Tanks: HEAT
games.title: World of Tanks: HEAT
games.description: World of Tanks: HEAT is a free-to-play PvP vehicle shooter with powerful hero abilities and explosive team combat. Pilot customizable tanks, unleash Agent skills, and take control in 10v10 online battles where tactical warfare meets FPS-style intensity.

games.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
games.title: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
games.description: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

games.name: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check
games.title: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check
games.description: Command the checkpoint in a collapsing city. Screen survivors, manage scarce resources, and hold back the undead. Every choice matters and one mistake could unleash the plague beyond your walls.

games.name: Baldur's Gate 3 - Digital Deluxe Edition
games.title: Baldur's Gate 3 - Digital Deluxe Edition
games.description: A Next-Generation RPG Set in the World of Dungeons & Dragons

games.name: Hollow Knight: Silksong
games.title: Hollow Knight: Silksong
games.description: Discover a vast, haunted kingdom in Hollow Knight: Silksong! Explore, fight and survive as you ascend to the peak of a land ruled by silk and song.

games.name: Hollow Knight: Voidheart Edition
games.title: Hollow Knight: Voidheart Edition
games.description: Descend into the world of Hollow Knight! The award winning action adventure of insects and heroes. Explore twisting caverns, ancient cities and deadly wastes. Battle tainted creatures and befriend bizarre bugs. Uncover ancient history and solve the mysteries buried at the kingdom's heart.

games.name: Hades II
games.title: Hades II
games.description: Battle beyond the Underworld using dark sorcery to take on the Titan of Time in this bewitching sequel to the award-winning rogue-like dungeon crawler.

games.name: Gotham Knights: Deluxe
games.title: Gotham Knights: Deluxe
games.description: The Gotham Knights Deluxe Edition includes the main game and Visionary Pack.

games.name: Forza Motorsport Standard Edition

games.description:
Bench Simulator is a narrative simulation game where you experience the world from the perspective of a park bench.

Across several in-game days, different people come to the park, sit on the bench, and leave behind pieces of their lives. Couples, strangers, lonely night visitors, suspicious characters, families, and emotionally troubled people all pass through the same quiet place. You cannot walk, speak, or directly control them — but your small reactions can influence what happens.

As the bench, you observe conversations, read emotional situations, and react through subtle interactions such as shaking, shifting, creaking, or staying completely still. A small movement at the right time may interrupt an argument, create an awkward silence, comfort someone, or change the direction of a conversation.

Bench Simulator is not about action or combat. It is about presence, memory, timing, and the quiet impact of being there.

Every visitor brings a different story. Some moments are funny,

Experience a highly social destination for up to 52 players where you can explore all the city has to offer!

Be the ultimate socialite and hang out in restaurants, house parties or rooftop clubs. Chat with friends or make new ones, activities in LEGO® Fortnite Brick Life are better together. Host a band practice down the beach, grab a bite to eat with others or race through the streets on hover boards.

Take on a job, complete tasks to earn some spending money and start living the life in Brick Bay with vehicles, housing and more. Customize your home with furnishings from the local store or invite your friends over to hang out.

Getting this add-on is not necessary to access this content.

games.name: Totally Reliable Delivery Service

games.description: Buckle up your back brace and fire up the delivery truck, it's time to deliver! Join up to three of your friends and haphazardly get the job done in an interactive sandbox world. Delivery attempted, that's a Totally Reliable Delivery Service guarantee!

games.title: The Jackbox Party Pack 11

games.name: PUCKOFF: RELOADED

games.name: The King is Watching
games.title: The King is Watching

games.name: Jurassic World Evolution 3: Deluxe Edition

games.name: Persona 3 Reload Digital Premium Edition
games.title: Persona 3 Reload Digital Premium Edition

games.name: Cup Heroes

games.name: Bounty Star

games.developerName: PlatinumGames Inc. / Team NINJA / KOEI TECMO GAMES CO., LTD.)

games.name: Sengoku Dynasty
games.title: Sengoku Dynasty
games.description: Sengoku Dynasty is the ultimate feudal Japan experience: build villages, grow your community, and shape the open world through combat or economy. Rise to power as a ruler or relax in hot springs. The choice is yours alone - or that of up to 4 players in multiplayer co-op!

games.name: NINJA GAIDEN 2 Black
games.title: NINJA GAIDEN 2 Black
games.description: The legendary high-speed ninja action game returns graphically remastered!

games.name: Forza Horizon 6 Deluxe Edition
games.title: Forza Horizon 6 Deluxe Edition
games.description: Discover the breathtaking landscapes of Japan in over 550 real-world cars and become a racing Legend in Forza Horizon's biggest open world driving adventure yet. Forza Horizon 6 Deluxe Edition includes the full game, Welcome Pack and Car Pass (30 cars delivered to your game, one per week).

games.name: Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii

games.name: Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl 2
games.title: Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl 2
games.description: Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl 2 lets you duke it out with the biggest and best fighting character roster yet! Choose your favorite brawlers, master their unique move sets, and use all-new powerful Supers to land the finishing blow with friends or across a unique, roguelike player campaign!

games.name: Train Sim World® 5: Standard Edition
games.title: Train Sim World® 5: Standard Edition
games.description: The Rails are Yours in Train Sim World 5! Take on new challenges and new roles as you master the tracks and trains of iconic cities across 3 new routes. Immerse yourself in the ultimate rail hobby and embark on your next journey.

games.name: Bag Fight
games.title: Bag Fight
games.description: Pack your bags! Adventure awaits!

games.name: Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse Midnight Edition
games.title: Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse Midnight Edition

Crimson Curse —Will Your Fate Bloom in Despair or Salvation
Set 23 years after Castlevania Dracula's Curse - follow Rose Belmont's journey in an all new 2D Action-Exploration title from KONAMI, Evil Empire and Motion Twin.

games.name: Just Cause 4: Reloaded
games.title: Just Cause 4: Reloaded
games.description:
Just Cause 4 Reloaded delivers an expansive and explosive gameplay experience in an all-new package! Just Cause 4 Reloaded includes additional premium content as well as all previously released improvements and additions to the game.

Just Cause 4 Reloaded includes:
- Just Cause 4
