- Black Hand Stealth Micro Jet
- Neon Racer Pack
- Deathstalker Scorpion Pack
- Renegade Pack

games.name: Monster Hunter Rise
games.title: Monster Hunter Rise
games.description: Rise to the challenge and join the hunt! In Monster Hunter Rise, the latest installment in the award-winning and top-selling Monster Hunter series, you’ll become a hunter, explore brand new maps and use a variety of weapons to take down fearsome monsters as part of an all-new storyline.

games.name: PGA TOUR 2K25 Legend Edition Year 2
games.title: PGA TOUR 2K25 Legend Edition Year 2
games.description:
Step onto golf’s biggest stages and prove you can rise among the greats. Compete in some of the ultimate tests: The PGA Championship, The U.S. Open, and The Open Championship.
 
 Feel greatness in the Legend Edition with Tiger’s own SUN DAY RED pack and build your MyPLAYER with the Pro Accelerator Pack with access to all 8 Seasons through the Members and Year 2 Members Passes.
 
 You didn’t show up for second place.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks
games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks
games.description: High-orktane combat racing in the Warhammer 40,000 universe! Drive buggies, tanks and helicopters, mastering advanced movement and explosive weaponry online or against bots. Unlock gear, customize your rides and use the Creation Workshop to create, share, and play custom maps from the community!

games.name: Age of Mythology: Retold
games.title: Age of Mythology: Retold
games.developer: World's Edge | Forgotten Empires | Tantalus Media | Virtuos | CaptureAge
games.description: From the creators of the award-winning Age of Empires franchise, Age of Mythology: Retold goes beyond history to a mythical age where gods, monsters, and humans collide.
games.developerName: World's Edge | Forgotten Empires | Tantalus Media | Virtuos | CaptureAge

games.name: Hidden Cats in Barcelona
games.title: Hidden Cats in Barcelona
games.description: Tour beautiful places and dance the Sardana with the hidden cats of Barcelona!

games.name: CONTROL Resonant Digital Deluxe Edition
games.title: CONTROL Resonant Digital Deluxe Edition
games.description: Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation in this thrilling action-adventure RPG. Unleash the extraordinary powers of Dylan Faden as he fights for his humanity and our survival against a reality-bending cosmic threat.

games.name: FINAL FANTASY I-VI Bundle
games.title: FINAL FANTASY I-VI Bundle
games.description: The games that inspired a generation come to life once more, in the ultimate 2D pixel remaster!

games.name: Zoo Tycoon: Ultimate Animal Collection
games.title: Zoo Tycoon: Ultimate Animal Collection
games.description: The wildly popular Zoo Tycoon series gets fully-remastered and set to crank up the excitement, challenge, and fun of building the ultimate zoo. Let your imagination run wild with "Zoo Tycoon: Ultimate Animal Collection"! Build, manage, and maintain your dream zoo alone or with up to four players on Xbox LIVE.  This zoo simulation will charm animal lovers of all ages.

games.name: Disneyland Adventures
games.title: Disneyland Adventures
games.description: Disneyland Adventures allows children and Disney fans of all ages to explore Disneyland park in 4K Ultra HD and HDR, enjoy immersive adventures based on 18 popular attractions, engage in 100 challenging quests, and interact with 35 beloved Disney characters.  Disneyland Adventures is your ticket to the magical world of Disneyland right in your living room.

games.name: DIRT 5
games.title: DIRT 5
games.description: Let Loose in DIRT 5 -  the boldest off-road racing experience ever, with a star-studded Career, four-player split-screen, innovative online modes, livery editor and more. Blaze a trail on global tracks, covering gravel, ice, snow and sand, with cars ranging from rally icons, to trucks, to GT heroes.

games.name: Fool's Pub
games.title: Fool's Pub
games.description: Play your best game to stay alive!

games.name: Superliminal
games.title: Superliminal
games.description: Perception is reality. Escape a mind-bending dream by solving impossible puzzles using your perspective.

games.name: Kiln
games.title: Kiln
games.description: An online multiplayer, pottery party brawler where teams of colorful spirits sculpt ceramic battle armor on a pottery wheel, and the size and shape of your pots determine your play-style and abilities

games.name: Visage
games.title: Visage
games.description: Visage is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore a mysterious ever-changing house in a slow-paced, atmospheric world that combines both uncannily comforting and horrifyingly realistic environments, and enjoy a genuinely terrifying experience.

games.name: Choo-Choo Charles
games.title: Choo-Choo Charles
games.description: Navigate an open-world island in an old train, upgrade it over time, and use it to fight an evil spider train named Charles.

games.name: DREDGE
games.title: DREDGE
games.description: DREDGE is a single-player fishing adventure with a sinister undercurrent. Sell your catch, upgrade your boat, and dredge the depths for long-buried secrets. Explore a mysterious archipelago and discover why some things are best left forgotten.

games.name: Creepy Shift: Roadside Diner
games.title: Creepy Shift: Roadside Diner
games.description: A broke young man takes on the night shift at a roadside diner. In the glow of the blood moon, routine tasks turn into a fight for survival. First-person horror based on a dark creepypasta with a set of rescue rules.

games.name: SILENT HILL 2 & SILENT HILL f Standard Dual Pack
games.title: SILENT HILL 2 & SILENT HILL f Standard Dual Pack

games.name: CULTIC
games.title: CULTIC
games.description: Death is only the beginning in this haunting, retro-style FPS, where creativity and brutality go hand-in-hand. Crawl from your grave and fight your way through the ranks of a twisted cult. Includes the original campaign, Interlude, Chapter Two expansion, all Survival maps, and the Cultmas bonus map.

games.name: FINAL FANTASY
games.title: FINAL FANTASY
games.description: The original FINAL FANTASY comes to life with completely new graphics and audio as a 2D pixel remaster!

games.name: Redfall

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 - 2-Year Anniversary Edition
games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 - 2-Year Anniversary Edition
games.description:
Warhammer: Space Marine 2’s 2-Year Anniversary Edition includes the base game, the Season Pass 1 and the Season Pass 2.
Unleash the superhuman skill and brutality of a Space Marine against the relentless Tyranid swarms in solo or multiplayer modes.

games.name: Hellblade II: Senua's Saga
games.title: Hellblade II: Senua's Saga
games.description: The sequel to the award winning Hellblade: Senua’s Sacrifice, Senua returns in a brutal journey of survival through the myth and torment of Viking Iceland. Intent on saving those who have fallen victim to the horrors of tyranny, Senua faces a battle of overcoming the darkness within and without.

games.name: The Lonesome Guild
games.title: The Lonesome Guild
games.description: The world of Etere was shattered after the discovery of a terrifying truth. Play as Ghost to gather the Champions and restore balance to a world in conflict in this action RPG that takes you on an epic journey to fulfil Etere’s destiny.

games.name: DEEEER Simulator: Your Average Everyday Deer Game
games.title: DEEEER Simulator: Your Average Everyday Deer Game
games.description: Become an average, everyday deer and stretch your neck out a bit.

games.name: The Oregon Trail
games.title: The Oregon Trail
games.description: A modern twist on the road to Oregon, this official game will immerse players in historical journeys. Pick your traveling party, stock the wagon with supplies, and embark on an adventure filled with tough choices, new dangers, and unexpected situations.

games.name: Ascend to ZERO
games.title: Ascend to ZERO
games.description: You control the power of time in Ascend to ZERO! Turn every second into a weapon and fight your way to the top in this action-roguelike!

games.name: Bassmaster® Fishing
games.title: Bassmaster® Fishing
games.description: Bassmaster Fishing , the official video game is OUT NOW, bringing the thrill of competitive big bass fishing to Xbox One & Xbox Series X|S. Dive into the fully licensed content from the Bassmaster series from amateur to elite events.

games.name: Life is Strange: Reunion
games.title: Life is Strange: Reunion
games.description:
Chloe Price was Max Caulfield’s partner in time… Losing her is Max’s greatest regret.
 
Now Chloe has come to Caledon University. Haunted by nightmares and impossible memories, Chloe needs Max’s help. 

But Max is already in crisis: in three days, a deadly inferno will destroy the campus. 

Max’s Rewind power has bought her time – but she can’t prevent the blaze alone.

The fire will force Max and Chloe to make devastating decisions. Can they find a future together… Before everything burns?

games.name: Tainted Grail: Conquest
games.title: Tainted Grail: Conquest
games.description: A unique, infinitely replayable, story-driven hybrid between a deck-building Roguelike and an RPG game. Explore the ever-changing maps, fight with deadly enemies, and learn what happened to the cursed island of Avalon.

games.name: MotoGP™26
games.title: MotoGP™26
games.description: Live the real MotoGP™ experience with all the thrills of the Official 2026 Season, renewed physics built around a new rider-based handling system, a more complete Career mode, dynamic Riders Ratings and much more.

games.name: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2 Deluxe Edition

games.description: This game is a work in progress. It may or may not change over time or release as a final product. Purchase only if you are comfortable with the current state of the unfinished game. EMPULSE is an upcoming fast-paced 6v6 movement shooter.

games.name: Barbie™ Horse Trails
games.title: Barbie™ Horse Trails
games.description: There’s plenty to unlock and discover in Canterbury Trails Park. Ride along as Barbie™, and Barbie with your horse, Lucky on this wild adventure.

games.name: RoboCop: Rogue City
games.title: RoboCop: Rogue City
games.description: Become the legendary part man, part machine, all cop hero and dish out justice in Old Detroit.

games.name: Wasteland Remastered
games.title: Wasteland Remastered
games.description: The RPG classic rises from the nuclear ashes! Wasteland Remastered is an overhaul of the 1988 title that brought the post-apocalypse to video games. Bring law to a lawless future or burn everything to the ground with full freedom of choice and consequence. See where the Wasteland series began and experience the character and world the sequels are built on.

games.name: 33 Immortals
games.title: 33 Immortals
games.description: 33 Immortals is a co-op action-roguelike for 33 players. Jump straight into runs, solo or with friends. Battle hordes of monsters, defeat massive bosses, and grow stronger each run. Use in-game emotes to coordinate and combine powers with your fellow rebels, and face the Wrath of God, together.

games.name: Rain World
games.title: Rain World
games.description: You are a nomadic slugcat, both predator and prey in a broken ecosystem. Grab your spear and brave the industrial wastes, hunting enough food to survive, but be wary— other, bigger creatures have the same plan... and slugcats look delicious.

games.name: Dune: Spice Wars
games.title: Dune: Spice Wars
games.description: A 4X real-time strategy game from the developers of the critically acclaimed Northgard. Set in Frank Herbert’s groundbreaking Dune universe, you must lead your faction and battle for control and dominance over the harsh desert planet of Arrakis.

games.name: Secret Neighbor
games.title: Secret Neighbor
games.description:
Secret Neighbor is a suspenseful Multiplayer Horror Game where a group of kids try to rescue their friend from the Neighbor's creepy basement. Only problem is one of the kids is the Neighbor in disguise.
All new graphics, Hello Neighbor 2 characters and much more in this update.

games.name: Frostpunk 2
games.title: Frostpunk 2
games.description: Develop, expand, and advance your city in a society survival game set 30 years after an apocalyptic blizzard ravaged Earth. In Frostpunk 2, you face not only the perils of never-ending winter, but also the powerful factions that watch your every step inside the Council Hall.

games.name: Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree
games.title: Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree
games.description: An epic action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Battle monsters, master six unique Classes, craft hundreds of useful items, and explore the secrets of an expansive, interconnected world.

games.name: Outer Wilds
games.title: Outer Wilds
games.description: Outer Wilds is an open world mystery about a solar system trapped in an endless time loop.

games.name: KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC)
games.title: KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC)
games.description: KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC) brings one chapter of the series to a close.

games.name: Another Crab's Treasure
games.title: Another Crab's Treasure

games.name: Sea of Stars: Sunset Edition
games.title: Sea of Stars: Sunset Edition
games.description: A journey of peril and wonder awaits in this classics-inspired turn-based RPG

games.name: Dome Keeper
games.title: Dome Keeper
games.description: Defend against waves of alien monsters in this unique roguelike action miner. Dig for resources, collect useful gadgets, and upgrade equipment to increase odds of survival – just hurry back before your dome is destroyed!

games.name: MOTORSLICE
games.title: MOTORSLICE
games.description:
Parkour through the ruins of a megastructure, climb massive bosses, and hunt down every construction equipment in this slice of life action-adventure with immaculate vibes.

Play as a girl named ‘P’, and use everything at her disposal to escape from deadly traps. Run, climb, slide, crouch, wall run, perform stunts, and even use your chainsaw to cross impossible distances.

games.name: The Thaumaturge
games.title: The Thaumaturge
games.description: The Thaumaturge is a character-driven RPG with a rich story, morally ambiguous choices, and turn-based combat. In a city on the brink of change, use your mystical powers to read emotions, uncover motives, and command folklore-inspired demons — while resisting the temptation of your own pride.

games.name: Rubber Bandits
games.title: Rubber Bandits
games.description: Not every heist goes as planned

games.name: Vampire Hunters
games.title: Vampire Hunters
games.description: To hunt vampires, you'll need guns. Lots of guns. Mow down hordes of undead creatures by stacking your guns into absurd, over-the-top builds. Unleash your firepower and survive the mayhem in this Roguelite Survivors FPS.

games.name: Persona 3 Portable
games.title: Persona 3 Portable
games.description: If I say there’s an hour “hidden” between one day and the next... would you believe me? Master the power of the heart, Persona, and uncover the tragic truth of the Dark Hour.

games.name: Easy Delivery Co.
games.title: Easy Delivery Co.
games.description: Easy Delivery Co. is a relaxing driving game with strange secrets. Chill out, make deliveries and get to know the mysterious residents of this scenic mountain town, all while earning well below minimum wage.

games.name: DOOM 3
games.title: DOOM 3
games.description: A demonic invasion has overwhelmed the Union Aerospace Corporation's Mars research facility. As one of only a few survivors, you must fight your way to hell and back against a horde of demons in this award-winning horror/action FPS and reimagining of the original DOOM.

games.name: Ultimate Sheep Raccoon
games.title: Ultimate Sheep Raccoon
games.description: Ultimate Sheep Raccoon is a bike-racing party game where you and your friends build the course together. Add obstacles and dangerous traps, take the lead with power-ups, and race to the finish!

games.name: Heretic + Hexen
games.title: Heretic + Hexen
games.description:
Step into the definitive re-release of two dark spell-casting shooters that shaped the genre. This enhanced restoration makes Heretic™ + Hexen™ available to new audiences and long-time fans with expanded accessibility across more platforms and languages than ever before.

Whether you're returning to these shadowy realms or discovering them for the first time, an epic legacy awaits.

games.name: Beatdown City Survivors
games.title: Beatdown City Survivors
games.description: Eradicate hordes of monsters in this survivors style roguelite set in a rotting, destructible city that hates you. Start fires, blow stuff up, electrify water, you name it. Upgrade & craft an arsenal of oddball weapons including pigeons riding boots. Unlock & upgrade offbeat characters & SURVIVE!

games.name: Coral Island
games.title: Coral Island
games.description: Coral Island is a vibrant, laid-back farm sim reimagined with multiplayer! Experience enchanting island life at your own pace: farm with friends, nurture animals, build relationships, hang out with a diverse cast of characters, and dive into the magical Merfolk Kingdom.

games.name: Still Wakes the Deep
games.title: Still Wakes the Deep
games.description: It’s Christmas 1975, and celebrations are cut short as disaster strikes an oil rig off the Scottish mainland. Traverse the rig to save your crew from an otherworldly horror, as you struggle to stay alive amid a scene on the edge of all logic and reality.

games.name: Wild West Legacy
games.title: Wild West Legacy
games.description: Conquer the Wild West. Explore the open world of a fictitious American Midwest and survive the harsh environment. Convince other settlers to join you and manage your ever-growing settlements. Build a home, take care of your farm and become a legend in Wild West Legacy.

games.name: Crashout Crew
games.title: Crashout Crew
games.description: Time to clock in at DE NILE SHIPPING, the world’s “most efficient” warehouse! Work together in online co-op with up to 4 players to fulfill orders of increasingly chaotic, physics-based boxes. Time is money, and safety is no concern… just try not to crash out!

games.name: Star Trucker
games.title: Star Trucker
games.description: Haul cargo, trade salvage and keep your space suit close as you search for fame and fortune among the stars in a game that puts an interstellar twist on the truck sim genre.

games.name: Black Jacket
games.title: Black Jacket
games.description: The Blackjack-inspired rogue-lite deck builder where you gamble your way out of hell. Stack broken cards, bend the rules, and unleash insane combos. Read your enemy, bribe the ferryman, and escape the afterlife.

games.name: FATE: Reawakened
games.title: FATE: Reawakened
games.description: Reawaken the critically acclaimed FATE games like never before! Play all 4 classic dungeon crawler titles with enhanced graphics as you battle through challenging procedurally generated dungeons, learn powerful spells, and fish to your heart’s content. Are you up to the task? Your FATE awaits!

games.name: DRAGON QUEST® XI S: Echoes of an Elusive Age™ - Definitive Edition
games.title: DRAGON QUEST® XI S: Echoes of an Elusive Age™ - Definitive Edition
games.description: The Definitive Edition includes the critically acclaimed DRAGON QUEST XI, plus additional scenarios, orchestral soundtrack, 2D mode and more! Whether you are a longtime fan or a new adventurer, this is the ultimate DQXI experience. You are the Luminary, a hunted Hero who must uncover the mystery of his fate with the aid of a charismatic band of adventurers.

games.name: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION
games.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION
games.description: The final battle to decide the fate of the world has begun. Take to the skies, chart your course, and stand with your companions against Sephiroth one last time. A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

games.name: Wildgate
games.title: Wildgate
games.description: Wildgate is a PvPvE multiplayer shooter that blends tactical ship-to-ship combat with fast-paced first-person action. Evade deadly environmental hazards, search for powerful weapons and ship upgrades, and be the first crew to escape with the Artifact... or the last crew left flying.

games.name: Hello Neighbor 2
games.title: Hello Neighbor 2

games.name: As Dusk Falls
games.title: As Dusk Falls
games.description: As Dusk Falls is an original interactive drama from INTERIOR/NIGHT that explores the entangled lives of two families across thirty years. Starting in 1998 with a robbery-gone-wrong in small town Arizona, the choices you make have a powerful impact on the characters’ lives in this uncompromising story of betrayal, sacrifice and resilience. Drive the lives and relationships of multiple characters in a decades-spanning story told across two intense books.

games.name: FBC: Firebreak
games.title: FBC: Firebreak
games.description: Purchase FBC: Firebreak and invite your friends to play the full game for free on any platform. FBC: Firebreak is a three-player cooperative first-person shooter set within a mysterious federal agency under assault by otherworldly forces.

games.name: CONSCRIPT
games.title: CONSCRIPT
games.description: During the First World War, a lone French soldier must navigate twisted trenches, scavenge for limited supplies and solve complex puzzles - all whilst fighting for survival in the midst of mankind’s most brutal and horrifying conflict. CONSCRIPT is a new take on classic survival horror.

games.name: Moss: The Forgotten Relic
games.title: Moss: The Forgotten Relic

games.name: Halo Wars 2: Complete Edition
games.title: Halo Wars 2: Complete Edition
games.description: Halo Wars 2: Complete Edition

games.name: Fuzion Frenzy®
games.title: Fuzion Frenzy®
games.description: Players: 1-4, Multiplayer Versus. GAME-PLAY ALERT: This game has been fully tested to successfully play on your Xbox 360 console. However, in some cases, you may see some minor irregularities with audio/video for brief periods. For more details, see www.xbox.com/xboxoriginals. Fuzion Frenzy® combines the continuous, frenetic action of a futuristic street sport with the action-packed fun of mini-games set in a dynamic 3-D urban environment. Six arenas and more than 45 mini-games provide plenty …

games.name: Egging On

games.title: Amnesia: The Bunker
games.description:

Face the oppressing terrors stalking the dark corridors. Search for and use the tools and weapons at your disposal, while keeping the lights on at all costs. Overcome fear, persevere, and make your way out alive.

games.name: John Fart : Text-iverse of Crazyness

Select your character, pass, kick and pave the way to victory!

games.name: KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue
games.title: KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue
games.description: Three key adventures unite, paving the way for KINGDOM HEARTS III.

games.name: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World
games.title: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World
games.description:
In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle.

Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

games.name: South of Midnight Weaver's Edition
games.title: South of Midnight Weaver's Edition
games.description: South of Midnight is a new action-adventure from Compulsion Games. Learn an ancient weaving power, explore the Deep South mythos and confront mysterious creatures in this folktale for modern times.

games.name: Ghostwire: Tokyo
games.title: Ghostwire: Tokyo
games.description: Tokyo's population has vanished, and deadly supernatural forces prowl the streets. Use an arsenal of elemental abilities to unravel the truth behind the disappearance and save Tokyo.

games.name: Tell Me Why
games.title: Tell Me Why
games.description: Twins Alyson and Tyler Ronan return to their small Alaskan town to sell their childhood home. As they sift through memories, ghostly images from their childhood cast doubt on what they remember about their mother's final days.

games.name: Airplane Flight Simulator : Combat Zone
games.title: Airplane Flight Simulator : Combat Zone
games.description: Do you like piloting legendary fighter jets? In Airplane Flight Simulator : Combat Zone, you have open-world maps to explore, with an amazing selection of realistic airplanes. Enjoy the fully immersive experience provided by awesome flight controls, realistic interiors, sound effects and challenging weather scenarios.

games.name: Overthrown
games.title: Overthrown
games.description: Lift and throw anything as you build and manage your kingdom in this chaotic city builder for 1-6 players. Harness the power of your soul-stealing crown to defend your citizens from bandits and mutants, farm the land, and gather resources.

games.name: RoboCop: Rogue City - Alex Murphy Edition
games.title: RoboCop: Rogue City - Alex Murphy Edition
games.description: Become the legendary part man, part machine, all cop hero and deliver justice in Old Detroit.

games.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 - Aviator Edition
games.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 - Aviator Edition
games.description: Pursue your aviation career throughout the world with dynamically-generated missions ranging from Medevac and Search & Rescue to Aerial Firefighting and Passenger Transport. Compete against other pilots in the iconic Reno and Red Bull Air Races. Enhanced physics and aircraft systems and a groundbreaking flight planner create an unparalleled simulation experience. Explore the most detailed digital twin of the world to date with real-time air and ship traffic and a vast array of animals. Set out on your global adventure with our largest fleet of aircraft as Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 takes simulation to new heights of authenticity and realism.

games.name: Eternal Strands
games.title: Eternal Strands
games.description: Fight epic, towering creatures while blending magical abilities with an arsenal of powerful weapons to keep the world from crumbling in this third-person, action-adventure game.

games.name: FINAL FANTASY V
games.title: FINAL FANTASY V
games.description: The original FINAL FANTASY V comes to life with completely new graphics and audio as a 2D pixel remaster!

games.name: Nice Day for Fishing - Epic Edition
games.title: Nice Day for Fishing - Epic Edition
games.description: The world needs you Adventurer! Battle fish, look epic, and save Azerim!

games.name: Syberia - The World Before
games.title: Syberia - The World Before
games.description: Embark on a journey across continents and through time, as you piece together the puzzle of a life.

games.name: Heart of Darkness Collection
games.title: Heart of Darkness Collection

games.description: The Heart of Darkness Collection is the ultimate Legacy of Kain experience, bringing together Defiance Remastered Deluxe Edition and Ascendance.

games.name: Rogue Waters
games.title: Rogue Waters

games.title: Moving Out 2

games.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 9
games.title: The Jackbox Party Pack 9
games.description: Save your next party with friends or family! Play five uproarious new games in one Party Pack: the trivia bluff-off Fibbage 4, the team sorting test Quixort, the magical joke auction Junktopia, the silly guessfest Nonsensory and the salacious reality TV game Roomerang.

games.name: Moonlighter
games.title: Moonlighter
games.description: Moonlighter is an Action RPG with rogue-lite elements that demonstrates two sides of the coin – revealing everyday routines of Will, an adventurous shopkeeper that secretly dreams of becoming a hero.

games.name: Winds of Arcana: Ruination
games.title: Winds of Arcana: Ruination
games.description: Discover the secrets of a sundered world as you help Aryn save his comrades in this story-rich, fully-voiced, 2.5D action-platformer. Fight terrible dangers and explore ancient mysteries as Aryn uncovers the forces that forge his destiny.

games.name: Puzzle Galaxy Xbox Edition
games.title: Puzzle Galaxy Xbox Edition
games.description: Unwind in a casual jigsaw puzzle game with a variety of themes, pleasing graphics and adorable effects.

games.name: ReCore
games.title: ReCore
games.description:
From legendary creator Keiji Inafune and the makers of Metroid Prime comes the “ReCore Definitive Edition”, an action-adventure masterfully crafted for a new generation.
 
As one of the last remaining humans, forge friendships with courageous robotic companions and lead them on an epic adventure through a mysterious dynamic world.
 
Includes the new “Eye of Obsidian” adventure and “T8-NK” Corebot frame!

games.name: Post Trauma
games.title: Post Trauma
games.description: Post Trauma is a modern-day survival horror, inspired by genre-defining classics. You awaken to find yourself in a twisted reality full of mind-bending puzzles, breathtaking tension, and unspeakable nightmares. Can you face your greatest fears and find your way home?

games.name: Monster Hunter Rise + Sunbreak Deluxe
games.title: Monster Hunter Rise + Sunbreak Deluxe
games.description: Experience Monster Hunter Rise and its massive expansion Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak in one convenient set featuring deluxe content for both games!

games.name: Seal: WHAT the FUN
games.title: Seal: WHAT the FUN
games.description: "Seal: WHAT the FUN" is an omniverse multiplayer party royale game that allows up to 10 players to enjoy a range of compact plays in 10 minutes. Players can customize their characters with variety of effects and features, making the game more interactive and unpredictable.

games.name: Blue Prince
games.title: Blue Prince
games.description: Welcome to Mt. Holly, where every dawn unveils a new mystery. Navigate through shifting corridors and ever-changing chambers in this genre-defying strategy puzzle adventure. But will your unpredictable path lead you to the rumored Room 46?

games.name: Murky Divers
games.title: Murky Divers
games.description: Solo or up to 8 players. Get rid of your employer's failed experiments in abandoned underwater labs. Navigate your submarine, avoid abyssal terrors, and remove all corpses.

games.name: BRAVELY DEFAULT FLYING FAIRY HD Remaster
games.title: BRAVELY DEFAULT FLYING FAIRY HD Remaster
games.description: BRAVELY DEFAULT returns in HD! Relive the tale of the warriors of light. Enjoy strategic battles and over 20 different jobs. Plus modern gameplay enhancements and all-new minigames. The story of light and shadow that never fades is reborn.

games.name: Eternal Card Game
games.title: Eternal Card Game
games.description: Join the battle in the new strategy card game of unlimited choices and fun.

games.name: INSIDE
games.title: INSIDE
games.description: Hunted and alone, a boy finds himself drawn into the center of a dark project.

games.name: Life is Strange: Double Exposure
games.title: Life is Strange: Double Exposure
games.description:
Max Caulfield, photographer-in-residence at the prestigious Caledon University, discovers her closest new friend, Safi, dead in the snow. 

Murdered.

To save her, Max tries to Rewind time – a power she’s not used in years… instead, Max opens the way to a parallel timeline where Safi is still alive, and still in danger!

Max realizes the killer will soon strike again – in both versions of reality.

With her new power to Shift between two timelines – can Max solve and prevent the same murder?

games.name: Forza Motorsport Premium Edition
games.title: Forza Motorsport Premium Edition
games.description: Race over 500 real-world cars including modern race cars and more than 100 cars new to Forza Motorsport. Make every lap count across 30 living tracks with multiple layouts to master and fan-favorite locations Fujimi Kaido, Nürburgring Nordschleife and Sunset Peninsula, each featuring live on-track scoring, fully dynamic time-of-day with weather and unique driving conditions that ensure no two laps ever look or play the same. Celebrate 20 Years of Forza Motorsport in the 20th Anniversary Tour and obtain special rewards.

games.name: Century: Age of Ashes
games.title: Century: Age of Ashes
games.description: Century: Age of Ashes is a free-to-play multiplayer dragon battle game. Master a growing roster of classes and dragons, compete in intense arena battles and rule the skies in fast-paced aerial combats.

games.name: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined
games.title: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined
games.description: Unravel the mysteries of the past in DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined! Gather your companions and travel beyond the shores of your small kingdom to discover why it is the only remaining island in the world.

games.name: Screamer
games.title: Screamer
games.description: High-octane action and anime aesthetics collide in this arcade racing game, featuring fighting mechanics and a storyline that hits hard. In this world, some race for glory while others seek power or revenge. Every race is a fight and every battle is personal.

games.name: Persona 5 Tactica
games.title: Persona 5 Tactica
games.description:
After a strange incident, the Phantom Thieves find themselves in grave danger until a mysterious revolutionary rescues them and offers a deal in exchange for their help. 
Assemble a team of beloved heroes in a brand-new story in this thrilling combat adventure set in Persona’s iconic universe!

games.name: Celeste
games.title: Celeste
games.description: Help Madeline survive her inner demons on her journey to the top of Celeste Mountain, in this super-tight platformer from the creators of TowerFall. Brave hundreds of hand-crafted challenges, uncover devious secrets, and piece together the mystery of the mountain.

games.name: Order 13
games.title: Order 13
games.description: Work fast, stay safe, and protect your cat

games.name: OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0
games.title: OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0

Embark on an adventure of your own creation.
The latest in the OCTOPATH TRAVELER series

games.name: Danganronpa V3: Killing Harmony Anniversary Edition
games.title: Danganronpa V3: Killing Harmony Anniversary Edition
games.description:
Danganronpa V3 is finally available on Xbox!

Welcome to a new world of Danganronpa, with an all-new "psycho-cool" environment and cast of characters! 
Survive through the revamped Class Trials with its myriad of new minigames!

games.name: Crimson Skies®: High Road to Revenge™

For more details, see www.xbox.com/xboxoriginals. Crimson Skies®: High Road to Revenge™ combines thrilling aerial combat with the swashbuckling style of a Holl…

games.name: Persona 3 Reload Digital Deluxe Edition
games.title: Persona 3 Reload Digital Deluxe Edition
games.description: Digital Deluxe Edition includes base game, digital artbook and soundtrack!

games.name: Star Fire: Eternal Cycle
games.title: Star Fire: Eternal Cycle
games.description: Star Fire is a love letter to classic arcade side-scrollers, reimagined with roguelite progression, modern action polish, and that “just one more run” itch. It’s fast, punchy, and all about no-pressure fun with tight combat, slick movement, and endless ways to cause chaos.

games.name: 9th Dawn Remake
games.title: 9th Dawn Remake
games.description: Rediscover the magic of the 9th Dawn series with this complete re-imagining of the original game. Venture into a massive 2.5D open world. Explore 45 new dungeons in single-player or online/local co-op, craft weapons, raise pets, play a deck-building card game, and take down the Castle of Maltyr!

games.name: Flint: Treasure of Oblivion
games.title: Flint: Treasure of Oblivion
games.description: Experience the golden age of piracy through a strong and original narrative, real-time exploration and turn-based tactical combat in Flint - Treasure of Oblivion.

games.name: Bubsy 4D
games.title: Bubsy 4D
games.description: The infamous, wise-cracking bobcat has returned to 3D in a new platforming adventure. Bubsy is back with new challenges, new moves, and even more purrsonality. Run, jump, glide, and roll across alien planets, battle robotic sheep, and collect tons and tons of yarn. What could possibly go wrong?

games.name: Captain Bones
games.title: Captain Bones
games.description: In a dangerous and exciting world, set sail as a pirate captain and build your legacy. Explore a vast open world, battle enemies, and discover hidden treasures.

games.name: Aragami 2
games.title: Aragami 2
games.description: Aragami 2 is a third person stealth game where you play as an assassin with the power to control the shadows. You are one of the last elite warriors of your kin, the Aragami. Victims of a supernatural affliction which corrodes the body and devours the mind, the Aragami control Shadow Essence - a mystical power which grants the ability to control the shadows. With this power the Aragami carry out their tasks and quests - assignments made all along the valley to ensure the subsistence of the village and to free the Aragami enslaved by the invader armies.

games.name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 – Deluxe Edition
games.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 – Deluxe Edition
games.description: Get the ultimate Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 experience with the Deluxe Edition!

games.name: Sniper Elite V2 Remastered
games.title: Sniper Elite V2 Remastered
games.description:
In the dark days of the end of World War 2 amidst the ruins of Berlin, one bullet can change history…

Remastered from the 2012 favourite, Sniper Elite V2 will see you parachuted into World War 2 Berlin amidst the Germans’ final stand. Stealth is key as you find yourself trapped between two desperate armies in a race against time. 

Includes all DLC, modernised graphics, photo mode and more!

games.name: Lightyear Frontier (Game Preview)
games.title: Lightyear Frontier (Game Preview)
games.description: In Lightyear Frontier you use your powerful trusty mech to farm on a large beautiful alien planet. Settle your homestead, farm and deliver produce to remote colonies, gather and manage resources, build, craft, explore, expand,  improve your mech, meet neighbors, and make a place to call your own.

games.name: FINAL FANTASY IV
games.title: FINAL FANTASY IV
games.description: The original FINAL FANTASY IV comes to life with completely new graphics and audio as a 2D pixel remaster!

games.name: Bus Simulator 27
games.title: Bus Simulator 27
games.description: Drive officially licensed buses from renowned manufacturers and manage your bus company to success. Felicia Bay’s public transportation system is counting on you!

games.name: Necrophosis: Full Consciousness
games.title: Necrophosis: Full Consciousness
games.description: A first-person horror adventure that plunges you into a nightmarish realm teeming with grotesque forms and ominous visuals. Delve into eerie landscapes, solve unnerving puzzles and uncover secrets in this atmospheric journey through the macabre.

games.name: MotoGP™24
games.title: MotoGP™24
games.description: Rev up your engines, MotoGP™24 is back! Dive into the heart-pounding action of the 2024 season and immerse yourself in the thrills of unexplored landscapes, all thanks to the revolutionary Riders market!

games.name: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales
games.title: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales
games.description: Hope is Timeless

games.name: Legacy of Kain: Ascendance
games.title: Legacy of Kain: Ascendance
games.description: Enter the dark world of Nosgoth – Ascendance is a fast paced, 2D action platformer built around fluid combat, vertical movement, vampiric powers, and skill-driven play.

games.name: HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™ 2 - Turbocharged
games.title: HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™ 2 - Turbocharged
games.description:
The world’s raddest cars are back and taking the fun to the next level! 
Race over 130 vehicles with crazy new mechanics and even more vehicle types. Plus, build your tracks with stunning new environments and different game modes to have fun off and online!

games.name: Grim Trials
games.title: Grim Trials
games.description: Prove your worth. Hack and blast your way through the Grim Trials. Explore the (after)life of the Academy – a training ground for aspiring Grim Reapers. Befriend fellow Reapers, learn from your mentors, and uncover the secrets of your life and love before your death.

games.name: Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch
games.title: Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch
games.description: When stranded on a cursed island, survival takes strategy as well as strength. Conquer intense turn-based battles, recruit allies, adapt to ever-shifting events, and grow stronger with every run. Will you prevail and uncover the truth lying between life and death?

games.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator Pre-Order Bonus
games.title: TCG Card Shop Simulator Pre-Order Bonus
games.description: Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

games.name: Forever Skies
games.title: Forever Skies
games.description: Forever Skies is a first-person post-apocalyptic survival game. Play it solo or in coop and return to Earth, ravaged by an ecological disaster. Build, fly, upgrade and customize your high-tech airship. Craft tools, and scavenge resources to survive. Face dangers on the surface and hunt for viruses to cure a mysterious illness.

games.name: Eyes: The Horror Game
games.title: Eyes: The Horror Game
games.description: You’re alone, and no one will save you... this was your choice.

games.name: What have you done, Father?

games.description: A 1940s narrative thriller. Play as a priest haunted by forbidden desires, dark secrets, and supernatural forces. Will you find redemption?

games.name: Towerborne

games.description: Towerborne is an exciting side-scrolling Action RPG Brawler. As an immortal warrior journey across a crumbling world, uncover the mystery of the fallen City of Numbers, and push back the corruption threatening humanity’s survival.

games.name: MULLET MADJACK
games.title: MULLET MADJACK
games.description: MULLET MADJACK is a HIGH-OCTANE-ACTION SHOOTER that put you directly inside a CLASSIC ANIME. Pick your favorite weapon and reach the last floor; Beat your best time or try again. Haste makes waste… OF YOUR ENEMIES!

games.name: Akatori
games.title: Akatori
games.description: Take on the role of a young battle monk and, together with her mysterious companion, experience the twists and turns of a story about inner strength, trials of fate, and a great mystery.

games.name: Darkest Dungeon II
games.title: Darkest Dungeon II
games.description: Darkest Dungeon II is a roguelike road trip of the damned. Form a party, equip your stagecoach, and set off across the decaying landscape on a last gasp quest to avert the apocalypse. The greatest dangers you face, however, may come from within...

games.name: SILENT HILL f - Deluxe Edition
games.title: SILENT HILL f - Deluxe Edition
games.description: Hinako's hometown is engulfed in fog, driving her to fight grotesque monsters and solve eerie puzzles. Uncover the disturbing beauty hidden in terror.

games.name: Train Sim World® 7: Standard Edition
games.title: Train Sim World® 7: Standard Edition
games.description: Find Your Way in Train Sim World 7! Embark on a thrilling journey as you master formidable trains across the Airedale & Wharfedale Network, Nürnberg - Würzburg and Florida’s Tri-Rail. Discover new ways to play with Freight Hauler, Live Weather and more. Enjoy your hobby in your own way.

games.name: Scorn
games.title: Scorn

games.name: HARDWIRED: Ghost In The Reset
games.title: HARDWIRED: Ghost In The Reset
games.description: An intense action shooter by a solo developer. Follow Kay, a cold combatant forced to survive alongside Icarus, a conscious robot. Unleash brutal firefights and unearth the secrets of Omnia. Can her heart survive?

games.name: Garten of Banban 2
games.title: Garten of Banban 2
games.description: Continue the eerie story of Banban's Kindergarten in Garten of Banban 2. Delve deeper into the bizarre, suspiciously abandoned underground facility and uncover the truth behind it with the help of your trusty drone… if you can survive meeting its eccentric residents.

games.name: Ni no Kuni™ II: Revenant Kingdom - The Prince's Edition
games.title: Ni no Kuni™ II: Revenant Kingdom - The Prince's Edition
games.description: Join the young king, Evan, as he sets out on an epic quest to found a new kingdom and save his world. The Prince's Edition includes the full game and all DLCs.

games.name: SOMA
games.title: SOMA
games.description: From the creators of Amnesia: The Dark Descent comes SOMA, a sci-fi horror game set below the waves of the Atlantic ocean. Struggle to survive a hostile world that will make you question your very existence.

games.name: Psychonauts 2
games.title: Psychonauts 2
games.description: Combining quirky missions and mysterious conspiracies, Psychonauts 2 is a platform-adventure game with cinematic style and tons of customizable psychic powers.

games.name: Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven
games.title: Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven
games.description: Rule and expand the Varennes Empire across multiple generations, engage the Seven Heroes in a battle that spans millennia, and make choices that drastically alter the course of your journey in this non-linear RPG!

games.name: Phantom Dust
games.title: Phantom Dust
games.description:
Phantom Dust for Xbox One and Windows 10 PC is a re-release of the original Xbox classic, adding full Xbox LIVE support, Xbox Play Anywhere, cross-device multiplayer and over 15 hours of single player content.

It blends third-person arena combat and collectable card game. Collect 300 unique skills and build your arsenal of powers, taking them into battle online with up to three other players!

games.name: TRON: Catalyst
games.title: TRON: Catalyst
games.description: Dive back into Disney's iconic TRON universe and explore the Arq Grid, a server on the brink of collapse. Meet new and interesting characters, influence warring factions, and unlock intriguing mysteries as you immerse yourself in this thrilling all-new TRON storyline.

games.name: Planet of Lana
games.title: Planet of Lana
games.description: A young girl and her loyal friend embark on a rescue mission through a colorful world full of cold machines and unfamiliar creatures. Planet of Lana is a cinematic puzzle adventure framed by an epic sci-fi saga that stretches across centuries and galaxies.

games.name: Wrap House Simulator

games.name: Winter Burrow
games.title: Winter Burrow
games.description: Winter Burrow is a cozy woodland survival game about a mouse returning home to restore their childhood burrow. Explore, gather resources, craft, knit warm sweaters, bake pies and meet the locals.

games.name: Old Market Simulator
games.title: Old Market Simulator
games.description: Farm, fish, craft, and decorate your cozy market with friends.

games.name: Broforce

games.name: Train Sim World® 6: Standard Edition

Immerse yourself in the unfamiliar territory of random events and listen out for station announcements. Enjoy your hobby in your own way.

games.name: SCARLET NEXUS Deluxe Edition
games.title: SCARLET NEXUS Deluxe Edition

The Deluxe Edition includes:
• SCARLET NEXUS (full game)
• Brain Punk Bundle

Deluxe Edition Bonuses:
• Additional Attachment "The Other"
• SAS Plug-in Variations (3)

Choose between Yuito and Kasane, elite psionics each armed with a talent in psychokinesis and their own reason to fight. Complete both of their stories to unlock all the mysteries of a Brain Punk future caught between technology and psychic abilities.

games.name: Spiritfarer®: Farewell Edition
games.title: Spiritfarer®: Farewell Edition
games.description: Spiritfarer is a cozy management game about dying. As ferrymaster to the deceased, build a boat to explore the world, care for your spirit friends, and guide them across mystical seas to finally release them into the afterlife.

games.name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Anniversary Edition + Fallout 4: Anniversary Edition Bundle
games.title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Anniversary Edition + Fallout 4: Anniversary Edition Bundle

games.name: The Outer Worlds 2 Premium Edition
games.title: The Outer Worlds 2 Premium Edition

Time to clear your calendar – get ready for an action-packed adventure with a new crew, new weapons, and new enemies in a new colony! So much newness!

games.name: Monster Hunter Rise + Sunbreak
games.title: Monster Hunter Rise + Sunbreak

games.name: Yakuza: Like a Dragon Legendary Hero Edition
games.title: Yakuza: Like a Dragon Legendary Hero Edition
games.description:
Become Ichiban Kasuga, a low-ranking yakuza grunt left on the brink of death by the man he trusted most. Take up your legendary bat and get ready to crack some underworld skulls in dynamic RPG combat set against the backdrop of modern-day Japan in Yakuza: Like a Dragon.

Yakuza: Like a Dragon Legendary Hero Edition includes Job Set, Crafting Mat Set, Management Mode Set, Karaoke Set, Ultimate Costume Set, and Stat Boost Set DLC.

Russian and Brazilian Portuguese subtitles available in early 2021 via patch update.

Game leverages Smart Delivery allowing access to both the Xbox One title and Xbox Series X title when available. Product does not yet have a firm release date. If pre-ordered, you will be notified when the release date is set and opportunity provided to manage your order.

games.name: Unmourned
games.title: Unmourned
games.description: Unmourned is a first-person psychological horror game where Jason moves into a new house only to be haunted by escalating paranormal events. Driven by fear, he must uncover the truth behind the previous owners' disappearance. Can he solve the mystery before it's too late?

games.name: Exoprimal
games.title: Exoprimal
games.description: Exoprimal is an online, team-based action game that pits humanity's cutting-edge exosuit technology against history's most ferocious beasts – dinosaurs.​​

games.name: BLiNX: The Time Sweeper
games.title: BLiNX: The Time Sweeper
games.description: Blinx: The Time Sweeper is a fast-paced action game featuring a cool, clever new character in wild, warped worlds. The ability to control the flow of time provides a totally new 4-dimensional gaming experience only possible on Xbox.

games.name: Chicken Run: Eggstraction
games.title: Chicken Run: Eggstraction
