games.name: DreamWorks Gabby’s Dollhouse: Ready to Party
games.title: DreamWorks Gabby’s Dollhouse: Ready to Party
games.description: Throw a party with Gabby and the Gabby Cats. Explore magical worlds – enjoy fun activities, minigames and rewards playing solo or with a friend.

games.name: Remnant: From the Ashes - Complete Edition
games.title: Remnant: From the Ashes - Complete Edition
games.description: Take home the complete Remnant: From the Ashes experience, as you fight through a post-apocalyptic world overrun by monstrous creatures - fighting to restore humanity while overcoming hordes of deadly enemies and epic bosses alone, or alongside up to two other players.

games.name: TRIALS of MANA
games.title: TRIALS of MANA
games.description:
Different destinies, different choices. 
The tale of three interwoven stories begins again. 

A full remake of Trials of Mana, originally released in 1995 and loved to this day by many Mana fans, finally makes its appearance on Xbox!

games.name: Bus Driving Simulator : EVO
games.title: Bus Driving Simulator : EVO
games.description: Get behind the wheel and become a professional bus driver! This amazing bus simulator will allow you to transport passengers across three different cities (Rio de Janeiro, Munich and Los Angeles) using various bus models with realistic physics and graphics. Play this bus simulator in single-player with career and freeride modes.

games.name: Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name
games.title: Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name
games.description:
ERASE YOUR PAST TO PROTECT YOUR FUTURE
Once a legendary yakuza, Kazuma Kiryu faked his own death and abandoned his name for the sake of protecting his family. Now, he is thrust into conflict by a mysterious figure attempting to drive him out of hiding.

Under the codename “Joryu,” Kiryu embarks on a gripping action narrative with bone-shattering combat in vibrant locations filled with exciting characters and activities.

games.name: NINJA GAIDEN: Master Collection
games.title: NINJA GAIDEN: Master Collection
games.description: 3 high speed ninja action titles are now available in one package!

games.name: Clean Up Earth
games.title: Clean Up Earth
games.description: A relaxing co-op restoration game where you vacuum waste, rebuild ecosystems, and watch nature return. Play solo, with friends, or in online sessions with up to 25 players. Community gameplay helps support real environmental initiatives with no extra spending required.

games.name: Talisman: Digital Edition
games.title: Talisman: Digital Edition
games.description: The officially licensed multiplayer version of the classic fantasy adventure board game, Talisman. On your travels, you will need strength, courage and some good dice rolls to survive the dangers you face and beat your opponents to the centre of the board!

games.name: Life is Strange: True Colors
games.title: Life is Strange: True Colors
games.description: Alex Chen hides her 'curse': the psychic power of Empathy, the ability to absorb and manipulate the strong emotions of others. When her brother dies in a so-called accident, Alex must embrace her power to find the truth — and reveal secrets long-buried.

games.name: Alfred Hitchcock - Vertigo
games.title: Alfred Hitchcock - Vertigo
games.description: Can you trust your own mind? Immerse yourself in a psychological thriller of a new kind, playing with the limits between reality and fantasy. Freely inspired by Alfred Hitchcock’s universe.

games.name: Peppa Pig: World Adventures
games.title: Peppa Pig: World Adventures
games.description: Play in the bigger, wider world of Peppa Pig, and bring your family into the story! Make pizza in Italy, walk on Hollywood Boulevard, climb the Eiffel Tower and more on your world tour. Create your own unique and dazzling family home, and discover more characters, quests and fun than ever before!

games.name: Lou's Lagoon
games.title: Lou's Lagoon
games.description: Take flight in your seaplane on a heartfelt adventure across the tropical Limbo archipelago. After a devastating storm, gather materials with your Swirler, and help the locals rebuild. Can you uncover the truth behind Uncle Lou’s disappearance?

games.name: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: All-Star Battle R Deluxe Edition
games.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: All-Star Battle R Deluxe Edition
games.description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
• Full game
• Season Pass
• 5 Special Event Outfits

JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: All-Star Battle R brings Hirohiko Araki's masterpiece to life in fighting game form!

Battle with 50 colorful characters from the world of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, wielding Stands, Hamon, and more!
See how characters who could never meet in the story interact when they come face to face!

Even newcomers to the fighting game genre can have fun with one-button combos and ultimate moves.

games.name: DRAGON QUEST - HD-2D Erdrick Trilogy Collection
games.title: DRAGON QUEST - HD-2D Erdrick Trilogy Collection

games.name: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy
games.title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy
games.description: Become Phoenix Wright and experience the thrill of battle as you fight to save your innocent clients in a court of law. Play all 14 episodes, spanning the first three games, in one gorgeous collection.

games.name: House Flipper Remastered Collection
games.title: House Flipper Remastered Collection
games.description: Guess who's back – and shinier than ever! House Flipper Remastered Collection lets you become a one-person renovation crew. Clean, build, decorate, and sell for profit! Now with better graphics, voice acting, all expansions in one toolbox, and some more heartfelt additions. It’s flipping time!

games.name: Ground Zero Hero
games.title: Ground Zero Hero
games.description: Kill mutants. Absorb their remains. Mutate into something stronger every run. Stack insane power combos and survive overwhelming hordes in this fast, chaotic, highly replayable action roguelite bullet hell.

games.name: HOTEL BARCELONA
games.title: HOTEL BARCELONA
games.description: From the creators of DEADLY PREMONITION + NO MORE HEROES. A marshal possessed by a murderer. A hotel full of killers. CHECK IN, WIPE 'EM OUT.

games.name: Voidwrought
games.title: Voidwrought
games.description: Voidwrought is a 2D action-platformer set in a hand-drawn world of cosmic horrors. Explore the thawing ruins of the First Civilisation and strike down the gods that dwell there. Grow your powers, uncover ancient artifacts, and expand your shrine amid the wreckage.

games.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator Deluxe Edition Bonus
games.title: TCG Card Shop Simulator Deluxe Edition Bonus
games.description: Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

games.name: ANNO : Mutationem
games.title: ANNO : Mutationem
games.description: ANNO: Mutationem is an action-adventure game with RPG elements set in a cyberpunk world, featuring a unique mix of pixelated 2D & 3D graphic style with a rich, dark and bizarre plot.

games.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tactical Takedown
games.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tactical Takedown
games.description: Splinter and Shredder are dead. Help the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles tackle deadly new threats and the approach of adulthood in this fast-paced turn-based beat-em-up!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO METAL SLUG X
games.title: ACA NEOGEO METAL SLUG X
games.description:
METAL SLUG X is an action shooting game released by SNK in 1999. 
It is a rearranged version of METAL SLUG 2 Using METAL SLUG 2 as a base, 
a variety of new weapons and enemies have been added. 
Furthermore, with position changes of bosses and more, the game's difficulty has been completely readjusted.

games.name: Leafy Corner
games.title: Leafy Corner
games.description: Run a cute little plant shop in this cozy and relaxing game. Grow, sell, and care for a variety of real-life plants, help customers find their dream plants, complete orders, and customize your cozy shop just the way you like!

games.name: Disney Illusion Island Starring Mickey and Friends
games.title: Disney Illusion Island Starring Mickey and Friends
games.description: Adventure awaits Mickey and Friends

games.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl — Standard to Ultimate Upgrade
games.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl — Standard to Ultimate Upgrade
games.description: Go all-in with the Ultimate Edition. Includes all Deluxe content, extra weapons and gear, a Season Pass for future expansions and bonus quest.

games.name: Wizard of Legend 2
games.title: Wizard of Legend 2
games.description: In an age of myth and magic, ambitious wizards from around the world have assembled to undertake the perilous Trials of Legend in the Floating Lands. Many will try. Most will fail. Only those who have truly mastered the chaotic, shifting elemental forces of Arcana will become a Wizard of Legend!

games.name: Enter The Gungeon
games.title: Enter The Gungeon
games.description: Enter the Gungeon is a gunfight dungeon crawler following a band of misfits seeking to shoot, loot, dodge roll and table-flip their way to personal absolution by reaching the legendary Gungeon’s ultimate treasure: the gun that can kill the past.

games.name: Keeper
games.title: Keeper
games.description: Keeper is a story told without words, in which a long-forgotten lighthouse is awakened and embarks upon an unexpected journey into realms beyond understanding.

games.name: Ocean Keeper
games.title: Ocean Keeper
games.description: Explore dungeons, fight hordes of monsters and survive on a huge map. This is Ocean Keeper - an action roguelike with tower defense elements. Mine resources in caves, customize your Mech Spider, upgrade different weapons and face dangerous bosses that won't leave you a chance!

games.name: The Wellmonts Case
games.title: The Wellmonts Case
games.description: The Wellmonts Case is a first-person psychological horror game set in 1993, Northern Maine. As a private detective, you explore the abandoned Wellmont farm, search for clues, photograph unsettling evidence, and uncover the truth behind a family's unexplained disappearance.

games.name: Battletoads
games.title: Battletoads
games.description:
The wait is over! Rash, Zitz and Pimple are returning at last to smash-hit their way through an all-new action-packed adventure of choreographed chaos, and couch co-op may never be the same again. 

1-3 players will take control of the Battletoads and team up to storm through wild and unpredictable stages with only one rule – expect the unexpected. Teamwork makes the dream work in a drop-in, drop-out gameplay blast, filled with over-the-top gameplay moments that anyone can enjoy, but only a True ‘Toad’ can master.

games.name: Bluey's Quest for the Gold Pen
games.title: Bluey's Quest for the Gold Pen

games.name: Solasta: Crown of the Magister
games.title: Solasta: Crown of the Magister
games.description: Roll for initiative, take attacks of opportunity, manage player location and the verticality of the battle field in this upcoming Turn-Based Tactical RPG based on the SRD 5.1 Ruleset. In Solasta, you make the choices, dice decide your destiny.

games.name: We Happy Few
games.title: We Happy Few
games.description: Set in a drug-fuelled, retrofuturistic city in an alternative 1960s England, We Happy Few is an action/adventure game in which you hide, fight, and conform your way out of a delusional Joy-obsessed world.

games.name: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown
games.title: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown
games.description: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown is a story-driven survival strategy game in which the fate of the iconic starship is in your hands. Take the helm, manage the ship and resources, and make difficult decisions. Will you be able to bring home the ship and its crew?

games.name: PAW Patrol Mighty Pups Save Adventure Bay
games.title: PAW Patrol Mighty Pups Save Adventure Bay
games.description: Join the Mighty Pups on a super-heroic mission to Save Adventure Bay. Have fun together in 2-player co-op mode, unlock fun mini-games, rescue familiar friends and use each pup’s mighty powers to make the town PAWsome again!

games.name: KIBORG
games.title: KIBORG
games.description: KIBORG is a fast-paced, story-driven action game with rogue-lite encounters. Each challenge is unique and the narrative always moves forward, win or lose. Become an unstoppable war machine and face the consequences of your actions as you lead a resistance group on a faraway prison planet.

games.name: Warm Snow
games.title: Warm Snow
games.description:
In the year 27 of the Longwu era, a strange warm snow refuses to melt and plunges the world into chaos, turning the people into uncontrollable monsters.

As you play “Bi An”, a mysterious warrior wandering in this oriental dark fantasy universe, your mission is to confront the 5 houses which used to protect the world by delivering them from the corruption and finally defeat the White Lotus. 

Adapt your equipment to your way of fighting and engage in challenging battles against fierce enemies to solve the riddle behind the warm snow and deliver the world from this plague!

games.name: SILENT HILL 2 & SILENT HILL f Deluxe Dual Pack
games.title: SILENT HILL 2 & SILENT HILL f Deluxe Dual Pack

games.name: Hi-Fi RUSH
games.title: Hi-Fi RUSH
games.description: Feel the beat as wannabe rockstar Chai and his ragtag team fight against an evil megacorp with raucous rhythm combat! From Tango Gameworks comes Hi-Fi RUSH, an all-new action game where the world syncs to the music.

games.name: Brews & Bastards
games.title: Brews & Bastards
games.description: Brews & Bastards is a local co-op, twin-stick shooter for 1 to 4 players, overflowing with action-packed combat, magical brews and outlandish bosses. Select from a group of distinct heroes and blast your way through hordes of drunken demons in search of the stolen Brew Stone.

games.name: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle™: Digital Premium Edition
games.title: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle™: Digital Premium Edition
games.description: Live the adventure with the Premium Edition and receive Indiana Jones and the Great Circle™: The Order of Giants Story DLC, a digital artbook, and the Temple of Doom™ Outfit, Indy’s iconic look as seen in Temple of Doom™.

games.name: One Lonely Outpost
games.title: One Lonely Outpost
games.description: An alien world sometimes needs a farmer’s touch to bring it to life. In this sci-fi, colonization-life sim, terraform a barren world: turn wastelands into verdant landscapes while exploring, farming, building, and unlocking all the mysteries of this strange new planet.

games.name: Remnant: From the Ashes
games.title: Remnant: From the Ashes
games.description: The world has been thrown into chaos by an ancient evil from another dimension. As one of the last remnants of humanity, you must set out alone or alongside up to two other survivors to face down hordes of deadly enemies to try to carve a foothold, rebuild, and retake what was lost.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO THE KING OF FIGHTERS 2002
games.title: ACA NEOGEO THE KING OF FIGHTERS 2002
games.description:
THE KING OF FIGHTERS 2002 is a fighting game released by SNK in 2002.
The 9th entry in the KOF series. In this tame, the Striker System is replaced by creating teams for the comeback of the 3-on-3 Battle Mode.
The easier to use MAX Activation System adds a more in-depth experience to your gameplay!

games.name: Aggelos 2
games.title: Aggelos 2
games.description: With the Gods of light about to lose the great battle against the Army of Darkness, the Aggelos must learn to embrace his darker side. Explore two opposing realms full of secrets, puzzles and intense 2D combat in this challenging action-platformer

games.name: ACA NEOGEO METAL SLUG
games.title: ACA NEOGEO METAL SLUG
games.description:
"METAL SLUG" is the original entry in one of the most famous action game series ever released. It was originally released by SNK in 1996.
Players control Marco and Tarma who belong to the Special Forces team known as the "Peregrine Falcon Squad." They fight to defeat General Donald Morden, in an effort to take back their stolen weapon known as the "METAL SLUG." Players can utilize various weapons and vehicles such as the METAL SLUG to sway the fight in their favor.

games.name: Like a Dragon: Ishin!
games.title: Like a Dragon: Ishin!
games.description: 1860s Kyo is plagued by vast inequality — one samurai will change the course of history in his search for justice. Draw your blade and join the revolution in this heated historical adventure.  Pre-order now to add three exclusive weapons to your arsenal.

games.name: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage 30th Anniversary Edition
games.title: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage 30th Anniversary Edition

games.name: Beastro
games.title: Beastro
games.description: Welcome to Beastro! In this charming fusion of fantasy adventure, not all heroes wield swords… Some prefer the spoon. And, sometimes to save the world you’ve got to start with a really good meal.

games.name: Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor - Deluxe Edition
games.title: Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor - Deluxe Edition
games.description: Join Thomas and his friends on a special journey across Sodor! Ride with the classic steam team, including James, in this Deluxe Bundle, and enjoy nostalgic stories and new narratives from the driver’s seat. Explore the Wonders of Sodor – fun and magic await!

games.name: BlazBlue: Cross Tag Battle Special Edition
games.title: BlazBlue: Cross Tag Battle Special Edition
games.description: THE COLLISION IS INEVITABLE! THE IMPACT WILL BE UNAVOIDABLE! Cross over between 4 different universes! Play as characters from the BlazBlue, Persona, Under Night In-Birth, and (for the first time ever in a fighting game), RWBY series!

games.name: Machine Gun Fury
games.title: Machine Gun Fury
games.description: When tyranny takes control… someone has to pull the trigger. Machine Gun Fury is a bold revival of the classic arcade military shooter — no cover systems, no moral debates, just pure reflex-driven carnage. It’s you, your trigger finger, and a limited supply of grenades against entire armies. If you grew up blasting through classic arcade games, welcome back to the frontline, soldier.

games.name: Echo Generation 2
games.title: Echo Generation 2
games.description: Embark on a sci-fi deckbuilding RPG odyssey. Build your crew, master powerful decks, and uncover the truth behind a growing cosmic threat. Deal the cards. Defy the cosmos. Embrace the adventure.

games.name: Visions of Mana
games.title: Visions of Mana
games.description: Explore a world of elemental spirits and adventure in the latest Mana action-RPG.

games.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 10
games.title: The Jackbox Party Pack 10
games.description: Ready to be a party legend? The celebrated franchise returns with epic drawing battles in Tee K.O. 2, chaotic type-offs in FixyText, time-travel trivia in Timejinx, hidden identity intrigue in Hypnotorious, and group music-making in Dodo Re Mi.

games.name: Another Dawn
games.title: Another Dawn
games.description: A quiet holiday on a tropical island suddenly becomes your worst nightmare when a ruthless criminal organization kidnaps your family. Battle against hunger, thirst, unscrupulous mercenaries and wild creatures in order to stay alive and save your beloved!

games.name: Rudolph The Red Nosed Reindeer
games.title: Rudolph The Red Nosed Reindeer
games.description: Dash into the enchanting world of Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer and embark on a holly jolly quest to save Christmas in this magical adventure inspired by the beloved 1964 animated classic!

games.name: Submerged: Hidden Depths
games.title: Submerged: Hidden Depths
games.description: Boat, climb, interact and explore in the beautiful ruins of a sunken world.

games.name: CyberCorp
games.title: CyberCorp
games.description: Brutal fast-paced isometric Co-op Loot Shooter in Cyberpunk world. Equipment-based combos. Exotic Weapons and Armor. Easy to start, hard to master. Play solo or with friends.

games.name: Cassette Beasts
games.title: Cassette Beasts
games.description: Collect awesome monsters to use during turn-based battles in this open-world RPG, now with online multiplayer mode. Combine any two monster forms using Cassette Beasts’ Fusion System to create unique and powerful new ones!

games.name: The Bard's Tale Trilogy
games.title: The Bard's Tale Trilogy
games.description: Experience the events that led to The Bard’s Tale IV: Barrows Deep and The Mage’s Tale! The Bard's Tale Trilogy is a remastering of the classic 1980s series, one of the godfathers of the RPG genre. Create an adventuring party in the first volume and play it across all three, creating a heroic story all your own!

games.name: NO-SKIN
games.title: NO-SKIN
games.description: NO-SKIN is a horror roguelike where experimental art style and storytelling meet strategic gameplay.

games.name: Legend of Mana
games.title: Legend of Mana
games.description: Loved by Mana fans since its original release in 1999, Legend of Mana comes to Xbox as an HD Remaster, 25 years after its original release.

games.name: OUTRIDERS
games.title: OUTRIDERS
games.description: Square Enix and People Can Fly present OUTRIDERS; a 1-3 player, drop-in-drop-out co-op shooter set in an original, dark and desperate sci-fi universe.

games.name: Observer: System Redux
games.title: Observer: System Redux
games.description: A first‑person cyberpunk horror detective story set in a decaying, neon‑scarred future. As an Observer who invades minds to hunt for clues, you will sift through corrupted memories to track down a mysterious killer and confront your own dark past.

games.name: Totally Normal Journey: The Interactive Musical
games.title: Totally Normal Journey: The Interactive Musical
games.description: Totally Normal Journey is the most hip and cool game for the true cool kids!

games.name: Gear.Club Unlimited 3 - Deluxe Edition
games.title: Gear.Club Unlimited 3 - Deluxe Edition
games.description: Get the Deluxe Edition of Gear.Club Unlimited 3 and enjoy bonus content. Customize your favourite cars for speeding along the roads of France and Japan. Be the best while showing off your style!

games.name: Dark Light
games.title: Dark Light
games.description: Dark Light is a post-apocalyptic cyberpunk action-platformer with intense hack'n slash combat. Explore the unknown, enhance your abilities with cyberwares, and face off against supernatural entities to seal the Dark Void and end the eternal darkness.

games.name: Metal Slug Tactics
games.title: Metal Slug Tactics
games.description: METAL SLUG makes an explosive return! Dive into this dynamic tactical RPG with a roguelite thrill and experience the iconic run'n'gun action of the original series, redefined. Grab your weapons, assemble your squad and conquer the battlefield to defeat the infamous Rebel Army.

games.name: SD GUNDAM BATTLE ALLIANCE
games.title: SD GUNDAM BATTLE ALLIANCE
games.description:
In SD Gundam Battle Alliance, Mobile Suits and characters from across Mobile Suit Gundam history take center stage in this all-new action RPG.

• Combo action with stunning visuals and dynamic animation
• Strange phenomena known as Breaks are twisting legendary moments from Gundam history, and you're in charge to fix them.
• Tackle missions with friends in multiplayer!

games.name: Twelve Minutes
games.title: Twelve Minutes
games.description: An interactive thriller about a man trapped in a time loop. Featuring James McAvoy, Daisy Ridley, and Willem Dafoe.

games.name: NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound
games.title: NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound
games.description: A brand-new side-scrolling entry to the NINJA GAIDEN series from the team behind Blasphemous, NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound redefines the classic platformer saga in a spectacular, thrilling and challenging ninja adventure.

games.name: The Grinch 2: Saving Christmas
games.title: The Grinch 2: Saving Christmas
games.description: Play as the Grinch, collect ornaments, master gadgets, and tackle festive challenges to decorate the ultimate Christmas tree for the Whos.

games.name: Wasteland 2: Director's Cut
games.title: Wasteland 2: Director's Cut
games.description: From the Producer of the original Fallout comes Wasteland 2, the sequel to the first-ever post-apocalyptic computer RPG! With over 80 hours of gameplay, you will deck out your Ranger squad with the most devastating weaponry this side of the fallout zone, test the limits of your strategy skills, and bring justice to the wasteland - the choices are yours, but so are the consequences.

games.name: Orcs Must Die! Deathtrap
games.title: Orcs Must Die! Deathtrap
games.description: Orcs Must Die! Deathtrap combines chaotic third-person combat with devious trap-laying strategy. Enjoy endless replayability as your War Mage grows stronger with every battle. Repel relentless orc hordes solo or with up to 4 players.

games.name: Froggy Hates Snow
games.title: Froggy Hates Snow
games.description: Dig, fight, and survive as Froggy in a frozen world where warmth means life. Each run brings new upgrades and dangers as you carve paths through snow, battle eerie obsidian creatures, and uncover treasures beneath the frost.

games.name: John Fox
games.title: John Fox
games.description: Your beloved pet, Milo, has been killed. You have to avenge him!

games.name: Just Cause 4 - Complete Edition
games.title: Just Cause 4 - Complete Edition
games.description:
Unlock the true potential of Just Cause 4 with the Complete Edition! 
Strap into your wingsuit, equip your fully customizable grappling hook, and get ready to bring the thunder!

Just Cause 4 Complete Edition includes:
- Just Cause 4
- Black Market Bundle (Access to all Black Market/Premium Content)
- Dare Devils of Destruction Expansion
- Los Demonios Expansion
- Danger Rising Expansion
- Skystriker Weaponized Wingsuit
- Black Hand Stealth Micro Jet

games.name: Escape Academy
games.title: Escape Academy
games.description: Welcome to Escape Academy. Train to become the ultimate Escape Room master. Solve Puzzles. Hack Servers. Meet the Faculty. Brew the perfect cup of tea. Entirely playable in single player or co-op with a friend - local or online!

games.name: DISORDER for Xbox
games.title: DISORDER for Xbox
games.description: Escape the department store and uncover the hidden truth in this full 3D roguelike dungeon crawler

games.name: Sniper Elite 5 Complete Edition
games.title: Sniper Elite 5 Complete Edition
games.description: Sniper Elite 5 Complete Edition includes the base game, Season Pass One, and Season Pass Two.

games.name: WINGSPAN
games.title: WINGSPAN
games.description: Wingspan is a relaxing, award-winning strategy card game about birds for  1 to 5 players. Each bird you play extends a chain of powerful  combinations in one of your three habitats. Your goal is to discover and  attract the best birds to your network of wildlife preserves.

games.name: DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake
games.title: DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake
games.description: DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake is a stunning reimagination of the first two legendary adventures in The Erdrick Trilogy, brought together in one package.

games.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl — Deluxe to Ultimate Upgrade
games.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl — Deluxe to Ultimate Upgrade
games.description: Already own the Deluxe Edition? Upgrade to Ultimate for powerful bonus gear, the Ward Exoskeleton suit, and the Season Pass for future expansions and all DLCs.

games.name: Death Howl
games.title: Death Howl
games.description: Journey through the sorrowful spirit world in a soulslike deck builder. Craft cards and claim powerful totems to defeat the woeful spirits lurking in the mystical lands. Unravel the tale of a grieving mother in her desperate attempt to defy death and bring back her son.

games.name: Decollate Decoration
games.title: Decollate Decoration
games.description: A haunting adventure where love lingers beyond death!

games.name: FORENSIC - M.E. Protocol
games.title: FORENSIC - M.E. Protocol
games.description: Put on your gloves and step into the crime scene in FORENSIC M.E. Protocol, a forensic investigation sim where science is your weapon and truth is your goal. 9 unique cases are waiting to be solved.

games.name: Barbie Project Friendship™
games.title: Barbie Project Friendship™
games.developer: Xaloc Studios S.L and Casual Brothers Ltd.
games.description: Join Barbie™ on a fun summer adventure to save the Malibu Waves Community Center! Help friends, unlock minigames and earn points for upgrades while you restore a beloved landmark.
games.developerName: Xaloc Studios S.L and Casual Brothers Ltd.

games.name: Stampede: Racing Royale (Game Preview)
games.title: Stampede: Racing Royale (Game Preview)
games.description: Welcome to the wildest kart racing event ever devised, where 60 players go bumper-to-bumper on outrageous circuits filled with power-ups. Avoid elimination and fight your way to the front of the herd in the scramble to be crowned champion.

games.name: Little Noah: Scion of Paradise Special Edition
games.title: Little Noah: Scion of Paradise Special Edition
games.description:
Explore ancient ruins with the alchemist Noah and her trusty cat companion!
Create unique teams and combos from 40+ recruitable allies in this casual but compelling game!

games.name: The Wandering Village
games.title: The Wandering Village
games.description:
In a world where mysterious plants are spreading all over the earth, emitting toxic spores as they grow, a small group of survivors seeks shelter on the back of a giant, wandering creature they call 'Onbu'.
Become their leader, build their settlement and form a symbiotic relationship with the creature to survive together in this hostile, yet beautiful post-apocalyptic world that now surrounds you.

games.name: Drop Duchy - Complete Edition
games.title: Drop Duchy - Complete Edition
games.description: Build your duchy piece by piece in this refreshing hybrid rogue-lite game. Use block-dropping mechanics to collect resources, recruit troops to fight against belligerent armies, and let every block shape your realm, leading your path to victory!

games.name: Sniper Dan
games.title: Sniper Dan
games.description: Sniper Dan is a ridiculous, family-friendly 3D Hidden Object game with a big twist. Use a high-powered sniper rifle to solve low-stakes problems. Scope the scene, spot the problem,  and shoot the solution. No violence. Just wholesome chaos and good intentions!

games.name: Dark Reflection
games.title: Dark Reflection
games.description: A thrash metal album reveals a ritual that opens a portal to another world.

games.name: The Ascent
games.title: The Ascent
games.description: The Ascent is a solo and co-op Action-shooter RPG set in a cyberpunk world. The mega corporation that owns you and everyone, The Ascent Group, has just collapsed. Can you survive without it?

games.name: Soul Hackers 2
games.title: Soul Hackers 2
games.description: Explore a supernatural RPG with stylish summoners and dark dangers lurking under the neon lights of a cyberpunk Japan. It is up to the agents of Aion to decrypt destiny and save the world from apocalypse!

games.name: A Tower Full of Cats
games.title: A Tower Full of Cats
games.description: Find hundreds of cats hidden across time in this vertical adventure

games.name: FINAL FANTASY III
games.title: FINAL FANTASY III
games.description: The original FINAL FANTASY III comes to life with completely new graphics and audio as a 2D pixel remaster!

games.name: Myst
games.title: Myst
games.description: Welcome to Myst: the starkly beautiful island, eerily tinged with mystery and shrouded in intrigue. Explore the deeper connections and uncover a story of ruthless family betrayal.

games.name: Gear.Club Unlimited 3
games.title: Gear.Club Unlimited 3
games.description: The Gear.Club series is back! Customize and set up your favourite cars to race at top speed along the roads of the French Mediterranean coast and Japan. Don't just win – show off your style!

games.name: Spelunky 2
games.title: Spelunky 2
games.description: Spelunky 2 builds upon the unique, randomized challenges that made the original a roguelike classic, offering a huge adventure designed to satisfy players old and new.

games.name: Two Point Campus
games.title: Two Point Campus
games.description: Build the university of your dreams with Two Point Campus, the follow up management sim with a twist from the creators of Two Point Hospital.  Get to know your students, explore their personalities and fulfill their wants and needs.  Craft buildings, choose courses, hire the best staff and build an academic institution to stand the test of time.

games.name: Ruiner
games.title: Ruiner
games.description: RUINER is a brutal action shooter set in the year 2091 in the cyber metropolis Rengkok. A wired sociopath lashes out against a corrupt system to retrieve his kidnapped brother and uncover the truth under the guidance of a secretive Hacker friend. Experience a dark adventure in the shadiest back alleys of Rengkok City and dismantle the corporate titans of virtuality dealers at HEAVEN.

games.name: Asdivine Cross
games.title: Asdivine Cross
games.description: Bear the fate of light and shadow to save Asdivine in a grand fantasy RPG!

games.name: Neptunia: Sisters VS Sisters
games.title: Neptunia: Sisters VS Sisters
games.description: With Gamindustri on the brink of destruction, Nepgear and the Candidates must band together and restore order!

games.name: Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny
games.title: Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny
games.description: Bring iconic Nickelodeon heroes into a world of fantasy and real-time RPG action. Throw the dice and dive into a wild, action-packed adventure with SpongeBob, Katara, Leonardo, and others. Featuring epic battles, dynamic environments, it's an engaging gameplay experience for players of all ages.

games.name: LUNAR Remastered Collection
games.title: LUNAR Remastered Collection
games.developer: GAME ARTS Co., Ltd., ASHIBI Co., Ltd.
games.description: Dive into the enchanting worlds of LUNAR: Silver Star Story Complete and LUNAR 2: Eternal Blue Complete! Tag along on Alex and Hiro's quests and challenge enemies like the Magic Emperor and God of Destruction to save the world from dire peril in two adventures set 1000 years apart from each other!
games.developerName: GAME ARTS Co., Ltd., ASHIBI Co., Ltd.

games.name: Junkster
games.title: Junkster
games.description: Junkster is a 3D action platformer with an awesome building mechanic. Plucky, little construction bot, UM-13 has crash-landed on a dangerous junkyard planet. Armed only with his trusty robo-wrench, Um must repair his ship and recover his lost cargo of precious human artifacts.

games.name: My Little Pony: A Zephyr Heights Mystery
games.title: My Little Pony: A Zephyr Heights Mystery
games.description: Take friendship to new heights and tame the chaotic magic that’s turning the world upside down, in a mystery adventure for one or two ponies!

games.name: Dungeons Of Hinterberg
games.title: Dungeons Of Hinterberg
games.description: Armed with a sword and a tourist guide, explore the beautiful alpine village of Hinterberg and uncover the magic hidden within its dungeons! Master magic, solve puzzles, slay monsters; all this and more await you in Hinterberg!

games.name: Suikoden I&II HD Remaster Gate Rune and Dunan Unification Wars
games.title: Suikoden I&II HD Remaster Gate Rune and Dunan Unification Wars
games.description: A hero's destiny is written in the Stars. The legendary Konami JRPGs Suikoden I and Suikoden II have now been remastered in HD!

games.name: DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS 2
games.title: DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS 2
games.developer: Developed by KOEI TECMO GAMES CO.,LTD.
games.description: DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS™ 2 is a block-building RPG set in a fantasy land threatened by an evil cult. Explore, battle, create and harvest in the charming single-player campaign or build big projects in the online sandbox mode for up to 4-players.
games.developerName: Developed by KOEI TECMO GAMES CO.,LTD.

games.name: Amerzone - The Explorer's Legacy
games.title: Amerzone - The Explorer's Legacy
games.description: Set off on a quest for the Great White Birds in a mysterious land full of secrets!

games.name: Trash Goblin
games.title: Trash Goblin
games.description: A wholesome, cosy shopkeeping game with no pressures, no stress, and endless good vibes! Uncover and clean trinkets then upcycle them to sell to endless colourful and quirky customers. Spend your savings to upgrade your shop, buy better tools, plus expand and customise your space.

games.name: Golf Up
games.title: Golf Up
games.description: Golf Up is a fun-loaded golf game you can play with up to 4 friends in several game modes.

games.name: Dead Reset
games.title: Dead Reset
games.description:
Trapped in a terrifying deathloop, surgeon Cole Mason is kidnapped and brought to an underwater facility, forced to operate on a patient to extract an evolving parasitic horror. Dead Reset is a blood-soaked interactive horror, where each death brings you closer to the truth.

Developed by Wales Interactive and Dark Rift Horror.

games.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl — Standard to Deluxe Upgrade
games.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl — Standard to Deluxe Upgrade
games.description: Upgrade to the Deluxe Edition to access exclusive weapons, suits, a bonus side quest, and the official artbook and soundtrack. Enhance your journey through the Zone with premium content.

games.name: The Jackbox Party Starter
games.title: The Jackbox Party Starter
games.description: Your next game night is all planned out with The Jackbox Party Starter! Featuring new updates to Quiplash 3, Trivia Murder Party 2 and Tee K.O.! Leave the life of the party to us at your next event with The Jackbox Party Starter!

games.name: Bugsnax
games.title: Bugsnax
games.description: Catch mysterious living snacks and feed them to your friends in this unusual island adventure!

games.name: Back to the Dawn
games.title: Back to the Dawn
games.description: Back to the Dawn is a story-rich RPG set in a high-security prison ruled by factions and buried secrets. Investigate two conspiracies from the inside, gather evidence, and outsmart a system designed to silence you. Make friends (or foes) with fellow inmates and with their help, break out of prison!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO METAL SLUG 5
games.title: ACA NEOGEO METAL SLUG 5
games.description:
METAL SLUG 5 is an action shooting game released by SNK in 2003.
The Ptolemaic Army has stolen some very confidential files! Choose from four familiar faces: Marco, Eri, Tarma, or Fio to take them down!
Look forward to the new Slug Gunner and slide mechanic!

games.name: Lost Islands
games.title: Lost Islands
games.description: Explore this survival and exploration RPG game that combines adventure, escape, fantasy. All in one game!

games.name: TUNIC
games.title: TUNIC
games.description: Explore a land filled with lost legends, ancient powers, and ferocious monsters in TUNIC, an isometric action game about a small fox on a big adventure.

games.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator Deluxe Pre-Order Bonus
games.title: TCG Card Shop Simulator Deluxe Pre-Order Bonus
games.description: Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

games.name: No Sun To Worship
games.title: No Sun To Worship
games.description: No Sun To Worship is a minimalist, stealth-action game that captures the brilliance of the first pioneers of the stealth genre and recreates their retro-aesthetic charm within an echo of a dying world.

games.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 - Premium Deluxe Edition
games.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 - Premium Deluxe Edition
games.description: Pursue your aviation career throughout the world with dynamically-generated missions ranging from Medevac and Search & Rescue to Aerial Firefighting and Passenger Transport. Compete against other pilots in the iconic Reno and Red Bull Air Races. Enhanced physics and aircraft systems and a groundbreaking flight planner create an unparalleled simulation experience. Explore the most detailed digital twin of the world to date with real-time air and ship traffic and a vast array of animals. Set out on your global adventure with our largest fleet of aircraft as Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 takes simulation to new heights of authenticity and realism.

games.name: Chess Royal
games.title: Chess Royal
games.description: A simple yet satisfying game of chess that anyone can play and learn from!

games.name: Sniper Elite: Resistance Deluxe Edition
games.title: Sniper Elite: Resistance Deluxe Edition
games.description: The acclaimed Sniper Elite franchise returns with a new lead operative. Infiltrate occupied France and fight alongside the French Resistance to stop the Nazis developing an insidious new wonder weapon that could change the course of the war. (242 characters with spaces)

games.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020) Premium Deluxe 40th Anniversary Edition
games.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020) Premium Deluxe 40th Anniversary Edition
games.description:
From light planes to wide body jets to gliders and helicopters, fly highly detailed and accurate aircraft in the Microsoft Flight Simulator 40th Anniversary Edition. The world is at your fingertips.

The Premium Deluxe 40th Anniversary Edition includes everything from the Deluxe Edition plus 5 additional highly accurate planes with unique flight models and 5 additional handcrafted international airports.

games.name: Rollerdrome
games.title: Rollerdrome
games.description: Rollerdrome is a third person action shooter that seamlessly blends high octane, visceral combat with fluid movement and tricking mechanics into one complementary and challenging whole, to create an original adrenaline-pumping shooter experience like no other.

games.name: Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor
games.title: Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor
games.description: Join Thomas and his friends on a special journey across Sodor! Hop into the cabs of North Western Railway’s classic steam team to enjoy nostalgic stories and all-new narratives right from the drivers’ seats. Explore the Wonders of Sodor – fun and magic await!

games.name: Wild West Supermarket Simulator
games.title: Wild West Supermarket Simulator
games.description: Run a General Store in the Wild West. Customize and expand your shop. Make sure that your customers’ constantly changing needs are satisfied. Work every job yourself or let your employees stack the shelves and work the till. Find out what it feels like to own a Wild West Supermarket.

games.name: DRAGON QUEST III HD-2D Remake
games.title: DRAGON QUEST III HD-2D Remake
games.description: The Legacy Begins

games.name: The Invincible
games.title: The Invincible
games.description: Rethink human’s dominion in The Invincible: a story-driven adventure set in a hard sci-fi world by Stanisław Lem. Discover planet Regis III as scientist Yasna, use atompunk tools looking for a missing crew and face unforeseen threats. Make choices in a philosophical story that’s driven by science.

games.name: Death Match Love Comedy!
games.title: Death Match Love Comedy!
games.publisher: KEMCO in Japan & Asia, PQube in North America & Europe
games.description:
Afflicted by a crazy curse that causes strange phenomena including being attacked by women, you must avoid being confessed to in order to survive!
From the creators of “Raging Loop” comes a wild ride of a visual novel, full of romance, comedy, and explosions!
games.publisherName: KEMCO in Japan & Asia, PQube in North America & Europe

games.name: FatalZone
games.title: FatalZone
games.description: FatalZone is an auto shooter with roguelike and RPG elements set in a savage world of zombies. Exterminate zombie hordes, collect resources, upgrade your camp, and level up mercenaries. Humanity must survive at any cost!

games.name: Craftopia (Game Preview)
games.title: Craftopia (Game Preview)
games.description: Craftopia is the brand new multiplayer survival action game made in Japan. We combined many features we find enjoyable, such as hunting, farming, hack-and-slash, building, automation to develop this game.

games.name: FINAL FANTASY II
games.title: FINAL FANTASY II
games.description: The original FINAL FANTASY II comes to life with completely new graphics and audio as a 2D pixel remaster!

games.name: Chorus
games.title: Chorus
games.description:
She was once the Circle’s deadliest warrior – now she’s their most wanted fugitive. As Nara and her starfighter, Forsaken, journey across the galaxy to unite resistance forces against the Circle and free the universe from oppression. 

A JOURNEY OF REDEMPTION – Play as Nara and her sentient AI companion and starfighter, Forsaken on her quest to face her haunted past and destroy the cult that created her. 

VENTURE BEYOND THE VOID –  Experience fast-paced, frenetic action that evolves the spirit of classic space shooter and engage in exhilarating zero-g dogfights, from epic cosmic vistas, to tight crystalline corridors. 

ONE PILOT, ONE SHIP, ONE LIVING WEAPON – Attain powerful and distinct weapons and combat upgrades. Master your ship’s unique drift mechanic and deadly mind-bending abilities, including extra-sensory perception, teleportation and telekinesis, to overcome massive hordes of enemies and take down titanic battleships.

games.name: Amnesia: Rebirth
games.title: Amnesia: Rebirth
games.description: A first-person horror adventure. Uncover your past and survive the Algerian desert. Fear is your enemy; stay calm to not succumb to an illness threatening you and your loved one. Avoid darkness, hide from monsters and solve puzzles. Adventure Mode available for a less scary experience.

games.name: KARMA: The Dark World
games.title: KARMA: The Dark World
games.description: KARMA: The Dark World is a first-person cinematic psychological thriller set in a dystopian world where the Leviathan Corporation is omnipresent. The time is 1984, the place is East Germany, and things are not quite what they seem.

games.name: Screamer - Digital Deluxe Edition
games.title: Screamer - Digital Deluxe Edition
games.description: Dive into the Screamer - Digital Deluxe Edition! In addition to the full game, enjoy the Digital Deluxe Upgrade content once unlocked in-game and take part in the deadliest racing tournament ever!

games.name: Just Cause 4 - Gold Edition
games.title: Just Cause 4 - Gold Edition
games.description:
Strap into your wingsuit, equip your fully customizable grappling hook, and get ready to bring the thunder! 

Just Cause 4 Gold Edition includes:
- Just Cause 4
- The Expansion Pass
- Golden Gear Pack
- ‘Skystriker’ Weaponized Wingsuit
- Black Hand Stealth Micro Jet
- Neon Racer Pack
- Deathstalker Scorpion Pack
- Renegade Pack

games.name: Worms Rumble
games.title: Worms Rumble
games.description: Worms Rumble is Worms like you’ve never played it before, with intense, real-time, arena-based 32 player cross-platform combat. Get ready for Deathmatch and Last Worm Standing modes where you’re only ever a Holy Hand Grenade away from death!

games.name: Avowed Premium Edition
games.title: Avowed Premium Edition
games.description:
Premium Edition includes:  
- Avowed base game  
- Up to 5 days early access 
- Two Premium Skin Packs  
- Access to Avowed Digital Artbook & Original Soundtrack

games.name: Anomaly Hunter: Observation Duty
games.title: Anomaly Hunter: Observation Duty
games.description: Your shift has started. Monitor the security cameras, spot the anomalies, and report anything out of the ordinary. Trust your eyes, but don't trust the shadows. Can you survive the night in Anomaly Hunter: Observation Duty?

games.name: Shredders
games.title: Shredders
games.description:
CONTROLLER REQUIRED TO PLAY

Break into the snowboarding event of the year in the hope of scoring a wildcard entry to an exclusive invitational. To prove you’re up to the challenge, master the art of park riding, buttering, rails and massive kickers and earn your place in the world of snowboarding.

games.name: EVERSPACE™ 2
games.title: EVERSPACE™ 2
games.description: EVERSPACE™ 2 is a fast-paced single-player spaceship shooter with worthwhile exploration in space and on planets, tons of loot, RPG elements, mining, and crafting. Experience a thoughtful sci-fi story, set in a vivid, handcrafted open world full of secrets, puzzles, and perils.

games.name: Halls of Torment
games.title: Halls of Torment
games.description:
Slay hordes of terrifying monsters in this horde survival roguelite.
Descend into the Halls of Torment where the Lords of the underworld await you.
Treasures, magical trinkets, and a growing cast of heroes will grant you the power
to vanquish these horrors from beyond. How long can you survive?

games.name: Savara
games.title: Savara
games.description: In this colorful action roguelite, participate in the festivities organized for the pleasure of the warrior god. Equip your best weapons, prove your valor against powerful monsters, and permanently engrave your name in history!

games.name: Miraculous - Paris Under Siege
games.title: Miraculous - Paris Under Siege
games.description: Step into the suits of Ladybug and Cat Noir in their most daring adventure yet!  Embark on a thrilling adventure where heroism, acrobatic combat and parkour agility collide as Shadow Moth unleashes a wave of villains across the city.  It’s up to you and your friends to save Paris!

games.name: Herdling
games.title: Herdling
games.description: Guide a herd of mysterious creatures on a stirring and beautiful journey into the mountains… and beyond.

games.name: Ace Attorney Anthology
games.title: Ace Attorney Anthology
games.description: Take that! All six mainline entries in the legendary Ace Attorney series are now available together in one special bundle. Go head to head with prolific prosecutors in the heated courtroom battles of Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney Trilogy and Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy.

games.name: Big Buck Hunter: Ultimate Trophy
games.title: Big Buck Hunter: Ultimate Trophy
games.description: Get ready to lock, load, and dominate the wild like never before with Big Buck Hunter: Ultimate Trophy! This groundbreaking experience takes the #1 arcade hunting game to thrilling new heights, delivering over 3X the content of its hit predecessor.

games.name: Ni no Kuni Wrath of the White Witch™ Remastered
games.title: Ni no Kuni Wrath of the White Witch™ Remastered
games.description: Journey back to the other world in Ni no Kuni: Wrath of the White Witch Remastered. LEVEL-5’s classic tale returns better than ever, with improved graphics and performance. Join Oliver as he embarks on an adventure through a world inhabited by new friends and ferocious foes alike in the hopes of bringing back his mother after a tragic incident.

games.name: Kusan: City of Wolves
games.title: Kusan: City of Wolves
games.description: Kusan: City of Wolves is a high-octane hardcore top-down shooter set in a brutal urban jungle ruled by gunfire and corruption.

games.name: Planet Coaster 2: Deluxe Edition

games.name: Nice Day for Fishing
games.title: Nice Day for Fishing

games.name: Formula Legends
games.title: Formula Legends

games.name: Totally Spies! - Cyber Mission
games.title: Totally Spies! - Cyber Mission
games.description: Get ready for an electrifying 2.0 adventure! The Spies are back into action in a brand-new story set in the lively city of Singapore. Brace yourself for the return of high-tech gadgets, ecstatic missions, old friends, and the signature humor of the animated series.

games.name: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION Premium Edition
games.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION Premium Edition
games.description: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION's Premium Edition. This product includes the main game, the Story Expansion Pass, and Early Access, which allows you to play the game 24 hours before its release.

games.name: Isekai Villain

games.name: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION
games.title: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION

In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle.

Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

games.name: Echoes of the Plum Grove
games.title: Echoes of the Plum Grove
games.description: A new life awaits in Honeywood! Build a thriving community that will last generations in this cozy farm simulator. Farm, socialize, make friends, cook, craft, forage and uncover the secrets of the island! If someone doesn’t want to be friends? There are always other means.

games.name: Monster Train 2

games.name: Beat 'Em Up Collection (QUByte Classics)
games.title: Beat 'Em Up Collection (QUByte Classics)

games.name: The Crimson Maid
games.title: The Crimson Maid
games.description: A marriage of first-person exploration and visual novel storytelling in a period drama of romance, deception, and murder. Play as a young cleric who must resist or surrender to the charms of a strikingly beautiful maid.

games.name: Haven
games.title: Haven

games.name: Realm of Ink

Only by breaking free can she unveil the truth of her existence and challenge the constraints of fate.

games.developerName: PlatinumGames Inc. / Team NINJA / KOEI TECMO GAMES CO., LTD.)

games.title: The Grinch: Christmas Adventures - Merry & Mischievous Edition

Greedland” is a roguelike game mixed with survivor-like elements.  It's reminiscent of Crimsonland and Vampire Survivors, and as the battle progresses your character will become a mobile arsenal of destruction!

Play Anywhere, Slay Everywhere: Greedland Hits Windows with Xbox Play Anywhere & Major 1.0 Update!

games.name: New Super Lucky's Tale

games.title: Ace Attorney Investigations Collection

Miles Edgeworth's dramatic turnabouts take center stage!

Experience both Ace Attorney Investigations games in one gorgeous collection!

Investigate crime scenes and solve tough, intriguing cases through logic and deduction.

When Edgeworth's past and present collide, his future begins!

games.name: Charon's Staircase

New Slugs such as a Drill Slug will also show up in gameplay, leading to even more fierce and exciting action!

games.name: The Last Case of John Morley
games.title: The Last Case of John Morley

games.name: Looney Tunes: Wacky World of Sports
games.title: Looney Tunes: Wacky World of Sports

games.name: Life is Strange: Reunion Deluxe Edition

games.name: A Little to the Left
games.title: A Little to the Left
games.description: A Little to the Left is a cozy puzzle game that has you sort, stack, and organize household items into pleasing arrangements while you keep an eye out for a mischievous cat with an inclination for chaos. Check out this playful and intuitive puzzler with 100+ satisfying messes to tidy.

games.name: Speedball
games.title: Speedball
games.description: Speedball is a no-holds-barred arena sport pitting two teams head-to-head in a pulse-racing match-up requiring speed, agility and aggression.

games.name: Bridge Constructor: The Walking Dead
games.title: Bridge Constructor: The Walking Dead
games.description: Prepare for the ultimate mashup experience! Bridge Constructor: The Walking Dead combines the legendary and challenging puzzle gameplay of Bridge Constructor™ with the post-apocalyptic zombie universe of AMC’s The Walking Dead.

games.name: Spray Paint Simulator
games.title: Spray Paint Simulator
games.description: Bring color to the world in Spray Paint Simulator! Restore worn-out surfaces with a fresh coat of paint and watch them come back to life. Use your spray tool with precision, cover every inch, and enjoy the satisfaction of a flawless finish.

games.name: Coffee Talk
games.title: Coffee Talk
games.description: Coffee Talk is a coffee brewing and heart-to-heart talking simulator about listening to fantasy-inspired modern peoples’ problems, and helping them by serving up a warm drink or two.

games.name: Lost Ember: Rekindled Edition
games.title: Lost Ember: Rekindled Edition
games.description: Explore the acclaimed animal adventure in never before seen beauty! Slip into the role of different animals to uncover the fate of an ancient world. Dive into deep waters, fly at lofty heights or even climb steep cliffs with a mountain goat, there are lots of ways of getting around.

games.name: Educational Family Games
games.title: Educational Family Games
games.description: Award-winning educational party fun for kids and families! Play 80 quick games across math, geography, science, logic & more in a 1-4 player violence-free family game, fully voiced in 19 languages.

games.name: DETECTIVE - Rainy Night
games.title: DETECTIVE - Rainy Night
games.description: Detective Rainy Night is a narrative adventure with elements of deduction. Violent crimes, mature stories, and a touch of psychological horror await you at the Motel Holiday. Grab a pencil and paper because solving this case won’t be easy.

games.name: Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess
games.title: Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess
games.description:
A new tale of the Kami awaits...
Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess is a unique Japanese-inspired, single player Kagura Action Strategy game.

games.name: Call of Heroes: Tower Defense
games.title: Call of Heroes: Tower Defense
games.description: Embark on a magical and exciting journey to protect the fairy kingdom in this epic TD game. Recruit unique heroes with powerful magic. Craft exclusive weapons for each hero. Defend the fairy kingdom!

games.name: Harvest Moon: Light of Hope SE Complete
games.title: Harvest Moon: Light of Hope SE Complete
games.description: Looking for a fresh start and some new surroundings, you set off on a voyage to begin your new life!

games.name: Whisper Of The House
games.title: Whisper Of The House
games.description: Whisper of the House is a cozy game about organizing and decorating. You'll take on various tasks from the townspeople—helping them move, organize, and clean their spaces. In the process, your gentle touch might make a difference in their lives, and perhaps uncover some hidden stories...

games.name: Before We Leave
games.title: Before We Leave
games.description: Before We Leave is a city building game set in a cozy corner of the universe. Nurture your Peeps and their surroundings while rebuilding and rediscovering civilisation. Settle new lands and planets while avoiding hungry Space Whales.

games.name: Bomb Rush Cyberfunk
games.title: Bomb Rush Cyberfunk
games.description: Bomb Rush Cyberfunk is 1 second per second of advanced funkstyle. Battle rival crews and dispatch militarized police to conquer the five boroughs of New Amsterdam. Become All City.

games.name: Children of Morta
games.title: Children of Morta
games.description: Children of Morta is a story-driven action RPG game about an extraordinary family of heroes. Lead the Bergons, with all their flaws and virtues, against the forthcoming Corruption. Will you be able to sacrifice everything to save the ones you care for?

games.name: Dragon Ruins II
games.title: Dragon Ruins II
games.description: Explore dungeons, grow stronger, and slay the dragon to become a hero!

games.name: Kabuto Park
games.title: Kabuto Park
games.description: Kabuto Park is a cute and short bug collection game.

games.name: Terrinoth®: Heroes of Descent
games.title: Terrinoth®: Heroes of Descent
games.description: Step into the world of Descent with the first fantasy co-op tactical RPG from the legendary dungeon crawling board game. Lead a company of heroes across Terrinoth®, survive epic boss battles in turn-based combat, and settle the fate of a world facing unending darkness.

games.name: The Karate Kid: Street Rumble
games.title: The Karate Kid: Street Rumble
games.description: Dominate the dojo in The Karate Kid: Street Rumble, a pixel art beat ‘em up adventure. Grab your friends for local co-op multiplayer and dive into the classic The Karate Kid journey with retro-style gameplay, dynamic combat, and epic boss battles.

games.name: EMPTY SHELL
games.title: EMPTY SHELL
games.description: Classic survival-horror fused with top-down roguelite shooter

games.name: DJMAX RESPECT V
games.title: DJMAX RESPECT V
games.description: DJMAX RESPECT V is the latest installment from the creators of the critically acclaimed rhythm game franchise ‘DJMAX.’ Experience tracks from popular artists such as Marshmello, Porter Robinson, and Yukika, exclusive Full HD Music Videos, online multiplayer, new game modes, and more!

games.name: PAW Patrol The Movie: Adventure City Calls
games.title: PAW Patrol The Movie: Adventure City Calls
games.description: Big city, bigger adventure! The PAW Patrol must save Adventure City from Mayor Humdinger’s selfish scheming - and they need YOU on Team PAWsome! Be the pups – including Chase, Skye, and streetwise Liberty – and use next-level gadgets to save the day, in this fun-for-all 3D platformer for one or two players.

games.name: Heroes of Mount Dragon
games.title: Heroes of Mount Dragon
games.description: Unleash dragon-morphing powers in this action-packed side-scrolling brawler! Choose from unique heroes, each with their own fighting style. Play couch co-op or online with up to 3 friends. Team up to defeat evil or compete for supremacy. Fun and accessible for all skill levels!

games.name: Airoheart
games.title: Airoheart
games.description: Airoheart is a top-down action-adventure RPG inspired by the classics. Embark on an epic journey to save the world from evil and test the strength of your heart in this emotional tale of betrayal, tragedy and redemption.

games.name: Goosebumps: Terror in Little Creek - Frightmare Edition
games.title: Goosebumps: Terror in Little Creek - Frightmare Edition
games.description:
The most-frightening Goosebumps bundle! Includes:
• Full Goosebumps: Terror in Little Creek base game
• 5 iconic monster masks (Slappy, Haunted Mask & more)
• Matching slingshot skins w/ custom VFX
• 3D Model Viewer
• Concept Art Gallery

games.name: Ember Knights : Heroes of the Nexus Edition
games.title: Ember Knights : Heroes of the Nexus Edition
games.description: Ember Knights is an action rogue-lite for 1-4 players where you play as legendary knights! Wield weapons & skills, build synergies with game-changing relics and face hordes of monsters and bosses. DLC Wrath of the Architect is included.

games.name: Fate Seeker II
games.title: Fate Seeker II
games.description:
It describes the growth story of young Zhuge Yu.
The sequel to the Fate Seeker series; Fate Seeker: Journey tells the story of the young "Zhuge Yu" who suffered a heavy accident and fell into a predicament of confusion and memory loss. 
Develop and strengthen abilities, challenge former enemies, and finally find yourself gradually.

games.name: Heading Out
games.title: Heading Out
games.description: Flee your fear and carve your legend on mythic highways. Choose your path, manage your fuel, and outrun danger in a roguelike road trip where every decision counts. This isn’t just a drive—it’s a chase, a journey, and a story only you can write.

games.name: Funguys Swarm
games.title: Funguys Swarm
games.description: Funguys Swarm is a cartoony survivor bullet hell where the forest is on fire. Become a Funguy, arm yourself with forest-crafted weapons, and unleash some bonkers powers on the Fireking’s army. And maybe... just maybe, save the day if you’re skilled (or lucky) enough.

games.name: Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii Deluxe Edition
games.title: Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii Deluxe Edition

games.name: Ghost Song
games.title: Ghost Song
games.description: On the desolate moon of Lorian, a long-dormant Deadsuit awakens from slumber. Journey beneath the surface on an atmospheric 2D adventure of self-discovery, ancient mysteries, and cosmic terror. Explore winding caverns and acquire new abilities to unearth this alien world’s long-buried secrets.

games.name: The Grinch: Christmas Adventures
games.title: The Grinch: Christmas Adventures
games.description: Have a great Grinchy time trying to stop Christmas in this festive platformer and help the Grinch’s heart grow three sizes along the way!

games.name: Syberia - Remastered
games.title: Syberia - Remastered
games.description: More than 20 years after its original release, Syberia is reborn in a fully modernized version. Rediscover its iconic locations and unforgettable characters through a stunning visual overhaul, redesigned gameplay, and the same captivating storytelling that made it a classic.

games.name: The Forgotten City
games.title: The Forgotten City
games.description: Travel 2,000 years into the past and relive the final days of a cursed Roman city, where if one person sins, everyone dies. Unravel the mystery at the city’s heart by exploiting its deadly time loop, questioning locals, exploring, and solving puzzles.

games.name: Wax Heads
games.title: Wax Heads
games.description: Wax Heads is a cozy-punk narrative sim about working in a struggling record store. Chat to quirky customers with unique tastes, explore a handcrafted record collection, fall in love with bands (and their drama!), or just slack off with your colleagues - whatever gets everyone’s groove back!

games.name: My Little Universe
games.title: My Little Universe
games.description: Stranded on a barren moon with nothing but your tools, fuelless ship, and celestial powers of creation, you are destined to recreate what was once lost and be the hero of your own Little Universe! Don't forget to call in up to three of your friends to join your journey in the Splitscreen Co-op Mode!

games.name: Minishoot' Adventures
games.title: Minishoot' Adventures
games.description: Fly into a charming handcrafted world and go on an adventure that mixes up open exploration with crispy twin-stick shooter action.

games.name: Fae Farm
games.title: Fae Farm
games.description: Escape to the magical life of your dreams in Fae Farm, a farm sim RPG for 1-4 players. Craft, cultivate, and decorate to grow your homestead, and use spells to explore the enchanted island of Azoria!

games.name: The 7th Guest Remake
games.title: The 7th Guest Remake
games.description: The iconic game The 7th Guest has been brought back to life with modern technology, delivering an atmospheric story like no other. Explore a foreboding mansion, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover its dark secrets. The 7th Guest is the ultimate mystery adventure, reimagined for modern platforms.

games.name: Changeable Guardian ESTIQUE
games.title: Changeable Guardian ESTIQUE
games.description: The ultimate brand-new 8-bit shmup created in the 21st century.

games.name: RIDE 6 - Ultimate Edition
games.title: RIDE 6 - Ultimate Edition
games.description: Live the ultimate challenge with RIDE 6 - Ultimate Edition. In addition to the full game, you'll get Season Pass Vol. 1 and Vol. 2 and you will obtain bikes, tracks and extra Career areas as soon as they become available.

games.name: Outbreak: Shades of Horror
games.title: Outbreak: Shades of Horror
games.description: Cross-platform Online 4-player co-op survival horror returns in this early 2000s-inspired, undead apocalyptic nightmare.

games.name: No More Slimes!!
games.title: No More Slimes!!
games.description: Defend the peaceful canyon from a mysterious slime army! As the lone fixer, hunt endless swarms with interdimensional mercenaries. Build your style with a vast skill tree and relics. Upgrade weapons for max firepower. Can you find the mastermind and save the canyon?

games.name: Kona II: Brume
games.title: Kona II: Brume
games.description: Northern Québec, 1970. A bizarre mist —the Brume— is disconnecting a rural mining village from its quiet reality.  Step into the shoes of Detective Carl Faubert as he unfolds the mysteries haunting the region while battling for his own survival.

games.name: The Smurfs - Village Party
games.title: The Smurfs - Village Party
games.description: Embark on a party game set in the Smurfs' Village, featuring an adventure mode!

games.name: Lonely Mountains: Downhill
games.title: Lonely Mountains: Downhill
games.description: Just you and your bike - take it on a thrilling ride down an unspoiled mountain landscape. Make your way through thick forests, narrow trails and wild rivers. Race, jump, slide and try not to crash - all the way from the peak to the valley!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO METAL SLUG 2
games.title: ACA NEOGEO METAL SLUG 2
games.description:
METAL SLUG 2 is an action game released by SNK in 1998.
Players can choose from Marko, Tarma, Eri and Fio, with the aim of defeating Morden’s Rebel Army which is plotting a coup once again. In addition to the Heavy Machine Guns and Shotguns from the previous games, new weapons such as laser guns have been added for even more battle variations.

games.name: Moon Mystery
games.title: Moon Mystery
games.description: The Moon's haunted - and when an astronaut loses contact with Earth, the adventure begins in full. Fill up your oxygen, load up the guns, and set out on an interstellar FPS adventure across the stars, filled with puzzles, fights, exploration, and strange secrets of the universe.

games.name: Alt Girl for Skoof - ALTiversary Edition
games.title: Alt Girl for Skoof - ALTiversary Edition
games.description: Choose your ideal & absolutely legal Alt Girl right now!

games.name: The Necromancer's Tale
games.title: The Necromancer's Tale
games.description: A story-rich gothic RPG. Master the rituals of an ancient spellbook. Raise an undead army to march against your enemies. Commune with the realm of the dead & struggle with your descent into madness. Progress through secrecy, diplomacy, blackmail, coercion & seduction until ready to reveal yourself.

games.name: Dragon Takers
games.title: Dragon Takers
games.description: Rise and resist the dragons in a fantasy RPG acquiring enemy skills!

games.name: Mokoko X
games.title: Mokoko X
games.description: Nostalgic arcade gameplay remastered! Conquer the bigger portion of the screen and save the unlucky girls from the various absurd troublemakers.

games.name: Galaxy Control: Arena
games.title: Galaxy Control: Arena
games.description: Duel players from around the world in real-time

games.name: ARC SEED
games.title: ARC SEED
games.description: Face the interstellar Archangels in a turn-based tactical game with deckbuilding elements and destructible environment, where you pilot powerful mechs to save the Earth from destruction.

games.name: Five Dates
games.title: Five Dates
games.description: Five Dates is an interactive rom-com about the unpredictable world of digital dating. With five potential female matches, Vinny explores whether compatibility, chemistry and connection is still possible in a world where physical touch is no longer an option.

games.name: World War II City Rebirth Tycoon
games.title: World War II City Rebirth Tycoon

games.name: BAD END THEATER
games.title: BAD END THEATER
games.description: An experience where you have the power to determine the destinies of four unique protagonists. As you navigate through various choices and collect endings, you'll slowly uncover the true story of tragedy itself.

games.name: Maid of Sker
games.title: Maid of Sker
games.description:
Brave the nightmares of the Quiet Ones. Do not panic…don’t even breathe!

Maid of Sker is a first-person survival horror, set in a remote hotel with a gory and macabre history from British folklore. Inspired by the haunting tales of Elisabeth Williams, discover a suffocating family secret with stealth tactics amongst sound-based AI enemies.

games.name: EVERSPACE™
games.title: EVERSPACE™
games.description: EVERSPACE™ combines fast-paced combat with roguelike elements, great visuals and a captivating story. It takes you on a challenging journey through an ever-changing, beautifully crafted universe full of surprises. Shoot, craft and loot your way to victory while the odds are stacked against you.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO METAL SLUG 4
games.title: ACA NEOGEO METAL SLUG 4
games.description: METAL SLUG 4 is an action shooting game released by SNK in 2002. It is the fifth title in the METAL SLUG series. In addition to Marco and Fio, new characters Trevor and Nadia have joined the battle! Aim for the high score as you play with new items and the new Metallish System.

games.name: Hatsune Miku - The Planet Of Wonder And Fragments Of Wishes
games.title: Hatsune Miku - The Planet Of Wonder And Fragments Of Wishes
games.description: Explore a planet full of wonders with Miku and friends!

games.name: Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus and Butterfly
games.title: Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus and Butterfly
games.description: A coffee-brewing and heart-to-heart talking simulation.

games.name: OCTOPATH TRAVELER II
games.title: OCTOPATH TRAVELER II
games.description:
In the world of Solistia, eight new travelers venture forth into an exciting new era.
Where will you go? What will you do? Whose tale will you bring to life?
Every path is yours to take. 
Embark on an adventure all your own.

games.name: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival
games.title: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival
games.description:
Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival is a drum-based rhythm game featuring songs from genres such as Anime and VOCALOID™, and also a variety of game modes!
Have fun playing solo or online!

games.name: Pathologic 3
games.title: Pathologic 3
games.description: Save a town from a mysterious plague in this in narrative first-person RPG. Learn the stories of its unusual inhabitants. Shape their lives with your decrees. Diagnose patients. Connect the dots. Find out who killed the immortal man. Correct your mistakes in the past.

games.name: Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance Digital Deluxe Edition
games.title: Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance Digital Deluxe Edition
games.description: The Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance Digital Deluxe Edition bundles the base game with all purchasable DLC content including three Mitama items and two Demon Subquests.

games.name: RESEARCH and DESTROY
games.title: RESEARCH and DESTROY
games.description: RESEARCH and DESTROY is a TURN-BASED ACTION GAME with simultaneous local or online co-op. Take control of three brilliant scientists as you RESEARCH and develop strange new weapons and gadgets to DESTROY the Supernatural hordes that have all but crushed humanity!

games.name: DIRT 5 Year One Edition
games.title: DIRT 5 Year One Edition
games.description: Punch your ticket to a host of incredible DIRT 5 perks and content by purchasing the Year 1 Edition, ensuring you have the keys to everything the boldest, bravest off-road racing game has to offer at launch, and are first in line for everything we create in Year 1!

games.name: Dustwind: Resistance
games.title: Dustwind: Resistance
games.description: Dustwind: Resistance is a single-player tactical game. Lead your squad—including your dog—against a brutal raider army. Pause to plan tactics. Use brutal firepower, stealth, traps, turrets, or an armored car to outmaneuver enemies. Protect your home and freedom. No surrender!

games.name: Bleeding Edge
games.title: Bleeding Edge
games.description: Team Up. Cause Chaos. Grab your team and tear it up in Bleeding Edge, an electrifying online brawler where every fighter comes mechanically enhanced for mayhem!

games.name: Wind Peaks
games.title: Wind Peaks
games.description: In a place called Wind Peaks, mysteries happen, help the scouts find all the missing objects in this fun and relaxing adventure of treasure hunt.

games.name: Volcano Princess
games.title: Volcano Princess
games.description: Prepare the next monarch by finding her hobbies, training her for battle, and befriending the citizens she'll one day protect. Dive into an all-new parenting-simulator-RPG adventure, where every decision you make will not only affect the future of your daughter but that of an entire empire!

games.name: Goosebumps: Terror in Little Creek
games.title: Goosebumps: Terror in Little Creek
games.description: Enter the chilling world of Goosebumps in Goosebumps: Terror in Little Creek! Unravel eerie mysteries, confront sinister monsters, and navigate haunted locations inspired by R.L. Stine’s legendary books —all while experiencing the Goosebumps signature blend of spooky adventure and playful twists

games.name: Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S+
games.title: Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S+
games.description: Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S+ is coming to Microsoft Store!

games.name: OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0 Digital Deluxe Edition
games.title: OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0 Digital Deluxe Edition
games.description:
Embark on an adventure of your own creation.
The latest in the OCTOPATH TRAVELER series

games.name: Midnight Fight Express
games.title: Midnight Fight Express
games.description: A former member of the criminal underworld is lured back into “the life” by a mysterious drone claiming they have until sunrise to prevent a citywide criminal takeover together.

games.name: D.U.M.B.E.R. Ducks
games.title: D.U.M.B.E.R. Ducks
games.description: The D.U.M.B. ducks are back for an Emergency Rescue!

games.name: The Bunker
games.title: The Bunker
games.description: As the last remaining survivor in a nuclear bunker, John’s daily routine is the one thing that keeps him sane. But when an alarm goes off, his mind starts to self-destruct. The Bunker is a live-action psychological horror game starring Adam Brown (The Hobbit) and Sarah Greene (Penny Dreadful) with writing talent behind The Witcher, Broken Sword and SOMA.

games.name: The Smurfs – Dreams
games.title: The Smurfs – Dreams
games.description: The fate of the Smurf Village rests in your dreams: dive into a fantastic journey to save it in this fully immersive and magical 3D platformer!

games.name: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined Digital Deluxe Edition
games.title: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined Digital Deluxe Edition
games.description: Unravel the mysteries of the past in DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined! Gather your companions and travel beyond the shores of your small kingdom to discover why it is the only remaining island in the world.

games.name: art of rally
games.title: art of rally
games.description: Race in the golden era of rally. Drive iconic cars from the 60s to Group B on challenging stages through stylized environments inspired by real worldwide locations. Will you master the art of rally?

games.name: The Knight Witch
games.title: The Knight Witch
games.developer: Super Awesome Hyper Dimensional Mega Team
games.description: The Knight Witch is a metroidvania adventure game with fast-paced, shoot 'em up combat set in a beautifully hand-drawn world. Cast devastating card-based spells, forge close bonds, and make moral choices all in your quest to save your home and discover who's behind the War Golem invasion.
games.developerName: Super Awesome Hyper Dimensional Mega Team

games.name: Nobody Saves the World
games.title: Nobody Saves the World
games.description: A shape-changing, ability-blending Action-RPG! Change forms, combine abilities, save the world!

games.name: Allison's Diary: Rebirth
games.title: Allison's Diary: Rebirth
