games.description: Immerse yourself into this terrifying first person horror adventure, where you will have to explore and search for the truth about the night Allison killed her parents, while trying to survive against the darkness.

games.name: Arcade Paradise
games.title: Arcade Paradise
games.description: With keys to the family laundromat but plans for something bigger, Ashley must stay one step ahead and manage profits in order to build an Arcade Paradise!

games.name: NITRO GEN OMEGA
games.title: NITRO GEN OMEGA
games.description: A sandbox tactical RPG of steel, fire, friendship, and shonen anime. Assemble your crew, customize your Mech, and lead them in cinematic turn-based battles through a world ruled by rogue AI. The bonds you forge will decide who survives!

games.name: Persona 4 Revival: Digital Deluxe Edition
games.title: Persona 4 Revival: Digital Deluxe Edition
games.description:
Step into a Supernatural Turn-Based RPG Adventure 
Solve Mysteries, Strengthen Bonds, and Awaken Your Persona 

Take your Persona 4 Revival experience to the next level with the Digital Deluxe Edition, featuring the base game alongside deluxe add-ons designed to enhance your journey through Inaba and the Midnight Channel.

games.name: Bratz® Rhythm & Style
games.title: Bratz® Rhythm & Style
games.description: Rule the runway and take the stage with the Bratz Pack! Customize fierce fashions, groove to songs from the Bratz Universe like ‘So Good’, and jet off to iconic cities. Outshine mean Burdine and the Tweevil Twins in epic fashion battles—solo or with friends.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO PREHISTORIC ISLE 2
games.title: ACA NEOGEO PREHISTORIC ISLE 2
games.description: PREHISTORIC ISLE 2 is a shooting game released by SNK in 1999. Dinosaurs large, small, and winged have appeared in the city, and these primeval beasts must be taken out. Rescue the trapped citizens and help them escape as you progress. Experience a variety of stages and colorful settings.

games.name: Bee With Gun
games.title: Bee With Gun
games.description: Help this bee save the entire hive.

games.name: One Card One Shot - Mafia
games.title: One Card One Shot - Mafia
games.description: The first Sniper Card Game: infiltrate the mafia underworld with cards, precise aim, and quick choices. Each mission brings new enemies and unique surprises. One shot can seal the contract… or your life.

games.name: Gears Triple Bundle
games.title: Gears Triple Bundle
games.description: Squad up for Gears 5, Gears Tactics and the Gears 5: Hivebusters expansion. From the early days of the Locust war to the jungles of the Galangi islands, experience the pivotal moments in the wars to save Sera. This bundle is optimized for Xbox Series X|S.

games.name: Arkanoid Eternal Battle
games.title: Arkanoid Eternal Battle
games.description:
Discover or re-discover, the emblematic block breaker game in a fully modernized version! Classic elements from the franchise will definitely make a comeback, with a brand-new look, new rules, as well as new effects, bonuses and features! Including, for the very first time, a Battle Royale mode called ""Eternal Battle"".  
Guaranteed to take veteran players by surprise!

games.name: Space Warlord Baby Trading Simulator
games.title: Space Warlord Baby Trading Simulator
games.description: Buy low, sell high, and short an entire universe of babies in this arcade stock market sim set in the world of Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator.

games.name: Snoopy & The Great Mystery Club - Deluxe Edition
games.title: Snoopy & The Great Mystery Club - Deluxe Edition
games.description: Take flight, hit the race track, and join Snoopy for an adventure like no other! The Snoopy & The Great Mystery Club – DELUXE EDITION includes the full standard-game, PLUS four exciting mini-games, the legendary Joe Cool outfit, and an ultimate collection of 75 full-color Peanuts comics.

games.name: Dragon Ruins
games.title: Dragon Ruins
games.description: Explore ancient ruins and defeat the dragon in a dungeon crawler RPG!

games.name: Trident's Tale
games.title: Trident's Tale
games.description: Uncover the Secrets of the Storm Trident and Rule the Seas - Your Legend Awaits in Trident's Tale!

games.name: Mini Tank Mayhem
games.title: Mini Tank Mayhem
games.description: Mini Tank Mayhem is a roguelike deck-building tower defense game where you command a powerful mini-tank to repel waves of alien invaders. Craft your very own deck, deploy strategic defenses, and unleash devastating combos to protect Earth from pesky aliens!

games.name: DESOLATIUM
games.title: DESOLATIUM
games.description: DESOLATIUM is a new graphic adventure based on Lovecraft mythos. Investigate the mysterious disappearance of a friend through the eyes of 4 different characters and discover a dark path filled with Lovecraftian myths and creatures.

games.name: Hidden Cats in Spooky Village
games.title: Hidden Cats in Spooky Village
games.description: Seek the whiskers in the dark... Find the cats in the Spooky Village!

games.name: Full Throttle Remastered
games.title: Full Throttle Remastered
games.description: A classic graphic adventure game from industry legend Tim Schafer, telling the story of Ben Throttle, the butt-kicking leader of biker gang the Polecats who gets caught up in a tale of Motorcycles, Mayhem, and Murder.

games.name: Archerio
games.title: Archerio
games.description: Archerio is a fast-paced action roguelite where precision, reflexes, and smart upgrades decide your fate.

games.name: Grim Fandango Remastered
games.title: Grim Fandango Remastered
games.description: Grim Fandango's epic story of four years in the life (or death) of Manny Calavera, travel agent to the dead, has been remastered to look, sound, and control even better than when it won GameSpot's Game of the Year award upon its original launch.

games.name: Lethal League Blaze
games.title: Lethal League Blaze
games.description: Lethal League Blaze is an intense, high speed ball game, with unique characters, outta sight sounds and none of that weak stuff. In Shine City, the anti-gravity ball game has long been illegal. The group who kept playing was dubbed the Lethal League. Even now, with their sport pushed underground, players and crews compete in the League for challenge and respect.

games.name: Carnage: Battle Arena
games.title: Carnage: Battle Arena
games.description: Unleash chaos in Carnage Battle Arena! Smash, race, and survive in blocky, retro-styled mayhem. 82 cars, dozens of maps, epic destruction, and game-changing power-ups await. Master multiple modes like Death Match, Survival, and Racing. Get ready for nonstop adrenaline! 🚗🔥

games.name: Forza Horizon 5 Premium Add-Ons Bundle
games.title: Forza Horizon 5 Premium Add-Ons Bundle
games.description: The Forza Horizon 5 Premium Add-Ons Bundle includes Forza Horizon 5: Rally Adventure, Forza Horizon 5: Hot Wheels, VIP, Car Pass and the Welcome Pack. This add-on requires Forza Horizon 5 (game sold separately).

games.name: ACA NEOGEO THE KING OF FIGHTERS '98
games.title: ACA NEOGEO THE KING OF FIGHTERS '98
games.description:
THE KING OF FIGHTERS '98 is a fighting game released by SNK in 1998.
In the previous installment KOF' 97, the story of the "Orochi Saga" reached its exciting conclusion. As a result, the next entry in the series THE KING OF FIGHTERS '98 was released as a dream match version of THE KING OF FIGHTERS Series.
It is one of the most popular and well known versions of the game, partially thanks to the many balance changes that received high praise from fans around the world.

games.name: Dinosaur Fossil Hunter - Paleontology Simulator
games.title: Dinosaur Fossil Hunter - Paleontology Simulator
games.description: Paleontology Simulator

games.name: Prodeus
games.title: Prodeus
games.description: Prodeus is a first-person shooter of old, re-imagined using modern rendering techniques and technology. Experience the quality you’d expect from a modern AAA game, designed with retro aesthetics and gameplay that invoke the tech-imposed limits of older hardware.

games.name: Crypt Custodian
games.title: Crypt Custodian
games.description: Sweep up the afterlife as Pluto the cat in this charming action adventure/Metroidvania about life, relationships, and moving on.

games.name: LEGRAND LEGACY: Tale of the Fatebounds
games.title: LEGRAND LEGACY: Tale of the Fatebounds
games.description: Join the Fatebounds as they travel the world of Legrand in a desperate attempt to stop the Mugna Feud, a war of unparalleled savagery, and uncover the sinister forces behind it!

games.name: The Bard's Tale ARPG : Remastered and Resnarkled
games.title: The Bard's Tale ARPG : Remastered and Resnarkled
games.description: You are the Bard, a selfish rogue weary of pointless sub-quests and rat-infested cellars. Through magical song you summon characters to join your quest!

games.name: Ashen
games.title: Ashen
games.description: Ashen is an open world co-op action RPG about a wanderer in search of a place to call home.

games.name: Dora™: Rainforest Rescue
games.title: Dora™: Rainforest Rescue
games.description: Are you ready for an interactive adventure with Dora and her amigos? Stop Swiper, fix the Duplicator and restore the Alejibre tree. !Vámonos! Let’s go!

games.name: Bioweaver
games.title: Bioweaver
games.description: Bioweaver is an RPG game with the main content of treasure hunting and character building. You can use basic programming logic to deeply customize your skill sets, and you can also create organs with different attributes and functions with the special crafting system.

games.name: Metal: Hellsinger - Complete Edition
games.title: Metal: Hellsinger - Complete Edition
games.description: Dig your claws into the complete Metal: Hellsinger experience with the base game and all DLCs, containing more original and licensed music, new weapons, and new outfits.

games.name: Hot Wheels Monster Trucks: Stunt Mayhem™
games.title: Hot Wheels Monster Trucks: Stunt Mayhem™
games.description: Hot Wheels™ Monster Trucks are ready to catch some wild air and perform insane stunts while smashing and bashing through fantastical arenas in a new game that brings your favorite monster trucks to your fingertips!

games.name: Dreamscaper
games.title: Dreamscaper
games.description: By night, delve deep into your subconscious and discover powerful artifacts to conquer your nightmares. By day, explore the city of Redhaven and build relationships to unlock the power of your dreams. DREAM. DIE. WAKE. REPEAT.

games.name: Miraculous: Paris Under Siege - Deluxe Edition
games.title: Miraculous: Paris Under Siege - Deluxe Edition
games.description: Miraculous: Paris Under Siege - Deluxe Edition contains the base game,  as well as an exclusive Digital Art Book, two new outfits, and two new visual effects for Ladybug and Cat Noir.

games.name: Construction Simulator - Titanium Edition
games.title: Construction Simulator - Titanium Edition
games.description: The Construction Simulator – Titanium Edition is your perfect entry into the fascinating world of construction and heavy machinery.

games.name: Spell Disk
games.title: Spell Disk
games.description: Build unique synergy spell combos to destroy the hordes of monsters and bosses in this rogue-lite action game.

games.name: Let Them Come: Onslaught
games.title: Let Them Come: Onslaught
games.description: Battle alien swarms and build your loadout in this fast-paced roguelite shooter. Try the free demo of Let Them Come: Onslaught and experience explosive weapon upgrades, intense bullet heaven combat, and retro sci-fi action. Survive, upgrade, and unleash hell!

games.name: Jusant
games.title: Jusant
games.description: Enjoy meditative vibes in Jusant, an action-puzzle climbing game. Scale an immeasurably tall tower and ascend to new heights alongside your watery companion. Master your climbing tools, find your way up through diverse biomes, and piece together the tower’s past.

games.name: Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney Trilogy
games.title: Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney Trilogy
games.description: Join rookie attorney Apollo Justice and his mentor, the legendary Phoenix Wright, in this collection of 3 games! This title features 16 episodes (including previously DLC-only episodes) and supports English, French, German, Japanese Korean, and Traditional and Simplified Chinese.

games.name: Kentum
games.title: Kentum
games.description: Crafting, cloning, and comedy await in this survival-infused metroidvania adventure. Wake up as the last human alive on a wondrous and weird future Earth. Seek out supplies, build machines, platform through mysterious biomes, unceremoniously die, and reclone on your mission to rebuild civilization.

games.name: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales Digital Deluxe Edition
games.title: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales Digital Deluxe Edition
games.description: Hope is Timeless

games.name: Astria Ascending
games.title: Astria Ascending
games.description: As one of the Fated Eight, explore the world of Orcanon where twelve ancient beasts dwell, and fight against your destiny to save the world in this hand-drawn, turn-based RPG

games.name: Montabi
games.title: Montabi
games.description: Tame, collect, fight! Assemble an unstoppable team of unique Montabi in this Creature-Collector Roguelike Deckbuilder. Master their awesome abilities, synergize their strategic strengths and save the city in tactical turn-based combat!

games.name: PAC-MAN MUSEUM+
games.title: PAC-MAN MUSEUM+
games.description:
PAC-MAN MUSEUM+ includes 14 titles from the legendary PAC-MAN series!

Play a variety of classic and nostalgic PAC-MAN games across many genres!

games.name: Agatha Christie - Murder on the Orient Express
games.title: Agatha Christie - Murder on the Orient Express
games.description: Step on board the legendary Orient Express and immerse yourself in the most famous detective suit in a race against the clock to unmask the murderer.

games.name: Call of Toys: Tower Defense!
games.title: Call of Toys: Tower Defense!
games.description: Embark on an exhilarating journey to protect Santa's Valley in this epic Tower Defense game. Explore an arsenal of 13 unique towers, each equipped with magical spells and exclusive abilities. Customize your towers with numerous upgrades that enhance their strength and unlock new magical powers.

games.name: The Jackbox Survey Scramble
games.title: The Jackbox Survey Scramble
games.description: Discover how people across the country think! The Jackbox Survey Scramble is a collection of hilarious survey-based games, using real one-word answers from real people. Really! Learn more about humanity by guessing the most popular and least popular choices in Hilo, compete with your friends to guess as many answers as quickly as possible in Speed, discover answers to get three-in-a-row in Squares, and compete with your team to score more points in the competitive Bounce.

games.name: Tony Hawk's™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4 - Digital Deluxe Edition
games.title: Tony Hawk's™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4 - Digital Deluxe Edition
games.description:
Purchase the Digital Deluxe Edition to skate as the Doom Slayer and rip and tear through a ton of additional content.

Get hyped for the legendary franchise to return with Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4. Everything you loved is back, but revamped with more skaters, new parks, gnarlier tricks, eardrum shattering music, plus a whole lot more.

games.name: Hole io
games.title: Hole io
games.description: Show who is the biggest black hole in town!

games.name: Remnant II® - Deluxe Edition
games.title: Remnant II® - Deluxe Edition
games.description: Remnant II® pits survivors of humanity against new deadly creatures and god-like bosses across terrifying worlds. Play solo or co-op with two other friends to explore the depths of the unknown to stop an evil from destroying reality itself.

games.name: Ultros
games.title: Ultros
games.description: Break the cycle – Deliver the demon

games.name: Townscaper
games.title: Townscaper
games.description: Instant town building toy. Place housing blocks and watch them transform, piece by piece, into idyllic ocean-side towns, pastoral gardens, or sweeping cities on the sea.

games.name: Death Come True
games.title: Death Come True
games.description: Everything rides on your choices in this new wave interactive movie game. Experience a thrilling science fiction mystery in full-length live-action format—from genius creator of the "Danganronpa" series, Kazutaka Kodaka!

games.name: Don't Starve: Giant Edition
games.title: Don't Starve: Giant Edition
games.description:
Don’t Starve: Giant Edition is an uncompromising wilderness survival game full of science and magic. 

You play as Wilson, an intrepid Gentleman Scientist who has been trapped by a demon and transported to a mysterious wilderness world. Wilson must learn to exploit his environment and its inhabitants if he ever hopes to escape and find his way back home.

games.name: Golftacular!
games.title: Golftacular!
games.description: Mini-golf turned upside down! Abuse wild items on a variety of challenging golf tours. Shoot, fly, explode, and whatever else you can to get in the hole! It’s golf... barely.

games.name: Lil Gator Game
games.title: Lil Gator Game
games.description: Embark on an adorable adventure, discover new friends and uncover everything the island has to offer. Climb, Swim, Glide and slide your way into the hearts of the many different characters you meet on your travels!

games.name: Johnny Trigger
games.title: Johnny Trigger
games.description: Looking for action? Here’s Johnny!

games.name: Beholder: Conductor
games.title: Beholder: Conductor
games.description: A Beholder series spin-off. Become a conductor of the Determination Bringer train: monitor passengers, report incidents, and carry out important Ministry assignments — whose level of secrecy depends only on your loyalty. And remember: mission success is very important to you!

games.name: Loop Hero
games.title: Loop Hero
games.description: The Lich has thrown the world into a timeless loop and plunged its inhabitants into neverending chaos. Wield an expanding deck of mystical cards to place enemies, buildings, and terrain along each unique expedition loop for the brave hero.

games.name: Lake
games.title: Lake
games.description: It's 1986 - Meredith Weiss takes a break from her career in the big city to deliver mail in her hometown. How will she experience two weeks in beautiful Providence Oaks, with its iconic lake and quirky community? And what will she do next? It's up to you.

games.name: Boyfriend Dungeon
games.title: Boyfriend Dungeon
games.description: Date your weapons! Level up your love in this “shack-and-slash” dungeon crawling adventure.

games.name: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle™: Digital Premium Upgrade
games.title: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle™: Digital Premium Upgrade
games.description: Live the adventure with the Premium Upgrade to receive Indiana Jones and the Great Circle™: The Order of Giants Story DLC, a digital art book, and the Temple of Doom™ Outfit, Indy’s iconic look as seen in Temple of Doom™. Base Game not included.

games.name: Imagine Earth
games.title: Imagine Earth
games.description: In this build-up strategy game you build global colonies on distant planets. Establish space trade and research to lead your corporation into wealth and prosperity. Find allies, compete against rivals, and protect your civilization from natural disasters and climate change.

games.name: Hidden Cats in Christmas
games.title: Hidden Cats in Christmas
games.description: Reveal the magic of Christmas colors with the Hidden Cats!

games.name: Never Grave: The Witch and The Curse
games.title: Never Grave: The Witch and The Curse
games.description: A Metroidvania x Roguelite where you journey with the aid of a cursed hat. Use a variety of magic or possess your enemies to reach the lowest levels! Bring back loot, build new facilities in your village, make a living and strengthen yourself for the next battle! Supports up to 4-player multiplayer.

games.name: Golfing in Aether
games.title: Golfing in Aether
games.description: Minigolf for up to 16 players online, or 4 players via split screen. Features randomized course layout allowing you to experience something different every time you play.

games.name: Yerba Buena
games.title: Yerba Buena
games.description: Dive into a surreal 1970s gameworld and save San Francisco from a sinister threat. Play as Barb, and use the Oscillator to capture and reapply the physical traits of objects to solve mind-bending environmental platforming puzzles.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO THE KING OF FIGHTERS 2003
games.title: ACA NEOGEO THE KING OF FIGHTERS 2003
games.description:
THE KING OF FIGHTERS 2003 is a fighting game released by SNK in 2003.
It features the same 3-on-3 battle system as the previous title in the series, but this time players are able to use the "Multi-Shift" format to freely tag in team members for speedier gameplay. A new character named ASH is also introduced, marking the beginning of a new chapter for the series!

games.name: Wheel World
games.title: Wheel World
games.description: Dive into Wheel World as Kat, a rider chosen by ancient cycling spirits. Race elite teams, trick out your bike, and perform the long overdue Great Shift ritual to save a universe on the brink! Your bike is your destiny.

games.name: Observation
games.title: Observation
games.description: Observation is a sci-fi thriller uncovering what happened to Dr. Emma Fisher, and the crew of her mission, through the lens of the station’s artificial intelligence S.A.M.

games.name: Trash Raccoon
games.title: Trash Raccoon
games.description: You play as a speedy raccoon on his quest for snacks. Collect fruits that make you strong and break those sweet trash cans open! Unlock fancy skins and powerful upgrades while enjoying hand-crafted art and music.

games.name: The Bard's Tale IV: Director's Cut
games.title: The Bard's Tale IV: Director's Cut
games.description: The Bard's Tale IV: Director’s Cut is the triumphant return of one of the most iconic RPG series of all-time. Delve into a tactically rich combat system that rewards creativity, solve puzzles to gain treasure and advantages, and discover a beautifully crafted world.

games.name: Stable Stories - Forest and Meadow Ride
games.title: Stable Stories - Forest and Meadow Ride

games.name: 70s-style Robot Anime Geppy-X
games.title: 70s-style Robot Anime Geppy-X
games.description:
A fully remastered 70s-style super robot anime meets fast-paced arcade-style 2D side-scrolling shooter action.
A Japanese cult classic finally available worldwide — now reborn in HD.

games.name: This War of Mine: Final Cut
games.title: This War of Mine: Final Cut
games.description: In This War Of Mine, you do not play as an elite soldier, rather as a group of civilians trying to survive in a besieged city; struggling with a lack of food, medicine and constant danger from snipers and hostile scavengers.

games.name: Ghetto Zombies: Graffiti Squad
games.title: Ghetto Zombies: Graffiti Squad
games.description: Expect blasts of green zombie goo painting the screen in this top-down shooter packed with crazy guns that blow the heads off some… freaky zombies. Your mission is simple: graffiti the whole city before these mutants dog-pile you

games.name: Robots at Midnight
games.title: Robots at Midnight
games.description: Bash through gangs of hostile robots and corrupt bosses in this punchy Action-RPG. As Zoe, a scrappy agile hero, you’ll search for your past while fighting for the future. Just be home before midnight.

games.name: K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut
games.title: K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut
games.description:
The ultimate crossover between K-pop and Life Simulation! Step into the role of manager and build your dream idol group by scouting talent, managing schedules, choosing outfits, planning social media, and organizing the perfect album.
Can you make it to debut?

games.name: Beat The Champions
games.title: Beat The Champions
games.description: A fast-paced arcade football game with legendary players and special abilities.

games.name: Evil Genius 2: World Domination
games.title: Evil Genius 2: World Domination
games.description: Evil Genius 2 is a satirical spy-fi lair builder, where players take control of an Evil Genius and set their plans for world domination in motion. When it feels this good to be bad, the Forces of Justice don’t stand a chance!

games.name: SWORN - Digital Deluxe Edition
games.title: SWORN - Digital Deluxe Edition
games.description: Take the battle to Arthur in style with Deluxe Edition, giving you access to the ultimate collection of cosmetic upgrades for SWORN.

games.name: Save My Scrap
games.title: Save My Scrap
games.description: A puzzle adventure where you repair androids to uncover the secrets of the past.

games.name: Monster Hunter Rise Deluxe Edition
games.title: Monster Hunter Rise Deluxe Edition
games.description: Includes Monster Hunter Rise and the Deluxe Kit content in one package!

games.name: Railroads Online
games.title: Railroads Online
games.description: Build your dream railroad across a huge open world! You can build tracks and stations, drive detailed locomotives, and transport goods to earn money and experience. Play exciting Online Multiplayer sessions with your friends or create your very own sandbox!

games.name: Arsene Lupin - Once A Thief
games.title: Arsene Lupin - Once A Thief
games.description: Discover the youth of a legend - Experience the transformation of Arsene Lupin, from whimsical thief to legendary hero, in 'Arsene Lupin - Once a Thief', an adventure and investigation game freely adapted from the works of Maurice Leblanc, with its events unfolding in the early 20th century.

games.name: Neon White
games.title: Neon White
games.description: Neon White is a lightning fast first-person action platformer set beyond the pearly gates of Heaven.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO TOP PLAYERS GOLF
games.title: ACA NEOGEO TOP PLAYERS GOLF
games.description: TOP PLAYER’S GOLF is a sports game released in 1990 by SNK. Three modes, STROKE PLAY, MATCH PLAY, and NASSAU GAME, are available along with two types of courses. You'll find yourself fully absorbed in this game's immersive graphics and strategic skill planning.

games.name: Preserve
games.title: Preserve
games.description: Preserve is a relaxing puzzle nature-building game in which you flourish a vibrant ecosystem by cleverly placing plants and animals to create a perfect symbiosis to your liking.

games.name: Exo One
games.title: Exo One
games.description: A strange signal... an alien craft... Exo One is an interplanetary, gravity-defying journey through space and time.

games.name: Cuisineer
games.title: Cuisineer
games.description: A super cute and tasty roguelite-flavored dungeon crawler! Explore a lush world and defeat monsters with your trusty spatula and some boba tea, then gather delicious ingredients and bring them home to cook and serve at your restaurant!

games.name: Dicey Dungeons
games.title: Dicey Dungeons
games.description: Become a giant walking dice and battle to the end of an ever-changing dungeon! Can you escape the cruel whims of Lady Luck?

games.name: The Empty Desk
games.title: The Empty Desk
games.description: Immerse yourself in a psychological thriller with narrative adventure elements and unsettling details. Join Detective Bennett on his final case and uncover dark secrets in a world where reality bends and sanity wavers.

games.name: Snoopy & The Great Mystery Club
games.title: Snoopy & The Great Mystery Club
games.description: Join Snoopy and the gang in an all-new mystery adventure packed with charm, clever puzzles, and heartwarming friendships! Step into Snoopy’s paws and detective hat as you explore the town, solve challenging cases, and uncover hidden secrets—with help from the lovable Peanuts gang.

games.name: Dodo Duckie
games.title: Dodo Duckie
games.description: You’re a DUCK! with one special cap that gives you the power to switch between 2D and 3D. Use it to explore, switch perspectives, solve puzzles and save your chicken friends.

games.name: Samurai Aces III: Sengoku Cannon
games.title: Samurai Aces III: Sengoku Cannon
games.description:
Fire the exciting cannon shot!
The Japanese-style shooter with quirky aesthetics is back for a third go!
Now with online rankings!

games.name: Mad Streets
games.title: Mad Streets
games.description: Mad Streets is the kind of game that makes you crack a smile all while punching some one in the face.

games.name: Cash Cleaner Simulator: The Complete Collection
games.title: Cash Cleaner Simulator: The Complete Collection
games.description: Check it, clean it, sort it, ship it. Don't just take jobs from underworld contacts and clean some cash, but do it in style with additional cosmetics and even a new money gun as you upgrade your base game of Cash Cleaner Simulator with three expansive DLCs...

games.name: Paper Bad
games.title: Paper Bad
games.description: The Most Chaotic Paper Route Ever!

games.name: Bunny Park
games.title: Bunny Park
games.description: Manage your own bunny park! Give snacks and toys to your bunnies. Improve and decorate your park to increase its popularity and collect all the bunnies!

games.name: Project Winter
games.title: Project Winter
games.description: Project Winter 2.0: Cabin Fever is an 8-player survival and social deception game where teamwork is vital, but betrayal is inevitable. Face the wilderness, uncover traitors, and survive paranoia in this streamlined yet chaotic multiplayer experience.

games.name: People of Note
games.title: People of Note
games.description: In this turn-based RPG musical, join pop singer Cadence as she recruits an ensemble of musicians on her quest for stardom.

games.name: Into the Pit
games.title: Into the Pit
games.description: A fast-paced retro-FPS roguelite! As a member of a family of lore-hunting mystics you are summoned to a cursed village, drawn by rumors of a demonic portal. Dark magics have overwhelmed the village, It's up to you to rescue the survivors, grow your powers, and journey forth INTO THE PIT.

games.name: to a T
games.title: to a T
games.description: A charming, colorful adventure game from the creator of Katamari Damacy and the uvula team about a teen navigating life in a small town with their cute dog companion. While their body is stuck in a T-pose, they do their best to make the most of it.

games.name: The Elf on the Shelf®: Christmas Heroes
games.title: The Elf on the Shelf®: Christmas Heroes
games.description: Santa needs you! Become a Scout Elf, gathering Christmas Spirit and dodging obstacles. Pledge to make things merry and be a Christmas Hero!

games.name: Turmoil
games.title: Turmoil
games.description: Drill for oil like it's 1899! Turmoil offers players a visually charming, tongue-in-cheek take on the simulation genre inspired by the 19th century oil rush in North America.

games.name: Forza Motorsport Deluxe Edition
games.title: Forza Motorsport Deluxe Edition
games.description: Race over 500 real-world cars including modern race cars and more than 100 cars new to Forza Motorsport. Make every lap count across 30 living tracks with multiple layouts to master and fan-favorite locations Fujimi Kaido, Nürburgring Nordschleife and Sunset Peninsula, each featuring live on-track scoring, fully dynamic time-of-day with weather and unique driving conditions that ensure no two laps ever look or play the same. Celebrate 20 Years of Forza Motorsport in the 20th Anniversary Tour and obtain special rewards.

games.name: My Life: Farm Vet
games.title: My Life: Farm Vet
games.description: They need you on the farm - examine and treat lots of animals!

games.name: Wildfrost
games.title: Wildfrost
games.description: Take on the elements in Wildfrost, a tactical roguelike deckbuilder! Journey across a frozen tundra, collecting cards strong enough to banish the eternal winter…

games.name: Orange Season
games.title: Orange Season
games.description: Make your farmer dreams come true in Orange Season. With your parents’ help, you’ve finally saved enough money to buy a plot of land in the charming Orange Town. Grow crops, raise animals, fish, and mine materials to help your farm thrive and establish your presence in town.

games.name: Saint Kotar
games.title: Saint Kotar
games.description: Saint Kotar is a psychological horror detective game set in a cursed valley in rural Croatia. Investigate the disappearance of your relative in the occult-ridden town of Sveti Kotar as you switch between conflicting realities through the eyes of two godly men.

games.name: 80's OVERDRIVE
games.title: 80's OVERDRIVE
games.description: Ultimate racing game in a style of 80's with the best synth music.

games.name: Little Witch in the Woods (Game Preview)
games.title: Little Witch in the Woods (Game Preview)
games.description: This game is a work in progress. It may or may not change over time or release as a final product. Purchase only if you are comfortable with the current state of the unfinished game.

games.name: Card Collector Trading Shop
games.title: Card Collector Trading Shop
games.developer: Console Labs S.A/ Digital Melody S.A. / PlayWay S.A.
games.developerName: Console Labs S.A/ Digital Melody S.A. / PlayWay S.A.

games.name: Shard Squad
games.title: Shard Squad
games.description: Form a squad of elemental creatures and face hordes of challenging enemies! Choose your Shards according to their synergies to gain new abilities, and equip relics that will make the winds blow in your favor! Survive through different environments and save your lands!

games.name: Matchbox™ Driving Adventures
games.title: Matchbox™ Driving Adventures
games.description: Jump into your vehicle and use your imagination to tackle missions and win races. Navigate dynamic landscapes, earn medals, and Drive Your Adventure.

games.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020) Deluxe 40th Anniversary Edition
games.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020) Deluxe 40th Anniversary Edition
games.description:
From light planes to wide body jets to gliders and helicopters, fly highly detailed and accurate aircraft in the Microsoft Flight Simulator 40th Anniversary Edition. The world is at your fingertips.

The Deluxe 40th Anniversary Edition includes everything from the Standard Edition plus 5 additional highly accurate planes with unique flight models and 5 additional handcrafted international airports.

games.name: Hot Wheels Let's Race™ : Ultimate Speed - Deluxe Edition
games.title: Hot Wheels Let's Race™ : Ultimate Speed - Deluxe Edition
games.description: The Deluxe Edition of Hot Wheels Let's Race™: Ultimate Speed includes the full game plus the High Voltage Speed Pack. Race the futuristic Power Surge and sleek Mach Speeder, build with electrified track parts, and customize with 6 exclusive high-tech decals. Get ready to light up the track!

games.name: Torchlight III
games.title: Torchlight III
games.description: In Torchlight III, Novastraia is again under threat of invasion and it’s up to you to defend against the Netherim and its allies. Gather your wits and brave the frontier to find fame, glory, and a new adventure!

games.name: A Short Hike
games.title: A Short Hike
games.description: Hike, climb, and soar through the peaceful mountainside landscapes of Hawk Peak Provincial Park as you make your way to the summit.

games.name: PC Building Simulator
games.title: PC Building Simulator
games.description: Build and grow your very own computer repair enterprise as you learn to diagnose, fix and build PCs. With real-world licensed components and comprehensive hardware and software simulation, you can plan and bring your ultimate PC to life.

games.name: Outbreak: Shades of Horror Emporium DLC Collection
games.title: Outbreak: Shades of Horror Emporium DLC Collection
games.description: The Emporium has packed this online co-op collection full of DLC for Outbreak: Shades of Horror! This bundle contains new content that is also available for purchase separately.

games.name: Orcs Must Die! 3
games.title: Orcs Must Die! 3
games.description: Slice, burn, toss, zap, grind and gib massive hordes of repugnant orcs in this long-awaited successor to the award-winning Orcs Must Die! series.

games.name: Hatsune Miku Jigsaw Puzzle
games.title: Hatsune Miku Jigsaw Puzzle
games.description: Hatsune Miku Jigsaw Puzzles Now Available in the Microsoft® Store!

games.name: Day of the Tentacle Remastered
games.title: Day of the Tentacle Remastered
games.description: A mind-bending, time travel, cartoon puzzle adventure game in which three unlikely friends work together to prevent an evil mutated purple tentacle from taking over the world!

games.name: Thank Goodness You're Here!
games.title: Thank Goodness You're Here!
games.description: Thank Goodness You're Here! is an absurd comedy slapformer set in the bizarre Northern English town of Barnsworth. As a traveling salesman, take the time to see the sights and meet the locals, who are very eager to give you a series of increasingly odd jobs…

games.name: Farlands
games.title: Farlands
games.description: Congratulations, you've bought your own planet! An agrarian rock in the edge of the galaxy, which, for some reason, was almost given away for free. So the time has come to leave the hectic and stressful life of the overcrowded metropolis for a more rural and rewarding life.

games.name: Meow Moments: Celebrating Frost & Flora
games.title: Meow Moments: Celebrating Frost & Flora
games.description: Join cute cats in a cozy getaway! Find feline friends and pop balloons as you explore a snowy winter village and a peaceful Japanese cherry blossom park.

games.name: The Complex
games.title: The Complex
games.developer: Wales Interactive, Good Gate Media, Little Jade Productions
games.description: After a major bio-weapon attack on London, two scientists find themselves in a locked-down laboratory with time, and air, running out. Make or break relationships to discover one of eight suspenseful endings in this interactive sci-fi thriller movie from Wales Interactive.
games.developerName: Wales Interactive, Good Gate Media, Little Jade Productions

games.name: Chained Echoes
games.title: Chained Echoes
games.description: Take up your sword, channel your magic or board your Mech. Chained Echoes is a 16-bit SNES style RPG set in a fantasy world where dragons are as common as piloted mechanical suits.

games.name: Return to Monkey Island
games.title: Return to Monkey Island
games.description: Return to Monkey Island is an unexpected, thrilling return of series creator Ron Gilbert that continues the story of the legendary adventure games.

games.name: Life is Strange: True Colors - Deluxe Edition
games.title: Life is Strange: True Colors - Deluxe Edition
games.description: Alex Chen must embrace her volatile psychic power of Empathy to uncover the truth about her brother's death. Get the Deluxe Edition to play as Steph in the all-new story 'Wavelengths', plus 4 exclusive Life is Strange hero outfits for Alex.

games.name: Nick Jr. Party Adventure
games.title: Nick Jr. Party Adventure
games.description: You're invited on a party adventure with your favorite Nick Jr. characters, in a colorful puzzle platformer that everyone can enjoy!

games.name: Relic Hunters Legend
games.title: Relic Hunters Legend
games.description: A Top-Down Shooter/Looter RPG with a touching story inspired by JRPG classics. Shoot enemies, get loot, and customize your characters. Multiple endgame systems and over 100 hours of play await you solo or up to 4-player co-op!

games.name: Harvest Cafe
games.title: Harvest Cafe
games.description: Explore, grow, repair and cook delicious food! Harvest Cafe combines an open-world adventure with a restaurant business simulation, giving you the opportunity to enjoy farm life.

games.name: Speedway Racing
games.title: Speedway Racing
games.description:
Get ready to feel the speed!

In Speedway Racing, you will enjoy the fastest, most spectacular races at over 350 Km/h, avoiding multiple collisions against 20 rivals.
There are several modes available, including Championship, Arcade and 4-player multiplayer.

games.name: Headbangers: Rhythm Royale
games.title: Headbangers: Rhythm Royale
games.description: Headbangers is a light-hearted, Rhythm Battle Royale Game where you and 29 other Pigeons compete against each other, all to complete your quest of claiming the title of Master Headbanger!

games.name: Open Roads
games.title: Open Roads
games.description: Long-lost family secrets. Hints of a hidden fortune. And miles to go before they sleep. Tess Devine’s relationship with her mom has never been easy, but they’re about to set out together on a journey into the past that they’ll never forget.

games.name: Crash Drive 3
games.title: Crash Drive 3
games.description: Are you ready for THE car stunting playground? Experience ridiculous fun in this cross-platform multiplayer, free-roaming game! Drive monster trucks, tanks and more amazing vehicles across a huge open world. Level up, play events, earn cash, unlock new cars and discover secrets.... Crash Drive is back!

games.name: THE TAG-ALONG OBSESSION
games.title: THE TAG-ALONG OBSESSION
games.developer: Eastasiasoft Limited, LuLuDu Tech Co. Ltd.
games.developerName: Eastasiasoft Limited, LuLuDu Tech Co. Ltd.

games.name: The Outer Worlds 2 Premium Upgrade
games.title: The Outer Worlds 2 Premium Upgrade
games.description: The Outer Worlds 2 is the eagerly-awaited sequel to the award-winning first-person sci-fi RPG from Obsidian Entertainment (just look at the exciting number of dashes in this sentence!). Time to clear your calendar – get ready for an action-packed adventure with a new crew, new weapons, and new enemies in a new colony! So much newness!

games.name: Touhou Luna Nights
games.title: Touhou Luna Nights
games.description: Touhou Luna Nights is a Metroidvania title with a heavy emphasis on exploration and action based on the Touhou Project.

games.name: Oddsparks: An Automation Adventure
games.title: Oddsparks: An Automation Adventure
games.description: A blend of Automation and Real Time Strategy for both the die-hard fans of the Automation genre and the Automation-curious. Explore a strange fantasy world, uncover the mysteries of the past, automate your workshops, and go on adventures with your odd & adorable Sparks!

games.name: Moonglow Bay
games.title: Moonglow Bay
games.description: Embark on a journey as a rookie angler in Moonglow Bay, fulfilling your partner's final wish. Team up with friends, family, and neighbours to hone your fishing skills, nourish relationships, and restore a remote town's fractured community in this slice-of-life fishing RPG!

games.name: Spirit of the North 2
games.title: Spirit of the North 2
games.description: Unveil the mysteries of a beautiful ancient world in this breathtaking 3rd-Person Adventure, a sequel to the acclaimed ‘Spirit of the North.’ Take on the role of an isolated fox with a raven companion on a quest to restore the lost guardians and return home.

games.name: Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders
games.title: Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders
games.description: Test your skiing skills in serene mountain scenery. Perform tricks, discover shortcuts and try to best your time in the snowy followup to Lonely Mountains: Downhill. Enjoy the slopes alone, participate in thrilling online multiplayer races or gather your friends and conquer the mountains together.

games.name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 3
games.title: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 3
games.description: The Fuga: Melodies of Steel series has reached its epic conclusion! Dive into this dramatic RPG featuring a brand-new, strategic battle system, enhanced Taranis training during intermission, and tactical route progression and event battles!

games.name: One Move Away
games.title: One Move Away
games.description: One Move Away is a 3D, first-person puzzle game that blends puzzles with packing vehicles. Players experience packing at various stages of life, each level offering their own challenges. Master the art of packing by completing every objective!

games.name: Life is Strange: Double Exposure Ultimate Edition
games.title: Life is Strange: Double Exposure Ultimate Edition
games.description:
Get the Ultimate Edition to add five Outfit Packs for Max, and the Exclusive Cat Content!

The Life is Strange: Double Exposure Ultimate Edition contains:

•	Life is Strange: Double Exposure - complete game
•	Spooky Outfit Pack
•	Decades Outfit Pack
•	Final Fantasy VII Outfit Pack
•	Fan Favorite Outfit Pack
•	Paw Prints Cat Outfit Pack
•	Exclusive Cat Content

Max Caulfield, photographer-in-residence at the prestigious Caledon University, discovers her closest new friend, Safi, dead in the snow. 

Murdered.

To save her, Max tries to Rewind time – a power she’s not used in years… instead, Max opens the way to a parallel timeline where Safi is still alive, and still in danger!

Max realizes the killer will soon strike again – in both versions of reality.

With her new power to Shift between two timelines – can Max solve and prevent the same murder?

FINAL FANTASY and FINAL FANTASY VII are registered trademarks or trademarks of Square Enix Holdings Co., Ltd.

games.name: Peter Pan: Hidden Objects
games.title: Peter Pan: Hidden Objects
games.description: The window is open—time to fly! Join Peter Pan to uncover Neverland’s secrets. From the Lost Boys’ hideout to the Jolly Roger, solve Hidden Objects, Jigsaw Puzzles, and more. The crocodile can wait. Neverland cannot. Start playing!

games.name: Bulwark Evolution: Falconeer Chronicles
games.title: Bulwark Evolution: Falconeer Chronicles
games.description: Bulwark: Evolution mixes elements of a chill builder with grand strategy and exploration elements. It's a genre bending experimental game that can be both a peaceful building experience or a total conquest with airships, warbirds and fortresses. It's up to the player to decide.

games.name: Duck Detective: The Ghost of Glamping
games.title: Duck Detective: The Ghost of Glamping
games.description: You are the one and only Duck Detective, a depressed and recently divorced duck who must quack the case. Inspect evidence, make de-duck-tions, and solve this no-murder mystery!

games.name: Cocoon
games.title: Cocoon
games.description: From Jeppe Carlsen, the lead gameplay designer of LIMBO and INSIDE — COCOON takes you on an adventure across worlds within worlds. Master world-leaping mechanics and solve intricate puzzles to unravel a cosmic mystery.

games.name: Echo Generation: Midnight Edition
games.title: Echo Generation: Midnight Edition
games.description: Lead a gang of kids to uncover spooky mysteries, battle creatures, and explore the supernatural side of your hometown in Echo Generation, a turn-based adventure set in the 90s.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO THE KING OF FIGHTERS 2001
games.title: ACA NEOGEO THE KING OF FIGHTERS 2001
games.description: THE KING OF FIGHTERS 2001 is a fighting game released by SNK in 2001. The third entry in the King of Fighters NESTS collection, which reaches its conclusion at last in this tournament! 40 characters in total battle it out with a variety of fighting styles! Make a team of up to 4 fighters with the new Tactical Order Select system!

games.name: We Don't Cry: Zombie Survival
games.title: We Don't Cry: Zombie Survival
games.description: Survive waves of zombies and raiders in this action-packed survival horror shooter. Defend, build, scavenge, and adapt in a post-apocalyptic world where every choice matters.

games.name: Cassette Beasts - New Wirral Edition
games.title: Cassette Beasts - New Wirral Edition
games.description: A perfect fit for savvy collectors is Cassette Beasts' New Wirral Edition! Includes the base game and all DLCs.

games.name: Jumanji: Wild Adventures
games.title: Jumanji: Wild Adventures
games.description: Drop into Jumanji, a world full of dangerous beasts and secret treasures, as you search for its stolen Jewel and a way home!

games.name: Great God Grove
games.title: Great God Grove
games.description: THE WORLD IS ENDING AND THE GODS ARE SQUABBLING! Suck up and launch dialogue in a world of puzzles, puppets, and weird gods… or THE RIFT WILL CONSUME US ALL!

games.name: Yakuza: Like a Dragon Hero Edition
games.title: Yakuza: Like a Dragon Hero Edition
games.description:
Become Ichiban Kasuga, a low-ranking yakuza grunt left on the brink of death by the man he trusted most. Take up your legendary bat and get ready to crack some underworld skulls in dynamic RPG combat set against the backdrop of modern-day Japan in Yakuza: Like a Dragon.

Yakuza: Like a Dragon Hero Edition includes Job Set and Management Mode Set DLC.

Russian and Brazilian Portuguese subtitles available in early 2021 via patch update.

Game leverages Smart Delivery allowing access to both the Xbox One title and Xbox Series X title when available. Product does not yet have a firm release date. If pre-ordered, you will be notified when the release date is set and opportunity provided to manage your order.

games.name: The Last Kids on Earth and the Staff of Doom
games.title: The Last Kids on Earth and the Staff of Doom
games.description: Join Jack and his friends in an epic, post-apocalyptic quest to save our world from the Queen of the Slime Monsters!

games.name: Undead Horde
games.title: Undead Horde
games.description: Become a necromancer and raise the dead. Undead Horde is an action RPG and an RTS in an undead package. Command, lead, raze, loot, and fight your way through the lands of the living with your horde. Ultimately claim back the kingdom for the Undead Horde!

games.name: Mutant Year Zero: Road to Eden
games.title: Mutant Year Zero: Road to Eden
games.description: A tactical adventure game combining the turn-based combat of XCOM with story, exploration, stealth, and strategy. Take control of a team of Mutants navigating a post-human Earth. Created by a team including former HITMAN leads and the designer of PAYDAY.

games.name: ACRES
games.title: ACRES
games.description: ACRES is a cozy strategy sim where you grow crops, manage land, and fulfill market orders one acre at a time. In Normal Mode, you decide which orders to take and when � no rush, just careful planning and steady progress. Or crank up the pressure in Challenge Mode, where demands arrive nonstop. Expand your farm, hire farmhands, upgrade your tools, and see how long you can keep things growing.

games.name: The Cub
games.title: The Cub
games.description: The Jungle Book meets the armageddon. A story-rich, old-school tough platformer inspired by SEGA classics but built for today. Platform parkour through the remains of humanity as smooth apocalypse-wave tunes and stories reveal more.

games.name: FRONT MISSION 1st: Remake
games.title: FRONT MISSION 1st: Remake
games.description: FRONT MISSION 1st: Remake is an immersive, tactical turn-based RPG, placing you in command of the awe-inspiring Wanzers – powerful military machines.

games.name: We Happy Few Digital Deluxe
games.title: We Happy Few Digital Deluxe
games.description: Set in a drug-fuelled, retrofuturistic city in an alternative 1960s England, We Happy Few is an action/adventure game in which you hide, fight, and conform your way out of a delusional Joy-obsessed world.

games.name: Raging Loop
games.title: Raging Loop
games.description: Hang the wolves! Purge the yomibito! What awaits at the end of the looping...?

games.name: Acorn Avengers
games.title: Acorn Avengers
games.description: When the forest ranger is abducted, it's the Acorn Avengers to the rescue! Classic 16-bit platforming mayhem for up to 2 players co-op!

games.name: Frogging Up: Frog Climb Rage Game
games.title: Frogging Up: Frog Climb Rage Game

games.name: Minami Lane
games.title: Minami Lane
games.description: Build your own street in this tiny cozy, casual management sim.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO THE KING OF FIGHTERS '94
games.title: ACA NEOGEO THE KING OF FIGHTERS '94
games.description:
"THE KING OF FIGHTERS '94" is a fighting game that was released from SNK in 1994.
The original characters of "THE KING OF FIGHTERS '94" and popular characters from series such as "FATAL FURY" and "IKARI WARRIORS" come together to battle it out in no holds barred 3-on-3 team battles.

games.name: Oceanhorn 2 - Knights of the Lost Realm
games.title: Oceanhorn 2 - Knights of the Lost Realm
games.description: Sequel to the critically acclaimed action adventure. Experience a gorgeous new third person 3D view and embark on an epic journey that unfolds the mysteries of what happened 1000 years ago.

games.name: Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator
games.title: Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator
games.description: Dive into the quivering innards of alien capitalism in Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator: the sci-fi body horror market tycoon game you didn't know you needed.

games.name: Exoprimal Deluxe Edition
games.title: Exoprimal Deluxe Edition
games.description: Exoprimal is an online, team-based action game that pits humanity's cutting-edge exosuit technology against history's most ferocious beasts – dinosaurs.​​

games.name: Cozy Grove: Camp Spirit
games.title: Cozy Grove: Camp Spirit
games.description: All those who are lost deserve kindness. Help cute, ghostly bears find peace in this relaxing sequel to the beloved life-sim game Cozy Grove, where kindness rules and new crafting, building, and camping island adventures await.

games.name: Cats and Seek : Tokyo
games.title: Cats and Seek : Tokyo
games.description: The cats have boarded the bus to Tokyo! Are you ready to find them?

games.name: Little Noah: Scion of Paradise
games.title: Little Noah: Scion of Paradise
games.description:
Explore ancient ruins with the alchemist Noah and her trusty cat companion!
Create unique teams and combos from 40+ recruitable allies in this casual but compelling game!

games.name: Spirit of the North: Enhanced Edition
games.title: Spirit of the North: Enhanced Edition
games.description: Awaken the Spirit of the North and start your journey. Set out on a beautiful and meaningful adventure across landscapes inspired by those in Iceland. Discover a land left in ruin as you're guided across mountains by the Guardian of the Northern Lights, solving environmental puzzles to uncover what happened to the ancient civilisation that once lived there.

games.name: Puppergeist
games.title: Puppergeist
games.description: Journey through the Doggie Underworld in this heartwarming rhythm and visual novel hybrid. Reunite with your lost Pup by connecting with the souls of other dogs, learning their stories, and lifting their spirits through rhythm games full of charm and playful challenges!

games.name: Star Trucker - Deluxe Bundle
games.title: Star Trucker - Deluxe Bundle
games.description: Everything a trucker needs to start a career among the stars, in one place!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO BASEBALL STARS 2
games.title: ACA NEOGEO BASEBALL STARS 2
games.description: BASEBALL STARS 2 is a sports game released by SNK in 1992. Get the full experience with intense graphics and passionate announcers! 　Time to see some exciting baseball! Use the Power-bat to send the ball flying for an amazing home run! The Auto-Fielding system allows for even beginners to enjoy the intense gameplay.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO THE KING OF FIGHTERS 2000
games.title: ACA NEOGEO THE KING OF FIGHTERS 2000
games.description:
THE KING OF FIGHTERS 2000 is a fighting game released by SNK in 2000. 
Featuring numerous improvements from KOF '99, KOF 2000 also introduces the all-new “Active Striker” system where players can enjoy exciting striker-based battle strategies. 
Plenty of nostalgic characters from the SNK Universe appear as “another strikers”.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO THE KING OF FIGHTERS '99
games.title: ACA NEOGEO THE KING OF FIGHTERS '99
games.description:
"THE KING OF FIGHTERS '99" is a fighting game released by SNK in 1999.
This entry in this series marks the beginning of the “NESTS” chapter of the KOF story, and focuses on the new character K’ instead of Kyo Kusanagi.
This entry introduces a new Striker Match mode, adding an even more strategic element to the classic KOF game system.

games.name: Black Spades
games.title: Black Spades
games.description: Yep, that's right! Spades the way your friends and family play at home, college, reunions, and holiday get-togethers! The only spades game with Jokers, Deuces, and Reneg calling!

games.name: Supraland: Six Inches Under
games.title: Supraland: Six Inches Under
games.description: Dig beneath the surface of Supraland: Six Inches Under, a first-person adventure full of puzzles, exploration, gags, and secrets to discover. Find your own way through an interconnected underground world in this standalone follow-up to the beloved original.

games.name: Rolling Hills: Make Sushi, Make Friends
games.title: Rolling Hills: Make Sushi, Make Friends
games.description: Serve up sushi as a robot chef in Rolling Hills, a life sim about running your own restaurant in a cozy village. Make new friends, purchase ingredients, enhance your shop, and improve the lives of your neighbors as you perfect your craft!

games.name: Basketball Pinball
games.title: Basketball Pinball
games.description: Score some points and slam dunk in the most entertaining Pinball!

games.name: Double Dragon 4
games.title: Double Dragon 4
games.description: The classical side-scroll action game, "Double Dragon" series' newest sequel! A new legend begins!!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO BIG TOURNAMENT GOLF
games.title: ACA NEOGEO BIG TOURNAMENT GOLF
games.description:
"BIG TOURNAMENT GOLF" is a golf game released by SNK in 1996.
Players can choose from a total of six golfers with different abilities and play on courses located around the world such as Australia or Germany.
Players can test out their golf game skills against friends with game modes such as "STROKE PLAY" and "MATCH PLAY (2P battle only).

games.name: Whacking Hell!
games.title: Whacking Hell!
games.description: The gates of hell have opened: whack all the monsters before they whack you! Collect their souls, ramp up your weapons and your spells, and become a slaughtering machine in this frantic roguelite top-down 2D shooter!

games.name: Hot Wheels Let's Race™: Ultimate Speed
games.title: Hot Wheels Let's Race™: Ultimate Speed
games.description: Get ready to race, drift, and build in Hot Wheels Let’s Race™: Ultimate Speed! Race through wild tracks, face epic bosses, and unlock iconic cars from the hit Netflix series. Build a track in Track Builder mode. Play solo or in local 4-player split-screen!

games.name: Detective Holmes: Hidden Objects
games.title: Detective Holmes: Hidden Objects
games.description: Step into 221B Baker Street! Search for hidden clues in beautifully detailed scenes, enjoy twisted hidden object challenges, and solve a mysterious new case. Can you outsmart the shadows and solve the crime? London is waiting!

games.name: Wall World 2
games.title: Wall World 2
games.description: The adventure in the mysterious world of the Wall continues! Pilot your robospider into its depths, uncover lost artifacts and technologies, upgrade your exosuit and spider, and battle the horrors lurking in the dark. Unravel the mysteries buried in the depths of the Wall!

games.name: Beacon Pines
games.title: Beacon Pines
games.description: Beacon Pines is a cute and creepy adventure game. Sneak out late, make new friends, uncover hidden truths, and collect words that will change the course of fate!

games.name: Train Sim World® 6: Deluxe Edition
games.title: Train Sim World® 6: Deluxe Edition
games.description: Expect the Unexpected in Train Sim World 6: Deluxe Edition! Be ready for anything as you master additional trains & services across the Riviera Line, Leipzig - Dresden and Morristown Line. Deluxe Edition additionally includes the CrossCountry Voyager, DB BR 294 Shunter & NJ TRANSIT® ALP-45DP locos!

games.name: Nachtmahr
games.title: Nachtmahr
games.description: Nachtmahr is a single-player, third-person adventure where you become a mythical unicorn bound by magic and mystery. Experience five breathtaking realms—each with its own haunting beauty, original soundtrack, and secrets waiting to be unraveled.

games.name: Arkham Horror: Mother’s Embrace
games.title: Arkham Horror: Mother’s Embrace
games.description: Inspired by the award-winning board game franchise, Arkham Horror: Mother’s Embrace is an investigation game served with turn-based combat, set in the  haunted worlds of H.P. Lovecraft’s Cthulhu mythos. Plunge into an original story written by Fantasy Flight Interactive’s official writers and explore the American Roaring Twenties.

games.name: Turbo Golf Racing
games.title: Turbo Golf Racing
games.description: An action-packed fusion of racing and golf. Traverse across a diverse range of courses, using your car to skillfully putt your ball in the hole. Make every shot count in golf mode, compete against 7 opponents in Race mode, or test your skills against the clock in Time Trials.

games.name: Garfield - Escape From Monday
games.title: Garfield - Escape From Monday
games.description: Wake up Garfield from this nightmarish veggie filled 3D Platformer! The laziest cat is about to work hard in Garfield - Escape from Monday!

games.name: Escape from Ever After
games.title: Escape from Ever After
games.description: A genre-bending RPG inspired by the classic Paper Mario games! When a greedy megacorp from the real world starts taking over fairytales for their cheap labor, a storybook hero must climb the corporate ladder, rally together other disgruntled employees, and fight back!

games.name: Basketball Classics
games.title: Basketball Classics
games.description: 5 on 5 Pro Basketball born from the golden era of sports games. This spiritual successor to the 8-bit ballers bridges the gap between retro and today’s simulation games.

games.name: Project Neon
games.title: Project Neon
games.description: Intense 16-bit arcade shmup action

games.name: F.I.S.T.: Forged In Shadow Torch
games.title: F.I.S.T.: Forged In Shadow Torch
games.description: Take the fight to the evil Legion with iron fist in a diesel-punk world.

games.name: RPGolf Legends
games.title: RPGolf Legends
games.description: Become the legend in this golf-action-adventure and save golf in the world!

games.name: Super Hero Demolition
games.title: Super Hero Demolition
games.description: unleash your inner hero

games.name: High Times
games.title: High Times
games.description: Manage a cafe and play the role of a donut therapist in this cozy dating/cooking sim. Feeling nervous? Need some cheer in your life? Here at High Times, there's a donut for every mood.

games.name: We Love Katamari REROLL+ Royal Reverie Special Edition
games.title: We Love Katamari REROLL+ Royal Reverie Special Edition
games.description:
The second title in the Katamari Damacy series has returned in a remastered, powered-up version!

We Love Katamari REROLL+ Royal Reverie is a fully remastered version of We Love Katamari Damacy, originally released in 2005, with new and improved graphics and gameplay enhancements to make it easier to jump in and have fun.

The Special Edition contains We Love Katamari REROLL+ Royal Reverie, the Little Prince Costume, and the Katamari Damacy Series Music Bundle.

games.name: Kingdom Rush
games.title: Kingdom Rush
games.description: Set your strategy to defend the kingdom in this Tower Defense game!

games.name: Nomori
games.title: Nomori
games.description: Nomori is a mind-bending adventure game where you control time and space to journey through a whimsical spirit world. Take shortcuts through portals, rotate your perspective, and control the flow of time to solve puzzles that are out of this world.

games.name: Flintlock: The Siege of Dawn
games.title: Flintlock: The Siege of Dawn
games.description: From games studio A44, makers of Ashen, comes an explosive Souls-lite, where Gods and guns collide in a battle for the future of humanity.

games.name: Discounty
games.title: Discounty
games.description:
Manage your own supermarket, explore the tight-knit community of Blomkest, build friendships or make enemies as you uncover the town's secrets in this cozy management sim RPG! 

Step into the quirky harbour town of Blomkest, where your aunt has entrusted you with managing its only supermarket. Design and organise your shop, manage stock levels, work the checkout, and strike trade deals. Build relationships with the charming locals, and grow your business empire while navigating community dynamics. Use every tool at your disposal to expand your business, but be mindful: rapid growth might ruffle a few feathers in this tight-knit community. Will you pursue endless profits, or find a way to benefit everyone in Blomkest?

games.name: Parkasaurus: Dinoluxe Edition
games.title: Parkasaurus: Dinoluxe Edition
games.description: Experience the prehistoric hijinks of building your very own dinosaur theme park. Packed with adorable, mischievous dinos to discover, this tycoon management sim challenges you to design exhibits, conduct research, and increase profits. Includes the Sea Monsters and Prehistoric Wonders DLCs.

games.name: Justice Chronicles
games.title: Justice Chronicles
games.description: Ultimate classic RPG where a young knight must fight destiny through the darkness that lurks in history!

games.name: Crazy Chicken Kart 2
games.title: Crazy Chicken Kart 2
games.developer: Original game developed by Higgs Games GmbH and GeekPit Studio. Ported by Raylight Games Srls.
games.description: The racing classic remastered!
games.developerName: Original game developed by Higgs Games GmbH and GeekPit Studio. Ported by Raylight Games Srls.

games.name: Die Again
games.title: Die Again
games.description: Frantic action game where you’ll test your survival skills, dodging death... as long as you have someone nearby! Will you make it to the Zero Zone?

games.name: Sable
games.title: Sable
games.description: Embark on a unique and unforgettable journey and guide Sable through her Gliding; a rite of passage that will take her across vast deserts and mesmerizing landscapes, capped by the remains of spaceships and ancient wonders.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2 NINJA EMAKI
games.title: Arcade Archives 2 NINJA EMAKI
games.description:
"NINJA EMAKI" is a shooter released by Nichibutsu in 1986.
Take control of the young hero Shinbei and fight to rescue the princess from the evil spirit army.
Pick up scrolls to gain access to 8 different kinds of Ninja Magic. Use them wisely, and they'll be the key to advancing through the game!

games.name: UNSIGHTED
games.title: UNSIGHTED
games.description: EXPLORE YOUR WAY. Awoken to a world ruined by war, Alma must traverse the vast city of Arcadia before the life force of her friends and herself withers away. Time is ticking, and every moment matters. Who will you save, and who will you leave to turn UNSIGHTED?

games.name: Blacksmith of the Sand Kingdom
games.title: Blacksmith of the Sand Kingdom
games.description: Become the court blacksmith adventuring in the Sand Kingdom in a fantasy RPG!

games.name: Trivia: Knowledge Trainer - the Quiz Game
games.title: Trivia: Knowledge Trainer - the Quiz Game
games.description: The quiz game for smart people. With high-quality and challenging questions.

games.name: Kingdom Rush Frontiers
games.title: Kingdom Rush Frontiers
games.description: Fantastic Tower Defense game with lots of strategic decisions. Great power-user stuff like Reinforcements, Meteor Strikes, Heroes and more.

games.name: SHARK! SHARK!
games.title: SHARK! SHARK!
games.description: Inspired by the legendary SHARK! SHARK!® game released in its original version for the Intellivision® home console in 1982, this reimagined version for up to four players offers you a modern and addictive gameplay, fantastic graphics, great sounds, lots of levels and many underwater characters.

games.name: Mortal Glory 2
games.title: Mortal Glory 2
games.description: Manage a team of traveling gladiators in this turn-based fantasy roguelike!

games.name: Romancing SaGa 3
games.title: Romancing SaGa 3
games.description: The celebrated RPG classic comes West for the first time! Romancing SaGa™ 3 was originally released in Japan in 1995. This HD remaster of the legendary RPG masterpiece introduces optimized graphics, a new dungeon  to explore, new scenarios and a new game+ function.

games.name: Embr
games.title: Embr
games.description:
Team up with friends to become the most über firefighters money can buy. Rush into burning buildings filled with dangerous hazards, valuables, and top-of-the-line security systems. Fight fires, save lives, salvage goods, and make life-changing money. Buy high tech tools with advanced upgrades, and fresh outfits that unlock new ways to play.

Embr will keep you coming back for more with new mission types, daily and weekly challenges, and plenty of achievements to hunt.

games.name: Agatha Christie - Hercule Poirot: The London Case
games.title: Agatha Christie - Hercule Poirot: The London Case
games.description:
From the brillant mind of the BAFTA Scotland Award-Wining studio, Blazing Griffin, get ready in 2023 for a new adventure as the famous detective Hercule Poirot travels to London for a seemingly simple task of delivering a painting for an exhibition, that will be unfortunately stolen during the grand opening.

For the first time ever, players will have the opportunity to team up with Poirot’s beloved sidekick in the books, Hastings, as they uncover a new mystery. Expérience a new location, adventure, and partner in this exciting next chapter of Hercule Poirot in his youth.

games.name: Kill The Brickman
games.title: Kill The Brickman
games.description: A brick breaking, turn-based rogue-like bullet-builder - Blast bricks to break the bank.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO THE KING OF FIGHTERS '97
games.title: ACA NEOGEO THE KING OF FIGHTERS '97
games.description: THE KING OF FIGHTERS '97 is a fighting game released by SNK in 1997. Featuring popular characters from FATAL FURY and ART OF FIGHTING, these fighters will battle to determine who is the strongest. The ADVANCED and EXTRA modes of gameplay offer an even deeper level of tactics.

games.name: Infinite Guitars
games.title: Infinite Guitars
games.description: Fight mechs with metal-crushing rock in Infinite Guitars, a genre-melting Rhythm RPG featuring vibrant anime-inspired art and a blazing original soundtrack. Battle against war machines with electrifying Guitar Solos, and save the planet!

games.name: Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector
games.title: Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector
games.description: A dice-driven RPG, in a human and heartfelt sci-fi world. You are an escaped android, with a malfunctioning body, a price on your head and no memory of your past. Get a ship, find a crew, and take on contracts while you navigate across the Starward Belt.

games.name: Gorogoa
games.title: Gorogoa
games.description: Gorogoa is an elegant evolution of the puzzle genre, told through a beautifully hand-drawn story designed and illustrated by Jason Roberts.

games.name: SOPA - Tale of the Stolen Potato
games.title: SOPA - Tale of the Stolen Potato
games.description: Miho steps into the pantry to fetch a potato for his grandma and falls into a magical world full of wonders. Meet quirky characters, venture through the depths of South America, and learn the importance of the things we pass along in this unforgettable emotional narrative adventure.

games.name: Momento
games.title: Momento
games.description: A cozy room decorator with a twist!

games.name: Nikoderiko: The Magical World - Director's Cut
games.title: Nikoderiko: The Magical World - Director's Cut
games.description: Jump into adventure in this love letter to platformers! Play in single-player or couch co-op, and enjoy 8 colorful worlds, classic platforming challenges, and music by legendary composer David Wise.

games.name: Mini Trains
games.title: Mini Trains
games.description: Welcome to the fantastic world of model railroads and steam locomotives where you can become both a constructor and a conductor. Choo Choo!

games.name: Late Shift
games.title: Late Shift
games.description: Late Shift is a high stakes FMV crime thriller. Forced into a brutal London heist, you must choose your own path in this interactive cinematic experience with adaptable storylines that lead to one of seven conclusions. Your decisions are you.

games.name: Road 96: Mile 0
games.title: Road 96: Mile 0
games.description: A prequel to Road 96, a story about two friends with different backgrounds. Meet Zoe and Kaito. This is where it all started. Challenge your beliefs!

games.name: Kingdom Rush Origins
games.title: Kingdom Rush Origins
games.description: Re-enter the world of Kingdom Rush: visit mysterious elven forests, magical faery realms and even floating ruins of an ancient metropolis!

games.name: Arcade Archives 2 PINBALL ACTION
games.title: Arcade Archives 2 PINBALL ACTION
games.description:
"PINBALL ACTION" is a pinball game released by TEHKAN (KOEI TECMO GAMES) in 1985.
Try to clear all the features on all four tables, switching between them over the game!
Use tricks to shake the tables, control the ball, and seize any chance at a win!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO THE KING OF FIGHTERS '96
games.title: ACA NEOGEO THE KING OF FIGHTERS '96
games.description:
THE KING OF FIGHTERS '96 is a fighting game released by SNK in 1996. 
A total of 27 playable characters are available. New game mechanics such as the Emergency Evasion, short and mid-hops make their entry for the first time in the legendary Series, adding a new depth to the fights. The story focuses on the second chapter of the Orochi trilogy.

games.name: Sleeping Beauty: Hidden Object Game
games.title: Sleeping Beauty: Hidden Object Game
games.description:
🌙 Step into Sleeping Beauty’s dreamworld!
Explore hand-painted scenes, find hidden objects, solve puzzles, and uncover magical secrets. Relax into a charming fairytale adventure where every clue brings you closer to the truth. ✨

games.name: Symphonia 𝄞
games.title: Symphonia 𝄞
games.description: Awaken an expansive musical realm in this non-violent and poetic platformer. In Symphonia, you'll use the power of your violin coupled with your platforming skills to gather an orchestra to bring the musical machinery of the world back to life.

games.name: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes
games.title: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes
games.description: Eiyuden Chronicles: Hundred Heroes is designed to bring players a modern take on a classic JRPG experience. Get ready to lead 100+ playable characters through a war-torn world only you can save.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO STREET HOOP
games.title: ACA NEOGEO STREET HOOP
games.description: STREET HOOP is a street basketball game released by Data East in 1994. Pick a team from the 10 competing countries and aim to be the world's best. In addition to a variety of techniques, power can be charged and released for flashy super dunk shots, making for exhilarating street basketball.

games.name: Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny - Deluxe Edition
games.title: Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny - Deluxe Edition
games.description: The Deluxe Edition of Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny includes the full game plus the Wardrobe of Wonder Pack - 9 dazzling new costumes that reimagine each hero with extra flair and fantasy style. Gear up, cast spells, and let your destiny shine!

games.name: Juufuutei Raden™'s Guide for Pixel Museum
games.title: Juufuutei Raden™'s Guide for Pixel Museum
games.description:
— Solve the puzzle and complete the art! —
"Pixel Puzzle" that lets you experience art and culture with Juufuutei Raden.

games.name: STRIKERS 1945 III
games.title: STRIKERS 1945 III
games.description:
This hardcore 90s arcade shooter was
Psikyo's challenge to the world!
Now with online rankings!

games.name: Ring of Pain
games.title: Ring of Pain
games.description:
Enter the Ring of Pain...

Delve into randomly generated ring dungeons where encounters come to you!
Observe and plan your route. Will you go for the loot or backstab a creeping horror? As you scavenge, fight and sneak to new encounters, the ring reacts to your actions.

Play as fast or slow as you like in this challenging, turn-based roguelike. Just be careful where you tread - You may find yourself ambushed, or worse...

games.name: Find My Frogs
games.title: Find My Frogs
games.description: Help Uncle Froger and find +350 hidden frogs across the fairytale village!

games.name: Yes, Your Grace
games.title: Yes, Your Grace
games.description: In this kingdom management RPG, petitioners will arrive in the throne room each turn to ask for your advice and assistance. Decide whether to help them with their problems, or to conserve resources for more important matters. Remember: supplies are limited, and not everyone has the kingdom’s best interests at heart...

games.name: Sky Revolver
games.title: Sky Revolver
games.description: Retro vertical shooter. Fight the Empire—breach waves, destroy bosses, upgrade with salvage. Strategic, skill-driven combat.

games.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor - Deluxe Edition
games.title: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor - Deluxe Edition
games.description: Is your pickaxe sharp, and your beard bushy? Do you dream of crushing bugs, and wake every morning ready for a wonderful day of working for the Deep Rock Galactic corporation? Would you like to shine brilliantly in the darkest depths, to stand out as a beacon of bravery to your fellow dwarves?

games.name: Humanity
games.title: Humanity
games.description: A unique blend of puzzle-solving and action-platforming, HUMANITY puts the fate of all mankind in your hands. Er, paws. Play a lone Shiba Inu charged with commanding massive, marching crowds to the goal in Story Mode, or craft your own stages via the in-game Stage Creator!

games.name: Sea Horizon
games.title: Sea Horizon
games.developer: Eastasiasoft Limited, Softstar Entertainment Inc., 45 Studio
games.developerName: Eastasiasoft Limited, Softstar Entertainment Inc., 45 Studio

games.name: Dodgeball Academia
games.title: Dodgeball Academia
games.description: Dodgeball Academia is a sports RPG game featuring rookie dodgeball student, Otto. Join Otto and an eclectic cast of characters as they train to dominate on and off the courts of the academia.

games.name: Citizen Sleeper
games.title: Citizen Sleeper
games.description: Roleplaying in the ruins of interplanetary capitalism. Live the life of an escaped worker, washed-up on a lawless station at the edge of an interstellar society. Inspired by the flexibility and freedom of TTRPGs, explore the station, choose your friends, escape your past and change your future.

games.name: Tesla vs Lovecraft
games.title: Tesla vs Lovecraft
games.description: Play as the enigmatic inventor Nikola Tesla! Use devastating weapons to mow down hordes of nightmarish monsters, collect mighty powerups to boost the carnage, and finally overwhelm your enemies with the immense firepower of the Tesla-Mech battle robot!

games.name: Lemon Cake
games.title: Lemon Cake
games.description: Restore an abandoned bakery and prepare pastries from farm to table! Grow fresh ingredients in the greenhouse, cook pastries & sweets in the kitchen and serve your baked goods to hungry customers in your own shop!

games.name: EDENS ZERO
games.title: EDENS ZERO
games.description:
This is a 3D action role-playing game based on the space fantasy comic/anime EDENS ZERO by Hiro Mashima, creator of Fairy Tail and Rave Master.
