The player controls a diverse cast of characters as they embark on an epic adventure across different planets while battling powerful enemies!

games.name: Bridge Race
games.title: Bridge Race
games.description: Build your way to victory, one brick at a time!

games.name: Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S
games.title: Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S
games.description:
"Hatsune Miku Logic Paint -MIKULOGI-" has evolved!
Hatsune Miku Logic Paint S is now available on the Microsoft® Store!

games.name: Train Sim World® 6: Special Edition
games.title: Train Sim World® 6: Special Edition
games.description: Discover the best Train Sim World has to offer with the Special Edition, featuring the 3 new routes from Train Sim World 6, additional TSW Compatible routes from our extensive range, including our first Dutch route, as well as the CrossCountry Voyager, DB BR 294 Shunter & NJ TRANSIT® ALP-45DP locos!

games.name: No Heroes Here 2
games.title: No Heroes Here 2
games.description: A group of non-adventurers is the last hope in defending the castle in this chaotic co-op tower defense game with roguelike features. With up to 4 players, your party must organize the castle, work as a team to craft ammo, and shoot at enemies to protect your kingdom!

games.name: Abathor
games.title: Abathor
games.description: Abathor is a 2D arcade action platformer for up to 4 players. You are the last hope in defense of Atlantis, you’ll face hordes of enemies and countless challenges. Enjoy its pixel art and epic music. A cooperative and competitive game to achieve glory or death.

games.name: There's a Gun in the Office
games.title: There's a Gun in the Office
games.developer: Take IT Studio! sp. z o. o.
games.publisher: Take IT Studio! sp. z o. o.
games.developerName: Take IT Studio! sp. z o. o.
games.publisherName: Take IT Studio! sp. z o. o.

games.name: Lost Twins 2
games.title: Lost Twins 2
games.description: A cute yet challenging puzzle-platformer where you move the world itself to create new paths. Play solo or in local co-op as Ben & Abi, solving clever puzzles that test your logic skills. Guide them home through a mysterious, enchanting world.

games.name: Speed Truck Racing
games.title: Speed Truck Racing
games.description: In Speed Truck Racing, you will enjoy the fastest, most spectacular races at over 200 Km/h, avoiding multiple collisions against 20 rivals.

games.name: RIDE 6 - Deluxe Edition
games.title: RIDE 6 - Deluxe Edition
games.description: Enjoy an even more thrilling riding experience with RIDE 6 - Deluxe Edition. In addition to the full game, you'll get Season Pass Vol. 1 with its amazing content as soon as it becomes available.

games.name: For The Warp
games.title: For The Warp
games.description: A roguelike deckbuilding game in space! Explore randomly generated systems, enemies, and strange encounters. Build your deck, survive, and reach For The Warp gate!

games.name: Saccharine Echo
games.title: Saccharine Echo
games.description: Saccharine Echo is a story that walks the line between psychological drama and dark paranormal romance. Your choices will shape the fate of a young woman haunted by an obsessive entity from another world.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO BASEBALL STARS PROFESSIONAL
games.title: ACA NEOGEO BASEBALL STARS PROFESSIONAL
games.description: BASEBALL STARS PROFESSIONAL is a sports game released in 1990 by SNK. One of the launch titles as the NEOGEO debuted, it came with both a VS Mode and Tournament Mode. The dynamic animation and powerful productions made for an exciting game.

games.name: Dolphin Spirit: Ocean Mission
games.title: Dolphin Spirit: Ocean Mission
games.description: Embark on an amazing adventure on the tropical island of Maupiroa! Take to the seas and discover the secrets that surround the island!  Dive into the ocean's depths, teeming with life and color, with your dolphin friend Keanu. Learn about marine life and ecology while helping the local environmentalists save the island from impending disaster.

games.name: Wargroove 2
games.title: Wargroove 2
games.description: Trouble stirs on the shores of Aurania. An ambitious new faction has unearthed forbidden relics capable of catastrophic consequences. But how far will they go to achieve glory? Take to the battlefield, sea, and sky with a cast of new Commanders, using your wits to wage turn-based war!

games.name: The Case of the Golden Idol
games.title: The Case of the Golden Idol
games.description: Dive into the twisted mystery of a family's cursed heirloom. Examine clues and use your powers of deduction to solve a series of grisly murders.

games.name: Narcissus
games.title: Narcissus
games.description: Narcissus is an adrenaline-pumping, top down, action-horror game that puts you in the shoes of the last survivor on a doomed spaceship. The clock is ticking, and danger lurks around every corner.

games.name: INK ENIGMA 2: Hidden Object Challenges
games.title: INK ENIGMA 2: Hidden Object Challenges
games.description: The ultimate cozy puzzle experience returns! Search for hidden objects across 40 intricate, black-and-white illustrations. Enjoy silky-smooth zooming and panning controls, and circle your discoveries with a fully customizable colored pen. Pure, relaxing observation awaits!

games.name: Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3
games.title: Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3
games.description: MATCH DNA BUBBLES IN AN UNDERGROUND LAB TO KEEP YOUR PSYCHIC CLONE FROM INVADING YOUR MIND AND TURNING YOU INTO A CANNIBAL. This is the match-3 survival horror comedy RPG metroidvania you didn't know you needed.

games.name: Gori: Cuddly Carnage
games.title: Gori: Cuddly Carnage
games.description: Humanity has been destroyed - and it's up to Gori, along with his deadly but wise-cracking sentient hoverboard, F.R.A.N.K, and morose AI companion, CH1-P, to shred and slay the evil Adorable Army!

games.name: D-topia
games.title: D-topia
games.description: Step into the world of D-topia in this gentle-paced puzzle adventure. In D-topia, life is curated by artificial intelligence to maximize happiness. As the newest Facilitator, it’s up to you to solve puzzles to keep the D-topia residents happy and the facility running.

games.name: Xeno Crisis
games.title: Xeno Crisis
games.description: Xeno Crisis is an arena shooter in which up to two players enter a ravaged research outpost to confront an alien menace and get out alive! Run and gun your way through thousands of adversaries as you search for the source of the deadly alien outbreak.

games.name: Dead Dragons
games.title: Dead Dragons
games.description: Dragons or humans—who will prevail? Join the battle in this epic RPG!

games.name: Limbot
games.title: Limbot
games.description: Limbot is a super silly, 3D platformer where you individually control the limbs of a giant cardboard robot! Master all four limbs in solo or embrace the chaos (and camaraderie) of couch co-op play, in this fully destructible cardboard world!

games.name: Echoes of Light: Child of the Balance
games.title: Echoes of Light: Child of the Balance
games.description:
In Echoes of Light, step into the worn boots of Kaela, a lone swordswoman on a desperate journey to rescue her kidnapped brother and restore the balance between light and shadow.

Explore a crumbling world consumed by darkness as you fight your way through corrupted forests, forgotten temples, and realms beyond time. With no magic to aid you-only steel and skill-you'll face brutal enemies and haunting bosses, each guarding a piece of the truth.

Light is fading. But not all hope is lost.

Will you rise with the blade... or fall into the shadow?

games.name: My Life: Pet Vet
games.title: My Life: Pet Vet
games.developer: Developed by Caipirinha Games GmbH. Ported by Raylight Games Srls.
games.description: Cute little pets need your help!
games.developerName: Developed by Caipirinha Games GmbH. Ported by Raylight Games Srls.

games.name: Carmen Sandiego
games.title: Carmen Sandiego
games.description: VILE is back on the scene, and for once, ACME and Carmen Sandiego have a common enemy. The world’s greatest thief must track down the syndicate before they can pull off their next big heist.

games.name: Accolade Sports Collection (QUByte Classics)
games.title: Accolade Sports Collection (QUByte Classics)
games.description: Relive retro sports glory! Five classic games. One epic collection!

games.name: Pro Wrestler Story
games.title: Pro Wrestler Story
games.description: Pro Wrestling Team Management Sim, Face off with fearsome foes!

games.name: Chasm: The Rift
games.title: Chasm: The Rift
games.description: Prepare for terror in this ground-breaking classic old-school FPS. Following the destruction of Time, you are left to battle in this horrific hellhole of multilevel interconnected missions populated by gruesome grotesque creatures.

games.name: Pool Slide Story
games.title: Pool Slide Story
games.description: Make a fantastic, dazzling water park!

games.name: We Love Katamari REROLL+ Royal Reverie
games.title: We Love Katamari REROLL+ Royal Reverie
games.description:
The second title in the Katamari Damacy series has returned in a remastered, powered-up version!

We Love Katamari REROLL+ Royal Reverie is a fully remastered version of We Love Katamari Damacy, originally released in 2005, with new and improved graphics and gameplay enhancements to make it easier to jump in and have fun. 

Plus, in Royal Reverie, play 5 all new challenges, rolling up katamari as the King of All Cosmos when he was a young prince!

games.name: The Legend of Tianding
games.title: The Legend of Tianding
games.developer: Creative Games Computer Graphics Corporation and Neon Doctrine
games.description: The Legend of Tianding is a sidescrolling action game about Liao Tianding, the legendary Taiwanese Folk Hero. Explore the dazzling streets of Colonial Japanese Taiwan in the early 20th century.
games.developerName: Creative Games Computer Graphics Corporation and Neon Doctrine

games.name: The Alters: Deluxe Edition
games.title: The Alters: Deluxe Edition
games.description: Explore an emotional sci-fi game that features a unique blend of adventure, survival, and base-building elements. Play as Jan Dolski, a simple worker who creates alternative versions of himself in a desperate attempt to escape from a planet where even sun rays can prove deadly.

games.name: Morsels
games.title: Morsels
games.description: Morsels is a fast-paced creature collecting roguelite with a rotating roster of characters to switch between at will. Overcome a clique of killer cats as you fight your way out of the sewers in this unique, action-packed journey.

games.name: Ravenlok
games.title: Ravenlok
games.description: Embark on an enchanting journey in Ravenlok, an action-packed fairytale adventure about a young heroine destined to fulfill a perilous prophecy.

games.name: Infinity Strash: DRAGON QUEST The Adventure of Dai
games.title: Infinity Strash: DRAGON QUEST The Adventure of Dai
games.developer: SQUARE ENIX, GameStudio Inc., KAI GRAPHICS INC.
games.description: The legendary anime DRAGON QUEST The Adventure of Dai arrives as an action RPG!
games.developerName: SQUARE ENIX, GameStudio Inc., KAI GRAPHICS INC.

games.name: Miden Tower
games.title: Miden Tower
games.description: RPG of a soul-stirring story of tragedy and revenge, and a wall maiden!?

games.name: Hoof and Seek
games.title: Hoof and Seek
games.description: Find all the hidden farm animals.

games.name: Together We Live
games.title: Together We Live
games.description: To atone for the sins of humanity, the girl continues to die

games.name: Akuma Rise
games.title: Akuma Rise
games.description: Adventure through the Shadow Realm with three princesses!

games.name: Asdivine Saga
games.title: Asdivine Saga
games.description: Uncover the evil machinations behind a warring kingdom in a fantasy RPG!

games.name: Sword and Fairy: Together Forever
games.title: Sword and Fairy: Together Forever
games.description: Enter a realm that blends ancient mythology with traditional oriental aesthetics in Sword and Fairy: Together Forever, the latest standalone entry in the nearly 27-year-old RPG franchise! Weaving its tale between the three clans of Human, Deity and Demon, Sword and Fairy: Together Forever puts you in command of a memorable party of characters, each with unique personalities, motives, skills, strengths and weaknesses. Only together can they shape the future! Guide them as one in this compelling standalone chapter that serves as a jumping-on point for those new to Sword and Fairy while paying tribute to the series' grand legacy.

games.name: Dragon Bobby
games.title: Dragon Bobby
games.description: A uniquely beautiful game with third-person exploration and puzzles that tells the story of a man's life from birth. You control a dragon who is an analogy of this man in the story. A true reflection on life.

games.name: Oh! Edo Towns
games.title: Oh! Edo Towns
games.description: Plunge into the past for a rousing romp through Edo period Japan!

games.name: Drake Hollow
games.title: Drake Hollow
games.description: Team up with friends to build and defend villages of vegetable folk from deadly feral beasts in the blighted world of The Hollow.

games.name: ImmortalLegacy:TheJadeCipherConsoleEdition
games.title: ImmortalLegacy:TheJadeCipherConsoleEdition
games.description: In order to explore the mystery of his past, TYRE, the former special forces soldier with a special constitution, came to Yingzhou Isle which was located in the legendary Dragon Triangle area. After being attacked by mysterious creatures, the plane that TYRE took crashed and he lost contact with his companions. He found a lot of traces of human activity on the island that had been believed inaccessible. While exploring the terrible secrets behind anomalies despite unpredictable threats, he gradually unfolds the mysterious origins of an ancient Chinese legend. A breathtaking adventure begins here.

games.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley - Digital Deluxe Edition
games.title: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley - Digital Deluxe Edition
games.description: Experience the complete Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley experience in Tove Jansson’s beautiful, lively and melancholic Moomin world in Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley - Digital Deluxe Edition.

games.name: Guacamelee! 2 Complete
games.title: Guacamelee! 2 Complete
games.description: Get the complete Guacamelee! 2 experience by picking up the game and both DLC packs together!

games.name: Street Racer Collection (QUByte Classics)
games.title: Street Racer Collection (QUByte Classics)
games.description: Street Racer is one of the most insane and fun kart racers of the 90s. Run, fight, and win! Speed and brawls on crazy tracks! A classic that mixes racing and fighting, bringing back chaotic battles and irreverent humor for up to 4 players!

games.name: Harvest Moon: Mad Dash
games.title: Harvest Moon: Mad Dash
games.description:
Go solo or take along a few friends in this fast-paced farming frenzy!

Harvest, fish, milk, and more as you fulfill orders to complete each level, but watch out for molten lava, raging boars, and other obstacles!

games.name: Ultimate Wobble Run
games.title: Ultimate Wobble Run
games.description: Run, jump, fall, recover, place obstacles, and race to the finish in Ultimate Wobble Run, a chaotic physics-based party racing game with single-player time trials, leaderboards, party mode, and local multiplayer for up to 4 players.

games.name: My Time at Sandrock Deluxe Edition
games.title: My Time at Sandrock Deluxe Edition

games.name: She Sees Red Interactive Movie
games.title: She Sees Red Interactive Movie

games.name: Forklift Extreme: Deluxe Edition
games.title: Forklift Extreme: Deluxe Edition

games.name: WorldNeverland - Elnea Kingdom
games.title: WorldNeverland - Elnea Kingdom

How would you like to live of life of freedom in the Elnea Kingdom?
Find solace in the company of unique residents,exploring, battling, collecting, farming, romancing, marrying, raising children, etc.
Kick back, relax and enjoy yourself inside the life simulation game, WorldNeverland -Elnea Kingdom.

games.name: Wizard Of Oz: Hidden Object Games

games.name: Dungeon Village 2
games.title: Dungeon Village 2

games.name: Immortality
games.title: Immortality

games.name: Marenian Tavern Story: Patty and the Hungry God
games.title: Marenian Tavern Story: Patty and the Hungry God
games.description: Run an adventure tavern in a fantasy land with Patty! A turn-based RPG where you cook, eat, collect, fight and explore!

games.name: Last Escape: Dead Complex
games.title: Last Escape: Dead Complex
games.description:
Dead Complex is a 2D Top Down, Survival Horror Game.

Sneak, Loot and Fight your way out of an infested apartment complex and begin your final escape from the city.

games.name: Martha Is Dead

games.name: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4 (Windows)
games.title: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4 (Windows)
games.description:
Pre-order any digital edition and receive:

- Items for immediate use in Call of Duty®: Black Ops 7 and Call of Duty®: Warzone™*. Also available in Modern Warfare® 4 at launch:
-- Hunter Killer Operator Skin - Immediately unlock the Hunter Killer Operator Skin
-- Gilded Pearl Camo Pack - Immediately unlock the Moonlit Pearl weapon camo. Plus, get access to unlock the Gilded Ruin weapon camo.
- Campaign Early Access, starting October 16th**

games.name: Tales from Toyotoki: Arrival of the Witch
games.title: Tales from Toyotoki: Arrival of the Witch

games.name: SongPop Party
games.title: SongPop Party
games.description: Can you guess the song? Step up and prove your music knowledge with this fast-paced, competitive, music-based trivia game. Party up locally with up to four players or online with up to eight players!

games.name: Ten Dates
games.title: Ten Dates
games.description: Ten Dates is the sequel to the interactive rom-com, Five Dates, taking place in the post-pandemic world.  Misha, a millennial from London in search of that elusive in-person connection, tricks her best friend Ryan into going to a speed dating event with her. Each with their own five potential matches, Misha and Ryan must pluck up the courage and turn on the charm to date wildly different personalities.

games.name: BALAN WONDERWORLD
games.title: BALAN WONDERWORLD
games.developer: SQUARE ENIX CO., LTD. / ARZEST Corp.
games.description: Over 80 different costumes open up all the action you could want! Welcome to a wondrous all-action show, the likes of which has never been seen before!
games.developerName: SQUARE ENIX CO., LTD. / ARZEST Corp.

games.name: Life is Strange: True Colors - Deluxe Upgrade
games.title: Life is Strange: True Colors - Deluxe Upgrade
games.description: Upgrade to the Deluxe Edition to get ‘Wavelengths’, an all-new story. Play as Steph in the year before Alex came to Haven Springs: spin records, host a radio show, and face your future. Plus: get 4 new Alex outfits inspired by past Life is Strange heroes.

games.name: Isekai Rondo
games.title: Isekai Rondo
games.description: Quest for a parallel universe after being reborn with the ultimate job!

games.name: Sea Fantasy
games.title: Sea Fantasy
games.description: Save the world with fishing!? A pixelated open-world RPG where you embark on an adventure to catch mysterious marine creatures called "Sea'Az".

games.name: Death's Gambit: Afterlife
games.title: Death's Gambit: Afterlife
games.description: A contract binds you to Death who seeks to eradicate immortality. Will you do his bidding and restore the natural order, or succumb to its power in this hardcore 2D action RPG?

games.name: Tears Revolude Special Edition
games.title: Tears Revolude Special Edition
games.description: Explore isometric dungeons and master evolving skills in a classic JRPG

games.name: The Wild at Heart
games.title: The Wild at Heart
games.description: Wield an ever-growing herd of quirky creatures to rebuild broken paths, battle perilous beasts, and solve peculiar puzzles in a rich, interconnected world. Join two young runaways as they unravel the mysteries of a lost realm in this nostalgic storybook fantasy!

games.name: 1f y0u're a gh0st ca11 me here!
games.title: 1f y0u're a gh0st ca11 me here!
games.description: Guide lost souls through chaos in the underworld’s busiest call center!

games.name: Vambrace: Cold Soul
games.title: Vambrace: Cold Soul
games.description: Vambrace: Cold Soul is a roguelike fantasy-adventure set amidst a frozen landscape. Plan your expeditions underground, then journey to the cursed city surface with your team of heroes. Wield unique powers, avoid dangerous traps, brave strange encounters, and survive deadly combat!

games.name: TENGAI
games.title: TENGAI
games.description:
The shrine maiden, monk, and kunoichi take to the sky in this second title
to feature a Japanese-style shooter with quirky aesthetics!
Now with online rankings!

games.name: Roll Mad
games.title: Roll Mad
games.description: Roll Into The Madness

games.name: Noob - The Factionless
games.title: Noob - The Factionless
games.description: Lead a team of adventurers to the highest rank of all guilds!

games.name: Recipe of Love
games.title: Recipe of Love
games.description: A lunch break hidden from the world—our story alone.

games.name: Football, Tactics & Glory – Treble Deluxe Edition
games.title: Football, Tactics & Glory – Treble Deluxe Edition
games.developer: Creoteam Games Ltd.; Raylight Games S.r.l.s.
games.description: Tactics meet passion – lead your team to glory!
games.developerName: Creoteam Games Ltd.; Raylight Games S.r.l.s.

games.name: Lornsword Winter Chronicle
games.title: Lornsword Winter Chronicle
games.description: Lornsword is a story driven action strategy game. As Corun Lan Ka, you will have to use both your sword and your mind to cut through battles. Fight, lead your men, capture gold mines, build your base and call a friend to help you at anytime.

games.name: Monster Boy and the Cursed Kingdom
games.title: Monster Boy and the Cursed Kingdom
games.description:
A legendary series returns with a grand new adventure!

Enjoy a colorful action-adventure game made alongside Ryuichi Nishizawa, creator of the original Wonder Boy in Monster World series.

Monster Boy and the Cursed Kingdom borrows the best from the classic series to deliver a fresh, modern adventure with fun gameplay, memorable music and gorgeous hand drawn animations.

games.name: Learning Factory
games.title: Learning Factory
games.description: It's a factory automation game on vacation: no enemies, no pressure, lots of cats, a three-level generated map, and complex engineering stuff including machine learning. Optimized for gamepads and couch chilling. Contains cat memes.

games.name: Eiyuden Chronicle: Rising
games.title: Eiyuden Chronicle: Rising
games.description: Eiyuden Chronicle: Rising is an action RPG set in the same world as Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. Features town-upgrading mechanics, fast-paced combat, and important back-story for several of the Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes cast of characters.

games.name: Tears Revolude
games.title: Tears Revolude
games.description: Explore isometric dungeons and master evolving skills in a classic JRPG

games.name: ACA NEOGEO FATAL FURY 3
games.title: ACA NEOGEO FATAL FURY 3
games.description:
FATAL FURY 3 is a fighting game released by SNK in 1995. 
A new “Story” is about to begin in the city of South Town. Five new characters join for a total of 10 hungry wolves ready for battle. 
Featuring new elements such as the Oversway and Combination Art mechanic, be ready for epic and intense fights!

games.name: Cat God Ranch
games.title: Cat God Ranch
games.description: Cat God Ranch is an animal-themed casual strategy roguelite game. Manage hundreds of animals to pay tribute to the Cat God! 8 animal families, 100+ animals, 10+ Cat Gods, 100+ items, and various animal combinations waiting for you to explore!

games.name: The House of Da Vinci 3
games.title: The House of Da Vinci 3
games.description:
The grand finale to The House of Da Vinci trilogy is here! Solve numerous new puzzles and mind benders and explore new mystifying locations of ravishing beauty. Use your wits and observational skills to escape rooms and solve the mysterious story behind one of the world’s most prolific inventors in history.

With sharp wits and an open mind, you will prevail.

games.name: Cozy Designer
games.title: Cozy Designer
games.description: Position furniture and objects however you prefer and decorate 60 incredibly cozy environments. Without right or wrong, the only limit is your imagination. Photograph the finished spaces and create your own design gallery!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO REAL BOUT FATAL FURY 2
games.title: ACA NEOGEO REAL BOUT FATAL FURY 2
games.description: REAL BOUT FATAL FURY 2 is a fighting game released by SNK in 1998. It is the 7th title in the Fatal Fury series. New elements have been added on top of refining the previous systems. This entry adds Rick Strowd and Li Xiangfei as playable characters, and Geese Howard makes his return as well!

games.name: I AM THE HERO
games.title: I AM THE HERO
games.description:
I Am The Hero is a pixel art, beat 'em up, fighting game that tells the story of a "Hero" with a glorious but mysterious past. Is he the hero he thinks he is or is there a another side to this legendary figure?

Enjoy fast paced, retro action inspired by modern and old-school classics. I Am The Hero will give you shot of nostalgia and adrenaline that you’ve been crazing.

games.name: Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo: Closure Edition
games.title: Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo: Closure Edition
games.description: A peaceful papercraft adventure where you’ll meet the many good and not-so-good folks of Limbo.

games.name: Lost in Random: The Eternal Die
games.title: Lost in Random: The Eternal Die
games.description: Take on an ancient evil in Lost in Random: The Eternal Die, a fast-paced action roguelite set in the whimsical world of Random. Play as Queen Aleksandra and her die-companion Fortune as you battle twisted foes, wield powerful relics and abilities, and roll the dice to escape this nightmarish realm.

games.name: Fortuna Magus
games.title: Fortuna Magus
games.description: A fantasy RPG where magic is forbidden and destiny begins to move

games.name: Realpolitiks New Power
games.title: Realpolitiks New Power
games.description: Become the leader of any contemporary country in this streamlined real-time grand strategy game. Use diplomacy, espionage, military and economic power to deal with other nations, while tackling issues such as terrorism, financial crises and medical epidemics, all in an effort to achieve global domination!

games.name: Cross Tails
games.title: Cross Tails
games.description: What will the tails witness after a crossing tale? A tactical RPG playable from two points of view!

games.name: Metal: Hellsinger (Xbox Series X|S & PC)
games.title: Metal: Hellsinger (Xbox Series X|S & PC)
games.description: Slay to the rhythm of metal and vengeance on an infernal journey through the eight Hells. Make them fear the beat. Metal: Hellsinger is a rhythm FPS bursting with demons, badass weapons, and heavy metal music.

games.name: Edge of Eternity
games.title: Edge of Eternity
games.description: Wage epic turn-based battles as you follow Daryon and Selene on their quest to find a cure to the all-consuming Corrosion in this grand tale of hope and sacrifice, created by a small team of passionate JRPG lovers.

games.name: DETECTIVE - The Test
games.title: DETECTIVE - The Test
games.description: Test your detective instincts across three challenging cases. No hints, no help, just you, your intuition, and your ability to piece together the truth. Can you solve the mystery?

games.name: Deathbulge: Battle of the Bands
games.title: Deathbulge: Battle of the Bands
games.description: Melt a face, slap a bass or kiss a drum in this RPG about three idiot musicians. Praised for its refreshing take on the JRPG genre.

games.name: FBC: Firebreak Deluxe Edition
games.title: FBC: Firebreak Deluxe Edition
games.description: FBC: Firebreak is a cooperative first-person shooter set within a mysterious federal agency under assault by otherworldly forces.

games.name: Without a Dawn
games.title: Without a Dawn
games.description: Without a Dawn is a dark, psychological, and philosophical visual horror novel.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO KING OF THE MONSTERS
games.title: ACA NEOGEO KING OF THE MONSTERS
games.description:
KING OF THE MONSTERS is an action game released by SNK in 1991.
Players choose from one of the six monsters available, and battle their way across Japan in order to claim the title of strongest monster.
In addition to normal attacks such as punches and kicks, master more destructive techniques such as flame and beam attacks to overcome the enemies.

games.name: The Quiet Things
games.title: The Quiet Things
games.description:
The Quiet Things is an autobiographical game about creators Alyx Jones’s personal experiences growing up in childhood abuse. 

Explore beautifully recreated environments to uncover the story through objects and diary entries.

Ultimately, it’s a game about empathy and hope.

games.name: Tails Noir
games.title: Tails Noir
games.description: Tails Noir is a post-noir narrative adventure. Become raccoon private eye Howard Lotor and explore dystopian Vancouver inhabited by animals as you uncover a deeply personal story of change and transformation.

games.name: RPG Time: The Legend of Wright
games.title: RPG Time: The Legend of Wright
games.description:
It's time for adventure!
When school's out, it's RPG time!
Let's play an RPG that's hand-drawn by a game-loving boy named Kenta, who drew it all on his notebook.
Fun and exciting gimmicks and tricks appear every time you turn the page!
A new, yet nostalgic gaming experience that has won numerous indie game awards is finally coming for your after-school entertainment!

games.name: The Big Con
games.title: The Big Con
games.description: Hustle your way across ‘90s America as a runaway teen con artist. Choose how to make your scratch as you don disguises, pick pockets, and rip people off in this comedic crime-filled adventure. Experience the totally rad '90s in all its plaid and payphone glory!

games.name: Spikeball Smash
games.title: Spikeball Smash
games.description: Play loud. Spikeball Smash is a 1–4 player online party sport. Smash, dive, and spike your way to victory on the beach, the quad, or the arena in fast-paced matches. Perfect for friends, built for parties, and ready to pick up and play even if you’re going solo.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO GAROU: MARK OF THE WOLVES
games.title: ACA NEOGEO GAROU: MARK OF THE WOLVES
games.description:
GAROU: MARK OF THE WOLVES is a fighting game released by SNK in 1999.
The son of Geese Howard, Rock Howard, who has been raised by Terry Bogard is the main character in this first episode of a new generation in the “FATAL FURY” Series. ’
Numerous new game mechanics such as the “Breaking” feature have been introduced in this acclaimed fighting masterpiece resulting in a game with a variety of deep strategies available to players.

games.name: Hot Wheels Monster Trucks: Stunt Mayhem™ Deluxe Edition
games.title: Hot Wheels Monster Trucks: Stunt Mayhem™ Deluxe Edition
games.description: Hot Wheels Monster Trucks: Stunt Mayhem™ Deluxe Edition is the definitive arcade Monster Trucks experience combining the full game with the exclusive Treasure Hunt Pack digital content.

games.name: Little Droid
games.title: Little Droid
games.description: Little Droid is an adventure platformer that takes you to a world of mysteries, tough enemies, and hidden dangers.

games.name: Foot Clinic
games.title: Foot Clinic
games.description:
Healing hands, happy feet!
Be the Foot Clinic hero!

games.name: Legend of Ixtona
games.title: Legend of Ixtona
games.description: Fight turn-based strategy battles and save the kingdom of Ixtona!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO REAL BOUT FATAL FURY SPECIAL
games.title: ACA NEOGEO REAL BOUT FATAL FURY SPECIAL
games.description: REAL BOUT FATAL FURY SPECIAL is a fighting game released by SNK in 1997. Introducing a brand-new 2-line battle system, a refinement of the Power Gauge system, and the abolishment of the ring-out system, the battle tactics of this system have been further improved. Along with Wolfgang Krauser, a total of 19 combatants appear.

games.name: Spacelines from the Far Out
games.title: Spacelines from the Far Out
games.description: Spacelines from the Far Out is a procedurally-generated co-op adventure where you and your friends are the crew of an intergalactic travel company - it’s your job to get your passengers to their location safe, happy, and hopefully with as little vomiting as possible.

games.name: STRIKERS 1945 II
games.title: STRIKERS 1945 II
games.description:
Rapid mainstream action with a hardcore twist!
The second game in the series is a highly polished Psikyo masterpiece—
now with online rankings!

games.name: Eastshade
games.title: Eastshade
games.description: You are a traveling painter, exploring the island of Eastshade. Capture the world on canvas using your artist’s easel. Talk to the inhabitants to learn about their lives. Make friends and help those in need. Visit cities, scale summits, unearth mysteries, and discover forgotten places!

games.name: The Strange Story Of Brian Fisher: Chapter 2
games.title: The Strange Story Of Brian Fisher: Chapter 2
games.description: Brian Fisher wakes up 30 years in the past as a small child, in an unfamiliar place, with no memory of how he arrived there. He is trapped in a different dimension of time and space, and his mission is to find something hidden within this dimension of time and space and bring it back to the present.

games.name: Micro Overdrive: Home Tour
games.title: Micro Overdrive: Home Tour
games.description: A fast-paced top-down arcade racer where tiny cars tear through giant household tracks. Race solo or with friends in chaotic local multiplayer, dodge hazards, master tight controls, and turn every room in the house into a high-speed battleground.

games.name: Pieced Together
games.title: Pieced Together
games.description: Pieced Together is a cozy scrapbooking game that takes you on a heartfelt journey about friendship and getting older.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO THE KING OF FIGHTERS '95
games.title: ACA NEOGEO THE KING OF FIGHTERS '95
games.description:
"THE KING OF FIGHTERS '95" is a fighting game released by SNK in 1995.
In addition to the character of popular work such as "FATAL FURY" and "ART OF FIGHTING" in the sequel title of the previous work "KOF '94", Yagamian will participate as the rival of the main character Kyo Kusanagi.
With the team edit function installed, it became possible to form a team with the player 's favorite character.

games.name: Club Soko
games.title: Club Soko
games.description: Navigate your way deep into an underground nightclub and discover secrets hidden in its depths.

games.name: Life is Strange: Double Exposure Deluxe Edition
games.title: Life is Strange: Double Exposure Deluxe Edition
games.description:
Choose the Deluxe Edition to get two extra Outfit Packs for Max, with 10 exclusive designs!

The Life is Strange: Double Exposure Deluxe Edition contains:

•	Life is Strange: Double Exposure - the complete game
•	Spooky Outfit Pack
•	Decades Outfit Pack

Both the Spooky Outfit Pack and Decades Outfit Pack will be available at launch of the base game.

SPOOKY OUTFIT PACK
Dial up the shivers and indulge your ghost-hunting, monster-wrangling passions with these outfits perfect for Halloween – or for witching hours all year round! This pack contains the Just Haunt It! coat and four indoor outfits: Maxidermy, Ragdoll Max, Max Ghoulfield, and Max O’Lantern.

DECADES OUTFIT PACK
Confront the inexorable passage of time and celebrate your colorful past, with iconic outfits that pay homage to 90s Grunge, 50s Rockabilly, 70s Flower Power, the 80s Mallrat, and 60s Psychedelia.

games.name: The Last Hero of Nostalgaia
games.title: The Last Hero of Nostalgaia
games.description:
The Last Hero of Nostalgaia is a satirical action-adventure, brought to life by a twisted and wicked tale.
Featuring hard but fair combat, *full character customization, unique battle armor and engaging narrative mechanics rich in lore, Nostalgaia plunges you into almost certain death at every turn.

games.name: Urban Jungle
games.title: Urban Jungle
games.description: Use luscious plants to turn your home into a green haven in Urban Jungle.

games.name: Never Grave: The Witch and The Curse -Deluxe Edition-
games.title: Never Grave: The Witch and The Curse -Deluxe Edition-
games.description: A Metroidvania x Roguelite where you journey with the aid of a cursed hat. Use a variety of magic or possess your enemies to reach the lowest levels! Bring back loot, build new facilities in your village, make a living and strengthen yourself for the next battle! Supports up to 4-player multiplayer.

games.name: STRIKERS 1945
games.title: STRIKERS 1945
games.description:
The immensely popular and challenging arcade shooter masterpiece from Psikyo—
now with online rankings!

games.name: Creatures of Ava
games.title: Creatures of Ava
games.description: Let your empathy guide you as you play an exciting action-adventure, creature saver game. Understand and tame the creatures of Ava and let them lead you through a variety of ecosystems – all in the hopes of saving the planet from a life-consuming infection.

games.name: Mori Carta
games.title: Mori Carta
games.description: Mori Carta is a handless deckbuilding roguelike. Choose left or right on every card to adventure through stories. Simple decisions lead to rich and rewarding gameplay. Four dramatically different characters with their own unique card sets, more than 1000 playable cards, over 185 unique enemies.

games.name: Around The World in 80 Days: Hidden Objects
games.title: Around The World in 80 Days: Hidden Objects
games.description: Join Phileas Fogg on a race around the globe! Solve the mystery of the Bank of England robbery as you explore stunning cities. Hunt for hidden objects and spot differences in this 19th-century detective adventure. The clock is ticking. Can you find the truth?

games.name: Riptide GP: Renegade
games.title: Riptide GP: Renegade
games.description: Experience the future of illicit hydrojet racing, where armored riders kick out death-defying stunts over massive waterfalls, dodge cops through public waterways, and boost at breakneck speeds across surging waves.

games.name: Sausage Wars
games.title: Sausage Wars
games.description: An epic sausage battle till the last drop of ketchup!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO AGGRESSORS OF DARK KOMBAT
games.title: ACA NEOGEO AGGRESSORS OF DARK KOMBAT
games.description: AGGRESSORS OF DARK KOMBAT is a fighting game released by SNK in 1994. Pick one of eight intense fighters and go into battle to accomplish their goals. Use the full playing field and dash combined with fierce attacks in this intense, unrestricted battle! Will you win by techniques or by force?! Experience the true rampage of battles.

games.name: Top Racer Collection
games.title: Top Racer Collection
games.description: The Top Racer Collection showcases the renowned 16-bit racing game franchise, featuring Top Racer, Top Racer 2, and Top Racer 3000, along with exciting new and exclusive content!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO MAGICIAN LORD
games.title: ACA NEOGEO MAGICIAN LORD
games.description:
MAGICIAN LORD is a side-scrolling action game released by SNK in 1990. 
This fantasy action game was one of the launch titles onNEOGEO. 
Control the magician Elta on a journey to save the world from Gal-Agiese, who came back to life once again.

games.name: Duck Detective: The Secret Salami
games.title: Duck Detective: The Secret Salami
games.description: Solving crime is no walk in the pond. You are a down-on-his-luck detective who also happens to be a duck. Use your powers of de-duck-tion to inspect evidence, fill in the blanks, and bust the case wide open.

games.name: Clan N
games.title: Clan N
games.description: Fight alone or with your friends, master the art of battle and bring peace back to the land in this arcade inspired epic brawler!

games.name: Samurai Aces
games.title: Samurai Aces
games.description:
The shrine maiden and monk take to the sky in Psikyo's debut game,
a Japanese-style shooter with quirky aesthetics.
Now with online rankings!

games.name: Cricket 26 - Pro Team Edition
games.title: Cricket 26 - Pro Team Edition
games.description: Featuring the all-new Management Career, a bigger and better Pro Team, in-depth Ashes mode, and expanded control on and off the field from enhanced gameplay and in-depth strategies - Cricket 26 is The Ultimate Showdown.

games.name: Bug Fables: The Everlasting Sapling
games.title: Bug Fables: The Everlasting Sapling
games.description: Follow Vi, Kabbu, and Leif as they uncover the secrets of the Land of Bugaria! Explore and combine your team's abilities to solve puzzles, defeat powerful enemies and find ancient treasures!

games.name: Go Mecha Ball
games.title: Go Mecha Ball
games.description: Load up and roll out, in this twin stick shooter with roguelike progression! Blast your way through arcade-style levels, using pinball-style physics mixed with an arsenal of devastating weapons. Defeat waves of enemy bots, battle big bosses, and upgrade your mech between runs!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO NINJA MASTER'S
games.title: ACA NEOGEO NINJA MASTER'S
games.description:
NINJA MASTER'S is a fighting game released by SNK in 1996.
Set in the world of Zipangu, where twelve fierce warriors known for being demons on the battlefield, both with and without weapons, clash spectacularly in a flurry of amazing combos and special attacks.
Don't miss any of the action, from the Strength Gauge to increase damage to the Super Fired-up Mode that leads to flashy action-packed moves!

games.name: Escape First
games.title: Escape First
games.description: Escape with your friends or take them up on a challenge to see who is going to Escape First!

games.name: Overrogue
games.title: Overrogue
games.description: A card deck-building roguelite! Explore labyrinths each time from level 1!

games.name: Tardy
games.title: Tardy
games.description: Tardy is a story driven space adventure about war, emotions, love and passion for old computer devices…

games.name: Rock 'N Racing Off Road
games.title: Rock 'N Racing Off Road
games.description: Rock'N Racing Off Road DX offers the most entertaining and exciting races, with loads of skids, crashes and amazing jumps. You will have several modes of play, such as Cup mode, time trial and multi-player with the option of up to 4 Players at a time.

games.name: Bloodshore
games.title: Bloodshore
games.developer: Wales Interactive, Good Gate Media, Wayout Pictures, Posterity Entertainment
games.description: Bloodshore is an interactive action movie about a televised battle royale between high-profile streamers, entertainers and death row inmates. You control the fate of Nick, a washed-up actor who fights for a life-changing cash prize.
games.developerName: Wales Interactive, Good Gate Media, Wayout Pictures, Posterity Entertainment

games.name: ACA NEOGEO 2020 SUPER BASEBALL
games.title: ACA NEOGEO 2020 SUPER BASEBALL
games.description:
2020 SUPER BASEBALL is a baseball game released by SNK in 1991.
In the near future, there are two leagues with 6 teams each. Players pick their team, and compete for the championship. As the game progresses, landmines will be set up on the field, and armor can be purchased during games to reinforce players. These unique aspects make for a very different baseball experience!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO ART OF FIGHTING 3
games.title: ACA NEOGEO ART OF FIGHTING 3
games.description: ART OF FIGHTING 3 is a fighting game released by SNK in 1996. As a side-story in the ART OF FIGHTING series, it portrays the drama and battles of the various fighters. With the Ultimate KO system and other mechanics, it makes a stake in a new frontier of 2D fighting games.

games.name: Mashina
games.title: Mashina
games.description: A little robot digs to repair her world. Dig, build, discover and mend in a chill, stop-motion world.

games.name: Nordic Ashes: The Complete Saga
games.title: Nordic Ashes: The Complete Saga
games.description: Nordic Ashes is a challenging Norse inspired roguelite-survivor game, where you’ll have to survive hordes of creatures that come your way.

games.name: Rhythm Doctor
games.title: Rhythm Doctor
games.description: Save patients' lives in this rhythm game where you heal by defibrillating in time to their heartbeats. Learn each patient's unique heartbeat and defeat boss viruses trying to sabotage your rhythm, all set to heart-pumping, soul-soothing music

games.name: ACA NEOGEO REAL BOUT FATAL FURY
games.title: ACA NEOGEO REAL BOUT FATAL FURY
games.description:
REAL BOUT FATAL FURY is a fighting game released by SNK in 1995.
Using the previous system as a base, isolating the Sweep Button, the inclusion of Combination Attacks, 
and other elements such as ring outs make for an even speedier and tempo-based play style.
Sixteen fighters battle it out to see who is the strongest.

games.name: Musical Vibes RX
games.title: Musical Vibes RX
games.description: Dance hands-free with Musical Vibes RX! Use your smartphone camera to track your moves, play solo or with a friend, customize your avatar, and light up your room with Philips Hue!

games.name: Hauntii
games.title: Hauntii
games.description: A beguiling adventure in which you uncover the secrets of an expansive and mysterious world - haunting both the environment and its denizens to craft ingenious solutions to the many challenges that await.

games.name: Operencia: The Stolen Sun
games.title: Operencia: The Stolen Sun
games.description: Operencia: The Stolen Sun embraces everything you love about classic first-person dungeon-crawlers, enhancing the old-school turn-based RPG experience with modern sensibilities. Gather your team of memorable characters and guide them through a world inspired by Central European mythology.

games.name: The Dungeon Of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet Of Chaos - Chicken Edition
games.title: The Dungeon Of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet Of Chaos - Chicken Edition
games.description: Step into the wacky heroic fantasy universe of the Dungeon of Naheulbeuk. Lead a team of unlikely and clumsy heroes in an epic and challenging tactical RPG. Live an adventure filled with humor, surprises and silly encounters.

games.name: Turnip Boy Commits Tax Evasion
games.title: Turnip Boy Commits Tax Evasion
games.description: Play as an adorable, yet trouble-making turnip. Avoid paying taxes, solve plantastic puzzles, and take on massive beasts in a journey to tear down a corrupt vegetable government!

games.name: The Smurfs 2 : The Prisoner of the Green Stone
games.title: The Smurfs 2 : The Prisoner of the Green Stone
games.description: Liberate the village of the Smurfs from the grip of the Green Stone!

games.name: Eastward
games.title: Eastward
games.description: Welcome to the charming world of Eastward - population declining! Journey through a society on the brink of collapse. Discover delightful towns, strange creatures and even stranger people! Wield a trusty frying pan and mystic powers on an adventure into the unknown…

games.name: Gigantosaurus: Dino Sports
games.title: Gigantosaurus: Dino Sports
games.description: On your marks for a roar-some sports party for one to four dinos. These eight chomp-sized games are enormous fun – but watch out for Giganto!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO ART OF FIGHTING
games.title: ACA NEOGEO ART OF FIGHTING
games.description:
"ART OF FIGHTING" is a fighting game released by SNK in 1992.
Ryo Sakazaki and Robert Garcia fight against numerous enemies to to free Yuri Sakazaki who was kidnaped by a mysterious person.This game is known as an ambitious title via the introduction of spirit gauge and representation on characters of the damage received by the enemy.

games.name: Edgar Poe: Hidden Objects Game
games.title: Edgar Poe: Hidden Objects Game
games.description: Unravel Poe’s captivating mystery in The Fall of the House of Usher! Explore haunting rooms, find hidden objects, and solve puzzles in this gothic detective adventure, now fully optimised for Xbox with enhanced visuals and full controller support!

games.name: The Procession to Calvary
games.title: The Procession to Calvary
games.description: The Procession to Calvary is an adventure game in which you journey through a richly detailed landscape built from hundreds of Renaissance paintings.

games.name: Metal Tales Overkill
games.title: Metal Tales Overkill
games.description: Survive with the ultimate 3D guitar-shooter roguelike. Fight the curse on your Metal brothers and deliver them from the ancestral evil.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO SAMURAI SHODOWN V SPECIAL
games.title: ACA NEOGEO SAMURAI SHODOWN V SPECIAL
games.description:
SAMURAI SHODOWN V SPECIAL is a fighting game released by SNK in 2004.
Bringing together 28 of your favorite characters, including past bosses!
The familiar Rage Explosion, Concentration One Gauge, and Fatal Flash from previous titles in the series are still here, and you can't miss this chance to take down your opponents in one hit with flashy Desperate Techniques!

games.name: Mythwrecked: Ambrosia Island
games.title: Mythwrecked: Ambrosia Island
games.description: You’re shipwrecked on a lost mythical island. As backpacker Alex, you must befriend the forgotten gods of Greek mythology and restore their memories. Explore the dynamic island and its story sandbox to build new friendships, solve the mystery and save the gods.

games.name: Educational Games for Kids (Cross-Buy)
games.title: Educational Games for Kids (Cross-Buy)
games.description: At last: a well thought-out, smart, polished, ‘console quality’ educational game pack is out for your kids. Suitable for boys and girls from ages 3 to 18. A pack of 21 different games with 51 variations that educate in various ways like: reflexes, logic, math, memory and knowledge. 4K@120FPS (Xbox Series X & PC) and 4K@60FPS (Xbox One & PC).

games.name: WORD SEARCH BY JGABRIB
games.title: WORD SEARCH BY JGABRIB
games.description: Playing word search puzzles helps improve focus, attention, and pattern recognition in a calm and enjoyable way. It’s a light mental exercise that keeps your mind active while offering a relaxing break from fast-paced games.

games.name: Ho Ho & Move
games.title: Ho Ho & Move
games.description: Collect gifts, and plan the perfect path.

games.name: Hypercar Racing
games.title: Hypercar Racing
games.description: In Hypercar Racing you'll enjoy the dirtiest, fastest, and most spectacular races at speeds over 200 Mp/h, avoiding multiple collisions against 20 adversaries. The game has different modes, such as Championship, Arcade, and 4-player multiplayer.

games.name: Riverbond
games.title: Riverbond
games.description: Riverbond is a fun and frantic couch co-op adventure game for 1 to 4 players set in a stunning voxel world. Embark on a heroic journey to complete missions, battle adorable enemies, and smash everything into tiny cubes! Will you and your friends be the legendary heroes of Riverbond?

games.name: Fortuna Magus Special Edition
games.title: Fortuna Magus Special Edition
games.description: A fantasy RPG where magic is forbidden and destiny begins to move

games.name: Touchdown Pinball
games.title: Touchdown Pinball
games.description: Score some touchdowns and win the game in the most entertaining Pinball!

games.name: Homestead Arcana
games.title: Homestead Arcana
games.description: Become a farming Witch and pioneer the range that has been mysteriously corrupted with Miasma. Discover the secret behind its appearance, grow plants to power up your spells, and use nature’s magic to heal the land.

games.name: Slayers X: Terminal Aftermath: Vengance of the Slayer
games.title: Slayers X: Terminal Aftermath: Vengance of the Slayer
games.description: So.... got what it takes to be a X Slayer?!?... 7 weapons, blood and gore, twisted music by Seepage & Psyko Syndikate, and maps where you can blow up everything. its awesome. started making it in 1998 in high school with my friend and now im 37, so i have life experience now.

games.name: Arashi Gaiden
games.title: Arashi Gaiden
games.description: Arashi Gaiden is a turn-based action game with frenetic dash and slash combat. Use your blades, shurikens, teleports and chains to quickly cut through enemies and face powerful Bosses with unique mechanics that redefine what a turn-based game is.

games.name: Guacamelee! 2
games.title: Guacamelee! 2
games.description: Head back to the Mexiverse in this long-awaited sequel to the smash hit Guacamelee! Uppercut your way to victory across stunning new hand-crafted levels. Featuring full 4-player co-op, fancy new wrestling moves, sassy new bosses, twice the enemies, and 300% more chickens!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO SENGOKU 2
games.title: ACA NEOGEO SENGOKU 2
games.description:
“SENGOKU 2” is a side scrolling action game released by SNK in 1993.
Take on the role of a warrior summoned by a shrine princess, and fight over various historical periods in order to defeat the dark monarch.
Players can enjoy new tactical features such as charge attacks and defensive abilities.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO FATAL FURY
games.title: ACA NEOGEO FATAL FURY
games.description:
"FATAL FURY" is a fighting game released by SNK in 1991.
Players take part in brutal street fights in a variety of locations, with the goal of toppling the infamous crime lord Geese Howard.
The game includes very unique features when compared to other fighting games available at the time, including a special Line Battle system that allows players to traverse between the foreground and background and 2-player co-op functionality.

games.name: Farworld Pioneers
games.title: Farworld Pioneers
games.description: An open-world, sci-fi sandbox. Explore alone or with friends in multiplayer, build and manage colonies on alien planets and recruit AI survivors with unique personalities and skills. Craft, build, mine and farm together, or strap an electric death rifle to your back and take on the galaxy!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO RAGNAGARD
games.title: ACA NEOGEO RAGNAGARD
games.description:
RAGNAGARD is a fighting game released by SNK in 1996.
Take control of unique characters based on gods and beasts of legend, and take down your enemies to gain power over Heaven.
This game's Element System allows for a variety of playing styles. Charge your Element Gauge to utilize destructive Disaster Arts and Miracle Arts!

games.name: The Artful Escape
games.title: The Artful Escape
games.description: On the eve of his first performance, Francis Vendetti battles with the legacy of a dead folk legend and the cosmic wanderings of his own imagination. Francis, a teenage guitar prodigy, sets out on a psychedelic, multidimensional journey to inspire his stage persona.

games.name: ZERO GUNNER 2-
games.title: ZERO GUNNER 2-
games.description:
Break through the encirclement
while controlling an attack helicopter in this top-down shooter.
Now with online rankings!

games.name: From Space
games.title: From Space
games.description: From Space is a solo and co-op action-shooter for squads up to four players. Take on the challenge of liberating the earth from an alien infestation with your friends, using over-the-top weaponry in a post-apolcayptic world with awesomely stylized graphics. The apocalypse has never been so much fun!

games.name: Wander Stars
games.title: Wander Stars
games.description: Unleash custom attacks by combining words in this Super! Anime! Turn-Based! RPG! Collect all 200 words, earn Pep Ups from honorable victories and become a Kiai master. Befriend your rivals, uncover dark mysteries, and seek out the pieces of the Wanderstar map in a wild race across the universe.

games.name: Ashen: Definitive Edition
games.title: Ashen: Definitive Edition
games.description: Ashen is an open world co-op action RPG about a wanderer in search of a place to call home.

games.name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel
games.title: Fuga: Melodies of Steel
games.description:
"We have to fight! If we don't, everyone we love will be taken away!"

One fateful night, a peaceful village is thrown into the flames of war. Determined to save their families, a group of children boards a giant tank and begins an offensive charge!

Fuga: Melodies of Steel is an RPG where you place children, each with their own unique characteristics and skills, at different gun turrets in a tank to fight against the enemy.

Living inside the tank, the children show emotion and gain affinity amongst each other. Manage these both to change the outcome of their journey!

games.name: Arcade Archives 2 Tatakae! Big Fighter
games.title: Arcade Archives 2 Tatakae! Big Fighter
games.description:
"Tatakae! Big Fighter" is a shooter released by Nichibutsu in 1989.
In this game, you can switch between fighter jet and robot form during battle.
The key to clearing a stage is to strengthen your ship with power-up items that appear along the way and change its shape to suit the situation.

games.name: Arcadia Fallen
games.title: Arcadia Fallen
games.description: Play the role of a young alchemist apprentice who is unwillingly bound to an illegal spirit. Suddenly drawn into a war between humanity and magic, they must join a group of unlikely heroes to escape their own doom, hopefully saving the world along the way.

games.name: MIDNIGHT Remastered
games.title: MIDNIGHT Remastered
games.description: A remastered version of the 2017 web game 'MIDNIGHT', collect the seven letters of the deadly sins and repent your past offences in this horror game.

games.name: Tri6: Infinite 2
games.title: Tri6: Infinite 2
games.description: Tri6: Infinite 2 is futuristic arcade racing without brakes: race across procedurally generated cyber tracks, dodge traps, use power-ups, and experience thrilling high-speed action. Every run is unique — how long can you last?

games.name: Car Cops
games.title: Car Cops
games.description: From traffic stops to high-speed chases – think you’ve got what it takes to keep the streets safe?

games.name: Shark Pinball
games.title: Shark Pinball
games.description: Try to survive this infested shark waters in this Pinball game.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO BURNING FIGHT
games.title: ACA NEOGEO BURNING FIGHT
games.description:
BURNING FIGHT is an action game released by SNK in 1991. 
Japanese and US detectives must work together and risk their lives to infiltrate the enemy hideout of a large syndicate and a crime organization that dominates western Japan. 
Use your punches, kicks, and deadly special moves to accomplish your mission!

games.name: PJ Masks Power Heroes: Mighty Alliance
games.title: PJ Masks Power Heroes: Mighty Alliance
games.description: Team up with the Power Heroes and rebuild PJ Power HQ. Hop into the Explorider, find the lost parts, and save the day!

games.name: Monster Train
games.title: Monster Train
games.description:
Hell has frozen over. Only you can protect the final burning pyre from the forces of heaven and restore the inferno. Monster Train brings a new strategic layer to roguelike deckbuilding, with three vertical playing fields to defend.
Includes the released updates Wild Mutations and Friends & Foes! 
Visit powerful locations
To take back hell, you’ll need to power up. Choose your route carefully, different locations yield different benefits; upgrade your champion, recruit powerful units, upgrade cards, gain passive bonuses or duplicate any card in your deck.
Strategize to fit your playstyle
With five clans to choose from, each has its own unique and surprising gameplay. Pick your primary and supporting clan to gain access to all cards from both. During your run you will be able to improve cards by mixing and matching upgrades to open up new roads to victory. 
Challenge your friends, build your own crazy run to defeat or join in the frantic multiplayer mode Hellrush.

games.name: FMV Thriller Killer
games.title: FMV Thriller Killer
games.description: Wales Interactive are proud to offer you the best FMV thriller killer games all discounted in one bundle!

games.name: Raging Bytes
games.title: Raging Bytes
games.description: A story-driven zombie RPG full of drama and pixels! Survive the raging bytes!

games.name: Ruinverse
games.title: Ruinverse
games.description: RPG with a two-souled heroine! Discover the mystery behind the stone monuments!

games.name: METRO QUESTER
games.title: METRO QUESTER
games.description: Seek the truth of a lost world in a hack and slash dungeon exploration RPG!

games.name: DEMON'S TILT
games.title: DEMON'S TILT
games.description: TURBO CHARGED PINBALL RETURNS! Now with bigger sprites, more baddies, more secrets & MORE BULLETS! Demon's Tilt pushes the limits of the Video Pinball genre with SHMUP & Hack N' Slash elements.

games.name: Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona
games.title: Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona
games.description: Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona is a challenging 2D action platformer with RPG elements inspired by Soulslike games.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO FATAL FURY 2
games.title: ACA NEOGEO FATAL FURY 2
games.description:
"FATAL FURY 2" is a fighting game released by SNK in 1992.
Terry, Andy, Joe return from the previous installment along withfive new fighters in order to decide whi is the strongest one.
In addition to Desperation Moves which can change the outcome of the battle, the two-lane plane mechanic is back stronger than ever, allowing players to fight each other in stage backgrounds.

games.name: Your Toy
games.title: Your Toy
games.description: “Your Toy” is a 3D first person escape game that incorporates elements of horror.

games.name: Turnip Boy Robs a Bank
games.title: Turnip Boy Robs a Bank
games.description: Turnip Boy is back! This time he’s teaming up with the fearsome Pickled Gang to plan and execute the weirdest heist of all time. Shake down hostages, steal precious valuables, battle the fuzz, and use wacky tools bought off the dark web to move further into the vaults of the Botanical Bank.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO FATAL FURY SPECIAL
games.title: ACA NEOGEO FATAL FURY SPECIAL
games.description:
FATAL FURY SPECIAL is a fighting game released by SNK in 1993. 
FATAL FURY SPECIAL is a powered-up version of FATAL FURY 2 which brings a faster game speed, introduces combo attacks for the first time in the Series, 
and welcomes more returning characters for a total of 15 fighters. 
Clear the game with specific conditions and Ryo Sakazaki from ART OF FIGHTING will appear.

games.name: XEL
games.title: XEL
games.description: XEL is an epic 3D sci-fi fantasy action-adventure.

games.name: Moon Raider: Anniversary Edition
games.title: Moon Raider: Anniversary Edition
games.description: A half-alien princess must save her dying mother, the former queen of the moon. Supports 2-player co-op!

games.name: SteamWorld Heist II
games.title: SteamWorld Heist II
games.description: Join Captain Leeway on the biggest Heist yet to save botkind from a brewing water crisis! With tactical turn-based battles featuring signature ricochet action, 150+ weapons and items, a new job system, real-time naval combat and 30+ hours of gameplay, prepare for an epic SteamWorld adventure!

games.name: 6 Beauty Simulator Games Collection
games.title: 6 Beauty Simulator Games Collection
games.description: Bake, style, and shine in the ultimate beauty simulator collection!

games.name: SOL DIVIDE -SWORD OF DARKNESS-
games.title: SOL DIVIDE -SWORD OF DARKNESS-
games.description:
Enter a world of swords and sorcery in this fantasy shooter,
and crush the enemy's plan to revive ancient demons!
Now with online rankings!

games.name: Nowhere Prophet
games.title: Nowhere Prophet
games.description: You are the last hope to a band of outcastes and refugees. Lead them across the randomly generated wastelands. Pick fights with greedy slavers and crazy machines using the turn-based card combat. Can you survive long enough to reach the mysterious Crypt?

games.name: ACA NEOGEO ART OF FIGHTING 2
games.title: ACA NEOGEO ART OF FIGHTING 2
games.description:
ART OF FIGHTING 2 is a fighting game released by SNK in 1994. 
Twelve fighters compete to be crowned as the strongest one in the “King of Fighters” ultimate fighting championship. 
 New mechanics such as the revamped “Rage Guage”, the addition of both weak and strong attacks, and a landing recovery mechanic mean that battles are even more intense than in the previous title!.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO NAM-1975
games.title: ACA NEOGEO NAM-1975
games.description:
NAM-1975 is an action game released by SNK in 1990. It was one of the first ever games released on NEOGEO!
Players will take on the role of U.S. Special Forces soldiers braving a harsh battlefield as they try to survive a series of deadly firefights.
Players will need to use collectible power-ups and other abilities such as their evasive roll to complete their mission!

games.name: Hidden Paws
games.title: Hidden Paws
games.description: It's winter and cats are still outside. Find them and bring them home.

games.name: Akuma Rise Special Edition
games.title: Akuma Rise Special Edition
games.description: Adventure through the Shadow Realm with three princesses!

games.name: Quest Hunter
games.title: Quest Hunter
games.description: Quest Hunter is an isometric action-RPG where your choice drives the story. Find tons of treasures and secrets, solve puzzles, equip your character, level up your skills and finish off enemy bosses. Play on the couch, alone or with friends, or make it an online party for up to four players!

games.name: Galacticare
games.title: Galacticare
games.description: Save the galaxy - one patient at a time! As the new director of Galacticare, you will build and manage a series of hospitals to keep your patients alive for as long as possible - for money! And also because it’s the right thing to do.

games.name: Sky Roll!
games.title: Sky Roll!
games.description: Tilt the world, roll the ball!

games.name: Showgunners
games.title: Showgunners
games.description: Join a brutal reality show in dystopian future. Win or die.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO SAMURAI SHODOWN V
games.title: ACA NEOGEO SAMURAI SHODOWN V
games.description: SAMURAI SHODOWN V is a fighting game released by SNK in 2003. Yoshitora Tokugawa, Mina Majikina and more join the cast of twenty-four warriors. New systems available include the Sword Gauge and Concentration One, for even more sword-swinging action.

games.name: Pets Hidden In The Office
games.title: Pets Hidden In The Office
games.description: Pets Hidden In The Office is a chaotic 3D hidden object game where you must find and catch wild pets causing mayhem at work. From fake deaths to crazy escapes, these furry troublemakers won’t go down easily. Time to clean up the office jungle!

games.name: Eville
games.title: Eville
games.description: In this multiplayer social deduction game you can live out your evil side and commit stealthy murders. As a villager, you must unmask the conspirators before you get an axe to your face! No matter what: you will need your social skills to stay alive!

games.name: Arcadia Fallen II
games.title: Arcadia Fallen II
games.description: In this sequel to the award-winning Roleplay Visual Novel, Arcadia Fallen, you play as a senior student at the Seven Winds Academy. Choose from three different magical disciplines, and let your choices shape the personality of your character as they navigate school life during a time of great change.

games.name: Infantry Attack
games.title: Infantry Attack
games.description:
Soldier! War is coming, and duty calls you! 
Enemies are invading our country, and we need YOU to defend it!

games.name: ARIDA: Backland's Awakening
games.title: ARIDA: Backland's Awakening
games.description: ARIDA: Backland's Awakening. A story of survival and adventure in the brazilian backlands. Face the drought to explore the more arid regions, gather resources and discover clues about the fate of the young Cícera.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO KING OF THE MONSTERS 2
games.title: ACA NEOGEO KING OF THE MONSTERS 2
games.description:
KING OF THE MONSTERS 2 is an action game released by SNK in 1992.
Choose 1 of 3 monsters to thrash aliens around the world and become the undisputed King of the Monsters!
Work together in a 2 player co-op mode, or duke it out in versus mode!

games.name: Chopper Strike!
games.title: Chopper Strike!
games.description: Adrenaline-fueled aerial combat

games.name: Virtual Families 3: Our Country Home
games.title: Virtual Families 3: Our Country Home
games.description: Virtual Families 3: Our Country Home is a new way to play! Now a premium experience with no micro transactions to buy!

games.name: Hannah
games.title: Hannah
games.description: 3D puzzle cinematic platformer set in a retro and surreal world. Help Hannah retrieve her doll that was kidnapped by a mysterious force. Experience a dark story in which the player can reach one of multiple endings.

games.name: Full Metal Furies
games.title: Full Metal Furies
games.description: From the creators of Rogue Legacy comes a "true-cooperative" action RPG. FULL METAL FURIES puts an emphasis on team play with a unique combat system where everyone is important. Play on the couch, alone or with friends, or make it an online party for up to four players!

games.name: Pinball Jam
games.title: Pinball Jam
games.description: The ultimate pinball collection it's here!

games.name: Frog Detective: The Entire Mystery
games.title: Frog Detective: The Entire Mystery
games.description: You're a detective, and a frog, and it's time to solve 3 thrilling mysteries!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO CROSSED SWORDS
games.title: ACA NEOGEO CROSSED SWORDS
games.description: CROSSED SWORDS is an action game released by SNK in 1991. In order to defeat the demon Nausizz, use Weapon Attacks, Magic Attacks, and your Defend ability as you make your way through seven intense stages. Up to two players can play simultaneously with the unique 3D perspective. Buy weapons with accumulated GOLD. Characters also grow in strength through an RPG-like system.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO PUZZLE BOBBLE
games.title: ACA NEOGEO PUZZLE BOBBLE
games.description:
PUZZLE BOBBLE is an action puzzle game released by Taito in 1994.
Bub and Bob, the bubble spitting dragons from the action game, BUBBLE BOBBLE, are back in a new bubble-based puzzle!
Skillfully bounce bubbles off the walls and match 3 or more bubbles of the same color to erase them!
Enjoy the easy to learn, but hard to master, bubble shooter puzzle game!

games.name: UnderMine
games.title: UnderMine
games.description: An action-adventure roguelike with a bit of RPG tossed in. Adventure deep into the UnderMine and discover powerful relics, deadly enemies, hidden secrets, and a few friends to help along the way.

games.name: NORCO
games.title: NORCO
games.description: NORCO is a text-based point & click adventure that immerses the player in the sinking suburbs and industrial swamplands of an increasingly surreal and distorted South Louisiana.

games.name: BROK the InvestiGator
games.title: BROK the InvestiGator
games.description:
The very first PUNCH & CLICK!
What kind of detective will you be?

games.name: Hundred Days - Winemaking Simulator
games.title: Hundred Days - Winemaking Simulator
games.description:
Winemaking could be your best adventure. 
Make the best wine interacting with soil and nature and take your winery to the top.
Your beautiful journey into the winemaking tradition starts now.

games.name: Countless Army
games.title: Countless Army
games.description: Be the villain in this Reverse Tower Defense. Send waves after waves of troops to break the enemy defenses. Summon, upgrade your troops and conquer the whole world.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2 MOUSER
games.title: Arcade Archives 2 MOUSER
games.description:
"MOUSER" is an action game released by UPL in 1983.
Take control of the tomcat Nyanta and rescue his lover Mariya from her mouse captors!
The tricky mice will come at you with all sorts of surprises.
Nyanta will need all your luck and help to make it back with his fiancée!

games.name: SteamWorld Dig 2
games.title: SteamWorld Dig 2
games.description: SteamWorld Dig is back! Dig deep, gain riches and unearth the terrors of the underworld in this platform mining adventure influenced by classic Metroidvania style games.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO FOOTBALL FRENZY
games.title: ACA NEOGEO FOOTBALL FRENZY
games.description:
FOOTBALL FRENZY is a sports game released by SNK in 1992. Select from one of ten individual teams and compete to win the championship.
A variety of formations allows for countless play patterns and extremely realistic games. A two-player versus mode is also available.

games.name: Ultra Pixel Survive 2
games.title: Ultra Pixel Survive 2
games.description: Ultra Pixel Survive is back with even more heroes, powers, and monsters!

games.name: Kingdom Two Crowns: Olympus Edition
games.title: Kingdom Two Crowns: Olympus Edition
games.description: In addition to Kingdom Two Crowns, this edition includes Call of Olympus, the latest major expansion set in ancient Greece!

games.name: Top Driver
games.title: Top Driver
games.description: The ultimate challenge of speed and skill

games.name: ACA NEOGEO SHOCK TROOPERS 2nd Squad
games.title: ACA NEOGEO SHOCK TROOPERS 2nd Squad
games.description:
SHOCK TROOPERS 2nd Squad is a military action game released by SNK in 1998. 
Four mercenaries have risen up to thwart the ambitions of a massive corporation. In addition to a main attack, weapon, and jump abilities, vehicles have also been added to the gameplay, which together with branching paths give the player the ultimate freedom in choosing how they will take on stages.

games.name: Tempopo
games.title: Tempopo
games.description: A psychedelic soundscape in the sky. Puzzle through the seasons by conducting chaotic Tempopo to rescue musical flowers. Design and populate your melodic garden, then let the music play!

games.name: Flock
games.title: Flock
games.description: Flock is a multiplayer co-op game about the joy of flight and collecting adorable flying creatures with your friends. Soar through beautiful landscapes, seeking out rare and elusive creatures to add to your flock.

games.name: The Touryst
games.title: The Touryst
games.description:
Enjoy your vacation!
Game leverages Smart Delivery allowing access to both the Xbox One title and Xbox Series X title when available

games.name: The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters
games.title: The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters
games.description: The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters is an atmospheric, story-driven game. Immerse yourself in the warped Sehwa district as you encounter an engaging cast of characters, solve puzzles, discover revealing clues, and fight for survival against a relentless psycho.

games.name: Black Pieces Move First
games.title: Black Pieces Move First
games.description: Chess, but with a unique twist: you freely control a rebellious black pawn, determined to change the rules of the game. Dozens of chess sokoban puzzles with a touch of action and a tale of revenge.

games.name: Smurfs Kart
games.title: Smurfs Kart
games.description: Who will be the fastest Smurf in town?

games.name: Ambition Record
games.title: Ambition Record
games.description: Raise the song of victory in a fantasy RPG and experience true dragon power!

games.name: Wild West: Hidden Objects
games.title: Wild West: Hidden Objects
games.description: Step into the Cyber Wild West as a sharp-eyed detective! Search for hidden objects, follow clues, and uncover secrets in a town ruled by tech and outlaws. Twists, rivals, and mysterious characters await in this stylish story-driven adventure!

games.name: The Pedestrian
games.title: The Pedestrian
games.description: I can see the signs in my sleep now, always guiding me closer. Will this really work? Have we almost achieved the impossible?

games.name: Noel the Mortal Fate
games.title: Noel the Mortal Fate
games.description:
A revenge drama about a girl, a devil and their companions...

Noel the Mortal Fate is an adventure title which started serialization as a free game in 2016 and later spawned comics and novels.
This version of the game has been remade for a console experience, with updated UI, story and dialogue. It follows the story from the prologue throught Season 7 of the series where the real battle begins for Noel and her companions. Furthermore, you can experience the epic story unfold through full HD support.

This version also features Season 3.5, a bonus season which takes place between the Burrows and Jullian storylines.

games.name: Brass: A Peaceful, Cozy Adventure
games.title: Brass: A Peaceful, Cozy Adventure
games.description: A Peaceful, Cozy Adventure Game

games.name: Kuznetsk 1997: Detective Visual Novel
games.title: Kuznetsk 1997: Detective Visual Novel
games.description: Uncover the secrets of the city of Kuznetsk - a detective story where the past comes to life!

games.name: Build a Bridge!
games.title: Build a Bridge!
games.description: Test your engineering and improvisation skills in a game where the stakes are as high as they get. It is you who will construct bridges for cars, trucks, buses..

games.name: Buffet Boss
games.title: Buffet Boss
games.description: Cook your way to the top and rule the restaurant scene!

games.name: KEMCO RPG Selection Vol. 1
games.title: KEMCO RPG Selection Vol. 1
games.description: Enjoy 4 fantasy adventures at once!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO NINJA COMMANDO
games.title: ACA NEOGEO NINJA COMMANDO
games.description: NINJA COMMANDO is an action game released by SNK in 1992. Fight to protect history from death merchants planning to bring chaos to the world. Shoot, use Ninja Tricks and Death Blows, and accumulate scrolls to perform Transformations for a variety of attacks. Two-player simultaneous play is also available.

games.name: Sisters Royale: Five Sisters Under Fire
games.title: Sisters Royale: Five Sisters Under Fire
games.description: Sparks flare around the man all five sisters wish to claim.

games.name: Goetia
games.title: Goetia
games.description: Goetia is a point & click adventure where you play the ghost of a young lady. You are Abigail. Abigail Blackwood.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO SHOCK TROOPERS
games.title: ACA NEOGEO SHOCK TROOPERS
games.description:
SHOCK TROOPERS is an action game released by SNK in 1997.
Players take part in a rescue operation for Dr. George and his granddaughter who have been kidnapped by the evil organization Bloody Scorpion. The game features the ability for players to choose which route to progress, adding even more replayablity to the title.

games.name: Evil Genius 2: World Domination Deluxe Edition
games.title: Evil Genius 2: World Domination Deluxe Edition
games.description:
Enhance your Evil Empire with the Deluxe Edition of Evil Genius 2!  This version includes the Season Pass.

Included in the Season Pass:
• 1 Campaign Pack
• 1 Lair Items Pack
• 2 Henchmen Packs
• 2 Minion Packs

games.name: ACA NEOGEO BLAZING STAR
games.title: ACA NEOGEO BLAZING STAR
games.description:
"BLAZING STAR" is a shooting game released by SNK in 1998.
Your mission is to take on the sinister AI “Brawshella” that is the main culprit behind an army of deadly biological weapons. You have 6 different ships at your disposal for this task.
