The game features classic high score gameplay with higher points awarded when players land successful charge shots to chain multiple enemies.

games.name: OOLO
games.title: OOLO
games.description: OOLO is a modern take on the classic isometric adventure. Embark on a non-linear journey across mysterious forests, haunted catacombs, and magical factories. Solve puzzles to collect keys and discover upgrades that change the way you explore this lush fantasy world.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO NINJA COMBAT
games.title: ACA NEOGEO NINJA COMBAT
games.description: NINJA COMBAT is an action game released in 1990 by SNK. In order to defeat the evil ninja clan KAGE ICHIZOKU, justice-seeking ninjas head towards NINJA TOWER. Enjoy battling with a wide array of weapons and Ninja Magic as well as the ability for a friend to join in on the action.

games.name: South of Midnight Premium Upgrade Edition
games.title: South of Midnight Premium Upgrade Edition
games.description: South of Midnight is a new action-adventure from Compulsion Games. Learn an ancient weaving power, explore the Deep South mythos and confront mysterious creatures in this folktale for modern times.

games.name: Card Party Showdown
games.title: Card Party Showdown
games.description: Gather family and friends for three lively card games filled with lucky draws, quick reactions, and playful rivalries. Play solo against computer opponents or compete locally with up to four players.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO GALAXY FIGHT: UNIVERSAL WARRIORS
games.title: ACA NEOGEO GALAXY FIGHT: UNIVERSAL WARRIORS
games.description:
"GALAXY FIGHT: UNIVERSAL WARRIORS" is a fighting game released by SUNSOFT in 1995.
In the world that was destroyed by the destructors of the universe, eight warriors challenge to fight each other 's speculation.
Please enjoy the world view of SF touch and the fight full of speed.

games.name: Raptor Evolution
games.title: Raptor Evolution
games.description: The hunt begins now!

games.name: Tinykin
games.title: Tinykin
games.description: Catch hundreds of tinykin and use their powers to bring Milo back to his home planet!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO SAMURAI SHODOWN
games.title: ACA NEOGEO SAMURAI SHODOWN
games.description: "SAMURAI SHODOWN" is a fighting game that was originally released by SNK in 1993. The game features 12 swordmasters, each with their own unique personality. They will battle it out among each other before taking on Shiro Tokisada Amakusa in the game’s climax. One of the unique characteristics of this game is the Rage Gauge which fills up as the player takes damage. Once that gauge is full the character’s attacks do more damage, keeping the battles tense and exciting.

games.name: Telling Lies
games.title: Telling Lies
games.description: An investigative thriller game with non-linear storytelling, Telling Lies revolves around a cache of secretly recorded video conversations. Starring Logan Marshall-Green, Alexandra Shipp, Kerry Bishé, Angela Sarafyan and directed by Sam Barlow, creator of Her Story and Silent Hill: Shattered Memories.

games.name: Airborne Kingdom
games.title: Airborne Kingdom
games.description: Airborne Kingdom — the sky city builder. Grow your unique town among the clouds, and fly it across a wide-open landscape. Explore the skies to restore serenity to the world below!

games.name: Theme Park Jam
games.title: Theme Park Jam
games.description: A vibrant and fast-paced puzzle game

games.name: ACA NEOGEO AERO FIGHTERS 2
games.title: ACA NEOGEO AERO FIGHTERS 2
games.description:
AERO FIGHTERS 2 is a vertical-scrolling shoot 'em up released in 1994 by VIDEO SYSTEM. 
A variety of unique pilots, including a pop singer and an aviation ninja, take place in dog fights at the speed of sound to save the world. 
Enjoy a story mode packed with multiple endings.

games.name: Hypnospace Outlaw
games.title: Hypnospace Outlaw
games.description: Greetings Enforcer, and thank you for enlisting in the Hypnospace Patrol Department! As the world falls into its slumber, Hypnospace becomes a bustling global village.

games.name: Elemental War 2
games.title: Elemental War 2
games.description: Elemental War 2 offers you the popular tower defense feeling combined with innovative game mechanics - the ultimate mix for many hours of fun!

games.name: Hidden Paws Mystery
games.title: Hidden Paws Mystery
games.description: Explore strange, beautiful islands to find all the little kittens hidden there.

games.name: El Coco
games.title: El Coco
games.description: EL COCO is a 3D action roguelike game that immerses you in a world of dreams, broken memories and nightmares incarnate. Descend into the Uncertain, a place as strange as it is dangerous, and fight to recover what you lost... if you can trust your guide.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO SUPER SIDEKICKS
games.title: ACA NEOGEO SUPER SIDEKICKS
games.description:
SUPER SIDEKICKS is a soccer game released by SNK in 1992. 
This is the very first realistic-looking soccer game released for the NEOGEO system. 
Use a variety of techniques such as dribbling and passing to compete against the best teams from around the world! Take part in exhilarating matches on your way to seizing the Champion Cup!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO TWINKLE STAR SPRITES
games.title: ACA NEOGEO TWINKLE STAR SPRITES
games.description: TWINKLE STAR SPRITES is a competitive shooting game released by SNK in 1996. Utilize Chain Explosions, Power Shots, and Bombs to defeat the incoming Enemy Golems, changing them into Attack Characters to assault your opponent! Experience a new style of shooting game with more than enough cute characters flying around to fill the sky!

games.name: 8-Ball Pocket
games.title: 8-Ball Pocket
games.description: 8-Ball Pocket brings you eight-ball pool, also known as American billiards. You can compete with up to 4 friends or against the AI in Versus mode, or challenge the best in the world in Arcade mode, where you can make combo shots and rack up points to become Number 1 in the online ranking. All of this comes in a setting with great graphics and Jazz music.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO WORLD HEROES 2 JET
games.title: ACA NEOGEO WORLD HEROES 2 JET
games.description: WORLD HEROES 2 JET is a fighting game released by SNK in 1994. It is the third title in the WORLD HEROES series. Sixteen heroes, villains, and other fighters have gathered to determine who is the strongest in the world. With dashes, back steps, and the addition of a counter system, you can enjoy speedy battles.

games.name: 30 Birds
games.title: 30 Birds
games.developer: Ram Ram Games, Business Goose Studios
games.description: Lantern City is on the verge of disaster: the Goddess Simurgh has been kidnapped by the evil Scientist! 30 Birds is a narrative puzzle game laid out on the surface of rotating lanterns. Wander through a gorgeous world inspired by Persian art, meet quirky birds, and solve puzzles to rescue Simurgh.
games.developerName: Ram Ram Games, Business Goose Studios

games.name: All You Need is Help
games.title: All You Need is Help
games.description:
"Bumping around! Helping each other! Turn your friendships into friend-shapes!"
Dive into a quirky multiplayer co-op puzzle game where adorable, fluffy cube-shaped creatures collaborate to reach their goals.
These creatures, each oddly shaped, jostle against each other to help solve puzzles together.
When in trouble, shout "HELP!" and friends will surely come to your aid. With everyone's strength, turn friendships into friend-shapes!

games.name: Hide 'N Seek!
games.title: Hide 'N Seek!
games.description: ...8, 9, 10. Ready or not, here I come!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO SENGOKU
games.title: ACA NEOGEO SENGOKU
games.description:
"SENGOKU" is an action game released by SNK in 1991.
Players will fight against past ghosts that have been revived to the present age in a devastated Washington City.
Players can use special characters who are confined, after releasing them. Fighting by switching to Armour-clad Wolf, Samurai, or Ninja according to the situation will be your key to success.

games.name: Venba
games.title: Venba
games.description: Cook delicious South-Indian food and experience the journey of an immigrant family in Venba!

games.name: Meow Moments: Celebrating Myth & Machine
games.title: Meow Moments: Celebrating Myth & Machine
games.description: Join cute cats in a time-travel adventure! Find feline friends and pop balloons as you explore a magical medieval kingdom and a chaotic sci-fi metropolis.

games.name: Infernax
games.title: Infernax
games.description: Infernax is the adventures of a great knight who returns to his homeland only to find it plagued with unholy magic. Uncover the mysteries of the curse and face the consequences of your actions.

games.name: Guts 'n Grunts Sr.
games.title: Guts 'n Grunts Sr.
games.description: 16-bits of speed and shooting!

games.name: Zombie Hill Racing
games.title: Zombie Hill Racing
games.description: Zombies roam all over the ruined lands, where it's hard to be the last survivor! Quickly get into your car and drive away!

games.name: Uboat Attack
games.title: Uboat Attack
games.description: Rise through the ranks and become a legendary commander!

games.name: Young Souls
games.title: Young Souls
games.description: Young Souls is a gorgeous 2D brawler meets story-rich action RPG. Fight hordes of belligerent goblins, level up with hundreds of weapons and accessories, explore, and journey between worlds, as rebellious twins battle their way to save their foster father.

games.name: Pato Box
games.title: Pato Box
games.description:
A surreal boxing quest with a duck! 

Test your reflexes as you fight your way through an evil corporation in search for retribution.

Will you chicken out or learn how to DUCK?

games.name: KEMCO RPG Selection Vol. 4
games.title: KEMCO RPG Selection Vol. 4
games.description: Enjoy 4 fantasy adventures at once!

games.name: GUNBIRD
games.title: GUNBIRD
games.description:
Marion and friends battle hard in the sprawling world
of yet another Psikyo shooter masterpiece.
Now with online rankings!

games.name: That's My Family: Family Fun Night
games.title: That's My Family: Family Fun Night
games.description: Family Fun Night is a party game with 14 different games from classics like Chess, Backgammon to newcomers Kings of Sieges. Play your favorite games in unique settings with friends and family!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO PUZZLE BOBBLE 2
games.title: ACA NEOGEO PUZZLE BOBBLE 2
games.description:
PUZZLE BOBBLE 2 is an action puzzle game released by Taito in 1995 as the second sequel of PUZZLE BOBBLE.
Bub and Bob, the bubble spitting dragons from the action game are back again to take on new challenges!
Skillfully bounce bubbles off the walls, make chains, and erase them!
Aim for even greater chains with the new Star Bubbles and Metal Bubbles!

games.name: You Suck at Parking® Complete Edition
games.title: You Suck at Parking® Complete Edition
games.description: You Suck at Parking® is a challenging racing game where your goal is to park your car. Customize your ride and drive along crazy courses in single-player campaigns and multiplayer challenges, or party up with friends. Take on the world or laugh at your blunders in this ever-evolving, frustratingly fun romp.

games.name: Green Soldiers Heroes: Extreme Bikers
games.title: Green Soldiers Heroes: Extreme Bikers
games.description: Open world motorcycle game with point-to-point races.

games.name: The Good Life
games.title: The Good Life
games.description: Enjoy everyday life while solving a murder mystery in Rainy Woods - known as the "happiest town in the world" - in this all-new "Debt Repayment RPG"!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO WORLD HEROES PERFECT
games.title: ACA NEOGEO WORLD HEROES PERFECT
games.description:
WORLD HEROES PERFECT is a fighting game released by SNK in 1995.
16 characters based on historical figures battle it out to decide who is the strongest. New elements such as hero gauge, extra attack, and guard attacks have been added to this version, leading to more exciting matches!

games.name: Yonder: The Cloud Catcher Chronicles
games.title: Yonder: The Cloud Catcher Chronicles
games.description: Unwind and enjoy the slow life in Yonder: The Cloud Catcher Chronicles, a relaxing open-world adventure game.

games.name: Chess Gambit
games.title: Chess Gambit
games.description:
Get ready to enjoy the best chess experience with animated pieces that come to life and engage in an exciting strategic battle. Are you ready to show off your skills and become the king of the board?
Download our game now and get ready for the action!

games.name: Killer Instinct
games.title: Killer Instinct
games.description: Killer Instinct is the ultimate fighting game for Xbox!  Experience 4K visuals and 60 FPS on Xbox Series X and Compatible PCs. Enjoy improved matchmaking and cross-play with Windows 11 PC. Fight on!

games.name: Silver Axe - The Honest Elf
games.title: Silver Axe - The Honest Elf
games.description: A fairy-tale epic adventure!

games.name: KEMCO RPG Selection Vol. 5
games.title: KEMCO RPG Selection Vol. 5
games.description: Enjoy 4 fantasy adventures at once!

games.name: Nexoria: Dungeon Rogue Heroes
games.title: Nexoria: Dungeon Rogue Heroes
games.description: This game is a unique mix of rogue-like with dungeon exploration, RPG, turn-based tactics and collectible card game. At the base of the turn-based system are not turns, but time. Find and improve new heroes and get coins to buy new spells. But remember, a hero’s death will be fatal.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO STRIKERS 1945 PLUS
games.title: ACA NEOGEO STRIKERS 1945 PLUS
games.description:
STRIKERS 1945 PLUS is a shoot 'em up game released by Psikyo in 1999. 
Make use of Shots, Super Shots, and Support Attacks to make your way through a chaotic dogfight!
Historical piston fighters, such as the P-38 Lightning, are ready to rumble!!
A state of the art arcade shoot 'em up from the masters of the genre, Psikyo.

games.name: Boxing Gym Story
games.title: Boxing Gym Story
games.description: Create your own gym, train boxers, and aim for the championship!

games.name: Dungeon Minesweeper
games.title: Dungeon Minesweeper
games.description: Minesweeper puzzle with RPG elements, magic combat, quests, and pixel art in mysterious dungeons.

games.name: Flat Heroes
games.title: Flat Heroes
games.description: Flat Heroes encourages you to stylishly navigate and survive over 300 handcrafted levels, destroy the most epic bosses around and truly be the two-dimensional hero (or heroes!) you’ve always dreamed you could be.

games.name: Tents & Trees
games.title: Tents & Trees
games.description: Think strategically to place tents in the peaceful universe of Tents and Trees, a chill puzzle game set in the great outdoors!

games.name: RAINBOW HIGH™: RUNWAY RUSH
games.title: RAINBOW HIGH™: RUNWAY RUSH
games.description: Play as the Rainbow High girls and use their unique talents to complete your first art assignment. #LetYourTrueColorsShine

games.name: Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny
games.title: Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny
games.description: Witness the resurrection of the foretold nemesis of the Jurnal Risa family, which was never revealed before. Unveil its dark destiny within this horror-adventure game.

games.name: KEMCO RPG Selection Vol. 3
games.title: KEMCO RPG Selection Vol. 3
games.description: Enjoy 4 fantasy adventures at once!

games.name: Kingdom Two Crowns: Essentials Pack
games.title: Kingdom Two Crowns: Essentials Pack
games.description: Get the full Kingdom Two Crowns experience with this bundle, which includes all additional campaign expansions for the game.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO SAMURAI SHODOWN III
games.title: ACA NEOGEO SAMURAI SHODOWN III
games.description: SAMURAI SHODOWN III is a fighting game released by SNK in 1995. It is a sequel to SAMURAI SHODOWN II. You can now fill your Rage Gauge, as well as block attacks mid-air. Player characters now have 2 styles to choose from: SLASH and BUST. The ways of battle have greatly expanded.

games.name: Zombie Rollerz: Pinball Heroes
games.title: Zombie Rollerz: Pinball Heroes
games.description: Zombie Rollerz is the ultimate mashup of classic pinball, zombie defense and rogue-like!

games.name: Nocturne Routes
games.title: Nocturne Routes
games.description: Plan your path. Control the night.

games.name: Garden Story
games.title: Garden Story
games.description: Embark on a wholesome adventure to save The Grove! Forage resources, combat the invasive Rot, and restore the community. Relax and enjoy the fruits of your labor in this charming action-RPG starring a grape.

games.name: SturmFront - The Mutant War: Ubel Edition
games.title: SturmFront - The Mutant War: Ubel Edition
games.description: Play as Siegfried von Hammerstein, a unique experimental battle unit whose only purpose to exist is to kill and destroy unrelenting mutant hordes!

games.name: METRO QUESTER | OSAKA
games.title: METRO QUESTER | OSAKA
games.description: Seek the lost world's truth in a hack and slash dungeon exploration RPG based in Osaka!

games.name: Ninja Nightfall
games.title: Ninja Nightfall
games.description: Step into the shadows of a dystopian metropolis overrun by ruthless machines. In Ninja Nightfall, you are the last silent guardian—an elite warrior trained in the ancient arts, now facing a city teeming with hostile AI.

games.name: Raji: An Ancient Epiс
games.title: Raji: An Ancient Epiс
games.description: Raji: An Ancient Epic is an action-adventure game set in ancient India. A young girl named Raji has been chosen by the gods to stand against the demonic invasion of the human realm. Her destiny? To rescue her younger brother and face the demon lord Mahabalasura.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO SAVAGE REIGN
games.title: ACA NEOGEO SAVAGE REIGN
games.description:
SAVAGE REIGN is a fighting game released by SNK in 1995.
In the first half of the 21st century, 10 great fighters have gathered to compete in King Lion's Battle of the Beast-God!
Howling fists and flying weapons! A completely new style of fighting game. Utilize the innovative 2 Line System to achieve victory in this vicious fight!

games.name: Despot's Game
games.title: Despot's Game
games.description: Roguelike, auto-battler, deep progression, gratuitous violence, pretzels!

games.name: Sundered®: Eldritch Edition
games.title: Sundered®: Eldritch Edition
games.description: Sundered is a chaotic hand­-drawn metroidvania where you resist or embrace ancient eldritch powers. Confront hordes of terrifying enemies in an ever-changing world inspired by the works of H.P. Lovecraft. Sundered is a challenging and unique take on a classic genre from the creators of Jotun, now with local co-op!

games.name: I Saw Black Clouds
games.title: I Saw Black Clouds
games.description: After the unexpected death of a close friend, Kristina returns to her hometown looking for answers, only to unearth a string of dark secrets. I Saw Black Clouds is an interactive psychological thriller with supernatural elements and branching storylines.

games.name: Knights and Bikes
games.title: Knights and Bikes
games.description: Saddle up for a bike-riding, friendship-building, frisbee-throwing, goose-petting, treasure-hunting adventure for 1 or 2 players!

games.name: The Anacrusis (Game Preview)
games.title: The Anacrusis (Game Preview)
games.description: The Anacrusis is a four-player, cooperative first-person shooter set aboard a massive starship stranded at the edge of explored space. Team up with your friends in an infinitely-replayable fight against alien hordes to unlock perks, weapons, and new ways to play that you can share with your team!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO OVER TOP
games.title: ACA NEOGEO OVER TOP
games.description:
“OVER TOP” is a racing game released by SNK in 1996.
Players will participate in breathtaking races through urban areas, mountainous regions, and snowy roads. The courses also feature weather variations to add more variety to the game. 
In addition to the various vehicles with different performance factors which players can use, they can also enjoy the thrill of drifting their way through corners to clear courses.

games.name: Outbreak: Shades of Horror Reel Cut Collection
games.title: Outbreak: Shades of Horror Reel Cut Collection
games.description: Online co-op and single-player narrative survival horror nightmares await in this flesh consuming collection! This bundle contains new content that is also available for purchase separately.

games.name: It Lurks Below
games.title: It Lurks Below
games.description: It Lurks Below is a retro-styled, 2D, action-oriented, survival RPG by David Brevik, creator of Diablo. A true RPG, with many stats and eight character-classes. Dig down and explore the randomly generated levels, find random items, and combat deadly monsters to get the answers.

games.name: Escape First 3 Multiplayer
games.title: Escape First 3 Multiplayer
games.description: Who is gonna Escape First?

games.name: Horrific Xanatorium
games.title: Horrific Xanatorium
games.description: A horror visual novel game set in a hospital in a post-pandemic world

games.name: ACA NEOGEO SAMURAI SHODOWN IV
games.title: ACA NEOGEO SAMURAI SHODOWN IV
games.description:
SAMURAI SHODOWN IV is a fighting game released by SNK in 1996.
Warriors with their own respective goalsspeculations will challenge Amakusa who has returned to life again, and plans to conquer the modern world.
Attacks using the “Anger Gauge” can lead to unexpected outcomes and make battles even more intense!

games.name: Game Dev Story
games.title: Game Dev Story
games.description: Work hard and you may reach the top of the video game industry!

games.name: Fritz - Don't call me a chess bot
games.title: Fritz - Don't call me a chess bot
games.description: Play chess with interactive hints and tips

games.name: SUDOKU CHAMPIONS
games.title: SUDOKU CHAMPIONS
games.description: THE MATH GAME

games.name: Silver Nornir
games.title: Silver Nornir
games.description: Can you change the repeating doomed fate of the world in a fantasy RPG?

games.name: Tchia
games.title: Tchia
games.description: A Tropical Open-World adventure. Climb, glide, swim, and sail your boat around a beautiful archipelago in this physics-driven sandbox. Take control of any animal or object you can find, and Jam on your fully playable Ukulele.

games.name: Fight For America
games.title: Fight For America
games.description: Gear up, soldier - it’s time to reclaim freedom!

games.name: Tram Simulator Urban Transit
games.title: Tram Simulator Urban Transit
games.description: Welcome to Tram Simulator Urban Transit - get on aboard! In this game, you take on the role of a tram driver and manager. Drive 6 tram models. Transport passengers and drive them to the numerous stops. Plan your own routes, manage your timetables, and expand your tram network.

games.name: Loot River
games.title: Loot River
games.description: Explore procedurally generated labyrinths in this challenging, dungeon crawling roguelike that combines tense combat with spatial block-shifting. Slide blocks of ancient ruins, fight brutal bestial abominations, loot, level-up, strategize, cast powerful spells, die and wake up anew.

games.name: Wargroove
games.title: Wargroove
games.description: Command an army, customize battlefields, and challenge your friends, in this richly detailed return to retro turn-based combat!

games.name: Guess the Flag! - World Flags Quiz
games.title: Guess the Flag! - World Flags Quiz
games.description: Test your knowledge of 255 countries, islands and international organizations in 6 addictive modes. Test your memory by matching the flag to the name of a country or play the reverse mode.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO LEAGUE BOWLING
games.title: ACA NEOGEO LEAGUE BOWLING
games.description:
LEAGUE BOWLING is a bowling game released by SNK in 1990. You are able to select your dominant arm and ball weight, using precise controls to play just like real bowling! Choose from one of three modes, REGULATION, FLASH, and STRIKE 90.
*Game sections requiring use of the connection jack are not included.

games.name: The Last Case of Benedict Fox: Definitive Edition
games.title: The Last Case of Benedict Fox: Definitive Edition

games.name: Cowboy Kart
games.title: Cowboy Kart
games.description: Good, old-fashioned kart racing in the old west! Up to 4 players.

games.name: JellyCar Worlds
games.title: JellyCar Worlds
games.description: It's a Car, made of Jelly! Squishy Physics, Tactile, Silly & Imaginative Driving/Platforming

games.name: Soccer Kid Collection (QUByte Classics)
games.title: Soccer Kid Collection (QUByte Classics)
games.description: A classic 16-bit platformer where your soccer ball is your weapon!

games.name: Cyber Shadow
games.title: Cyber Shadow
games.description: The world has been taken over by synthetic lifeforms. A desperate plea for help sets Shadow, the sole survivor of his clan, on one last mission to uncover what started the path to perpetual ruin.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO SAMURAI SHODOWN II
games.title: ACA NEOGEO SAMURAI SHODOWN II
games.description:
SAMURAI SHODOWN II is a fighting game released by SNK in 1994. 
The legendary weapon-wielding fighting game returns stronger / sharper than ever! 
Four newcomers join the battle for a total of 15 combatants ready to step on the stage of grand battles. 
With the new Rage System and Weapon Breaking Attacks, epic and intense battles are waiting for you!

games.name: Demon Castle Story
games.title: Demon Castle Story
games.description: Demon Castle Building Dungeon Management Simulation

games.name: Harold Halibut
games.title: Harold Halibut
games.description: Harold Halibut is a handmade narrative game about friendship and life on a city-sized spaceship submerged in an alien ocean. Join Harold as he explores a vibrant retro-future world in his quest to find the true meaning of ‘home’.

games.name: Meow Moments Bundle
games.title: Meow Moments Bundle
games.description: Celebrate special moments with cats and friends! This cozy bundle includes three Meow Moments games, each with two festive scenes to explore.

games.name: Alphadia I & II
games.title: Alphadia I & II
games.description: The legends of energi once again in a new edition!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO SENGOKU 3
games.title: ACA NEOGEO SENGOKU 3
games.description: SENGOKU 3 is a side-scrolling action game released by SNK in 2001. In order to purge malicious souls, Shinobi travel the world to defeat the undead. Cut, smash, throw, and use weapons as well as Ninja Arts and Ultimate Ninja Arts in this hyper-action ninja game.

games.name: Dentist Bling
games.title: Dentist Bling
games.description: Ready for the ultimate dental experience? Dive into the world of tooth care and become a master dentist!

games.name: GRAPPIN
games.title: GRAPPIN
games.description:
After a difficult awakening, you stumble upon the Grip, a mysterious artifact and grappling hook. 
Climb up the Mountain to bring back the Grip to the top and unravel the mystery surrounding the Grip in GRAPPIN, an exciting First-Person Adventure game.

games.name: Rain on Your Parade
games.title: Rain on Your Parade
games.description: Travel the world as a cute cardboard cloud and ruin everybody's day! Unlock new methods of mischief across 50 levels, each with unique setting and objectives. Make new friends and help them too - it's an adorable schadenfreude game!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO KIZUNA ENCOUNTER
games.title: ACA NEOGEO KIZUNA ENCOUNTER
games.description:
KIZUNA ENCOUNTER is a fighting game released by SNK in 1996.
Create a team of two fighters and use weapons and your fists to win in single-round sudden death tag-team matches!
Experience the feel of an advanced battle system that pairs mid-battle character change-ups and easy commands leading to rush combos!

games.name: Paper io 2
games.title: Paper io 2
games.description: Conquer territory solo or beat your friends in multiplayer mode!

games.name: Cafe Master Story
games.title: Cafe Master Story
games.description: Serve up food, drinks, and smiles in this retro cafe management sim!

games.name: Revenant Saga
games.title: Revenant Saga
games.description: Become a Revenant and find the truth beyond revenge in this gothic fantasy RPG with stunning 3D battles!

games.name: Aquapark io: Gold Edition
games.title: Aquapark io: Gold Edition
games.description: Race with your friends on waterslides and jump into the pool for victory!

games.name: Biomechanical Toy (QUByte Classics)
games.title: Biomechanical Toy (QUByte Classics)
games.description: Recover a stolen Magic Pendulum, face giant bosses, and wield powerful weapons in a biomechanical adventure filled with crazy toys.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO THE SUPER SPY
games.title: ACA NEOGEO THE SUPER SPY
games.description: THE SUPER SPY is an action game released by SNK in 1990. Punch, kick, and use guns to fight off terrorists as you make your way through the building to rescue their captives. Defeating enemies earns experience, which can be used in a Role Playing Game-like feature to level up.

games.name: ChildStory
games.title: ChildStory
games.description: ChildStory is about a girl returning to a winter town preparing for a festival, where the Moon disappears from the sky once again.

games.name: Fernz Gate
games.title: Fernz Gate
games.description: Travel to the other side and beyond and find a way back home in a fantasy RPG!

games.name: Shy Cats Hidden Orchestra 2
games.title: Shy Cats Hidden Orchestra 2
games.description: Find hidden cats and their instruments in the sequel to Shy Cats Hidden Orchestra. Search 10 charming levels, unlock chests, and reveal the shyest cat of all.

games.name: Hero Seekers
games.title: Hero Seekers
games.description: Restore the lost history in a summoning fantasy RPG!

games.name: Go North
games.title: Go North
games.description: Explore beautiful mazes, discover unique items and help other explorers complete unusual side quests in this cozy and narrative-driven adventure!

games.name: Monster Survivors
games.title: Monster Survivors
games.description: Survive, adapt, and conquer in a world overrun by monstrous creatures!

games.name: Insomnis
games.title: Insomnis
games.description: Insomnis is a first-person horror game focused on story, exploration and solving puzzles to advance through a terrifying atmosphere. Players take control of Joe Castevet, who will have to deal with a mysterious inheritance he has just received. Discover all the secrets of the Castevet mansion!

games.name: The House of Da Vinci
games.title: The House of Da Vinci
games.description: Enter The House of Da Vinci, a must-try 3D puzzle adventure game. Solve mechanical puzzles, discover hidden objects, escape from rooms and dive into the authentic atmosphere of the Renaissance. Use all your wits to find out what's behind your master's disappearance.

games.name: Thimbleweed Park
games.title: Thimbleweed Park
games.description: In Thimbleweed Park, a dead body is the least of your problems. Switch between five playable characters to uncover the surreal secrets of this strange town in a modern mystery adventure game from the creators of Monkey Island and Maniac Mansion. The deeper you go, the weirder it gets.

games.name: Inkulinati
games.title: Inkulinati
games.description:
Inkulinati is an ink-based strategy game straight from medieval manuscripts, where a rabbit’s bum can be deadlier than a dog's sword.

Take your turn in Inkulinati duels filled with unexpected tactical depth (and humour!). Embark on an ever-changing journey, build your own bestiary, defeat medieval superstars and collect perks to unleash special powers.

games.name: The Stone of Madness Special Edition
games.title: The Stone of Madness Special Edition

games.name: When the Past was Around
games.title: When the Past was Around
games.description: Something is missing from her world…

games.name: ACA NEOGEO WORLD HEROES
games.title: ACA NEOGEO WORLD HEROES
games.description:
"WORLD HEROES" is a fighting game that was originally released by SNK in 1992.
Eight characters based on historical celebrities such as Hattori Hanzo and Rasputin will fight each other to become the world's strongest champion. In addition to the Normal mode, a Deathmatch Mode featuring various stages full of traps awaits you for merciless battles!

games.name: Life is Strange: Reunion Deluxe Upgrade
games.title: Life is Strange: Reunion Deluxe Upgrade
games.description:
Upgrade to the Deluxe Edition to experience a host of new and exclusive behind-the-scenes bonus content celebrating the return of Max and Chloe!

The Life is Strange: Reunion Deluxe Upgrade contains:

• Digital Mini Soundtrack
• Digital Art Book
• Digital Comic
• Exclusive Behind the Scenes Documentary with Hannah Telle and Rhianna DeVries

games.name: Night Book
games.title: Night Book
games.description: Night Book is an interactive thriller about an online interpreter who is tricked into reading an ancient book that summons a demon into her home. From the studios that brought you The Complex, Five Dates, and Maid of Sker.

games.name: Magical Delicacy
games.title: Magical Delicacy
games.description: A wholesome pixel art platformer. Cook magical delicacies from a vast collection of ingredients in your own shop. Explore an unfamiliar town and deliver tasty treats to the townsfolk. Learn new ways to traverse, discover secrets, and experience a unique witchy world.

games.name: Alphadia III
games.title: Alphadia III
games.description: Fight the Energi War and find your path in a fantasy RPG!

games.name: Terror Mansion
games.title: Terror Mansion
games.description: Fight your fears and escape the Terror Mansion!

games.name: Chicory: A Colorful Tale
games.title: Chicory: A Colorful Tale
games.developer: Greg Lobanov, Alexis Dean-Jones, Lena Raine, A Shell in the Pit
games.description: A top-down adventure game in a coloring book world full of vibrant characters. Use painting powers to explore, solve puzzles, make friends, and draw on anything!
games.developerName: Greg Lobanov, Alexis Dean-Jones, Lena Raine, A Shell in the Pit

games.name: Legends of Heropolis DX
games.title: Legends of Heropolis DX
games.description: Build the town of Heropolis.Gather your strongest heroes and destroy Evilcorp!

games.name: Solar Ash
games.title: Solar Ash
games.description: From the creators of the award-winning Hyper Light Drifter comes the high-speed and gravity-bending world of Solar Ash. Play as Rei, a Voidrunner determined to stop at nothing to save her planet from falling prey to the Ultravoid’s path of eternal hunger.

games.name: CAFE 0 ~The Sleeping Beast~ REMASTERED
games.title: CAFE 0 ~The Sleeping Beast~ REMASTERED
games.description: The wandering soul of a novice maid, Corliss, finds her way to the mysterious “Cafe 0.” There, she gets the chance to go back to one week before her death. Can she unravel the mystery of her own death and the disappearance of her aunt 15 years ago?

games.name: ACA NEOGEO KARNOV'S REVENGE
games.title: ACA NEOGEO KARNOV'S REVENGE
games.description: KARNOV'S REVENGE is a fighting game released by Data East in 1994. Thirteen combatants have once again gathered to compete in the Great Grapple. The Weak Point system allows for enjoyable and deep combat.

games.name: Hidden Memory - Neko's Life
games.title: Hidden Memory - Neko's Life
games.description: In Hidden Memory - Neko's Life, help a stray kitten find a forever home. Memorize rules, solve logic puzzles, and unlock hand-painted art that narrates a heartwarming story of resilience. Unplug and relax in this zen-like world.

games.name: Paradise Killer
games.title: Paradise Killer
games.description: Paradise Island, a world outside reality. There’s been a murder that only "investigation freak" Lady Love Dies can solve. You can accuse anyone, but you’ll have to prove your case in trial to convict. It’s up to you to decide who’s guilty.

games.name: Swamp TD 2
games.title: Swamp TD 2
games.description: classic tower defense game

games.name: ACA NEOGEO PULSTAR
games.title: ACA NEOGEO PULSTAR
games.description:
PULSTAR is a side-scrolling shooting game released by SNK in 1995.
Control the “Dino246”, and take down the aliens who are attacking the solar system. 
The game features a verity of offensive and defensive options, including 5 unique Voyager items and special IO items. Use everything at your disposal to protect your ship and defeat the alien threat!

games.name: Cryptical Path
games.title: Cryptical Path
games.description: "Cryptical Path is an action rogue-lite that pushes the boundaries of the genre. Play the Architect, build your own rooms, and tame an ever-changing labyrinth you've been summoned in."

games.name: Turnip Mountain
games.title: Turnip Mountain
games.description: Turnip Mountain is a physics-based climbing adventure in which you control each hand independently. Grab, hold, swing and launch yourself to the summit your own way.

games.name: DIMENSIONS: The Catalyst
games.title: DIMENSIONS: The Catalyst
games.description: Dimensions: The Catalyst is a short and emotional story that follows Tani and Jhonny on their final mission, fifteen years before the first Dimensions. Their bond grows through silence and difficult choices as they cross the First Rift and face truths they have avoided for years. A compact, intense experience designed to be completed in a single session.

games.name: Eldgear
games.title: Eldgear
games.description: Live a grand adventure as an agent of Eldia to seal the ancient ruins!

games.name: Mineko's Night Market
games.title: Mineko's Night Market
games.description: Mineko’s Night Market is a narrative-driven, social simulation adventure game that celebrates Japanese culture and invites players to craft whimsical items, eat delicious snacks, and ultimately enjoy all the cats.

games.name: Metavoidal
games.title: Metavoidal
games.description:
Metavoidal is a 2D pixel art, action rogue-lite game where music determines your abilities, and your abilities shape the dynamic metal soundtrack.
Play as a drummer and escape the clutches of an eldritch metal band... or die trying! 
A dark, lovecraftian narrative that’s packed full of music industry tropes and jokes.

games.name: Mega Mall Story
games.title: Mega Mall Story
games.description: Design a towering mega mall in this mall management simulation game.

games.name: Mia and the Dragon Princess
games.title: Mia and the Dragon Princess
games.developer: Dead Pixel Productions, Good Gate Media, Wales Interactive
games.description: A live-action, interactive buddy-action movie following Mia, a plucky barmaid whose life is thrown into chaos when a mysterious woman turns up at her workplace, on the run from a group of violent thugs and unable to speak English.
games.developerName: Dead Pixel Productions, Good Gate Media, Wales Interactive

games.name: Spot Stories Vol. 3
games.title: Spot Stories Vol. 3
games.description: Spot Stories Vol. 3 brings the cozy spot-the-difference series to a close with one final collection of brand-new scenes. Find 160 differences across 32 levels as you compare two side-by-side images and search for every subtle change. Play solo at your own pace or team up in local multiplayer and share every discovery with a friend or family member. Can you spot them all?

games.name: Escape First 2
games.title: Escape First 2
games.description: Who is gonna Escape First?

games.name: Doom & Destiny Worlds
games.title: Doom & Destiny Worlds
games.description: When Destiny calls for help, but no one answers, only four nerds can save the day. Armed with hand crafted weapons and bad jokes, can the four nerds survive, defeat three almighty tyrants and find their way home?

games.name: ACA NEOGEO Gururin
games.title: ACA NEOGEO Gururin
games.description: Gururin is an action-puzzle game released in 1994 by FACE. Enjoy a puzzle game the likes of which you've never seen before while rotating the Magic Troupe "Gururin"! Comes with One Player Mode, Challenge Mode (VS CPU), and Two Player Mode.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO THE LAST BLADE 2
games.title: ACA NEOGEO THE LAST BLADE 2
games.description: THE LAST BLADE 2 is a fighting game released by SNK in 1998. The Four Gods aiming to seal Hell's Gate and the eternal dead who aim to stop them are in the middle of an intense battle. A variety of systems have been introduced. Characters have their own individual Sword Quality, the ability to Repel and turn back enemy attacks, Desperation Moves and Super Desperation Moves, as well as the ability to cancel enemy moves and sequence them into Desperation Moves known as Super Cancel.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO AERO FIGHTERS 3
games.title: ACA NEOGEO AERO FIGHTERS 3
games.description: AERO FIGHTERS 3 is a side-scrolling shooting game released in 1995 by VIDEO SYSTEM. Ten teams comprised of 14 humans and 2 animals have gathered from around the world and are flying on high-powered reciprocating engine planes, such as the ZERO FIGHTER, to save the world. The game offers route selection and multiple endings.

games.name: Asdivine Hearts I & II
games.title: Asdivine Hearts I & II
games.description: Experience epic RPG adventures at once! This bundle includes Asdivine Hearts and Asdivine Hearts II.

games.name: GUNBIRD 2
games.title: GUNBIRD 2
games.description:
Marion and friends are going on an epic adventure around the world
in the ultimate Psikyo shooting game.
Now with online rankings!

games.name: Railway Routes
games.title: Railway Routes
games.description: Guide trains, build tracks, and solve relaxing grid-based railway puzzles. Plan the perfect route across 100+ handcrafted levels and watch your railway come to life.

games.name: ASMR Slicing
games.title: ASMR Slicing
games.description: Slice multiple objects made of kinetic sand in the most satisfying ASMR cutting game!

games.name: PuzzlePet - Feed Your Cat
games.title: PuzzlePet - Feed Your Cat
games.description: Feed a cute kitten or many of them!

games.name: VED
games.title: VED
games.description: VED is a story-driven, hand-drawn RPG with a unique turn-based combat system and roguelite elements. Set in two different worlds, VED tells the story of Cyrus, a young hero who sets out on a quest to become a master of sword and magic, and save everything he knows from destruction.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO PLEASURE GOAL： 5 ON 5 MINI SOCCER
games.title: ACA NEOGEO PLEASURE GOAL： 5 ON 5 MINI SOCCER
games.description: PLEASURE GOAL: 5 ON 5 MINI SOCCER is a soccer game released by SNK in 1996. Face off with various teams from around the world, make it through the prelims, get to the finals, and go for the gold in the SAURUS CUP! A fast paced experience unique to Futsal! Use the trick play button to perform jaw-dropping plays and defeat your opponents!

games.name: Helix Jump
games.title: Helix Jump
games.description: Blast your way through helix platforms to reach the end! Sounds easy? You wish!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO TOP HUNTER RODDY & CATHY
games.title: ACA NEOGEO TOP HUNTER RODDY & CATHY
games.description: TOP HUNTER RODDY & CATHY is a side-scrolling action game released by SNK in 1994. Using a 2-line system with front and back lines that can freely be switched between, jump, shoot, throw, and perform special attacks to defeat the space pirates who aim for total domination. This game offers simultaneous 2 player mode.

games.name: Doom and Destiny
games.title: Doom and Destiny
games.description: Be ready for the nerdiest adventure of your life! Journey with four everyday friends into this turn based hilarious jrpg filled with parodies and cameos! Nerds are storming fantasy and it's awesome!

games.name: Matsuro Palette
games.title: Matsuro Palette
games.description: Survive seven days with a cursed painting! Will you be able to finish her?

games.name: Who Pressed Mute on Uncle Marcus?
games.title: Who Pressed Mute on Uncle Marcus?
games.description: An eccentric FMV murder mystery with a twist: someone has poisoned Uncle Marcus. Uncover the truth in the yearly family quiz and try to save him before it is too late.

games.name: Hell Is Other Demons
games.title: Hell Is Other Demons
games.description: A Roguelike Bullet Hell Set In Hell That's Heaven To Play

games.name: McPixel 3
games.title: McPixel 3
games.description: McPixel 3 is a mind-blowing save-the-day adventure that sees the titular wanna-be hero avert one disaster after another at every turn using unconventional yet entertaining methods of mayhem.

games.name: Alphadia Neo
games.title: Alphadia Neo
games.description: Find the essence of life in a fantasy RPG from the Alphadia series!

games.name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 2
games.title: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 2
games.description: The sequel to the captivating tale of Fuga: Melodies of Steel has arrived! This turn-based RPG is back with a ramped up battle system for more strategy, as well as a brand new event system that gives you more thrilling choices to affect your experience!

games.name: The Isle Tide Hotel
games.title: The Isle Tide Hotel
games.description: An absent father must rescue his teenage daughter from an eclectic cult before their final night at the Isle Tide Hotel. Players investigate the strange events that unfold to save Eleanor Malone in this live-action interactive mystery game, where every decision affects the story.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO RIDING HERO
games.title: ACA NEOGEO RIDING HERO
games.description:
RIDING HERO is a realistic racing game released in 1990 by SNK. WGP (World Grand Prix) mode is where you can compete against top riders of the world. Story mode puts you in the shoes of a young street racer aiming to challenge an eight-hour endurance race and comes packed with RPG elements. Experience realistic motorcycle action that will keep you at the edge of your seat. 
*Game sections requiring use of the connection jack are not included.

games.name: The Shapeshifting Detective
games.title: The Shapeshifting Detective
games.description: The Shapeshifting Detective is a supernatural-noir murder mystery FMV game where you play as a detective who can shapeshift into other characters, allowing you to unlock secret conversations and private encounters.

games.name: APFTU
games.title: APFTU
games.description: The city is hungry. It will devour us all. Dream with caution.

games.name: The Innsmouth Case
games.title: The Innsmouth Case
games.description: The Innsmouth Case is a text adventure game inspired by H.P. Lovecraft and the very first text-based adventure to combine horror and comedy in a fit and proper way.

games.name: Carnival Survivors The Parade
games.title: Carnival Survivors The Parade
games.description: Carnival Survivors is a 2D roguelike survival game where you control a parade truck, recruit musicians with unique abilities, and create powerful builds to defeat hordes of aliens who hate Carnival.

games.name: Glorious Savior
games.title: Glorious Savior
games.description: An everlasting story about the hero's sword with animated 3D battles!

games.name: Quest of Dungeloria
games.title: Quest of Dungeloria
games.description: Great metroidvania game!

games.name: Monster Viator
games.title: Monster Viator
games.description: Ride a dragon and journey with more than 20 monsters! Compelling pixel art breathes life into your adventure in a fantasy RPG!

games.name: Sudoku Relax
games.title: Sudoku Relax
games.description:
Relaxing Sudoku games with
satisfying effects when you
put the numbers in the right place.

games.name: HexaScape: Cyber Defense
games.title: HexaScape: Cyber Defense
games.description: Puzzler meets tower defense in cyberspace.

games.name: MetroLand
games.title: MetroLand
games.description: A Thrilling New Endless Runner That Elevates the Classic Experience!

games.name: Extra Coin
games.title: Extra Coin
games.description: Extra Coin is a story-rich life sim set between the real world and a virtual utopia: explore the city, do activities, and face your opponents. Would you rather respect the Loop or break it to find your lost parents?

games.name: Loretta
games.title: Loretta
games.description: Loretta is a housewife. Walter is a writer. Dragged from the glitz and glamor of 1940s New York City and thrust into a dilapidated farmhouse in the rural south, both are unsuccessful, struggling with their finances, and straining in their relationship. But when Loretta learns of her husband’s infidelity and a lucrative life insurance policy filed in his name, a grisly plan takes root. It is up to you to decide how far she should take it.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO WORLD HEROES 2
games.title: ACA NEOGEO WORLD HEROES 2
games.description:
WORLD HEROES 2 is a fighting game released by SNK in 1993.
Players are able to take part in epic battles between 14 historic figures such as Hanzo Hattori and Jeanne. Players can enjoy numerous battle strategies via the simple but deep game system   featuring mechanics such as "Throw Back" and "Projectile Bounce Back".

games.name: Seven Doors
games.title: Seven Doors
games.description: Solve challenging puzzles and experience seven different atmospheres. Each one is unique, special and surprising and will test your mind and awaken your wits. Stay alive until you reach the last door, but beware, as some doors could lead to your demise.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO CYBER-LIP
games.title: ACA NEOGEO CYBER-LIP
games.description: CYBER-LIP is an action game released in 1990 by SNK. The state-of-the-art scientific army computer CYBER-LIP has suddenly gone rogue! Use a variety of items and weapons to stop the slaughter of all humanity! In two-player mode, two people can work together to take out the target.

games.name: The Falconeer
games.title: The Falconeer
games.description: The Falconeer is an open-world air combat game, featuring frenetic aerial dogfights and deep exploration of the mysterious open-world of The Great Ursee.

games.name: Sky Rogue
games.title: Sky Rogue
games.description: Sky Rogue is a fwooshy rogue-lite action flight simulator! Blow things up over land, sea, and air, on an infinite number of procedurally-generated islands.

games.name: Chinatown Detective Agency
games.title: Chinatown Detective Agency
games.description: Singapore, 2037. Amira Darma has just opened her own detective agency. Travel the world, solve dangerous cases using real world research and take in the stunning retro design of this cybernoir detective adventure.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO SOCCER BRAWL
games.title: ACA NEOGEO SOCCER BRAWL
games.description: SOCCER BRAWL is a soccer game released by SNK in 1992. Sparks fly as teams representing 8 different countries battle for the championship. Staged in the near future, teams feature 7 robot player instead of the normal 11 players, allowing the defense to also go on the attack and for a variety of arrangements.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO THRASH RALLY
games.title: ACA NEOGEO THRASH RALLY
games.description:
THRASH RALLY is an original racing game released by SNK in 1991. Two game modes "World Rally Championship Mode" and "Rally Mode" are available. Travel through cities and the countryside as you make your way through the courses.
*Game sections requiring use of the connection jack are not included.

games.name: Virtual Families Cook Off: Chapter 1 Let's Go Flippin'
games.title: Virtual Families Cook Off: Chapter 1 Let's Go Flippin'
games.description: Virtual Families Cook Off: Let's Go Flippin' is a new way to play! Now a premium experience with no micro transactions to buy!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO 3 COUNT BOUT
games.title: ACA NEOGEO 3 COUNT BOUT
games.description: 3 COUNT BOUT is a pro-wrestling game released by SNK in 1993. Aim to become the world's strongest wrestler, and take the champion's throne for yourself! Chock full of the elements of pro-wrestling, including strike exchanges and aerial assaults, dash moves, even illegal moves! Enjoy interesting matches including electricity matches, street matches, and more.

games.name: Tin Hearts
games.title: Tin Hearts
games.description: Behind every brilliant invention, hides an incredible story. Guide a troop of tin soldiers through a magical toy-filled world, in this immersive puzzle adventure game from members of the team that brought you Fable.

games.name: Trinity Fusion
games.title: Trinity Fusion
games.description: Explore dark, sci-fi worlds and engage in fast-paced and precise combat in Trinity Fusion - a Rogue-Lite action platformer set in a sprawling, doomed multiverse.

games.name: Your Computer Might Be At Risk
games.title: Your Computer Might Be At Risk
games.description: Your Computer Might Be At Risk is a first-person narrative puzzle game. Locked up in a room after a mysterious car accident, you must figure out how to escape while surviving dangerous trials and solving dozens of puzzles. Narrated in parallel, twenty years later your son unravels the story of your mysterious vanishing.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO THE LAST BLADE
games.title: ACA NEOGEO THE LAST BLADE
games.description:
“THE LAST BLADE” is a fighting game released by SNK in 1997, set in Japan’s Edo period with a roster of unique swordsmen to choose from.
Thematically the game is similar to the “SAMURAI SHODOWN" series, but also features a wealth of innovative systems to set it apart. One such system is the ability to choose between “Power” and “Speed” styles when selecting a character. The “Power” system focuses on high damage while the “Speed” system focuses more on intricate combos and speed.

games.name: Tiny Witch
games.title: Tiny Witch
games.description: Run a witch shop! Brew minions, beat the clock, and keep clients happy.

games.name: Novel Rogue
games.title: Novel Rogue
games.description: Turn the page and shape destiny in a card deck-building roguelite JRPG!

games.name: 15in1 Solitaire
games.title: 15in1 Solitaire
games.description: Biggest Solitaire combo - can you beat all the game modes?

games.name: Kittens and Yarn
games.title: Kittens and Yarn
games.description: Lots of cuteness and mess! That's exactly what you get for having several kittens at home.

games.name: Adios
games.title: Adios
games.description: A pig farmer decides he no longer wants to dispose of bodies for the mob. What follows is a discussion between you, and the hitman who will have to kill you if he can't convince you to stay.

games.name: Old Man's Journey
games.title: Old Man's Journey
games.description: A heartfelt game about life, loss and hope.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO LAST RESORT
games.title: ACA NEOGEO LAST RESORT
games.description:
“LAST RESORT” is a shoot ‘em up game released by SNK in 1992.
Players can use weapons such as laser, homing, or grenades which can be powered up as many as three times, along with a "unit" that can nullify enemy bullets and attack foes. Using these abilities and many other attacks players will fight in order to win the war between robots and humanity.

games.name: Tamarin®
games.title: Tamarin®
games.description: Explore, leap and shoot to save your family from the insect invasion! Leap with the agility of a tamarin as you journey into the Northern wilderness, in a world full of exploration, 3D-platforming and bug-splattering action!

games.name: Dosa Divas
games.title: Dosa Divas
games.description: Two sisters and their spirit-mech cook, bond, and fight corpos in a spicy turn-based RPG. Platform through a vibrant world, cook savory meals, fight an evil fast food empire, and restore communities.

games.name: Light-It Up
games.title: Light-It Up
games.description: Swing, jump, flip and slide your stickman body from one neon color shape to another to make them glow and light-it up.

games.name: Vicious Attack Llama Apocalypse
games.title: Vicious Attack Llama Apocalypse
games.description: The world's best mass llama-slaughter roguelike-lite-ish couch co-op top-down twin-stick shooter!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO GHOST PILOTS
games.title: ACA NEOGEO GHOST PILOTS
games.description: GHOST PILOTS is a shooting game released by SNK in 1991. The hero flies an old-fashioned seaplane in order to fight the two powerful nations invading their own country. Alongside giant military weapons, a mysterious combat unit arrives and makes for an intense battle.

games.name: Wizards of Brandel
games.title: Wizards of Brandel
games.description: You wake up and notice... that your house is gone! Retrieve your life back through a new adventure in a fantasy RPG!

games.name: CROSSBOW: Bloodnight
games.title: CROSSBOW: Bloodnight
games.description: Hunt. Die. Hunt again. Master the frantic arena FPS set in a world of horror!

games.name: KEMCO RPG Selection Vol. 2
games.title: KEMCO RPG Selection Vol. 2
games.description: Enjoy 4 fantasy adventures at once!

games.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley
games.title: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley
games.description: Join Snufkin in this story-rich musical adventure about restoring harmony and balance to Moominvalley, home of wonderful and whimsical characters, and protecting it from the industrious Park Keeper.

games.name: Clarity: The Seven Demons of Vanguardia
games.title: Clarity: The Seven Demons of Vanguardia

games.name: ScourgeBringer
games.title: ScourgeBringer
games.description: ScourgeBringer is a fast-paced free-moving roguelite platformer. Help Kyhra to explore the unknown and slash her way through ancient machines guarding the seal of her past, and maybe the redemption of humanity.

games.name: The Strange Story Of Brian Fisher: Chapter 1
games.title: The Strange Story Of Brian Fisher: Chapter 1
games.description: Do you believe in time and space travel? Do you believe that out there is more beautiful and more powerful place than Earth? Dive into the journey and discover Brian Fisher's story about the unknown, about his father disappearance, about his journey through time and space.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO PUZZLED
games.title: ACA NEOGEO PUZZLED
games.description:
PUZZLED is a puzzle game released by SNK in 1990. 
Control Rad‘s airship and Am’sair balloon, and make your way  up through the block-filled Tower of the Sun in order to meet the God of Sun. 
Embark on an exciting adventure that will send you the puzzle skies!

games.name: Archvale
games.title: Archvale
games.description: Take up your weapon in this RPG bullet-hell world and embark on a journey to right wrongs from long ago. Only you can defeat the evil forces of the Undying guardians and reunite the world with the fabled Archvale.

games.name: Sizeable
games.title: Sizeable
games.description: Resize the world and uncover secrets in calm puzzle dioramas.

games.name: Plague Road
games.title: Plague Road
games.description: Rescue survivors, fight monsters and explore a once great city fallen to plague in a dark fantasy game combining turn-based tactical strategy and roguelike elements.

games.name: Heirs of the Kings
games.title: Heirs of the Kings
games.description: A story of destiny for those with the blood of the rulers!

games.name: Hidden Memory - Nature
games.title: Hidden Memory - Nature
games.description: Relax and disconnect in Hidden Memory - Nature. Memorize simple rules, solve puzzles with geometric shapes, and reveal beautiful hand-painted landscapes. A cozy, stress-free journey, perfect for finding peace in nature.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO MUTATION NATION
games.title: ACA NEOGEO MUTATION NATION
games.description:
MUTATION NATION is an action game released by SNK in 1992. 
Humans turned into mutants by the hands of a genius biologist have gone on a rampage. To save their hometown, 
two youths rise up to resist. Battle with courage using full action combos along with 6 special moves.

games.name: Snake Pass
games.title: Snake Pass
games.description: As Noodle the snake, slither, wriggle, curl, coil and climb your way to the top of Haven Tor in this one of a kind physics based, puzzle platform adventure from award winning independent studio Sumo Digital!

games.name: Munchkin: Quacked Quest
games.title: Munchkin: Quacked Quest
games.description: Dive into Munchkin: Quacked Quest and re-discover the parody, puns, and humor from the hit card game Munchkin by Steve Jackson.

games.name: KarmaZoo
games.title: KarmaZoo
games.description: Share the love and die trying! KarmaZoo is a joyful, altruistic, cooperative platformer where up to 10 random players help each other with the unique abilities of 50 different characters - all for the sake of good Karma.

games.name: Somerville
games.title: Somerville
games.description: In the wake of catastrophe you must find the means to make your family whole again. Somerville is a Sci-Fi adventure grounded in the intimate repercussions of large scale conflict.

games.name: Paper io 2: Gold Edition
games.title: Paper io 2: Gold Edition
games.description: Conquer territory solo or beat your friends in multiplayer mode!

games.name: Animus - Stand Alone
games.title: Animus - Stand Alone
games.description: Take on the role of an anonymous warrior — caught out of place and time — on a journey to bring an end to a broken world. Gather your weapons and choose with care: distance, timing, combinations, stamina, and attributes will determine the outcome of battle.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO ROBO ARMY
games.title: ACA NEOGEO ROBO ARMY
games.description:
ROBO ARMY is a beat 'em up action game released by SNK in 1991. 
Head out to crush and destroy your enemies in order to restore peace from under the grasp of the robot corps known as Hell Jeed. 
Collect items to power up and perform a variety of attacks in this exhilarating battle.

games.name: Rally Rock 'N Racing
games.title: Rally Rock 'N Racing
games.description: In Rally Rock 'N Racing, you’ll enjoy a wide variety of natural environments, such as deserts, snow-covered mountains, forests... where you can show your skill at the wheel, competing against everyone to become the fastest. The game has several modes, such as Championship, Time Trial, Arcade, and 4-player multiplayer.

games.name: Napoleon Maiden Episode.1 A maiden without the word impossible
games.title: Napoleon Maiden Episode.1 A maiden without the word impossible
games.description: Doki Doki! Pretty Girl Napoleon!

games.name: Adventures of Bertram Fiddle: Episode 1: A Dreadly Business
games.title: Adventures of Bertram Fiddle: Episode 1: A Dreadly Business
games.description: The Adventures of Bertram Fiddle is a hilarious tongue-in-cheek adventure game.

games.name: Sword of Elpisia
games.title: Sword of Elpisia
games.description: A fantasy RPG about a girl turned into a magic sword and its price!

games.name: LUMINES REMASTERED
games.title: LUMINES REMASTERED
games.description: The critically-acclaimed puzzle game produced by legendary creator Tetsuya Mizuguchi comes to XboxOne. An HD remaster of the original game, LUMINES REMASTERED beautifully marries the elements of sound, light and puzzle-action into one addictive, yet easy-to-play game.

games.name: Chrome Wolf
games.title: Chrome Wolf
games.description: Enjoy tank fights in a tale of fleeting memories and the lives of freedom fighters!

games.name: Mad Experiments: Escape Room
games.title: Mad Experiments: Escape Room
games.description: Award-nominated cross-platform escape game. Alone or with up to 5 players, explore 3 unique rooms, solve mind-bending puzzles, and unravel the dark secrets of the Professor Cheshire and his experiments.

games.name: Magic Twins
games.title: Magic Twins
games.description: Abra and Cadabra only wanted to make their wardrobe stylish but… what the hue? Hordes of elementals have appeared! The Colormageddon is here! Help the Magic Twins mend the damage done in this co-op Tower Defense game full of spooky but kawaii humor!

games.name: The Gardens Between
games.title: The Gardens Between
games.description: Fall into a series of vibrant, dreamlike island gardens with best friends Arina and Frendt. Manipulate time to solve puzzles in this mysterious realm where cause and effect are malleable.

games.name: Beastie Bay DX
games.title: Beastie Bay DX
games.description:
Develop a deserted island
and collect rare monsters!

games.name: CyberTD
games.title: CyberTD
games.description: Mutant viruses threaten the very heart of cyberspace! You'll need the right tactics and the "help" of your support drone to build a deck of terrific upgrades in this innovative deckbuilding tower defense game packed with a roguelite elements!

games.name: Vaporum: Lockdown
games.title: Vaporum: Lockdown
games.description: Grid-based dungeon crawler RPG in an original steampunk setting. Follow the story of a scientist trying to escape a tower, a place of a secret research project gone wrong.

games.name: BROK: The Brawl Bar
games.title: BROK: The Brawl Bar
games.description: A wild party beat 'em up with crazy challenges!

games.name: How to Sing to Open Your Heart Remastered
games.title: How to Sing to Open Your Heart Remastered
games.description: The third game in the romance fantasy visual novel "Story of Eroolia" series.

games.name: Drawngeon: Dungeons of Ink and Paper
games.title: Drawngeon: Dungeons of Ink and Paper
games.description: Inkland - the hand-drawn unusual world. Reveal the secret of the Mysterious Tower in this old-school role-playing game with a first-person perspective, real-time combat and grid-based movement.

games.name: Quisisana
games.title: Quisisana
games.description: Will you survive and uncover the truth?

games.name: Cinemoji Collection
games.title: Cinemoji Collection
games.description: 🎬 Test your movie knowledge! Guess over 500 movies and TV shows using only emojis. Cinemoji Collection includes 4 complete games in one package: The Original, Oscar Edition, Halloween Special, and TV Series. Fun for the whole family! 🍿

games.name: REPLAY BOYS
games.title: REPLAY BOYS
games.description: Band emergency! This was supposed to be Hannah’s day off, but now she’s been roped into managing The Replay Boys, an up-and-coming boy band. Make choices to stoke multi-timeline romances, keep the band from killing each other, and fight a resurrected ’80s pop star ghost. Can you manage?

games.name: Asdivine Dios
games.title: Asdivine Dios
games.description: How far would you go to protect the world of Asdivine? Create a new chapter in a grand fantasy RPG featuring turn-based battles!

games.name: Onigo Hunter
games.title: Onigo Hunter
games.description: What lies beyond the doors to the ruins? Become the best hunter in the world!

games.name: Ping Pong Up
games.title: Ping Pong Up
games.description:
Play face to face with up to 4 friends or against the AI.
What is your longest ping pong streak? Prove it with “Challenge” mode and reach Number 1 on the online ranking. But careful with the bonuses that will appear! Some will help you improve your score but others could end your game.

games.name: Liege Dragon
games.title: Liege Dragon
games.description: Find the Dragon Tools of legend to stand up to the Evil Dragon in a fantasy RPG!

games.name: Silver Screen Story
games.title: Silver Screen Story
games.description:
Movie Studio Management Simulation
Produce blockbusters and earn world-wide fame

games.name: Railway Islands 2
games.title: Railway Islands 2
games.description: Build safe train routes for passengers and packages across cozy and vibrant islands.

games.name: ParkingJam
games.title: ParkingJam
games.description: Can you get your car out of a jammed parking lot? Let's find out!

games.name: Akane
games.title: Akane
games.description:
Akane is a top-down 2D Action game, in which you must eliminate as many enemies as possible before losing. It's a sword fighting game, with lots of blood, violence, and samurai movie clichés. All mixed with the bright colors and futuristic suburban environments of cyberpunk style.

Akane is cornered by a horde of henchmen in the suburbs of Mega Tokyo. Tonight, she will die! But how many enemies will she take with her before the inevitable fate?

games.name: Swordbreaker The Game
games.title: Swordbreaker The Game
games.description: Heroic-fantasy interactive story inspired by the classic “choose your own adventure” books. Make crucial decisions that will lead your path to glorious or fatal outcomes... illustrated by over 300 beautiful images.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO SPIN MASTER
games.title: ACA NEOGEO SPIN MASTER
games.description:
SPIN MASTER is a side-scrolling action game released by Data East in 1993. 
The adventurer Johnny along with his best friend Tom will use a large variety of weapons and attacks in order to retrieve his beloved and the stolen treasure map from the mad scientist Dr. De Playne.

games.name: Pocket Mini Golf 2
games.title: Pocket Mini Golf 2
games.description: Do you want to chill or challenge your skills?

games.name: Journey to Kreisia
games.title: Journey to Kreisia
games.description: Become the Savior from the outer realm and bring everlasting peace to Kreisia in an epic fantasy RPG!

games.name: Alexandria IV
games.title: Alexandria IV
games.description: Tasked with commanding one of the most challenging sectors of the galaxy, the future of the Alexandria IV space station depends on your diplomatic and strategic capabilities. How far will you go to prevent a war? A space opera visual novel by J.M. Beraldo.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO ZED BLADE
games.title: ACA NEOGEO ZED BLADE
games.description:
ZED BLADE is a horizontal-scrolling shoot 'em up released by NMK in 1994. 
With the ability to select aircraft weaponry, you can battle in a way that fits your play style. 
Join Operation Ragnarok to destroy the giant runaway fortress Yggdrasil.

games.name: INK ENIGMA: Hidden Object Challenges
games.title: INK ENIGMA: Hidden Object Challenges
games.description: A nostalgic hidden‑object experience shaped by ’90s/2000s print puzzles. Circle each find with that satisfying marker “shhkk,” tick the list with a paper‑flip, and relax through  35+  warmly illustrated pages.

games.name: Summer in Mara
games.title: Summer in Mara
games.description: Be Koa, a little adventurer eager to explore her world!

games.name: Thirsty Suitors
games.title: Thirsty Suitors
games.description: From Outerloop Games, Thirsty Suitors is a stylish, story-driven adventure that unfolds through turn-based battles, skateboarding, and cooking. Help Jala confront her mistakes, make up with her exes, reconcile cultural differences, and become the person she was meant to be. Easy, right?

games.name: Dragon Pinball
games.title: Dragon Pinball
games.description: Challenge the Dragon and free the Kingdom!

games.name: Double Kick Heroes
games.title: Double Kick Heroes
games.description:
Double Kick Heroes mixes a shoot'em up with a rhythm game. 
You must survive on the highway to hell by killing monsters with your gundillac. 
Only the power of Metal can save your band!

games.name: My Horse Stories
games.title: My Horse Stories
games.description: Get ready to make unforgettable memories and experience the beauty of the countryside like never before!

games.name: Last Stop
games.title: Last Stop
games.description: Last Stop is a single-player third-person adventure set in present day London, where you play as three separate characters whose worlds collide in the midst of a supernatural crisis. An anthology drama, Last Stop is three stories in one.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO STAKES WINNER 2
games.title: ACA NEOGEO STAKES WINNER 2
games.description:
STAKES WINNER 2 is a horse racing action game released by SNK in 1996.
Choose your favorite of 12 horses and grasp victory in heated races!
Control your horse like never before! Be wary, as jockeys who break the rules may be punished!!
Make use of the controls, items and training systems to completely dominate the GI Races.

games.name: Color Water Sort
games.title: Color Water Sort
games.description: It's time to show how smart you are! Test your puzzle-solving skills in this water sorting game!

games.name: The Mildew Children
games.title: The Mildew Children
games.description: Featuring a blend of 2D adventure and visual novel, a grim tale about a village inhabited only by children who follow savage pagan traditions. A young witch named Kyrphel, along with her sisters, are bound to perform a macabre Ritual in order to save their village.

games.name: Spot Challenge Vol. 1
games.title: Spot Challenge Vol. 1
games.description: Spot Challenge is a game series inspired by 'Find the Differences,' where you compare two images and spot over 360 differences across 35 levels. Play solo or with friends and family—test your attention to detail in this fun challenge!

games.name: Endless Memories
games.title: Endless Memories
games.description: Join Rem on his journey through the dream world, inside the Laboratory of Dreams. Battle your way through an interconnected world where all minds are connected. Master many types of weapons and magic spells, solve the mysteries of the dreamers, and try to escape the Laboratory of Dreams.

games.name: Mechaconda
games.title: Mechaconda
games.description: Survive hordes of monsters and bosses while attaching weapons to your Mechaconda's body. A modern and intense reimagining of the classic Snake game with bullet hell and roguelike elements.

games.name: OBLITACRATER
games.title: OBLITACRATER
games.description: Dive into an action-packed shoot 'em up where every drop onto the planet could be your last. Fight through endless waves of increasingly deadly alien monsters while collecting powerful upgrades to aid you in battle. You can escape at any time, but beware — death resets your score to zero!

games.name: Alter Age
games.title: Alter Age
games.description: Alter between ages and adventure out in a fantastic RPG world!

games.name: Alvastia Chronicles
games.title: Alvastia Chronicles
games.description: RPG with over 100 companions?! Set out on an adventure in a retro-styled world!

games.name: ACA NEOGEO WAKU WAKU 7
games.title: ACA NEOGEO WAKU WAKU 7
games.description:
"WAKU WAKU 7" is a fighting game released by SUNSOFT in 1996.
Players will control characters who have one of 7 WAKU WAKU balls that grant wishes, and gather the remaining balls.
Let's gather power in exciting gauge, and attack all over with a personality-rich technique of each characters!

games.name: Crazy Athletics - Summer Sports and Games
games.title: Crazy Athletics - Summer Sports and Games
games.description: On your marks, get set, go! This is definitely the craziest summer sports game ever! Ten games and many more crazy tasks, with cartoon 4K 2D graphics: 4K@120FPS (Xbox Series X & PC) and 4K@60FPS (Xbox One & PC).

games.name: Genso Chronicles
games.title: Genso Chronicles
games.description: Forge bonds and fight with guardian beasts in this fantasy RPG!

games.name: Potions: A Curious Tale
games.title: Potions: A Curious Tale
games.description: Potions: A Curious Tale is an adventure & crafting game where wit are your greatest weapon and combat is not always the answer. Play as Luna, a young witch who overcomes obstacles with the potions she brews, as she gathers items from enchanted lands and conquers devious puzzles on her quest.

games.name: To The Sky
games.title: To The Sky
games.description: Take on the challenge and take flight in To the Sky!

games.name: BROK: Natal Tail, A New Christmas Special
games.title: BROK: Natal Tail, A New Christmas Special

games.name: Alder's Blood: Definitive Edition
games.title: Alder's Blood: Definitive Edition
games.description: Alder's Blood is a tactical strategy game with stealth-based combat, RPG elements, crafting, resources gathering, and management, exploration, and a rich storyline. Set in a grim world, where mankind killed their God and is facing extinction.

games.name: Diamond Painting ASMR
games.title: Diamond Painting ASMR
games.description: Let your imagination shine as you create stunning art with diamonds!

games.name: Omno
games.title: Omno
games.description: A single-player journey of discovery through an ancient world of wonders. Full of puzzles, secrets and obstacles to overcome, where the power of a lost civilisation will carry you through forests, deserts and tundras - even to the clouds.

games.name: BucketCrusher
games.title: BucketCrusher
games.description: Power up your machine and get caught up in the craze of destruction!

games.name: AMAZE!
games.title: AMAZE!
games.description: This game will AMAZE you!

games.name: God of Light: Remastered
games.title: God of Light: Remastered
games.description: God of Light: Remastered is a definitive version of the original award-winning game played by over 15 million people. The Remastered edition features all-new HD graphics, tailored light-physics controls and a remastered soundtrack by UNKLE.

games.name: Aquapark io
games.title: Aquapark io
games.description: Race with your friends on waterslides and jump into the pool for victory!

games.name: Doodle Devil: 3volution
games.title: Doodle Devil: 3volution
games.description:
The Power of Destruction is in Your Hands!
Embrace Your Dark Side with Doodle Devil!

While Doodle God was busy creating the universe, Doodle Devil was also having some fun. The same addictive, puzzle game play that made Doodle God a hit is back but with an evil twist. 

Discover the seven deadly sins and watch as the world crumbles at your fingertips as you create thousands of dastardly deeds. Combine fire, earth, wind & air to create demons, beasts, zombies... and much more. Being bad has never been so much fun!

games.name: Cinders
games.title: Cinders
games.description:
A mature take on Cinderella that's all about player choices and shaping the famous fairy tale in any way you like. 

Cinders is a witty young woman living with an overbearing stepmother and her two daughters, as if she was reenacting a certain well-known fairy tale. But unlike its protagonist, Cinders is not afraid of taking fate into her own hands. Even if it means breaking the rules...

games.name: Chroma Quaternion
games.title: Chroma Quaternion
games.description: A quest around four kingdoms, colored by the seasons!

games.name: While the Iron's Hot
games.title: While the Iron's Hot
games.description: Reforge a blacksmith’s village on an isle of the land’s finest artisans! Step into the boots of an expert smith for a crafty adventure filled with mystery and charm. Explore the land of Ellian, and prove that a hammer, anvil, and your wits can overcome any challenge.

games.name: TV Studio Story
games.title: TV Studio Story
games.description: Create shows, sign stars, and dominate the airwaves in this TV studio sim.

games.name: Elemental War Clash
games.title: Elemental War Clash
games.description: Tower defense with PvP, roguelite and RPG mechanics and level editor.

games.name: ACA NEOGEO ALPHA MISSION II
games.title: ACA NEOGEO ALPHA MISSION II
games.description:
“ALPHA MISSION II” is a shooting game released by SNK in 1991.
The game is a fan-favorite in the genre, and features unique gameplay allowing players to collect and upgrade armor power-ups and switch them out on the fly.
This second entry in the series adds a wealth of new flashy armor power-ups, expanding on the tactical and exciting gameplay the series is known for.

games.name: Asdivine Menace
games.title: Asdivine Menace
games.description:
Travel the galaxy to bring the truth full circle in an epic fantasy RPG!



A century after the events of Asdivine Dios, peace has finally settled in. That is, until a visitor from another world suddenly shows up proclaiming the entire universe is about to be destroyed. Hearing this, Izayoi sets off in an attempt to reverse this seemingly pronounced fate with a trio of very idiosyncratic spirits as they criss-cross four worlds in search of an answer.

games.name: Once Upon a Jester
games.title: Once Upon a Jester
