games.description: Travel the kingdom as Jester with his best friend Sok to improvise theatre shows and perform on stages far and wide. Sing your hearts out, crack jokes and impress audiences to become the stars of the famous Royal Theatrical Spectacle!

games.name: Figment: Journey Into the Mind
games.title: Figment: Journey Into the Mind
games.description: Figment is an action-adventure game that invites you to explore a unique surreal universe filled with music, humor and multi layered narrative. Join Dusty and his ever-optimistic friend, Piper, on an adventure through the different sides of the mind seeking to restore the courage that's been lost.

games.name: Ghostlore
games.title: Ghostlore
games.description: Ghostlore is an 'Eastpunk' Action-RPG where you fight monsters from Southeast-Asian folklore. Inspired by timeless classic ARPG's such as Diablo 2 and Titan Quest, Ghostlore features a detailed item and character customization system, procedurally generated maps, and authentic 90's retro graphics.

games.name: Spirit Valor
games.title: Spirit Valor
games.description: An exciting spirit-collection RPG where you get stronger with each contract!

games.name: Golden Knight
games.title: Golden Knight
games.description: Defeat the forces of darkness and bring peace back to the kingdom of Valerond in this action-packed mini metroidvania.

games.name: Timespinner
games.title: Timespinner
games.description: Travel back in time to change fate itself, in this beautifully crafted story-driven adventure, inspired by classic 90s action-platformers. Join timekeeper Lunais on her quest for revenge against the empire that killed her family, using time-bending powers to explore a vast, connected world.

games.name: Tacoma
games.title: Tacoma
games.description:
The Venturis Corporation wants their AI back. That's where you come in.

Tacoma is a narrative adventure set aboard a high-tech space station in the year 2088. As you go about your mission, you'll explore every detail of how the station's crew lived and worked, finding the clues that add up to a gripping story of trust, fear, and resolve in the face of disaster.

Tacoma is the next game from the creators of Gone Home, continuing a tradition of detailed, immersive, and powerful storytelling.

games.name: Legend of the Tetrarchs
games.title: Legend of the Tetrarchs
games.description: Free the light of courage to rip through the darkness! A fantasy RPG with turn-based battles and dungeons in beautiful pixel art!

games.name: Shy Cats Hidden Orchestra
games.title: Shy Cats Hidden Orchestra
games.description: Shy Cats Hidden Orchestra is a hidden object game where you need to find musician kittens that are embarrassed to play their music. When you find them, they will play songs for you.

games.name: Seek Hearts
games.title: Seek Hearts
games.description: Set out on an adventure to discover Izen's mysterious origins in a sci-fi RPG!

games.name: Astrune Academy
games.title: Astrune Academy
games.description: A fantasy RPG of a tale of fighting magical girls!

games.name: Pupperazzi
games.title: Pupperazzi
games.description: Who will photograph, pet, and befriend these dogs if you don't? The world NEEDS you in Pupperazzi, the dog photography game!

games.name: Island Farmer
games.title: Island Farmer
games.description: Arrange the farm islands and see your archipelago expand. Just swap the blocks of a 3D jigsaw puzzle.

games.name: 90'' Soccer
games.title: 90'' Soccer
games.description:
Tackle! Dribble! Shot!... and Goal!. But do it fast, because you have only 90 seconds to win!
This soccer game will give you no break.

games.name: Fairy Elements
games.title: Fairy Elements
games.description: What awaits at the end of an adventure that spans over 200 years in a fantasy RPG?

games.name: Werewolf Pinball
games.title: Werewolf Pinball
games.description: Beware of the full moon, the werewolf it's coming for you.

games.name: Crystal Ortha
games.title: Crystal Ortha
games.description: Search the mother lode of legend in a fantasy RPG with immersive pixels!

games.name: Spot The Differences! Party
games.title: Spot The Differences! Party
games.description: The most complete difference game on consoles, in an all-new version with gorgeous 4K graphics! Play solo or with up to 3 friends, and see who is the quickest spotter!

games.name: Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition
games.title: Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition
games.description:
Celebrating its first year of delighting millions of global players, the award-winning and best-selling strategy franchise continues with Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition, putting you at the center of even more epic historical battles that shaped the world. 

Featuring both familiar and innovative new ways to expand your empire, Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition brings an evolved real-time strategy game to the next level with a host of free new content and features including brand-new civilizations, new maps, additional in-game updates and languages, and new masteries, challenges, taunts and cheats – all at an amazing value that packs in more history than ever before!

games.name: Figment 2: Creed Valley
games.title: Figment 2: Creed Valley
games.description: Piano bridges, dancing plants and musical showdowns, ready to dive into The Mind?

games.name: Dandy Ace
games.title: Dandy Ace
games.description: Dandy Ace is an over the top action game that follows this fabulous magician seeking to combine and use his magical cards, fighting and looting his way to defeat the Green-Eyed Illusionist and free himself from a cursed mirror.

games.name: Headliner: NoviNews
games.title: Headliner: NoviNews
games.description: Award-winning adventure where you control national news. Watch the city change day by day and influence lives of 4 main characters. Multiple different endings!

games.name: Spot Stories Vol. 2
games.title: Spot Stories Vol. 2
games.description: Spot Stories Vol. 2 continues the spot-the-difference series with a brand-new collection of scenes where you compare two side-by-side images and try to find everything that changed. With 160 differences spread across 32 levels, can you spot them all? Play solo at your own pace or share the experience in local multiplayer, a rare and special twist for the genre that makes every discovery even more fun and memorable.

games.name: Baspetball
games.title: Baspetball
games.description: When the tutors leave, the house turns into a basketball court, and the ultimate showdown begins: Cats vs. Dogs. Lead the Gray Boss cat team in this turn-based isometric puzzle! Calculate your movements and passes to carry the yarn basketball straight into the hoop. Enjoy a casual and relaxing atmosphere with a complete Undo and Redo system to play at your own pace and make that swish!

games.name: GUNBARICH
games.title: GUNBARICH
games.description:
Shoot and repel enemy bullets!
This brick breaker shooting game is jam-packed with items and surprises.
Now with online rankings!

games.name: Teodoro
games.title: Teodoro
games.description: Dive into the Peaceful Forest with Teodoro, an adorable hand-drawn Sokoban puzzle game! Push blocks, solve puzzles, and reactivate the Flower Altars to restore nature's magic. Enjoy 50 relaxing levels, undo/redo support, customizable color palettes and a soothing soundtrack.

games.name: Time Trap: Hidden Objects Remastered
games.title: Time Trap: Hidden Objects Remastered
games.description: Unravel the mystery of a missing journalist by investigating an apocalyptic zone full of anomalies and dangerous secrets.

games.name: Steve Jackson's Sorcery!
games.title: Steve Jackson's Sorcery!
games.description: An epic fantasy adventure across a world of traps, monsters, and magic, where every decision counts and nothing is as it seems.

games.name: Detective Dotson
games.title: Detective Dotson
games.description: A cozy mystery game about a detective with Bollywood dreams.

games.name: Rail Rescue: Puzzle Lines - Complete Edition
games.title: Rail Rescue: Puzzle Lines - Complete Edition
games.description: Your train crashed! Find your friends and rebuild your home!

games.name: Our Metal Bowl
games.title: Our Metal Bowl
games.description: Explore a broken world. Fight with a silent machine. Solve puzzles that break the rules.

games.name: RunestoneKeeper
games.title: RunestoneKeeper
games.description: Morte from the graveyard and Dellamorey who works in the graveyard has now joined Runestone Keeper as the latest heroes, along with varies antiques and items digged from the graveyard!

games.name: CorpoNation: The Sorting Process
games.title: CorpoNation: The Sorting Process
games.description: Greetings, valued employee. You have been tasked with sorting the Ringo CorpoNation's genetic samples. With the credits that you earn, you can shop, game and pay your bills on time. Rogue workers may try to entice you into betraying your beloved employer, but we know you'll give 110%

games.name: Alphadia Genesis 1 & 2
games.title: Alphadia Genesis 1 & 2
games.description: Experience epic RPG adventures at once! This bundle includes Alphadia Genesis and Alphadia Genesis 2.

games.name: Primal Light
games.title: Primal Light
games.description: Become the mysterious blue creature known as Krog and, dressed in your trusty loincloth, traverse a labyrinth of ladders, levers, traps, and monsters. Defeat bosses and save your village!

games.name: Hamstory
games.title: Hamstory
games.description: Where heartfelt moments meet thrilling challenges

games.name: Knights of Grayfang
games.title: Knights of Grayfang
games.description: Unleash Bloodthirst skills in an epic vampire RPG!

games.name: The Gap
games.title: The Gap
games.description: Driven by a rare neurological affliction plaguing his family, Joshua has to recover his memories by exploring parallel realities through déjà vu. Facing the innermost depths of his past – moments both joyous and painful – seems to be the only way to get his life and family back together.

A 2d action-packed roguelite about a monkey hero protecting the jungle from the rise of a corruptive power.

games.name: Shiny Ski Resort

games.name: SpotCat vs The Cheddar Mafia In Asia

games.name: CometStriker DX

games.name: Twins of the Sun

Adventure shines brightest when family sticks together.
Explore wild lands and uncover secrets on your own or side by side.

games.name: Bob The Brick Breaker
games.title: Bob The Brick Breaker
games.description:
A game inspired by old arcade games, where waves of bricks make the climb to the top increasingly difficult. Adding to the challenge are minions and bosses, who will put us to the test.

Ask your friends for help, playing as a duo, or go head-to-head to see who's the best. If you think you're the best of the bunch, then get ready to prove to the rest of the world that you've got what it takes via the online leaderboards.

Prove you can outlast everyone else and be worthy of the title of brick king.

Let the challenge begin!

games.name: Back to Belt

games.description: are you ready to back to asteroids belt?

games.title: Zeus Quest - The Rebirth of Earth

games.name: Classic Snake Adventures (Cross-Buy)

games.description: A 4K@120FPS/60FPS reboot of the classic retro game snake  introduced in 1997. Remade with gorgeous hand-drawn 2d art and a 3d snake. The snake's mechanics are completely new. This 3d snake can bend, and change size and speed during game-play, something you won’t see in any other snake games. A state of the art game with the retro beloved gameplay of snake 97.

games.name: Arrest of a stone Buddha

games.name: Mind Over Magnet

games.name: Mute Crimson DX

games.name: DREAMOUT
games.title: DREAMOUT

games.name: Hexapoda
games.title: Hexapoda
games.description:
Get ready to fight giant Insects for the future of humanity!
After the last human war, gases were spread through the atmosphere, making it unbreathable.
The richest fled to orbital colonies and the others took refuge underground.

You are a young hothead, hired by a team of scientists left on earth who are looking for a solution to bring humans back to the surface.

Playable from 1 to 4 players (local co-op),
Hexapoda is inspired by Arcade classics.

- 3 Game Modes : Normal , Hard and Manic.
- Unlock 3 Different endings, new features and new items.
- 12 stages.
- 4 futuristic combat aircrafts with their own style of shooting.
- A bestiary composed of giant insects.
- Unlock all the 30 achievements !
- Leaderboards for each game mode.

Powered by an original epic soundtrack composed by the French band of electronic music: Double Dragon.

games.name: Seasons of the Samurai
games.title: Seasons of the Samurai
games.description:
Lead a samurai through a series of puzzles set in the eight provinces of Japan. Control the season and the time of day in order to change the configuration of each level, allowing the samurai a safe passage to the next level.

All puzzles require logic reasoning and good memory skills. New mechanisms appear as you make your way through each prefecture of Japan, increasing the challenge throughout your journey.

The combinations of seasons and times of day create realistic sunlight conditions. Leaves in the trees reflect all four seasons depicting the glowing reds of the maple trees in autumn and the beautiful purple and pink tints of the cherry trees in the spring.

Discover all the pieces of a Japanese painting and earn all the belts all the way to the black belt!

games.name: PictoQuest

games.name: Box Align X

games.name: Little Kite
games.title: Little Kite

games.name: RESIDENT EVIL 7 biohazard

"7" marks a new beginning for survival horror with the “Isolated View” of the visceral new first-person perspective. Powered by the RE Engine, horror reaches incredible heights of immersion as players enter a terrifyingly new world of fear as they fight to survive.
games.publisherName: 株式会社 カプコン

games.description: Sudoku is a puzzle in which you place numbers from 1 to 9 into a 9x9 grid, divided into horizontal and vertical lines and 3x3 blocks, filling up all of the spaces with the numbers. With everything from simple puzzles to super-difficult ones, this game is popular with a wide range of players, from beginners to veterans. Please enjoy this high-quality sudoku game.

games.name: Ruku's Heart Balloon
games.title: Ruku's Heart Balloon
games.description: This puzzle game can be enjoyed by players of all ages. The gentle story is straight out of a picture book with voices, like telling a story to a child. There is also a puzzle mode to enjoy at your leisure.

games.name: DYNABLASTER
games.title: DYNABLASTER
games.description: Having been a blockbuster, DYNABLASTER® is a game for the strategic thinker whose smart tactics will instill fear in his competitors – playing online or local against others or against the computer. In this captivating action game, destroy your enemies with cleverly placed bombs

games.name: Spheroids
games.title: Spheroids

games.name: Fearful Symmetry & the Cursed Prince
games.title: Fearful Symmetry & the Cursed Prince
games.description: Fearful Symmetry is a fun puzzle game with a unique brain-teasing twist. Control multiple characters at the same time; both in different dimensions. It is up to you to move the characters simultaneously in opposite directions to guide them through treacherous puzzles filled with traps.

games.name: Overdriven Reloaded: Special Edition
games.title: Overdriven Reloaded: Special Edition

Overdriven Reloaded: Special Edition 

The HD shoot' em up: vertical, fast & fun ! 
Relive the pleasures of arcade shoot'em ups in plenty of Game-Modes, 
from 1 to 4 Players in Local Co-op. 
Destroy Huge Bosses and dodge thousand of bullets ...
It's time to save the universe one more time !

games.name: Raining Blobs
games.title: Raining Blobs
games.description: Raining Blobs is a challenging, fast-paced arcade puzzle game based around matching falling blocks, featuring adorable anime-style pixelart! Prove that you have what it takes to survive the endless blob rain with up to 16 players!

games.name: TAURONOS

games.name: The Pyraplex

games.name: KAMIKO
games.title: KAMIKO
games.description: Wield your weapon bestowed by the gods, and open the gates between worlds!

games.name: The Long Dark
games.title: The Long Dark
games.description: The Long Dark is a thoughtful, exploration-survival experience that challenges solo players to think for themselves as they explore an expansive frozen wilderness in the aftermath of a geomagnetic disaster. There are no zombies -- only you, the cold, and all the threats Mother Nature can muster.

games.name: Control:Override
games.title: Control:Override
games.description: Control: Override is a puzzle game where you must share control between the environment and yourself. Defy Physics. Solve puzzles . Terminate the rogue AI. And perhaps confront the truth about why it went rogue.

games.title: Petey Pedro unBEETable Adventure
games.description: Help Petey Pedro get back home after falling into a magical world where the SWEETS he chose over a healthy BEET are now his worst nightmare. A colorful 2D platformer inspired by the golden age of classic side-scrolling adventures. Jump, explore, collect coins and hidden treasures, unlock power-ups, battle quirky bosses, and discover secret-filled levels in a fun family-friendly adventure.

games.name: Cherry Tower
games.title: Cherry Tower
games.description: Enter the world of Cherry Tower, a charming 2D pixel platformer that will take you on a sweet adventure unlike any other! Join Cherry on her small adventure climbing tower to return home and maybe even more. Overcome obstacles and traps to achieve your goals.

games.name: Splash Blast Panic
games.title: Splash Blast Panic
games.description: SPLASH BLAST PANIC is a multiplayer competitive party game where you must shoot, ram, dodge and overall bully your opponents outside the screen with a variety of watergun-based weaponry. Inspired by old arcade titles as well as newer competitive party games, ruin all your friendships in a variety of stages.

games.name: Stacky Dash

games.name: Ink & Paper: DoodleCut
games.title: Ink & Paper: DoodleCut

games.name: The Last Rolling Hero
games.title: The Last Rolling Hero
games.description:
In the distant future, toy robots lived on a distant planet.
But there was a terrible danger behind the sweet appearance. Their artificial intelligence was able to combine into a computer of incredible power.
And of course the evil forces wanted to take advantage of this.
Now only you can protect the universe. Take control of a robot defender and don't let the scary happen.

games.name: Sapu
games.title: Sapu
games.description: Help Sapu on this adventure in the middle of the forest to find a cure for his grandfather who was bitten by a poisonous carnivorous plant.

games.name: Neverout
games.title: Neverout
games.description: Neverout is a mysterious puzzle game. It puts you in a small, claustrophobic room that has only one way out, and its unique mechanics allow every wall to become the floor. Watch out for something heavy, giant spikes, or getting electrocuted! It will lock you down in a room and won't let you escape. Will you survive, or ever get out?

games.name: On A Roll 3D
games.title: On A Roll 3D
games.description: On A Roll 3D is a fast-paced 3D platform game. Roll your way through 24 huge levels across six different themes and be prepared to take on spikes, mines, dynamite, conveyor belts, springs, switches, doors, bumpers, lasers, saws, fire, ice, water, electricity, trapdoors and much much more.

games.name: Puzzle by Nikoli W Shikaku
games.title: Puzzle by Nikoli W Shikaku
games.description: "Shikaku" is one of Nikoli's own original casse-tête, with simple rules and a unique feeling of solution. Until you get used to it, you'll tend to solve the casse-tête with guesswork, but the real charm lies in solving them with logic. Once you master the method of solving the casse-tête by gradually stretching squares from the numbers, you'll be able to enjoy "Shikaku" on an even deeper level.

games.name: Guardian of Lore
games.title: Guardian of Lore
games.description: Play as Prince Sayri, and save the memory of ancient civilizations from wicked magic that aims to destroy the stories that contain it.

games.name: Dreamed Away
games.title: Dreamed Away
games.description: Dreamed Away is an emotional action-adventure RPG with psychological horror elements. Play as Théo, a boy lost in a dark, mysterious world. Explore a unique reality, duel against darkness in a unique, fast paced combat system and mind your choices.

games.name: Halo Wars: Definitive Edition (PC)
games.title: Halo Wars: Definitive Edition (PC)
games.description: Halo Wars: Definitive Edition is an enhanced version of the real-time strategy classic, Halo Wars, updated to run natively on Xbox One and Windows 10. Halo Wars: Definitive Edition includes improved graphics, new achievements and all of the DLC created for the landmark strategy game.

games.name: Repentant

games.name: HITMAN World of Assassination

Become Agent 47 in the ultimate spy-thriller adventure across more than 20 locations.

HITMAN World of Assassination brings together the best of HITMAN, HITMAN 2 and HITMAN 3, including the main campaign, contracts mode, escalations, elusive target arcades and HITMAN: Freelancer.

games.name: Hexologic

games.name: ShapeNeon Chaos

games.name: Puff Up

games.name: Puzzle by Nikoli W Heyawake
games.title: Puzzle by Nikoli W Heyawake
games.description: This is a progressive puzzle which you can comfortably enjoy working out using logic. "Heyawake" is a puzzle in which you fill in the spaces according to the rules. It's called "heyawake" ("split rooms") because the face of the board is divided into rooms. This puzzle first appeared in 1992, but a plethora of solutions have been developed, allowing for a very progressive puzzle. Each time you discover a new strategic move, your skills of solution will improve.

games.name: Mirage: Ignis Fatuus
games.title: Mirage: Ignis Fatuus
games.description: Turn your brain into mush in this unique and innovative isometric puzzle!

games.name: Hello Neighbor
games.title: Hello Neighbor
games.description: Hello Neighbor is a stealth horror game about sneaking into your neighbor's house to figure out what horrible secrets he's hiding in the basement. You play against an advanced AI that learns from your every move. Really enjoying climbing through that backyard window? Expect a bear trap there. Sneaking through the front door? There'll be cameras there soon. Trying to escape? The Neighbor will find a shortcut and catch you.

games.name: Birdcakes
games.title: Birdcakes
games.description: Step into a world of flying cupcake weaponry! After a picnic went horribly wrong, Pancake the flying cupcake will try to protect his girlfriend Cherry from hungry flies! Featuring randomly generated levels; colorful 2D art; tight shooting controls; and fluid aerial movement mechanics, you’ll be set for a wacky flight through the kitchen and beyond.

games.name: We Happy Few
games.title: We Happy Few
games.description: Set in a drug-fuelled, retrofuturistic city in an alternative 1960s England, We Happy Few is an action/adventure game in which you hide, fight, and conform your way out of a delusional Joy-obsessed world.

games.name: Puzzle by Nikoli W Kakuro
games.title: Puzzle by Nikoli W Kakuro
games.description: The royal road of pencil puzzles, this puzzle is extremely fun. In "Kakuro", you break down the totaled numbers given as hints to fill in the spaces. Well. We say "break down the numbers", but in Nikoli's Kakuro very little calculations are actually required, with concentration and the power of deduction being the most necessary attributes.

games.name: ASTROSMASH
games.title: ASTROSMASH
games.description: ASTROSMASH® was originally designed for the Intellivision® console in 1981. This reincarnation is much more exciting, more visually appealing, and somewhat more challenging without straying from the game’s original theme and gameplay. The new graphics are phenomenal and the amazing background music adds incredible excitement to this video game classic

games.name: Glitch Hero
games.title: Glitch Hero
games.description: A fatal error has trapped Ada’s father inside Codeland! As young Ada, wield the (virtually) mighty hammer.exe and debug the corrupted virtual world while learning basic coding concepts in an irreverent, fun and thrilling action puzzle adventure!

games.name: Mecho Tales
games.title: Mecho Tales
games.description: An all-new adventure in the world of Mecho Wars! Run and shoot through chaotic platforming levels filled with spikes, bottomless pits and an army of deadly robots. Go it alone or team up with your friends in 4-player local multiplayer. Directed by Luc Bernard.

games.name: Otherwar
games.title: Otherwar
games.developer: Take IT Studio! sp. z o. o.
games.publisher: Take IT Studio! sp. z o. o.
games.developerName: Take IT Studio! sp. z o. o.
games.publisherName: Take IT Studio! sp. z o. o.

games.name: Puzzle by Nikoli W Yajilin
games.title: Puzzle by Nikoli W Yajilin
games.description: Draw lines through the centers of cells to make a loop, and paint cells black in this original Nikoli puzzle. It's immensely satisfying to see how the lines and black cells all come together to form a solution, and figuring out how to draw the loop isn't as easy as it might seem.

games.name: ElecHead
games.title: ElecHead
games.description: spark of inspiration pazzle platformer

games.name: Puzzle by Nikoli W Hitori
games.title: Puzzle by Nikoli W Hitori
games.description: "Hitori" is a puzzle in which you fill in any unnecessary numbers, making sure that the same number doesn't appear twice in the same line. Once you get the hang of it, you can feel the joy of figuring out the many various gimmicks thought up by the creator. This is a puzzle for real connoisseurs.

games.name: Puzzle by Nikoli W Hashiwokakero
games.title: Puzzle by Nikoli W Hashiwokakero
games.description: "Hashiwokakero" is a puzzle in which the numbers resemble islands, through which you draw lines resembling bridges. You have to take the entire board into consideration while progressing piece by piece. You do need to pay attention for this puzzle, but it can be solved smoothly and nicely.

games.name: TactiCats
games.title: TactiCats
games.description: Knock down your enemies and collect all the cats and achievements in this pixel art party game for true cat lovers. Use different power-ups and survive the dangerous traps to show your friends who's the fluffiest of them all!

games.name: Puzzle by Nikoli W Akari
games.title: Puzzle by Nikoli W Akari
games.description: This famous and easily understandable puzzle was created in 2001. "Akari" is a puzzle in which you set lights based on the hint numbers in order to light up the entirety of the white space. The main features of "Akari" are the easy to understand rules, and the depth of the game. There are great numbers of patterns for which you will figure out "When the numbers and lights and spaces are combined like this, then THIS is how they are sure to match up", so you have plenty of opportunities to taste "the excitement of discovering new patterns".

games.name: Puzzle by Nikoli W Numberlink
games.title: Puzzle by Nikoli W Numberlink
games.description: Numberlink is a puzzle where you connect the same numbers without crossing lines. Trust your instinct and get connecting! Keep in mind that the longer the distance, the harder it gets.

games.name: Puzzle by Nikoli W Slitherlink
games.title: Puzzle by Nikoli W Slitherlink
games.description: In this - one of Nikoli's most awesome original puzzles - you connect the dots to make a single ring. "Slitherlink" is a puzzle in which you connect dots with a line according to the rules. The greatest attraction is the fact that there exist an unlimited number of set sequences known as "theorems". With this puzzle, you can actually feel your own skill level rising with each theorem you learn.

games.name: Puzzle by Nikoli W Masyu
games.title: Puzzle by Nikoli W Masyu
games.description: You won't use any letters or numbers in this original puzzle - the only hints are black circles and white circles. "Masyu" is a puzzle in which you draw a line through the spaces according to the rules. Learn the attributes of the black and white circles and you'll be able to play in no time. The patterns through which lines can be drawn are more numerous than you can imagine, and discovering tactical moves is also fun.

games.name: Puzzle by Nikoli W Nurikabe
games.title: Puzzle by Nikoli W Nurikabe
games.description: In this super popular puzzle, black spaces and white spaces slowly come together to show their true form. "Nurikabe" is a puzzle in which you refer to the arranged numbers to fill in all of the spaces. It's popular with a wide range of players, from beginners to experts. It feels great watching the black spaces stretch out like a soft-bodied animal.

games.name: HITMAN World of Assassination Part One
games.title: HITMAN World of Assassination Part One
games.description: Step into the shoes of Agent 47 and explore the six iconic locations from HITMAN (2016) in Part One of HITMAN World of Assassination.

games.name: We Happy Few Deluxe Edition
games.title: We Happy Few Deluxe Edition
games.description: Set in a drug-fuelled, retrofuturistic city in an alternative 1960s England, We Happy Few is an action/adventure game in which you hide, fight, and conform your way out of a delusional Joy-obsessed world.

games.name: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United Digital Deluxe Version
games.title: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United Digital Deluxe Version
games.description: Experience a full remake of Romancing SaGa 3, featuring fully realized 3D graphics, refined gameplay systems, new musical arrangements, voice acting, and more. Choose from eight different protagonists and embark on a turn-based RPG adventure as you uncover the fate of the Child of Destiny.

Choose from eight different protagonists and embark on a turn-based RPG adventure as you uncover the fate of the Child of Destiny.

games.name: Bluey's Happy Snaps: Deluxe Edition
games.title: Bluey's Happy Snaps: Deluxe Edition
games.description:
Explore Bluey's world like never before!
Play, explore, and capture moments with Bluey and Bingo in this photo-powered adventure across familiar spots from the show. Snap memories solo or side-by-side with a second player, discover Australian wildlife, and turn in-game moments into real fun for real life.
